File Summary

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: playwright.config.ts, package.json, src/hooks*, src/lib/**, src/routes/**, tests/**
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: **/.env*, **/node_modules/**, **/.svelte-kit/**, **/playwright-report/**, **/test-results/**, repomix*
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

<script lang="ts">
    import { fade } from 'svelte/transition';

    const CORE_TABLES = [
        'user_command_centers',
        'yield_reservoirs',
        'worker_profiles',
        'network_blocks',
        'liquidity_providers',
        'silo_staking_positions',
        'l1_payout_queue',
        'idempotent_payout_batches',
        'fiat_onramp_orders',
        'fiat_payout_queue',
        'fiat_bank_rails',
        'tax_ledger_events',
        'hifo_tax_lots',
        'hifo_disposal_matches',
        'rwa_oracle_feeds',
        'client_cold_vault_registry',
        'treasury_airlock_sweeps',
        'forge_monetary_policies',
        'forge_mineable_vaults',
        'forge_vesting_schedules',
        'p2p_orders',
        'whitelisted_wallets',
        'entity_kyc'
    ] as const;

    let {
        selectedTable = $bindable('yield_reservoirs'),
        tableRows = [],
        isLoadingTable = false,
        tableSearchFilter = $bindable(''),
        onLoadTable = async (_tableName: string) => {}
    }: {
        selectedTable: string;
        tableRows: any[];
        isLoadingTable: boolean;
        tableSearchFilter: string;
        onLoadTable: (tableName: string) => Promise<void>;
    } = $props();

    let filteredRows = $derived.by(() => {
        const q = tableSearchFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!q) return tableRows;
        return tableRows.filter((row) =>
            JSON.stringify(row).toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
    });

    let columnKeys = $derived.by(() => {
        if (!filteredRows || filteredRows.length === 0) return [];
        const keys = new Set<string>();
        for (const r of filteredRows.slice(0, 10)) {
            if (r && typeof r === 'object') {
                for (const k of Object.keys(r)) keys.add(k);
            }
        }
        return Array.from(keys);
    });

    function formatCellValue(val: any): string {
        if (val === null || val === undefined) return '—';
        if (typeof val === 'object') return JSON.stringify(val);
        return String(val);
    }
</script>

<div
    data-testid="director-db-explorer-tab"
    class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-start"
    in:fade={{ duration: 150 }}
>
    <div class="lg:col-span-3 bg-[#0a0d12] border border-white/10 rounded-[24px] p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 shadow-2xl">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-2.5 px-1">
            <span class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#18C6A5]">
                PostgreSQL Schema
            </span>
            <span class="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                {CORE_TABLES.length} Tables
            </span>
        </div>
        <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 max-h-[540px] overflow-y-auto pr-0.5">
            {#each CORE_TABLES as tbl (tbl)}
                {@const isActive = selectedTable === tbl}
                <button
                    type="button"
                    data-testid="director-table-btn-{tbl}"
                    onclick={() => {
                        selectedTable = tbl;
                        onLoadTable(tbl);
                    }}
                    class="w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-mono font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between border {isActive ? 'bg-[#161d29] text-[#18C6A5] border-[#18C6A5]/45' : 'bg-[#11161f]/60 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white border-white/5'}"
                >
                    <span class="truncate">{tbl}</span>
                    {#if isActive}
                        <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#18C6A5] shrink-0"></span>
                    {/if}
                </button>
            {/each}
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lg:col-span-9 bg-[#0a0d12] border border-white/10 rounded-[24px] p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 shadow-2xl min-h-[580px]">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-white/10 pb-3.5">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#11161f] border border-[#18C6A5]/40 text-xs font-mono font-black text-[#18C6A5]">
                    public.{selectedTable}
                </span>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                    {filteredRows.length} Row{filteredRows.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                    type="text"
                    bind:value={tableSearchFilter}
                    placeholder="Filter rows by wallet, txid, ticker..."
                    class="bg-[#11161f] border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono text-white outline-none w-64"
                />
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onclick={() => onLoadTable(selectedTable)}
                    disabled={isLoadingTable}
                    class="tactile-btn px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-neutral-200 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                >
                    {isLoadingTable ? 'Querying...' : 'Refresh ↻'}
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        {#if isLoadingTable}
            <div class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-mono text-[#18C6A5] animate-pulse uppercase tracking-widest">
                Querying PostgreSQL Table public.{selectedTable}...
            </div>
        {:else if filteredRows.length === 0}
            <div class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-mono text-neutral-500 uppercase tracking-widest border border-dashed border-white/10 rounded-2xl">
                0 matching rows in public.{selectedTable}
            </div>
        {:else}
            <div class="overflow-x-auto max-h-[500px] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl bg-[#11161f]/40">
                <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-[11px] font-mono">
                    <thead class="sticky top-0 bg-[#11161f] border-b border-white/10 z-10">
                        <tr>
                            {#each columnKeys as col (col)}
                                <th class="py-2.5 px-3 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400 whitespace-nowrap">
                                    {col}
                                </th>
                            {/each}
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody class="divide-y divide-white/5">
                        {#each filteredRows as row, rIdx (rIdx)}
                            <tr class="hover:bg-[#161d29]/70 transition-colors">
                                {#each columnKeys as col (col)}
                                    <td class="py-2.5 px-3 text-neutral-200 max-w-[260px] truncate" title={formatCellValue(row[col])}>
                                        {formatCellValue(row[col])}
                                    </td>
                                {/each}
                            </tr>
                        {/each}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        {/if}
    </div>
</div>

            default:
                return [];
        }
    });

    $effect(() => {
        if (assetClass) metadata = {};
    });

    let filesDropped = $state(false);
    let esignComplete = $state(false);
    let fileInputRef = $state<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
    let uploadedFiles = $state<{ name: string; size: number; sha256: string }[]>([]);
    let isHashingFiles = $state(false);
    let assetValuation = $state(1_000_000);
    let tokenSupply = $state(100_000);
    let tokenTicker = $state(DEFAULT_RWA_INDEX_TICKER);
    let rwaRevenueBurnBps = $state(50);
    let pricePerToken = $derived(assetValuation / (tokenSupply || 1));

    function bufferToHex(buffer: ArrayBuffer): string {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
        return Array.from(bytes)
            .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join('');
    }

    async function processComplianceFiles(fileList: FileList | null) {
        if (!fileList || fileList.length === 0) return;
        isHashingFiles = true;
        try {
            const processed: { name: string; size: number; sha256: string }[] = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < fileList.length; i++) {
                const file = fileList[i];
                const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
                const digestBuffer = await window.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', arrayBuffer);
                const hexDigest = bufferToHex(digestBuffer);
                processed.push({
                    name: file.name,
                    size: file.size,
                    sha256: hexDigest
                });
            }
            uploadedFiles = [...uploadedFiles, ...processed];
            if (uploadedFiles.length === 1) {
                complianceAttestationHash = uploadedFiles[0].sha256;
            } else {
                const combinedString = uploadedFiles.map((f) => f.sha256).join(':');
                const combinedBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(combinedString);
                const masterDigest = await window.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', combinedBytes);
                complianceAttestationHash = bufferToHex(masterDigest);
            }
            metadata.complianceSha256 = complianceAttestationHash;
            filesDropped = true;
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to compute SHA-256 digest for compliance files:', err);
        } finally {
            isHashingFiles = false;
        }
    }

    async function generateSelfAttestedComplianceDigest() {
        if (!browser) return;
        isHashingFiles = true;
        try {
            const canonicalDoc = JSON.stringify({
                assetName: assetName.trim() || 'Sovereign RWA Manifest',
                assetClass: assetClass || 'real_estate',
                metadata,
                issuer: identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign',
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
            const digestBuf = await window.crypto.subtle.digest(
                'SHA-256',
                new TextEncoder().encode(canonicalDoc)
            );
            const hexDigest = bufferToHex(digestBuf);
            complianceAttestationHash = hexDigest;
            metadata.complianceSha256 = hexDigest;
            uploadedFiles = [
                {
                    name: `${(assetName.trim() || 'Sovereign_RWA').replace(/\s+/g, '_')}_Manifest.json`,
                    size: canonicalDoc.length,
                    sha256: hexDigest
                }
            ];
            filesDropped = true;
            esignComplete = true;
        } finally {
            isHashingFiles = false;
        }
    }

    async function handleFileInputChange(e: Event) {
        const target = e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement;
        await processComplianceFiles(target.files);
    }

    async function handleFileDrop(e: DragEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.dataTransfer?.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            await processComplianceFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
        }
    }

    function nextStep() {
        if (currentStep < 4) currentStep++;
    }

    function prevStep() {
        if (currentStep > 1) currentStep--;
    }

    async function triggerIgniteRwaForge() {
        if (!complianceAttestationHash) {
            await generateSelfAttestedComplianceDigest();
        }
        await onExecuteRwaForge({
            assetName,
            assetClass,
            metadata,
            assetValuation,
            tokenSupply,
            tokenTicker,
            pricePerToken,
            complianceAttestationHash,
            rwaRevenueBurnBps
        });
    }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
    import { fade } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { browser } from '$app/environment';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
    import { computePayloadHash } from '$lib/stores/transaction.svelte';

    let {
        isForging = false,
        forgeStatusMessage = '',
        complianceAttestationHash = '',
        onExecuteVprogAnchor = async (_params: {
            resourceId: string;
            programHash: string;
            stateRootHex: string;
            subnetworkId: string;
            covenantRule: string;
            lockTime: number;
            gasLimit: number;
            envelopeJson: string;
        }) => {}
    }: {
        isForging: boolean;
        forgeStatusMessage: string;
        complianceAttestationHash?: string;
        onExecuteVprogAnchor: (params: {
            resourceId: string;
            programHash: string;
            stateRootHex: string;
            subnetworkId: string;
            covenantRule: string;
            lockTime: number;
            gasLimit: number;
            envelopeJson: string;
        }) => Promise<void>;
    } = $props();

    let vprogResourceId = $state('perennia-settlement-vprog-v1');
    let vprogProgramHash = $state(
        'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
    );
    let vprogStateRootHex = $state(
        '8f434346648f6b96df89dda901c5176b10a6d83961dd3c1ac88b59b2dc327aa4'
    );
    let vprogSubnetworkId = $state('0000000000000000000000000000000000000000');
    let vprogCovenantRule = $state<
        | 'SOVEREIGN_STATE_TRANSITION'
        | 'TIMELOCK_ESCROW_COVENANT'
        | 'ZK_STARK_VERIFIER_GATE'
        | 'ATOMIC_BATCH_SETTLEMENT'
    >('SOVEREIGN_STATE_TRANSITION');
    let vprogLockTime = $state(0);
    let vprogGasLimit = $state(0);
    let vprogComputedPayloadHash = $state('');

    function bufferToHex(buffer: ArrayBuffer): string {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
        return Array.from(bytes)
            .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join('');
    }

    function bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
        return Array.from(bytes)
            .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join('');
    }

    function encodeUtf8ToHex(str: string): string {
        return bytesToHex(new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    }

    let vprogEnvelopePreviewJson = $derived.by(() =>
        JSON.stringify({
            p: 'vprog-v1',
            op: 'anchor',
            res: vprogResourceId.trim() || 'perennia-vprog',
            prog: vprogProgramHash.trim().toLowerCase(),
            root: vprogStateRootHex.trim().toLowerCase(),
            cov: vprogCovenantRule,
            lock: Number(vprogLockTime || 0),
            sha256: complianceAttestationHash || undefined
        })
    );

    $effect(() => {
        const payloadHex = encodeUtf8ToHex(vprogEnvelopePreviewJson);
        const hashBytes = computePayloadHash(vprogSubnetworkId, payloadHex);
        vprogComputedPayloadHash = bytesToHex(hashBytes);
    });

    async function computeDeterministicVprogHashes() {
        if (!browser) return;
        const seedMaterial = JSON.stringify({
            resourceId: vprogResourceId.trim(),
            covenantRule: vprogCovenantRule,
            issuer: identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign',
            lockTime: vprogLockTime
        });
        const progDigest = await window.crypto.subtle.digest(
            'SHA-256',
            new TextEncoder().encode(`VPROG_VK:${seedMaterial}`)
        );
        const stateDigest = await window.crypto.subtle.digest(
            'SHA-256',
            new TextEncoder().encode(`VPROG_STATE_ROOT:${seedMaterial}:${Date.now()}`)
        );
        vprogProgramHash = bufferToHex(progDigest);
        vprogStateRootHex = bufferToHex(stateDigest);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge('forge_header_badge', 'VPROG HASHES COMPUTED ✓', '#3B82F6');
    }

    async function handleAnchorSubmit() {
        await onExecuteVprogAnchor({
            resourceId: vprogResourceId.trim(),
            programHash: vprogProgramHash.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^0x/, ''),
            stateRootHex: vprogStateRootHex.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^0x/, ''),
            subnetworkId:
                vprogSubnetworkId.trim() || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000',
            covenantRule: vprogCovenantRule,
            lockTime: Math.max(0, Number(vprogLockTime || 0)),
            gasLimit: Math.max(0, Number(vprogGasLimit || 0)),
            envelopeJson: vprogEnvelopePreviewJson
        });
    }
</script>

export function formatPortTierLabel(
    port: 3332 | 3333 | 3334,
    rawTierLabel: string
): string {
    if (identity.isCorporateAdmin) {
        return rawTierLabel;
    }
    return `PORT :${port}`;
}

export function resolvePortByHashrateTh(hashrateTh: number): {
    port: 3332 | 3333 | 3334;
    tierLabel: 'LOW AUTO-DIFF' | 'MID AUTO-DIFF' | 'HIGH AUTO-DIFF';
} {
    if (hashrateTh > 10.0) {
        return { port: 3334, tierLabel: 'HIGH AUTO-DIFF' };
    }
    if (hashrateTh >= 1.0) {
        return { port: 3333, tierLabel: 'MID AUTO-DIFF' };
    }
    return { port: 3332, tierLabel: 'LOW AUTO-DIFF' };
}

export function matchCatalogSpecForWorker(worker: Worker): KaspaMinerSpec | null {
    const hw = (worker.hardwareType || '').toLowerCase();
    const name = (worker.name || '').toLowerCase();
    for (const spec of [...KASPA_MINER_CATALOG].sort(
        (a, b) => b.model.length - a.model.length
    )) {
        if (
            hw === spec.model.toLowerCase() ||
            hw.includes(spec.model.toLowerCase())
        ) {
            return spec;
        }
    }
    if (hw.includes('iceriverminer-v1.1') || name.includes('ultra')) {
        return KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === 'ks0-ultra') || null;
    }
    if (
        hw.includes('iceriverminer-v7') ||
        name.includes('ks7lite') ||
        name.includes('ks7-lite')
    ) {
        return KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === 'ks7-lite') || null;
    }
    if (name.includes('ks0pro') || name.includes('ks0-pro')) {
        return KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === 'ks0-pro') || null;
    }
    if (name.includes('ks0')) {
        return KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === 'ks0') || null;
    }
    if (name.includes('ks5pro') || name.includes('ks5-pro')) {
        return KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === 'antminer-ks5-pro') || null;
    }
    if (name.includes('ks5m')) {
        return KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === 'ks5m') || null;
    }
    if (name.includes('ks5l')) {
        return KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.find((s) => s.id === 'ks5l') || null;
    }
    return null;
}

export function getWorkerPortTelemetry(worker: Worker): {
    port: 3332 | 3333 | 3334;
    tierLabel: 'LOW AUTO-DIFF' | 'MID AUTO-DIFF' | 'HIGH AUTO-DIFF';
    matchedSpec: KaspaMinerSpec | null;
} {
    const matchedSpec = matchCatalogSpecForWorker(worker);
    if (matchedSpec) {
        return {
            port: matchedSpec.port,
            tierLabel: matchedSpec.tierLabel,
            matchedSpec
        };
    }
    if (worker.hashRate && worker.hashRate > 0) {
        const byLiveHash = resolvePortByHashrateTh(worker.hashRate);
        return { ...byLiveHash, matchedSpec: null };
    }
    const explicitPortMatch = (worker.stratumUrl || '').match(
        /:(3332|3333|3334)$/
    );
    if (explicitPortMatch) {
        const p = Number(explicitPortMatch[1]) as 3332 | 3333 | 3334;
        const tierLabel =
            p === 3334
                ? 'HIGH AUTO-DIFF'
                : p === 3333
                  ? 'MID AUTO-DIFF'
                  : 'LOW AUTO-DIFF';
        return { port: p, tierLabel, matchedSpec: null };
    }
    return { port: 3332, tierLabel: 'LOW AUTO-DIFF', matchedSpec: null };
}

export function getWorkerStratumUrl(worker: Worker): string {
    const { port } = getWorkerPortTelemetry(worker);
    return `stratum+tcp://${STRATUM_HOST}:${port}`;
}

export function formatHardwareName(worker: Worker): string {
    const matched = matchCatalogSpecForWorker(worker);
    if (matched) return matched.model;
    const rawType = worker.hardwareType;
    if (!rawType) return 'Select Miner';
    if (rawType.includes('IceRiverMiner-v1.1')) return 'IceRiver KS0 Ultra';
    if (rawType.includes('IceRiverMiner-v7')) return 'IceRiver KS7 Lite';
    if (rawType.includes('IceRiver'))
        return rawType.replace('IceRiverMiner-', 'IceRiver KS');
    if (rawType.includes('Goldshell'))
        return rawType.replace('GoldshellMiner-', 'Goldshell KS');
    if (
        rawType === 'Awaiting Connection' ||
        rawType === 'Select Miner Type'
    )
        return 'Select Miner';
    return rawType.replace('Miner-', ' ').substring(0, 22);
}

export function toPlantTargetSpec(
    asset: UnifiedAsset,
    weightPct: number
): PlantAssetTarget {
    return {
        ticker: asset.ticker,
        name: asset.name,
        assetClass: asset.assetClass,
        spotPrice: asset.spotPrice,
        theme: asset.theme,
        imgUrl: asset.imgUrl,
        weightPct
    };
}

export function normalizePlantTargets(
    rawList: PlantAssetTarget[]
): PlantAssetTarget[] {
    if (rawList.length <= 1) {
        const first =
            rawList[0] || toPlantTargetSpec(treasury.getAsset('KAS'), 100.0);
        return [{ ...first, weightPct: 100.0 }];
    }
    const kasAsset = treasury.getAsset('KAS');
    const secondary = rawList
        .filter((a) => a.ticker.toUpperCase() !== 'KAS')
        .slice(0, 4);
    if (secondary.length === 0) {
        const usdc = treasury.getAsset('USDC');
        return [
            toPlantTargetSpec(kasAsset, 50.0),
            toPlantTargetSpec(usdc, 50.0)
        ];
    }
    const nSec = secondary.length;
    const rawSecSum = secondary.reduce(
        (s, a) => s + Math.max(0, Number(a.weightPct || 0)),
        0
    );
    let allocatedSec = 0;
    const normalizedSecondary = secondary.map((item, idx) => {
        let pct: number;
        if (idx === nSec - 1) {
            pct = Number(Math.max(0.01, 50.0 - allocatedSec).toFixed(2));
        } else if (rawSecSum > 0) {
            pct = Number(
                ((Math.max(0.1, item.weightPct) / rawSecSum) * 50.0).toFixed(2)
            );
        } else {
            pct = Number((50.0 / nSec).toFixed(2));
        }
        allocatedSec += pct;
        return {
            ...item,
            weightPct: pct
        };
    });
    return [toPlantTargetSpec(kasAsset, 50.0), ...normalizedSecondary];
}

export function hydrateSectorTargetAssets(sector: Sector): PlantAssetTarget[] {
    const cfg = sector.settlementConfig;
    if (
        cfg?.targetAssets &&
        Array.isArray(cfg.targetAssets) &&
        cfg.targetAssets.length > 0
    ) {
        return normalizePlantTargets(cfg.targetAssets);
    }
    if (cfg?.plantWeights && Object.keys(cfg.plantWeights).length >= 2) {
        const list: PlantAssetTarget[] = [];
        for (const [tick, w] of Object.entries(cfg.plantWeights)) {
            const assetObj = treasury.getAsset(tick);
            list.push(toPlantTargetSpec(assetObj, Number(w || 0)));
        }
        return normalizePlantTargets(list);
    }
    if (sector.routeMode === 'auto-lp') {
        const secTicker = cfg?.targetAsset?.ticker || 'USDC';
        return normalizePlantTargets([
            toPlantTargetSpec(treasury.getAsset('KAS'), 50.0),
            toPlantTargetSpec(treasury.getAsset(secTicker), 50.0)
        ]);
    }
    const singleTicker = cfg?.targetAsset?.ticker || 'KAS';
    return [toPlantTargetSpec(treasury.getAsset(singleTicker), 100.0)];
}

export function buildSvgPath(
    data: number[],
    width: number,
    height: number,
    groundZero: boolean = true
): string {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return '';
    const validData = data.filter((v) => v !== 0);
    const max = validData.length > 0 ? Math.max(...validData) * 1.2 : 1;
    const min = groundZero
        ? 0
        : validData.length > 0
          ? Math.min(...validData) * 0.95
          : 0;
    const range = max - min || 1;
    return data
        .map((d, i) => {
            const x = (i / Math.max(1, data.length - 1)) * width;
            const y =
                d === 0 ? height : height - ((d - min) / range) * height;
            return `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${x},${y}`;
        })
        .join(' ');
}

    );
    let draftInternalPairsCount = $derived(
        draftSelectedAssets.length >= 2
            ? (draftSelectedAssets.length * (draftSelectedAssets.length - 1)) / 2
            : 0
    );
    let editInternalPairsCount = $derived(
        editSelectedAssets.length >= 2
            ? (editSelectedAssets.length * (editSelectedAssets.length - 1)) / 2
            : 0
    );

    let filteredAssets = $derived(
        treasury.registry.filter((a) => {
            const q = assetSearchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
            const matchesSearch =
                !q ||
                a.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                a.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                a.assetClass.toLowerCase().includes(q);
            if (!matchesSearch) return false;
            if (assetCategoryFilter === 'MINEABLE') {
                return mineableVaultMap.has(a.ticker.toUpperCase());
            }
            if (assetCategoryFilter === 'EQUITIES') {
                return a.assetClass === 'Public Equity';
            }
            if (assetCategoryFilter === 'COMMODITIES') {
                return (
                    a.assetClass === 'Commodity' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'Sovereign Debt'
                );
            }
            if (assetCategoryFilter === 'CRYPTO') {
                return (
                    a.assetClass === 'Native L1' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'Stablecoin' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'Ecosystem' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'DeFi' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'Tokenized Asset'
                );
            }
            return true;
        })
    );

    function handleTokenIconError(e: Event) {
        const target = e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement;
        target.style.display = 'none';
        if (target.nextElementSibling) {
            (target.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement).style.display = 'inline';
        }
    }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
    import { slide } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { browser } from '$app/environment';
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { operations } from '$lib/stores/operations.svelte';
    import type { Worker } from '$lib/stores/type';
    import {
        STRATUM_HOST,
        KASPA_MINER_CATALOG,
        formatPortTierLabel,
        getWorkerPortTelemetry,
        getWorkerStratumUrl,
        formatHardwareName,
        type KaspaMinerSpec
    } from './operationsHelpers';

    let {
        displayedWorkers = [],
        displayHashrate = 0,
        totalShares = 0,
        unallocatedPercentage = 100,
        activeWorkerMenu = $bindable(null),
        activeMinerTypePickerWorkerId = $bindable(null),
        minerTypeSearch = $bindable(''),
        shimmerTargetId = null,
        onTriggerShimmer = (_id: string) => {},
        onSafeDispatch = async (_action: string, _payload: any) => {},
        onOpenSectorModal = () => {}
    }: {
        displayedWorkers: Worker[];
        displayHashrate: number;
        totalShares: number;
        unallocatedPercentage: number;
        activeWorkerMenu: string | null;
        activeMinerTypePickerWorkerId: string | null;
        minerTypeSearch: string;
        shimmerTargetId: string | null;
        onTriggerShimmer: (id: string) => void;
        onSafeDispatch: (action: string, payload: any) => Promise<void>;
        onOpenSectorModal: () => void;
    } = $props();

    let copiedMenuField = $state<string | null>(null);

    function markInlineCopied(key: string) {
        copiedMenuField = key;
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (copiedMenuField === key) copiedMenuField = null;
        }, 1800);
    }

    let filteredMinerCatalog = $derived(
        KASPA_MINER_CATALOG.filter((m) => {
            const q = minerTypeSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!q) return true;
            return (
                m.model.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                m.manufacturer.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                m.displayHashrate.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                String(m.port).includes(q)
            );
        })
    );

    function getWorkerIdentityString(worker: Worker): string {
        const targetAddr =
            identity.isCorporateAdmin &&
            ui.adminModeActive &&
            ui.adminTargetWallet
                ? ui.adminTargetWallet
                : identity.activeAddress;
        const cleanWallet = targetAddr?.replace(/kaspa:/i, '').trim() || '';
        return worker.walletWorker && !worker.walletWorker.includes('pending')
            ? worker.walletWorker
            : `kaspa:${cleanWallet}.${worker.name}`;
    }

    async function createManualWorker() {
        if (!identity.isWalletConnected || !identity.activeAddress) {
            ui.showWalletModal = true;
            return;
        }
        const randomSuffix = Math.random()
            .toString(36)
            .substring(2, 6)
            .toUpperCase();
        const defaultName = `RIG-${randomSuffix}`;
        const cleanWallet = identity.activeAddress
            .replace(/kaspa:/i, '')
            .trim();
        const newWorker: Worker = {
            id: Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase(),
            type: 'physical',
            name: defaultName,
            stratumUrl: `stratum+tcp://${STRATUM_HOST}:3332`,
            walletWorker: `kaspa:${cleanWallet}.${defaultName}`,
            hashRate: 0,
            isOnline: false,
            hardwareType: 'Select Miner Type',
            sharesContributed: 0,
            validShares: 0,
            rejectedShares: 0,
            acceptancePct: 100.0,
            blocksFound: 0
        };
        operations.workers = [...operations.workers, newWorker];
        onTriggerShimmer(`worker_${newWorker.id}`);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            `worker_${newWorker.id}`,
            'WORKER DEPLOYED ✓',
            '#18C6A5'
        );
        await onSafeDispatch('ADD_WORKER', newWorker);
    }

    async function selectWorkerMinerType(worker: Worker, spec: KaspaMinerSpec) {
        const updatedStratumUrl = `stratum+tcp://${STRATUM_HOST}:${spec.port}`;
        const updatedWorker: Worker = {
            ...worker,
            hardwareType: spec.model,
            stratumUrl: updatedStratumUrl
        };
        operations.workers = operations.workers.map((w) =>
            w.id === worker.id ? updatedWorker : w
        );
        activeMinerTypePickerWorkerId = null;
        minerTypeSearch = '';
        onTriggerShimmer(`worker_${worker.id}`);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            `worker_${worker.id}`,
            `${spec.model.toUpperCase()} • :${spec.port} ✓`,
            '#18C6A5'
        );
        await onSafeDispatch('DELETE_WORKER', { id: worker.id });
        await onSafeDispatch('ADD_WORKER', updatedWorker);
    }

    async function renameWorkerAction(worker: Worker) {
        activeWorkerMenu = null;
        activeMinerTypePickerWorkerId = null;
        const newName = prompt('Rename this worker:', worker.name);
        if (newName && newName.trim() !== '' && newName.trim() !== worker.name) {
            const cleanWallet = identity.activeAddress
                ?.replace(/kaspa:/i, '')
                .trim();
            const newWalletWorker = `kaspa:${cleanWallet}.${newName.trim()}`;
            operations.workers = operations.workers.map((w) =>
                w.id === worker.id
                    ? {
                          ...w,
                          name: newName.trim(),
                          walletWorker: newWalletWorker
                      }
                    : w
            );
            onTriggerShimmer(`worker_${worker.id}`);
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                `worker_${worker.id}`,
                'RENAMED ✓',
                '#18C6A5'
            );
            await onSafeDispatch('RENAME_WORKER', {
                id: worker.id,
                name: newName.trim(),
                walletWorker: newWalletWorker
            });
        }
    }

    async function deleteWorkerAction(id: string) {
        activeWorkerMenu = null;
        activeMinerTypePickerWorkerId = null;
        if (
            confirm(
                'Remove this worker? It will reappear if hardware continues hashing.'
            )
        ) {
            operations.workers = operations.workers.filter((w) => w.id !== id);
            await onSafeDispatch('DELETE_WORKER', { id });
        }
    }

    function copyWorkerStratumOnly(worker: Worker) {
        const rawUrl = getWorkerStratumUrl(worker);
        if (browser && navigator.clipboard) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(rawUrl);
        }
        markInlineCopied(`stratum_${worker.id}`);
        onTriggerShimmer(`worker_${worker.id}`);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            `worker_${worker.id}`,
            'STRATUM COPIED ✓',
            '#18C6A5'
        );
    }

    function copyWorkerIdentityOnly(worker: Worker) {
        const walletWorkerString = getWorkerIdentityString(worker);
        if (browser && navigator.clipboard) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(walletWorkerString);
        }
        markInlineCopied(`wallet_${worker.id}`);
        onTriggerShimmer(`worker_${worker.id}`);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            `worker_${worker.id}`,
            'WALLET.WORKER COPIED ✓',
            '#18C6A5'
        );
    }
</script>

    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2.5 mt-2">

                <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-neutral-500 font-bold leading-relaxed">
                    {#if !identity.isWalletConnected}
                        Connect wallet
                    {:else}
                        No hardware provisioned
                    {/if}
                </p>
            </div>
        {/if}

        {#each displayedWorkers as worker (worker.id)}
            {@const workerBadge = ui.microBadges[`worker_${worker.id}`]}
            {@const portTelemetry = getWorkerPortTelemetry(worker)}
            {@const liveStratumUrl = getWorkerStratumUrl(worker)}
            {@const liveWalletWorker = getWorkerIdentityString(worker)}

import { blake2b } from '@noble/hashes/blake2.js';

export const KASPA_UNSPENDABLE_BURN_ADDRESS =
    'kaspa:qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqkx9awp4e';

export const KASPA_CHARSET = 'qpzry9x8gf2tvdw0s3jn54khce6mua7l';
export const KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2PK_SCHNORR = 0x00;
export const KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2PK_ECDSA = 0x01;
export const KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2SH = 0x08;

export interface KasplexProtocolInfo {
    online: boolean;
    feeAddress: string;
    opFeeDeploySompi: bigint;
    opFeeMintSompi: bigint;
    opFeeDeployKas: number;
    opFeeMintKas: number;
    syncedBlockScore?: string;
}

export function hexToBytes(hex: string): Uint8Array {
    const clean = hex.trim().replace(/^0x/i, '');
    if (clean.length % 2 !== 0) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_HEX_LENGTH');
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(clean.length / 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
        bytes[i] = parseInt(clean.substring(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
    }
    return bytes;
}

export function bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    return Array.from(bytes)
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('');
}

export function writeUint16LE(val: number): Uint8Array {
    const arr = new Uint8Array(2);
    new DataView(arr.buffer).setUint16(0, val, true);
    return arr;
}

export function writeUint32LE(val: number): Uint8Array {
    const arr = new Uint8Array(4);
    new DataView(arr.buffer).setUint32(0, val, true);
    return arr;
}

export function writeBigUint64LE(val: bigint): Uint8Array {
    const arr = new Uint8Array(8);
    new DataView(arr.buffer).setBigUint64(0, val, true);
    return arr;
}

export function concatBytes(...arrays: Uint8Array[]): Uint8Array {
    const totalLen = arrays.reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0);
    const res = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const arr of arrays) {
        res.set(arr, offset);
        offset += arr.length;
    }
    return res;
}

export function kaspaPolymod(values: number[]): bigint {
    let c = 1n;
    for (const v of values) {
        const c0 = c >> 35n;
        c = ((c & 0x07ffffffffn) << 5n) ^ BigInt(v);
        if (c0 & 1n) c ^= 0x98f2bc8e61n;
        if (c0 & 2n) c ^= 0x79b76d99e2n;
        if (c0 & 4n) c ^= 0xf33e5fb3c4n;
        if (c0 & 8n) c ^= 0xae2eabe2a8n;
        if (c0 & 16n) c ^= 0x1e4f43e470n;
    }
    return c ^ 1n;
}

export function encodeKaspaBech32mWithVersion(
    versionByte: number,
    payload32: Uint8Array
): string {
    const prefix = 'kaspa';
    const prefixValues = prefix
        .split('')
        .map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 31)
        .concat([0]);
    const payload = [versionByte & 0xff, ...payload32.slice(0, 32)];
    let acc = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    const payload5: number[] = [];
    for (const byte of payload) {
        acc = (acc << 8) | byte;
        bits += 8;
        while (bits >= 5) {
            bits -= 5;
            payload5.push((acc >> bits) & 31);
        }
    }
    if (bits > 0) payload5.push((acc << (5 - bits)) & 31);
    const mod = kaspaPolymod([...prefixValues, ...payload5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
    const checksum = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((i) =>
        Number((mod >> BigInt(5 * (7 - i))) & 31n)
    );
    return (
        prefix +
        ':' +
        [...payload5, ...checksum].map((v) => KASPA_CHARSET[v]).join('')
    );
}

export function encodeKaspaAddressFromPubkeyBytes(pubKeyX: Uint8Array): string {
    return encodeKaspaBech32mWithVersion(KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2PK_SCHNORR, pubKeyX);
}

export function encodeKaspaP2shAddressFromScriptHash(scriptHash32: Uint8Array): string {
    return encodeKaspaBech32mWithVersion(KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2SH, scriptHash32);
}

export function deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress(seedLabel: string): string {
    const digest = new Uint8Array(
        blake2b(new TextEncoder().encode(`PERENNIA_CAP_TABLE:${seedLabel}`), {
            dkLen: 32
        })
    );
    return encodeKaspaAddressFromPubkeyBytes(digest);
}

export function deriveDeterministicKaspaP2shAddress(seedLabel: string): string {
    const digest = new Uint8Array(
        blake2b(
            new TextEncoder().encode(`PERENNIA_SILVERSCRIPT_VAULT:${seedLabel}`),
            { dkLen: 32 }
        )
    );
    return encodeKaspaP2shAddressFromScriptHash(digest);
}

export function validateKaspaBech32mAddress(rawAddress: string): {
    valid: boolean;
    normalized: string;
    version?: number;
    addressType?: 'P2PK' | 'P2SH';
    payloadBytes?: Uint8Array;
    error?: string;
} {
    const trimmed = String(rawAddress || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!trimmed) {
        return { valid: false, normalized: '', error: 'Address is empty.' };
    }
    if (!trimmed.startsWith('kaspa:')) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: trimmed,
            error: 'Mainnet prefix "kaspa:" is required.'
        };
    }
    const parts = trimmed.split(':');
    if (parts.length !== 2) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: trimmed,
            error: 'Malformed Kaspa address separator.'
        };
    }
    const payloadStr = parts[1];
    if (payloadStr.length < 61 || payloadStr.length > 69) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: trimmed,
            error: `Invalid Bech32m payload length (${payloadStr.length}).`
        };
    }
    const payloadWords: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < payloadStr.length; i++) {
        const idx = KASPA_CHARSET.indexOf(payloadStr[i]);
        if (idx === -1) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                error: `Invalid Bech32m character '${payloadStr[i]}' at index ${i}.`
            };
        }
        payloadWords.push(idx);
    }
    const prefixValues = 'kaspa'
        .split('')
        .map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 31)
        .concat([0]);
    const remainder = kaspaPolymod([...prefixValues, ...payloadWords]);
    if (remainder !== 0n) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: trimmed,
            error: 'Bech32m polymod checksum verification failed.'
        };
    }
    const dataWords = payloadWords.slice(0, payloadWords.length - 8);
    const decodedBytes: number[] = [];
    let val = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < dataWords.length; i++) {
        val = (val << 5) | dataWords[i];
        bits += 5;
        while (bits >= 8) {
            bits -= 8;
            decodedBytes.push((val >> bits) & 0xff);
        }
    }
    if (decodedBytes.length < 33) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: trimmed,
            error: 'Decoded Kaspa address payload is shorter than 33 bytes.'
        };
    }
    const version = decodedBytes[0];
    if (
        version !== KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2PK_SCHNORR &&
        version !== KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2PK_ECDSA &&
        version !== KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2SH
    ) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: trimmed,
            error: `Unsupported Kaspa address version byte 0x${version.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}.`
        };
    }
    return {
        valid: true,
        normalized: trimmed,
        version,
        addressType: version === KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2SH ? 'P2SH' : 'P2PK',
        payloadBytes: new Uint8Array(decodedBytes.slice(1, 33))
    };
}

export function decodeAddressToPubkey(address: string): Uint8Array {
    const formatted = address.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith('kaspa:')
        ? address.trim().toLowerCase()
        : `kaspa:${address.trim().toLowerCase()}`;
    const parts = formatted.split(':');
    if (parts.length !== 2) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_ADDRESS_FORMAT');
    const base32 = parts[1];
    if (base32.length < 9) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_ADDRESS_LENGTH');
    const decoded = new Uint8Array(base32.length - 8);
    for (let i = 0; i < base32.length - 8; i++) {
        const val = KASPA_CHARSET.indexOf(base32[i]);
        if (val === -1) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_BASE32_CHAR');
        decoded[i] = val;
    }
    const out: number[] = [];
    let val = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < decoded.length; i++) {
        val = (val << 5) | decoded[i];
        bits += 5;
        while (bits >= 8) {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push((val >> bits) & 0xff);
        }
    }
    return new Uint8Array(out.slice(1, 33));
}

export function decodeAddressToVersionAndHash(address: string): {
    version: number;
    hash32: Uint8Array;
    addressType: 'P2PK' | 'P2SH';
} {
    const formatted = address.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith('kaspa:')
        ? address.trim().toLowerCase()
        : `kaspa:${address.trim().toLowerCase()}`;
    const parts = formatted.split(':');
    if (parts.length !== 2) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_ADDRESS_FORMAT');
    const base32 = parts[1];
    if (base32.length < 9) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_ADDRESS_LENGTH');
    const decoded = new Uint8Array(base32.length - 8);
    for (let i = 0; i < base32.length - 8; i++) {
        const idx = KASPA_CHARSET.indexOf(base32[i]);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_BASE32_CHAR');
        decoded[i] = idx;
    }
    const out: number[] = [];
    let val = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < decoded.length; i++) {
        val = (val << 5) | decoded[i];
        bits += 5;
        while (bits >= 8) {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push((val >> bits) & 0xff);
        }
    }
    if (out.length < 2) throw new Error('ERR_DECODED_PAYLOAD_TOO_SHORT');
    const version = out[0];
    return {
        version,
        hash32: new Uint8Array(out.slice(1, 33)),
        addressType: version === KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2SH ? 'P2SH' : 'P2PK'
    };
}

export function decodeAddressToScript(address: string): string {
    const { version, hash32 } = decodeAddressToVersionAndHash(address);
    const hashHex = bytesToHex(hash32);
    if (version === KASPA_ADDR_VERSION_P2SH) {
        return `a9${hashHex}87`;
    }
    return `20${hashHex}ac`;
}

export async function resolveKasplexProtocolInfo(): Promise<KasplexProtocolInfo> {
    try {
        const res = await fetch('https://api.kasplex.org/v1/info', {
            headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000)
        });
        if (res.ok) {
            const data = await res.json();
            const result = data?.result || data || {};
            const feeAddress = String(result.fee_address || result.feeAddress || '').trim();
            const deploySompiRaw = String(result.op_fee_deploy || '100000000000').replace(
                /\D/g,
                ''
            );
            const mintSompiRaw = String(result.op_fee_mint || '100000000').replace(/\D/g, '');
            const opFeeDeploySompi = deploySompiRaw ? BigInt(deploySompiRaw) : 100_000_000_000n;
            const opFeeMintSompi = mintSompiRaw ? BigInt(mintSompiRaw) : 100_000_000n;
            return {
                online: true,
                feeAddress,
                opFeeDeploySompi,
                opFeeMintSompi,
                opFeeDeployKas: Number(opFeeDeploySompi) / 1e8,
                opFeeMintKas: Number(opFeeMintSompi) / 1e8,
                syncedBlockScore: String(result.block_score || result.daa_score || '')
            };
        }
    } catch {
        // Fallback when public Kasplex info endpoint is unreachable
    }
    return {
        online: false,
        feeAddress: '',
        opFeeDeploySompi: 100_000_000_000n,
        opFeeMintSompi: 100_000_000n,
        opFeeDeployKas: 1000,
        opFeeMintKas: 1
    };
}

export function getChainExplorerTxUrl(assetOrNetwork: string, txHash: string): string {
    const cleanAsset = String(assetOrNetwork || 'KAS')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const cleanTx = String(txHash || '').trim();
    if (!cleanTx) return '#';
    if (EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanAsset]) {
        return `${EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanAsset].explorerTxBase}${cleanTx}`;
    }
    switch (cleanAsset) {
        case 'KAS':
            return `https://kas.fyi/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'BTC':
            return `https://mempool.space/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'SOL':
            return `https://solscan.io/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'XRP':
            return `https://xrpscan.com/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'DOGE':
            return `https://blockchair.com/dogecoin/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'SUI':
            return `https://suiscan.xyz/mainnet/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'TRX':
            return `https://tronscan.org/#/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'ZEC':
            return `https://blockchair.com/zcash/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        default:
            return `https://kas.fyi/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
    }
}

export function getChainExplorerAddressUrl(assetOrNetwork: string, address: string): string {
    const cleanAsset = String(assetOrNetwork || 'KAS')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const cleanAddr = String(address || '').trim();
    if (!cleanAddr || cleanAddr.includes('Awaiting')) return '#';
    if (EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanAsset]) {
        return `${EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanAsset].explorerAddressBase}${cleanAddr}`;
    }
    switch (cleanAsset) {
        case 'KAS':
            return `https://kas.fyi/address/${cleanAddr.startsWith('kaspa:') ? cleanAddr : `kaspa:${cleanAddr}`}`;
        case 'BTC':
            return `https://mempool.space/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'SOL':
            return `https://solscan.io/account/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'XRP':
            return `https://xrpscan.com/account/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'DOGE':
            return `https://blockchair.com/dogecoin/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'SUI':
            return `https://suiscan.xyz/mainnet/account/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'TRX':
            return `https://tronscan.org/#/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'ZEC':
            return `https://blockchair.com/zcash/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        default:
            return `https://kas.fyi/address/${cleanAddr}`;
    }
}

export async function signAndBroadcastNonKaspaL1Transfer(params: {
    cleanAsset: string;
    cleanNetwork: string;
    dest: string;
    amount: number;
    contractAddress?: string;
    decimals?: number;
    keys: SovereignVaultKeys;
}): Promise<{ txId: string; explorerUrl: string }> {
    const { cleanAsset, cleanNetwork, dest, amount } = params;

    if (EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanAsset] || EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanNetwork]) {
        const chainSpec =
            EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanAsset] || EVM_CLIENT_CHAINS[cleanNetwork];
        if (!ethers.isAddress(dest)) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid EVM destination address: ${dest}`);
        }
        const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider(
            chainSpec.rpcUrl,
            chainSpec.chainId
        );
        const evmPrivKey = params.keys.ethereum.privateKey;
        const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(evmPrivKey, provider);
        const tokenContract = params.contractAddress || chainSpec.contractAddress;
        const isErc20 = Boolean(chainSpec.isToken || params.contractAddress);
        let txHash = '';
        if (isErc20 && tokenContract && ethers.isAddress(tokenContract)) {
            const decimals = params.decimals ?? chainSpec.decimals ?? 6;
            const contract = new ethers.Contract(
                tokenContract,
                ERC20_TRANSFER_ABI,
                wallet
            );
            const rawUnits = ethers.parseUnits(amount.toFixed(decimals), decimals);
            const tx = await contract.transfer(dest, rawUnits);
            txHash = String(tx.hash);
        } else {
            const rawWei = ethers.parseEther(amount.toFixed(18));
            const tx = await wallet.sendTransaction({
                to: dest,
                value: rawWei
            });
            txHash = String(tx.hash);
        }
        const explorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl(cleanNetwork, txHash);
        return { txId: txHash, explorerUrl };
    }

    if (cleanAsset === 'SOL' || cleanNetwork === 'SOL') {
        const secretBytes = hexToBytes(params.keys.solana.privateKey);
        const keypair =
            secretBytes.length === 64
                ? SolKeypair.fromSecretKey(secretBytes)
                : SolKeypair.fromSeed(secretBytes.slice(0, 32));
        const toPubkey = new PublicKey(dest);
        const lamports = Math.floor(amount * 1e9);
        if (lamports <= 0) throw new Error('Invalid SOL transfer amount.');
        const connection = new Connection(
            'https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com',
            'confirmed'
        );
        const { blockhash } = await connection.getLatestBlockhash('confirmed');
        const tx = new SolTransaction({
            recentBlockhash: blockhash,
            feePayer: keypair.publicKey
        }).add(
            SystemProgram.transfer({
                fromPubkey: keypair.publicKey,
                toPubkey,
                lamports
            })
        );
        tx.sign(keypair);
        secretBytes.fill(0);
        const sig = await connection.sendRawTransaction(tx.serialize(), {
            skipPreflight: false,
            preflightCommitment: 'confirmed'
        });
        const explorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('SOL', sig);
        return { txId: sig, explorerUrl };
    }

    if (cleanAsset === 'BTC' || cleanNetwork === 'BTC') {
        const privBytes = hexToBytes(params.keys.bitcoin.privateKey);
        const pubKeyCompressed = secp256k1.getPublicKey(privBytes, true);
        const sourceAddr = params.keys.bitcoin.address;
        const p2pkh = bitcoin.payments.p2pkh({
            pubkey: Buffer.from(pubKeyCompressed),
            network: bitcoin.networks.bitcoin
        });
        const p2wpkh = bitcoin.payments.p2wpkh({
            pubkey: Buffer.from(pubKeyCompressed),
            network: bitcoin.networks.bitcoin
        });
        const utxoRes = await fetch(
            `https://mempool.space/api/address/${sourceAddr}/utxo`
        );
        if (!utxoRes.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Failed to query Bitcoin UTXOs from mempool.space (${utxoRes.status}).`
            );
        }
        const utxos = await utxoRes.json();
        if (!Array.isArray(utxos) || utxos.length === 0) {
            throw new Error(`No spendable Bitcoin UTXOs found on ${sourceAddr}.`);
        }
        const targetSats = BigInt(Math.floor(amount * 1e8));
        if (targetSats < 546n) {
            throw new Error('BTC transfer amount is below the 546 satoshi dust limit.');
        }
        const psbt = new bitcoin.Psbt({ network: bitcoin.networks.bitcoin });
        let gatheredSats = 0n;
        const feeSats = 1500n;
        for (const u of utxos) {
            const val = BigInt(u.value || 0);
            if (val <= 0n) continue;
            gatheredSats += val;
            if (sourceAddr.startsWith('bc1') && p2wpkh.output) {
                psbt.addInput({
                    hash: u.txid,
                    index: Number(u.vout),
                    witnessUtxo: {
                        script: p2wpkh.output,
                        value: val
                    }
                });
            } else {
                const rawRes = await fetch(
                    `https://mempool.space/api/tx/${u.txid}/hex`
                );
                const rawHex = (await rawRes.text()).trim();
                psbt.addInput({
                    hash: u.txid,
                    index: Number(u.vout),
                    nonWitnessUtxo: Buffer.from(rawHex, 'hex')
                });
            }
            if (gatheredSats >= targetSats + feeSats) break;
        }
        if (gatheredSats < targetSats + feeSats) {
            throw new Error(
                `Insufficient BTC UTXO balance: required ${targetSats + feeSats} sats, available ${gatheredSats} sats.`
            );
        }
        psbt.addOutput({
            address: dest,
            value: targetSats
        });
        const changeSats = gatheredSats - targetSats - feeSats;
        if (changeSats >= 546n) {
            psbt.addOutput({
                address: sourceAddr || p2pkh.address!,
                value: changeSats
            });
        }
        const signer = {
            publicKey: Buffer.from(pubKeyCompressed),
            sign: (hash: Uint8Array) => {
                const sig = secp256k1.sign(hash, privBytes);
                return Buffer.from(sig.toCompactRawBytes());
            }
        };
        psbt.signAllInputs(signer as any);
        psbt.finalizeAllInputs();
        privBytes.fill(0);
        const rawTxHex = psbt.extractTransaction().toHex();
        const broadcastRes = await fetch('https://mempool.space/api/tx', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' },
            body: rawTxHex
        });
        if (!broadcastRes.ok) {
            const errText = await broadcastRes.text();
            throw new Error(`mempool.space rejected BTC transaction: ${errText}`);
        }
        const txId = (await broadcastRes.text()).trim();
        const explorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('BTC', txId);
        return { txId, explorerUrl };
    }

    if (cleanAsset === 'XRP' || cleanNetwork === 'XRP') {
        const xrpPrivHex = params.keys.xrp.privateKey.replace(/^0x/i, '').toUpperCase();
        const pubBytes = secp256k1.getPublicKey(hexToBytes(xrpPrivHex), true);
        const wallet = new XrplWallet(
            bytesToHex(pubBytes).toUpperCase(),
            xrpPrivHex
        );
        const client = new XrplClient('wss://xrplcluster.com');
        await client.connect();
        try {
            const prepared = await client.autofill({
                TransactionType: 'Payment',
                Account: wallet.classicAddress,
                Amount: xrpToDrops(amount.toFixed(6)),
                Destination: dest
            });
            const signed = wallet.sign(prepared);
            const submitRes = await client.submitAndWait(signed.tx_blob);
            const txHash = signed.hash || (submitRes.result as any)?.hash;
            if (!txHash) {
                throw new Error('XRPL node returned no transaction hash.');
            }
            const explorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('XRP', txHash);
            return { txId: txHash, explorerUrl };
        } finally {
            await client.disconnect().catch(() => {});
        }
    }

    throw new Error(
        `Direct browser-side L1 signing for ${cleanAsset} requires routing through the Sovereign L1 Dispatcher.`
    );
}

const EVM_TICKERS_AND_CHAINS = new Set([
    'ETH',
    'ETHEREUM',
    'USDC',
    'USDT',
    'POL',
    'POLYGON',
    'AVAX',
    'AVALANCHE',

const KASPA_ECOSYSTEM_TICKERS = new Set([
    'KAS',
    'KASPA',
    'SILO',
    'NACHO',
    'BEDRCK',
    'PERX'
]);

function hexToBytes(hex: string): Uint8Array {
    const clean = hex.trim().replace(/^0x/i, '');
    if (clean.length % 2 !== 0 || !/^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/.test(clean)) {
        throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_HEX_STRING');
    }
    const out = new Uint8Array(clean.length / 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
        out[i] = parseInt(clean.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
    }
    return out;
}

export function resolveCanonicalNetworkForTicker(
    assetOrNetwork: string,
    explicitNetwork?: string
): string {
    const cleanNet = String(explicitNetwork || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const cleanAsset = String(assetOrNetwork || 'KAS')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const target = cleanNet && cleanNet !== 'UNKNOWN' ? cleanNet : cleanAsset;

    if (KASPA_ECOSYSTEM_TICKERS.has(target) || KASPA_ECOSYSTEM_TICKERS.has(cleanAsset)) {
        return 'KAS';
    }
    if (target === 'BTC' || target === 'BITCOIN') return 'BTC';
    if (target === 'SOL' || target === 'SOLANA') return 'SOL';
    if (target === 'XRP' || target === 'RIPPLE') return 'XRP';
    if (target === 'DOGE' || target === 'DOGECOIN') return 'DOGE';
    if (target === 'SUI') return 'SUI';
    if (target === 'TRX' || target === 'TRON') return 'TRX';
    if (target === 'ZEC' || target === 'ZCASH') return 'ZEC';
    if (EVM_TICKERS_AND_CHAINS.has(target) || EVM_TICKERS_AND_CHAINS.has(cleanAsset)) {
        if (['POL', 'AVAX', 'ARB', 'BASE'].includes(target)) return target;
        return 'ETH';
    }
    return target || 'KAS';
}

export function validateColdVaultAddressForChain(
    assetOrNetwork: string,
    rawAddress: string,
    explicitNetwork?: string
): MultiChainAddressValidationResult {
    const network = resolveCanonicalNetworkForTicker(assetOrNetwork, explicitNetwork);
    const trimmed = String(rawAddress || '').trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: '',
            network,
            error: 'Address is empty.'
        };
    }

    if (network === 'KAS') {
        const candidate = trimmed.toLowerCase().startsWith('kaspa:')
            ? trimmed.toLowerCase()
            : `kaspa:${trimmed.toLowerCase()}`;
        const check = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(candidate);
        return {
            valid: check.valid,
            normalized: check.normalized,
            network: 'KAS',
            addressType: check.addressType
                ? `Kaspa ${check.addressType}`
                : 'Kaspa L1',
            error: check.error
        };
    }

    if (EVM_TICKERS_AND_CHAINS.has(network)) {
        if (!ethers.isAddress(trimmed)) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network,
                error: `Invalid ${network} EVM address (expected 0x... 40-hex format).`
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: ethers.getAddress(trimmed),
            network,
            addressType: `${network} EVM`
        };
    }

    if (network === 'BTC') {
        const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        const isBech32 = /^bc1[ac-hj-np-z02-9]{25,87}$/.test(lower);
        const isLegacyOrP2sh = /^[13][a-km-zA-HJ-NP-Z1-9]{25,34}$/.test(trimmed);
        if (!isBech32 && !isLegacyOrP2sh) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network: 'BTC',
                error: 'Invalid Bitcoin mainnet address (expected bc1..., 1..., or 3...).'
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: isBech32 ? lower : trimmed,
            network: 'BTC',
            addressType: isBech32 ? 'Bitcoin SegWit/Taproot' : 'Bitcoin Legacy/P2SH'
        };
    }

    if (network === 'SOL') {
        const isSolBase58 = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$/.test(trimmed);
        if (!isSolBase58) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network: 'SOL',
                error: 'Invalid Solana base58 public key.'
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: trimmed,
            network: 'SOL',
            addressType: 'Solana SPL/L1'
        };
    }

    if (network === 'XRP') {
        const isXrpl = /^r[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{24,34}$/.test(trimmed);
        if (!isXrpl) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network: 'XRP',
                error: 'Invalid XRPL classic address (expected r...).'
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: trimmed,
            network: 'XRP',
            addressType: 'XRP Ledger'
        };
    }

    if (network === 'DOGE') {
        const isDoge = /^[DA9][1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{25,34}$/.test(trimmed);
        if (!isDoge) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network: 'DOGE',
                error: 'Invalid Dogecoin mainnet address (expected D...).'
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: trimmed,
            network: 'DOGE',
            addressType: 'Dogecoin L1'
        };
    }

    if (network === 'SUI') {
        const isSui = /^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{60,64}$/.test(trimmed);
        if (!isSui) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network: 'SUI',
                error: 'Invalid Sui address (expected 0x followed by 64 hex chars).'
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: trimmed.toLowerCase(),
            network: 'SUI',
            addressType: 'Sui L1'
        };
    }

    if (network === 'TRX') {
        const isTron = /^T[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{33}$/.test(trimmed);
        if (!isTron) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network: 'TRX',
                error: 'Invalid TRON address (expected T... 34-char Base58).'
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: trimmed,
            network: 'TRX',
            addressType: 'TRON L1'
        };
    }

    if (network === 'ZEC') {
        const isZec = /^(t1|t3|zs1|u1)[a-zA-Z0-9]{25,95}$/.test(trimmed);
        if (!isZec) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                normalized: trimmed,
                network: 'ZEC',
                error: 'Invalid Zcash address (expected t1..., t3..., or shielded address).'
            };
        }
        return {
            valid: true,
            normalized: trimmed,
            network: 'ZEC',
            addressType: 'Zcash L1'
        };
    }

    if (trimmed.length < 12) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            normalized: trimmed,
            network,
            error: `Address is too short for ${network}.`
        };
    }

    return {
        valid: true,
        normalized: trimmed,
        network,
        addressType: `${network} L1`
    };
}

export async function detectHardwareSignerCapabilities(): Promise<HardwareEnvironmentCapabilities> {
    const isBrowser =
        typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof navigator !== 'undefined';
    const webCameraQrSupported = Boolean(
        isBrowser &&
            navigator.mediaDevices &&
            typeof navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia === 'function'
    );
    const barcodeDetectorSupported = Boolean(
        isBrowser && 'BarcodeDetector' in window
    );
    return {
        webCameraQrSupported,
        barcodeDetectorSupported
    };
}

export function parseMultiChainColdVaultQrPayload(
    rawQrString: string,
    expectedAssetOrNetwork = 'KAS',
    explicitNetwork?: string
): ColdVaultCardDescriptor {
    const trimmed = String(rawQrString || '').trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
        throw new Error('QR_PAYLOAD_EMPTY: Scanned QR code contained no data.');
    }

    const targetNetwork = resolveCanonicalNetworkForTicker(
        expectedAssetOrNetwork,
        explicitNetwork
    );

    if (trimmed.startsWith('{') && trimmed.endsWith('}')) {
        let parsed: Record<string, unknown>;
        try {
            parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
        } catch {
            throw new Error(
                'QR_JSON_MALFORMED: Unable to parse JSON cold vault payload.'
            );
        }

        const rawAddr = String(
            parsed.coldDestinationAddress ||
                parsed.coldKaspaAddress ||
                parsed.address ||
                parsed.kaspaAddress ||
                ''
        ).trim();
        const rawPubkey = String(
            parsed.cardPublicKeyHex || parsed.publicKey || parsed.pubkey || ''
        )
            .trim()
            .replace(/^0x/i, '')
            .toLowerCase();
        const label = String(
            parsed.vaultLabel ||
                parsed.cardLabel ||
                parsed.label ||
                'Perennia Cold Vault'
        ).trim();

        let candidateAddress = rawAddr;
        if (
            !candidateAddress &&
            targetNetwork === 'KAS' &&
            (rawPubkey.length === 64 || rawPubkey.length === 66)
        ) {
            const pubBytes = hexToBytes(
                rawPubkey.length === 66 ? rawPubkey.slice(2) : rawPubkey
            );
            candidateAddress = encodeKaspaAddressFromPubkeyBytes(pubBytes);
        }

        const validation = validateColdVaultAddressForChain(
            expectedAssetOrNetwork,
            candidateAddress,
            targetNetwork
        );
        if (!validation.valid) {
            throw new Error(
                `INVALID_COLD_ADDRESS: ${validation.error || 'Address validation failed.'}`
            );
        }

        return {
            coldKaspaAddress: validation.normalized,
            coldDestinationAddress: validation.normalized,
            network: validation.network,
            cardPublicKeyHex: rawPubkey.slice(-64),
            cardLabel: label || 'Perennia Cold Vault',
            signerMode: 'WEB_QR_AIRLOCK',
            cardUidHex: typeof parsed.uid === 'string' ? parsed.uid : undefined
        };
    }

    const strippedUri = trimmed
        .replace(
            /^(kaspa|bitcoin|ethereum|solana|xrpl|dogecoin|sui|tron|zcash):(\/\/)?/i,
            (match) => {
                if (match.toLowerCase().startsWith('kaspa')) return 'kaspa:';
                return '';
            }
        )
        .trim();

    const [addressPart, queryString] = strippedUri.split('?');
    let candidateAddress = addressPart.trim();
    if (targetNetwork !== 'KAS' && candidateAddress.includes('@')) {
        candidateAddress = candidateAddress.split('@')[0].trim();
    }

    let parsedLabel = 'Perennia Cold Vault';
    if (queryString) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(queryString);
        const labelParam = params.get('label') || params.get('message');
        if (labelParam) {
            parsedLabel = labelParam.trim();
        }
    }

    if (targetNetwork === 'KAS' && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(candidateAddress)) {
        const pubBytes = hexToBytes(candidateAddress);
        candidateAddress = encodeKaspaAddressFromPubkeyBytes(pubBytes);
    }

    const validation = validateColdVaultAddressForChain(
        expectedAssetOrNetwork,
        candidateAddress,
        targetNetwork
    );
    if (!validation.valid) {
        throw new Error(
            `INVALID_QR_ADDRESS: ${validation.error || `Scanned QR is not a valid ${targetNetwork} address.`}`
        );
    }

    return {
        coldKaspaAddress: validation.normalized,
        coldDestinationAddress: validation.normalized,
        network: validation.network,
        cardPublicKeyHex: '',
        cardLabel: parsedLabel,
        signerMode: 'WEB_QR_AIRLOCK'
    };
}

export function parseColdVaultQrPayload(rawQrString: string): ColdVaultCardDescriptor {
    return parseMultiChainColdVaultQrPayload(rawQrString, 'KAS', 'KAS');
}

export async function scanVideoFrameForQrPayload(
    videoEl: HTMLVideoElement
): Promise<string | null> {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !videoEl || videoEl.readyState < 2) {
        return null;
    }
    const BarcodeDetectorCtor = (
        window as unknown as { BarcodeDetector?: any }
    ).BarcodeDetector;
    if (!BarcodeDetectorCtor) {
        throw new Error(
            'BARCODE_DETECTOR_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not expose native BarcodeDetector. Paste your Cold Vault address directly.'
        );
    }
    const detector = new BarcodeDetectorCtor({ formats: ['qr_code'] });
    const results = await detector.detect(videoEl);
    if (Array.isArray(results) && results.length > 0 && results[0]?.rawValue) {
        return String(results[0].rawValue).trim();
    }
    return null;
}

export function buildAirgappedFundingQrPayload(params: {
    intent: 'HOT_TO_COLD_OVERFLOW' | 'COLD_TO_HOT_REFILL' | 'AIRGAPPED_PSBT_SIGN';
    sourceAddress: string;
    destinationColdAddress: string;
    amountKas: number;
    sighashHex?: string;
}): AirgappedQrSweepRequest {
    const cleanSource = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(params.sourceAddress);
    const cleanDest = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(params.destinationColdAddress);
    if (!cleanDest.valid) {
        throw new Error(
            `INVALID_COLD_DESTINATION: ${cleanDest.error || 'Cold vault address failed Bech32m checksum.'}`
        );
    }
    const safeKas = Math.max(0, Number(params.amountKas || 0));
    if (safeKas <= 0) {
        throw new Error(
            'INVALID_SWEEP_AMOUNT: Sweep amount must be greater than 0 KAS.'
        );
    }
    const sompi = BigInt(Math.round(safeKas * 1e8)).toString();
    return {
        version: 'perennia-airlock-v1',
        intent: params.intent,
        sourceAddress: cleanSource.valid
            ? cleanSource.normalized
            : params.sourceAddress.trim(),
        destinationColdAddress: cleanDest.normalized,
        amountKas: Number(safeKas.toFixed(4)),
        amountSompi: sompi,
        sighashHex: params.sighashHex,
        createdAtIso: new Date().toISOString()
    };
}

export async function renderAirgappedQrDataUrl(
    payload: AirgappedQrSweepRequest | string
): Promise<string> {
    const serialized =
        typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload);
    return QRCode.toDataURL(serialized, {
        margin: 1,
        width: 240,
        errorCorrectionLevel: 'M',
        color: {
            dark: '#000000',
            light: '#ffffff'
        }
    });
}

export function verifyAirgappedQrSignature(
    response: AirgappedQrSignedResponse
): boolean {
    const pubBytes = hexToBytes(response.signerPubkeyHex);
    const msgBytes = hexToBytes(response.sighashHex);
    const sigBytes = hexToBytes(response.schnorrSignatureHex);
    if (
        pubBytes.length !== 32 ||
        msgBytes.length !== 32 ||
        sigBytes.length !== 64
    ) {
        return false;
    }
    return schnorr.verify(sigBytes, msgBytes, pubBytes);
}

import { blake2b } from '@noble/hashes/blake2.js';
import {

    bytesToHex,
    writeBigUint64LE,
    concatBytes,

    encodeKaspaP2shAddressFromScriptHash,
