// WINDOWS (FRONTEND): C:\Users\send2\perennia-v5\perennia-frontend\tests\e2e\phase1-to-3-verification.spec.ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

async function enterPlatformWorkspace(page: Page) {
    await page.goto('/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });

    const headerSettingsBtn = page.getByTestId('header-settings-btn');
    const enterBtn = page.getByRole('button', {
        name: /Enter Nexus|ENTER|LAUNCH/i
    });

    // Retry clicking "Enter Nexus" until Svelte hydration transitions into the workspace
    await expect(async () => {
        if (await enterBtn.isVisible()) {
            await enterBtn.click();
        }
        await expect(headerSettingsBtn).toBeVisible({ timeout: 2000 });
    }).toPass({ timeout: 15000 });

    // Dismiss Sovereign Matrix Vault modal ("Return to Operations Deck") if open
    const walletDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
    if (await walletDialog.isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
        const closeWalletBtn = walletDialog
            .getByRole('button', {
                name: /Return to Operations Deck|Close|✕/i
            })
            .first();
        await closeWalletBtn.click();
        await expect(walletDialog).toBeHidden();
    }

    // Dismiss initial Tutorial Prompt if open
    const tutorialPrompt = page.getByTestId('tutorial-launch-modal');
    if (await tutorialPrompt.isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
        const skipTutorialBtn = tutorialPrompt
            .getByRole('button', { name: /Skip for Now|✕/i })
            .first();
        await skipTutorialBtn.click();
        await expect(tutorialPrompt).toBeHidden();
    }
}

        expect(checkIds).toContain('bridge_wire_rail');
        expect(checkIds).toContain('changenow_v2_dropship');
    });

    test('3. Settings Modal switches across 8 languages, 9 FX currencies, and launches the 7-Chapter Tour', async ({
        page
    }) => {
        await enterPlatformWorkspace(page);

        await page.getByTestId('header-settings-btn').click();
        const settingsModal = page.getByTestId('settings-modal-card');
        await expect(settingsModal).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('settings-guide-section')).toBeVisible();

        // Switch Language to Spanish (ES) and verify reactive header translation
        await page.getByTestId('settings-locale-btn-ES').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('header-nav-OPERATIONS')).toContainText(
            'OPERACIONES'
        );

        // Switch Language to German (DE) and verify reactive header translation
        await page.getByTestId('settings-locale-btn-DE').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('header-nav-OPERATIONS')).toContainText(
            'BETRIEB'
        );

        // Restore English (EN)
        await page.getByTestId('settings-locale-btn-EN').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('header-nav-OPERATIONS')).toContainText(
            'OPERATIONS'
        );

        // Switch Display Currency to EUR and verify live FX rate badge & Treasury symbol
        await page.getByTestId('settings-currency-btn-EUR').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('settings-fx-rate-badge')).toContainText(
            'EUR'
        );
        await expect(page.getByTestId('header-treasury-btn')).toContainText('€');

        // Restore USD
        await page.getByTestId('settings-currency-btn-USD').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('settings-fx-rate-badge')).toContainText(
            'USD'
        );

        // Launch Interactive Tour directly from Settings Modal
        await page.getByTestId('settings-launch-tour-btn').click();
        const floatingCard = page.getByTestId('tutorial-floating-card');
        await expect(floatingCard).toBeVisible();
        await expect(floatingCard).toContainText('Wallet • Step 1 of 9');

        // Exit Tour cleanly
        await page.getByTestId('tutorial-exit-btn').click();
        await expect(floatingCard).toBeHidden();
    });
});

    darkPoolLpAndOwnerDrawUsd: number;
    perenniaLpCompound60Usd: number;
    liquidClearingReserve40Usd: number;
}

export const ACH_FEE_USD = 0.0;

function roundCents(val: number): number {
    return Math.round(val * 100) / 100;
}

export function calculateGatewayGrossUpCents(params: {
    principalCents: number;
    loyalMinerOrSubscriber?: boolean;
    paymentMethod?: OnrampGatewayMethod;
}): {
    tierName: OnrampProfitTier;
    tierBps: number;
    tierBadgeLabel: string;
    paymentMethod: OnrampGatewayMethod;
    principalCents: number;
    perenniaFeeCents: number;
    targetNetCents: number;
    stripeGatewayFeeCents: number;
    grossChargeCents: number;
    requiresInstitutionalWire: boolean;
    autoDefaultedToAch: boolean;
} {
    const safePrincipalCents = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.round(params.principalCents || 0)
    );
    const isLoyal = Boolean(params.loyalMinerOrSubscriber);

    if (safePrincipalCents >= INSTITUTIONAL_WIRE_THRESHOLD_CENTS) {
        const perenniaFeeCents = Math.max(
            ONRAMP_MIN_FEE_FLOOR_CENTS,
            Math.ceil(
                (safePrincipalCents * INSTITUTIONAL_WIRE_ONRAMP_FEE_BPS) /
                    10_000
            )
        );
        const targetNetCents = safePrincipalCents + perenniaFeeCents;
        return {
            tierName: 'INSTITUTIONAL_WIRE',
            tierBps: INSTITUTIONAL_WIRE_ONRAMP_FEE_BPS,
            tierBadgeLabel:
                '🏛️ Institutional Wire Tier (0.20% Net • $0 Gateway Fee)',
            paymentMethod: 'wire',
            principalCents: safePrincipalCents,
            perenniaFeeCents,
            targetNetCents,
            stripeGatewayFeeCents: 0,
            grossChargeCents: targetNetCents,
            requiresInstitutionalWire: true,
            autoDefaultedToAch: false
        };
    }

    const isProOrMiner =
        safePrincipalCents >= PRO_TIER_THRESHOLD_CENTS || isLoyal;
    const tierName: OnrampProfitTier = isProOrMiner ? 'PRO_MINER' : 'RETAIL';
    const tierBps = isProOrMiner
        ? PRO_MINER_ONRAMP_FEE_BPS
        : RETAIL_ONRAMP_FEE_BPS;
    const tierBadgeLabel = isProOrMiner
        ? isLoyal
            ? '⛏️ Pro & Miner Loyalty Tier (0.35% Net • $2.50 Floor)'
            : '⚡ Pro Volume Tier (0.35% Net • $2.50 Floor)'
        : '🛡️ Retail Tier (0.85% Net • $2.50 Floor)';

    const perenniaFeeCents =
        safePrincipalCents > 0
            ? Math.max(
                  ONRAMP_MIN_FEE_FLOOR_CENTS,
                  Math.ceil((safePrincipalCents * tierBps) / 10_000)
              )
            : 0;
    const targetNetCents = safePrincipalCents + perenniaFeeCents;

    const autoDefaultedToAch =
        safePrincipalCents >= ACH_AUTO_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_CENTS &&
        params.paymentMethod !== 'card';
    const resolvedMethod: OnrampGatewayMethod =
        params.paymentMethod === 'card'
            ? 'card'
            : params.paymentMethod === 'wire'
              ? 'wire'
              : 'ach';

    if (safePrincipalCents <= 0) {
        return {
            tierName,
            tierBps,
            tierBadgeLabel,
            paymentMethod: resolvedMethod,
            principalCents: 0,
            perenniaFeeCents: 0,
            targetNetCents: 0,
            stripeGatewayFeeCents: 0,
            grossChargeCents: 0,
            requiresInstitutionalWire: false,
            autoDefaultedToAch
        };
    }

    let grossChargeCents = targetNetCents;
    if (resolvedMethod === 'card') {
        grossChargeCents = Math.ceil((targetNetCents + 30) / 0.971);
    } else if (resolvedMethod === 'ach') {
        if (safePrincipalCents >= ACH_AUTO_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_CENTS) {
            grossChargeCents = targetNetCents + 500;
        } else {
            const grossedBelowCap = Math.ceil(targetNetCents / 0.992);
            const impliedAchFee = grossedBelowCap - targetNetCents;
            grossChargeCents =
                impliedAchFee > 500 ? targetNetCents + 500 : grossedBelowCap;
        }
    }

    const stripeGatewayFeeCents = Math.max(
        0,
        grossChargeCents - targetNetCents
    );

    return {
        tierName,
        tierBps,
        tierBadgeLabel,
        paymentMethod: resolvedMethod,
        principalCents: safePrincipalCents,
        perenniaFeeCents,
        targetNetCents,
        stripeGatewayFeeCents,
        grossChargeCents,
        requiresInstitutionalWire: false,
        autoDefaultedToAch
    };
}

export function computePostTradeUsdSplit(
    grossUsd: number,
    explicitPerenniaFeeUsd?: number
): PostTradeUsdSplit {
    const safeGross = Math.max(0, grossUsd);
    const wholesaleApiFloatSweepUsd = roundCents(safeGross * 0.485);
    const chronosMinerSettlementUsd = roundCents(safeGross * 0.49);
    const llcTaxAndRailReserveUsd = roundCents(safeGross * 0.007);
    const netProfitAndRatchetUsd =
        explicitPerenniaFeeUsd !== undefined && explicitPerenniaFeeUsd > 0
            ? roundCents(explicitPerenniaFeeUsd)
            : roundCents(
                  Math.max(
                      2.5,
                      safeGross * 0.0035,
                      safeGross -
                          wholesaleApiFloatSweepUsd -
                          chronosMinerSettlementUsd -
                          llcTaxAndRailReserveUsd
                  )
              );
    const perenniaLpCompound60Usd = roundCents(netProfitAndRatchetUsd * 0.6);
    const liquidClearingReserve40Usd = roundCents(
        Math.max(0, netProfitAndRatchetUsd - perenniaLpCompound60Usd)
    );
    return {
        grossInboundUsd: roundCents(safeGross),
        wholesaleApiFloatSweepUsd,
        chronosMinerSettlementUsd,
        llcTaxAndRailReserveUsd,
        netProfitAndRatchetUsd,
        floatRatchetReinvestUsd: perenniaLpCompound60Usd,
        darkPoolLpAndOwnerDrawUsd: liquidClearingReserve40Usd,
        perenniaLpCompound60Usd,
        liquidClearingReserve40Usd
    };
}

export function computeOnrampCostPlusQuote(params: {
    assetTicker: string;
    grossUsd: number;
    spotPriceUsd: number;
    autoStakeSilo?: boolean;
    bundledKasOrSilo?: boolean;
    wholesaleFloorActive?: boolean;
    paymentMethod?: OnrampGatewayMethod;
}): CostPlusQuotePreview {
    const ticker = String(params.assetTicker || 'KAS').trim().toUpperCase();
    const principalUsdInput = Math.max(0, Number(params.grossUsd || 0));
    const principalCents = Math.round(principalUsdInput * 100);
    const liveSpot =
        Number.isFinite(params.spotPriceUsd) && params.spotPriceUsd > 0
            ? params.spotPriceUsd
            : 0;
    const loyalMinerOrSubscriber = Boolean(params.wholesaleFloorActive);

    const grossUp = calculateGatewayGrossUpCents({
        principalCents,
        loyalMinerOrSubscriber,
        paymentMethod: params.paymentMethod
    });

    const protocolFeeFloorPct = Number((grossUp.tierBps / 100).toFixed(2));

    if (principalCents <= 0) {
        return {
            direction: 'ONRAMP',
            assetTicker: ticker,
            tierName: grossUp.tierName,
            tierBadgeLabel: grossUp.tierBadgeLabel,
            tierBps: grossUp.tierBps,
            paymentMethod: grossUp.paymentMethod,
            principalCents: 0,
            perenniaFeeCents: 0,
            targetNetCents: 0,
            stripeGatewayFeeCents: 0,
            grossChargeCents: 0,
            principalUsd: 0,
            perenniaFeeUsd: 0,
            stripeGatewayFeeUsd: 0,
            totalGrossChargeUsd: 0,
            grossUsd: 0,
            hardCostUsd: 0,
            guaranteedProfitUsd: 0,
            feeUsd: 0,
            effectiveFeePct: 0,
            protocolFeeFloorPct,
            minerOrPassDiscountActive: loyalMinerOrSubscriber,
            guestNetUsd: 0,
            estimatedTokens: 0,
            spotPriceUsd: liveSpot,
            competitorFeeUsd: 0,
            competitorNetUsd: 0,
            guestSavingsUsd: 0,
            moonpayFeeUsd: 0,
            coinbaseFeeUsd: 0,
            savingsVsMoonpayUsd: 0,
            savingsVsCoinbaseUsd: 0,
            routingTopology: 'Direct Settlement',
            railLabel: 'ACH Direct Debit ($5.00 Cap)',
            whaleWireFeeWaived: false,
            bundledUsdcFeeWaived: false,
            requiresInstitutionalWire: false,
            autoDefaultedToAch: false,
            circuitBreakerTripped: liveSpot <= 0,
            circuitBreakerReason:
                liveSpot <= 0
                    ? `Live oracle spot price for ${ticker} is offline; failing closed.`
                    : undefined
        };
    }

    const principalUsd = roundCents(grossUp.principalCents / 100);
    const perenniaFeeUsd = roundCents(grossUp.perenniaFeeCents / 100);
    const stripeGatewayFeeUsd = roundCents(
        grossUp.stripeGatewayFeeCents / 100
    );
    const totalGrossChargeUsd = roundCents(grossUp.grossChargeCents / 100);
    const totalFeeUsd = roundCents(perenniaFeeUsd + stripeGatewayFeeUsd);
    const effectiveFeePct =
        principalUsd > 0 ? roundCents((totalFeeUsd / principalUsd) * 100) : 0;

    // MoonPay charges $3.99 ecosystem/base fee + 4.5% on cards (or 3.5% ACH / 1.25% wire)
    const moonpayFeeUsd = roundCents(
        grossUp.paymentMethod === 'card'
            ? 3.99 + principalUsd * 0.045
            : Math.max(
                  3.99,
                  principalUsd *
                      (grossUp.requiresInstitutionalWire ? 0.0125 : 0.035)
              )
    );
    // Coinbase charges $2.99 base spread fee + 3.84% card fee (or 2.49% ACH / 1.0% wire)
    const coinbaseFeeUsd = roundCents(
        grossUp.paymentMethod === 'card'
            ? 2.99 + principalUsd * 0.0384
            : Math.max(
                  2.99,
                  principalUsd *
                      (grossUp.requiresInstitutionalWire ? 0.01 : 0.0249)
              )
    );

    const competitorFeeUsd = Math.max(moonpayFeeUsd, coinbaseFeeUsd);
    const savingsVsMoonpayUsd = roundCents(
        Math.max(0, moonpayFeeUsd - totalFeeUsd)
    );
    const savingsVsCoinbaseUsd = roundCents(
        Math.max(0, coinbaseFeeUsd - totalFeeUsd)
    );
    const guestSavingsUsd = Math.max(savingsVsMoonpayUsd, savingsVsCoinbaseUsd);
    const competitorNetUsd = roundCents(
        Math.max(0, totalGrossChargeUsd - competitorFeeUsd)
    );
    const estimatedTokens = liveSpot > 0 ? principalUsd / liveSpot : 0;

    const isBundled = Boolean(params.autoStakeSilo || params.bundledKasOrSilo);
    const routingTopology = grossUp.requiresInstitutionalWire
        ? `Column N.A. / Mercury Direct Domestic Wire (${MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.routingNumber} / *${MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.accountLast4})`
        : grossUp.paymentMethod === 'card'
          ? `Stripe Card Gross-Up (2.9% + $0.30) → Mercury *${MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.accountLast4} → ${ticker}`
          : `Stripe ACH Gross-Up (0.8% Capped @ $5.00) → Mercury *${MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.accountLast4} → ${ticker}`;

    const railLabel = grossUp.requiresInstitutionalWire
        ? 'Institutional Domestic Wire ($0 Gateway Fee)'
        : grossUp.paymentMethod === 'card'
          ? 'Domestic Card (2.9% + $0.30 Gross-Up)'
          : principalCents >= ACH_AUTO_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_CENTS
            ? 'ACH Direct Debit ($5.00 Flat Cap)'
            : 'ACH Direct Debit (0.8% Gross-Up)';

    let circuitBreakerTripped = false;
    let circuitBreakerReason: string | undefined = undefined;
    if (liveSpot <= 0) {
        circuitBreakerTripped = true;
        circuitBreakerReason = `Live oracle spot price for ${ticker} is offline; failing closed.`;
    } else if (grossUp.perenniaFeeCents < ONRAMP_MIN_FEE_FLOOR_CENTS) {
        circuitBreakerTripped = true;
        circuitBreakerReason = `Net Perennia fee ($${perenniaFeeUsd.toFixed(2)}) fell below the $2.50 minimum floor; failing closed.`;
    }

    return {
        direction: 'ONRAMP',
        assetTicker: ticker,
        tierName: grossUp.tierName,
        tierBadgeLabel: grossUp.tierBadgeLabel,
        tierBps: grossUp.tierBps,
        paymentMethod: grossUp.paymentMethod,
        principalCents: grossUp.principalCents,
        perenniaFeeCents: grossUp.perenniaFeeCents,
        targetNetCents: grossUp.targetNetCents,
        stripeGatewayFeeCents: grossUp.stripeGatewayFeeCents,
        grossChargeCents: grossUp.grossChargeCents,
        principalUsd,
        perenniaFeeUsd,
        stripeGatewayFeeUsd,
        totalGrossChargeUsd,
        grossUsd: totalGrossChargeUsd,
        hardCostUsd: stripeGatewayFeeUsd,
        guaranteedProfitUsd: perenniaFeeUsd,
        feeUsd: totalFeeUsd,
        effectiveFeePct,
        protocolFeeFloorPct,
        minerOrPassDiscountActive:
            loyalMinerOrSubscriber || grossUp.tierName !== 'RETAIL',
        guestNetUsd: principalUsd,
        estimatedTokens,
        spotPriceUsd: liveSpot,
        competitorFeeUsd,
        competitorNetUsd,
        guestSavingsUsd,
        moonpayFeeUsd,
        coinbaseFeeUsd,
        savingsVsMoonpayUsd,
        savingsVsCoinbaseUsd,
        routingTopology,
        railLabel,
        whaleWireFeeWaived: grossUp.requiresInstitutionalWire,
        bundledUsdcFeeWaived: ticker === 'USDC' && isBundled,
        requiresInstitutionalWire: grossUp.requiresInstitutionalWire,
        autoDefaultedToAch: grossUp.autoDefaultedToAch,
        circuitBreakerTripped,
        circuitBreakerReason
    };
}

export function computeOfframpCostPlusQuote(params: {
    assetTicker: string;
    grossUsd: number;
    spotPriceUsd: number;
    payoutMethod?: 'ach' | 'wire' | 'ACH' | 'WIRE';
    wholesaleFloorActive?: boolean;
}): CostPlusQuotePreview {
    const ticker = String(params.assetTicker || 'KAS').trim().toUpperCase();
    const gross = Math.max(0, Number(params.grossUsd || 0));
    const grossCents = Math.round(gross * 100);
    const liveSpot =
        Number.isFinite(params.spotPriceUsd) && params.spotPriceUsd > 0
            ? params.spotPriceUsd
            : 0;
    const wholesaleActive = Boolean(params.wholesaleFloorActive);
    const isInstitutionalWire = grossCents >= INSTITUTIONAL_WIRE_THRESHOLD_CENTS;
    const isProOrMiner =
        grossCents >= PRO_TIER_THRESHOLD_CENTS || wholesaleActive;
    const tierName: OnrampProfitTier = isInstitutionalWire
        ? 'INSTITUTIONAL_WIRE'
        : isProOrMiner
          ? 'PRO_MINER'
          : 'RETAIL';
    const tierBps = isInstitutionalWire
        ? INSTITUTIONAL_WIRE_ONRAMP_FEE_BPS
        : isProOrMiner
          ? PRO_MINER_ONRAMP_FEE_BPS
          : RETAIL_ONRAMP_FEE_BPS;
    const tierBadgeLabel = isInstitutionalWire
        ? '🏛️ Institutional Wire Tier (0.20% Net)'
        : isProOrMiner
          ? '⛏️ Pro & Miner Loyalty Tier (0.35% Net)'
          : '🛡️ Retail Tier (0.85% Net)';
    const protocolFeeFloorPct = Number((tierBps / 100).toFixed(2));

    if (gross <= 0) {
        return {
            direction: 'OFFRAMP',
            assetTicker: ticker,
            tierName,
            tierBadgeLabel,
            tierBps,
            paymentMethod: 'ach',
            principalCents: 0,
            perenniaFeeCents: 0,
            targetNetCents: 0,
            stripeGatewayFeeCents: 0,
            grossChargeCents: 0,
            principalUsd: 0,
            perenniaFeeUsd: 0,
            stripeGatewayFeeUsd: 0,
            totalGrossChargeUsd: 0,
            grossUsd: 0,
            hardCostUsd: 0,
            guaranteedProfitUsd: 0,
            feeUsd: 0,
            effectiveFeePct: 0,
            protocolFeeFloorPct,
            minerOrPassDiscountActive: wholesaleActive,
            guestNetUsd: 0,
            estimatedTokens: 0,
            spotPriceUsd: liveSpot,
            competitorFeeUsd: 0,
            competitorNetUsd: 0,
            guestSavingsUsd: 0,
            moonpayFeeUsd: 0,
            coinbaseFeeUsd: 0,
            savingsVsMoonpayUsd: 0,
            savingsVsCoinbaseUsd: 0,
            routingTopology: 'Direct Bank Payout',
            railLabel: 'Bank ACH Payout',
            whaleWireFeeWaived: false,
            bundledUsdcFeeWaived: false,
            requiresInstitutionalWire: false,
            autoDefaultedToAch: true,
            circuitBreakerTripped: liveSpot <= 0,
            circuitBreakerReason:
                liveSpot <= 0
                    ? `Live oracle spot price for ${ticker} is offline; failing closed.`
                    : undefined
        };
    }

    const isWhaleWire =
        gross >= 2500 ||
        String(params.payoutMethod || '').toUpperCase() === 'WIRE';
    const perenniaFeeCents = Math.max(
        ONRAMP_MIN_FEE_FLOOR_CENTS,
        Math.ceil((grossCents * tierBps) / 10_000)
    );
    const railCostCents = isWhaleWire && gross >= 2500 ? 0 : 25;
    const totalFeeCents = perenniaFeeCents + railCostCents;
    const guaranteedProfitUsd = roundCents(perenniaFeeCents / 100);
    const hardCostUsd = roundCents(railCostCents / 100);
    const feeUsd = roundCents(totalFeeCents / 100);
    const effectiveFeePct = gross > 0 ? roundCents((feeUsd / gross) * 100) : 0;
    const guestNetUsd = roundCents(Math.max(0, gross - feeUsd));

    const moonpayFeeUsd = roundCents(Math.max(3.99, gross * 0.035));
    const coinbaseFeeUsd = roundCents(Math.max(2.99, gross * 0.025));
    const competitorFeeUsd = Math.max(moonpayFeeUsd, coinbaseFeeUsd);
    const competitorNetUsd = roundCents(Math.max(0, gross - competitorFeeUsd));
    const savingsVsMoonpayUsd = roundCents(Math.max(0, moonpayFeeUsd - feeUsd));
    const savingsVsCoinbaseUsd = roundCents(
        Math.max(0, coinbaseFeeUsd - feeUsd)
    );
    const guestSavingsUsd = Math.max(savingsVsMoonpayUsd, savingsVsCoinbaseUsd);
    const estimatedTokens = liveSpot > 0 ? gross / liveSpot : 0;

    let circuitBreakerTripped = false;
    let circuitBreakerReason: string | undefined = undefined;
    if (liveSpot <= 0) {
        circuitBreakerTripped = true;
        circuitBreakerReason = `Live oracle spot price for ${ticker} is offline; failing closed.`;
    } else if (perenniaFeeCents < ONRAMP_MIN_FEE_FLOOR_CENTS) {
        circuitBreakerTripped = true;
        circuitBreakerReason = `Off-ramp profit ($${guaranteedProfitUsd.toFixed(2)}) fell below the $2.50 minimum floor; failing closed.`;
    }

    return {
        direction: 'OFFRAMP',
        assetTicker: ticker,
        tierName,
        tierBadgeLabel,
        tierBps,
        paymentMethod: isWhaleWire ? 'wire' : 'ach',
        principalCents: grossCents,
        perenniaFeeCents,
        targetNetCents: Math.max(0, grossCents - totalFeeCents),
        stripeGatewayFeeCents: railCostCents,
        grossChargeCents: grossCents,
        principalUsd: roundCents(gross),
        perenniaFeeUsd: guaranteedProfitUsd,
        stripeGatewayFeeUsd: hardCostUsd,
        totalGrossChargeUsd: roundCents(gross),
        grossUsd: roundCents(gross),
        hardCostUsd,
        guaranteedProfitUsd,
        feeUsd,
        effectiveFeePct,
        protocolFeeFloorPct,
        minerOrPassDiscountActive: wholesaleActive,
        guestNetUsd,
        estimatedTokens,
        spotPriceUsd: liveSpot,
        competitorFeeUsd,
        competitorNetUsd,
        guestSavingsUsd,
        moonpayFeeUsd,
        coinbaseFeeUsd,
        savingsVsMoonpayUsd,
        savingsVsCoinbaseUsd,
        routingTopology:
            isWhaleWire && gross >= 2500
                ? 'Column N.A. / Mercury Same-Day Wire Settlement'
                : 'Column N.A. / Mercury Direct Bank ACH Settlement',
        railLabel:
            isWhaleWire && gross >= 2500
                ? 'Same-Day Bank Wire'
                : 'Bank ACH Payout',
        whaleWireFeeWaived: isWhaleWire && gross >= 2500,
        bundledUsdcFeeWaived: false,
        requiresInstitutionalWire: isInstitutionalWire,
        autoDefaultedToAch: !isWhaleWire,
        circuitBreakerTripped,
        circuitBreakerReason
    };
}

export function resolveOfframpDepositAddressPreview(
    ticker: string,
    masterTreasuryKasAddress = ''
): {
    address: string;
    routeLabel: string;
    confirmationsRequired: number;
} {
    const clean = String(ticker || 'KAS').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (clean === 'KAS' || clean === 'SILO') {
        return {
            address: masterTreasuryKasAddress.trim(),
            routeLabel: 'Perennia Treasury Settlement Address',
            confirmationsRequired: 10
        };
    }
    if (clean === 'BTC') {
        return {
            address: '',
            routeLabel: 'BTC Settlement Deposit Address',
            confirmationsRequired: 2
        };
    }
    if (clean === 'SOL') {
        return {
            address: '',
            routeLabel: 'SOL Settlement Deposit Address',
            confirmationsRequired: 12
        };
    }
    return {
        address: '',
        routeLabel: `${clean} Settlement Deposit Address`,
        confirmationsRequired: 6
    };
}

export function formatRetailSafeCopy(
    rawText: string | null | undefined
): string {
    const text = String(rawText || '');
    if (!text || identity.isCorporateAdmin) return text;
    return text
        .replace(/Dark Pool/gi, 'Liquidity Pool')
        .replace(/SIGHASH_SINGLE/gi, 'Atomic P2P')
        .replace(/VarDiff/gi, 'Auto-Difficulty');
}

export function evaluateAbaRoutingNumber(raw: string): AbaValidationResult {
    const cleanDigits = String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 9);
    if (cleanDigits.length < 9) {
        return {
            cleanDigits,
            isComplete: false,
            checksumValid: false,
            institutionName: null,
            fedDistrict: null
        };
    }
    const d = cleanDigits.split('').map((c) => parseInt(c, 10));
    const prefix2 = parseInt(cleanDigits.slice(0, 2), 10);
    const validFedPrefix =
        (prefix2 >= 1 && prefix2 <= 12) ||
        (prefix2 >= 21 && prefix2 <= 32) ||
        (prefix2 >= 61 && prefix2 <= 72) ||
        prefix2 === 80;
    const sum =
        3 * (d[0] + d[3] + d[6]) +
        7 * (d[1] + d[4] + d[7]) +
        1 * (d[2] + d[5] + d[8]);
    const checksumValid = validFedPrefix && sum > 0 && sum % 10 === 0;
    const knownBank = ABA_INSTITUTION_DIRECTORY[cleanDigits] || null;
    const districtMap: Record<string, string> = {
        '01': 'Boston Fed (01)',
        '02': 'New York Fed (02)',
        '03': 'Philadelphia Fed (03)',
        '04': 'Cleveland Fed (04)',
        '05': 'Richmond Fed (05)',
        '06': 'Atlanta Fed (06)',
        '07': 'Chicago Fed (07)',
        '08': 'St. Louis Fed (08)',
        '09': 'Minneapolis Fed (09)',
        '10': 'Kansas City Fed (10)',
        '11': 'Dallas Fed (11)',
        '12': 'San Francisco Fed (12)'
    };
    const fedDistrict =
        districtMap[cleanDigits.slice(0, 2)] || 'Federal Reserve ABA';
    return {
        cleanDigits,
        isComplete: true,
        checksumValid,
        institutionName:
            knownBank ||
            (checksumValid
                ? `Verified Commercial Bank (${fedDistrict})`
                : null),
        fedDistrict
    };
}

export function getPayoutStageIndex(statusRaw: string): number {
    const st = String(statusRaw || '').toUpperCase();
    if (st.includes('DISPATCHED') || st.includes('COMPLETED')) return 4;
    if (st.includes('QUEUED') || st.includes('PROCESSING')) return 3;
    if (st.includes('NETTED') || st.includes('CONFIRMING')) return 2;
    return 1;
}

export async function downloadWireSlipPdf(
    sessionObj: any,
    fallbackFiatUsd = '250'
) {
    if (!browser || !sessionObj) return;
    try {
        const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
        const page = pdfDoc.addPage([612, 580]);
        const fontReg = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Helvetica);
        const fontBold = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.HelveticaBold);
        const fontMono = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Courier);
        const slateBg = rgb(0.04, 0.05, 0.07);
        const teal = rgb(0.094, 0.776, 0.647);
        const dark = rgb(0.1, 0.12, 0.16);
        const muted = rgb(0.42, 0.46, 0.52);
        page.drawRectangle({
            x: 0,
            y: 500,
            width: 612,
            height: 80,
            color: slateBg
        });
        page.drawText(
            'PERENNIA, LLC TREASURY — OFFICIAL MERCURY / STRIPE SETTLEMENT RECEIPT',
            {
                x: 36,
                y: 544,
                size: 11.5,
                font: fontBold,
                color: teal
            }
        );
        page.drawText(
            `ORDER ID: ${sessionObj.sessionId || sessionObj.orderId} • STATUS: ${sessionObj.status || 'COMPLETED'}`,
            {
                x: 36,
                y: 522,
                size: 9,
                font: fontMono,
                color: rgb(0.9, 0.92, 0.95)
            }
        );
        const wi = sessionObj.wireInstructions || {
            beneficiaryName: MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.beneficiaryName,
            bankName: MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.bankName,
            routingNumber: MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.routingNumber,
            accountNumber: MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.accountNumber,
            bankAddress: MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.bankAddress,
            accountType: MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.accountType
        };
        const targetTicker = String(
            sessionObj.targetAsset || 'KAS'
        ).toUpperCase();
        const estOut = Number(
            sessionObj.deliveredTokens ??
                sessionObj.estimatedTokens ??
                sessionObj.estimatedKas ??
                0
        );
        const grossVal = Number(
            sessionObj.totalGrossChargeUsd ??
                sessionObj.fiatAmountUsd ??
                fallbackFiatUsd ??
                0
        );
        const feeVal = Number(sessionObj.feeUsd || 0);
        const netConvertedVal = Number(
            sessionObj.principalUsd ??
                sessionObj.netUsdConverted ??
                Math.max(0, grossVal - feeVal)
        );
        const lines = [
            [
                'REFERENCE MEMO (REQUIRED)',
                String(sessionObj.wireMemo || sessionObj.sessionId)
            ],
            [
                'BENEFICIARY & BANK',
                `${wi.beneficiaryName || 'Perennia, LLC'} • ${wi.bankName || 'Column N.A. (Mercury)'}`
            ],
            [
                'ABA ROUTING / ACCOUNT #',
                `Routing: ${wi.routingNumber || '121145433'} • Account: ${wi.accountNumber || '580798008849901'}`
            ],
            [
                'BANK ADDRESS',
                String(
                    wi.bankAddress ||
                        MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS.bankAddress
                )
            ],
            ['GROSS USD CHARGED / WIRED', `$${grossVal.toFixed(2)} USD`],
            [
                'FEES & PRINCIPAL CONVERTED',
                `Total Fee: $${feeVal.toFixed(2)} USD • Principal: $${netConvertedVal.toFixed(2)} USD`
            ],
            [
                `${targetTicker} DELIVERED`,
                `${estOut.toFixed(4)} ${targetTicker}`
            ],
            [
                'SETTLEMENT DESTINATION',
                `${sessionObj.settlementTarget || 'SELF_CUSTODY'} (${identity.activeAddress || sessionObj.walletAddress || ''})`
            ],
            [
                'SETTLEMENT TX / REF',
                String(sessionObj.txHash || sessionObj.orderId || 'CONFIRMED')
            ]
        ];
        let y = 466;
        for (const [label, val] of lines) {
            page.drawRectangle({
                x: 36,
                y: y - 8,
                width: 540,
                height: 28,
                borderColor: rgb(0.84, 0.87, 0.9),
                borderWidth: 1
            });
            page.drawText(label, {
                x: 46,
                y: y + 2,
                size: 8,
                font: fontBold,
                color: muted
            });
            page.drawText(val.slice(0, 62), {
                x: 225,
                y: y + 2,
                size: 8.2,
                font: fontMono,
                color: dark
            });
            y -= 34;
        }
        page.drawText(
            'Verified by Perennia, LLC Fiat Bridge • Column N.A. / Mercury Checking (*9901) • Zero-PII Client Receipt.',
            {
                x: 36,
                y: 36,
                size: 7.5,
                font: fontReg,
                color: muted
            }
        );
        const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
        const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as any], { type: 'application/pdf' });
        const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `Perennia_Purchase_Receipt_${sessionObj.wireMemo || sessionObj.sessionId}.pdf`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        a.remove();
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            'dex_fiat_btn',
            'RECEIPT PDF DOWNLOADED ✓',
            '#18C6A5'
        );
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to generate Wire Slip PDF:', err);
    }
}

    function formatSpotDisplay(price: number): string {

        if (price < 1) return `$${price.toFixed(4)}`;

            );
        }
    });

    $effect(() => {
        const addr =
            activeOfframpPass?.depositAddress || offrampDepositPreview.address;
        if (browser && addr) {
            QRCode.toDataURL(addr, {
                margin: 1,
                width: 180,
                color: { dark: '#000000', light: '#ffffff' }
            })
                .then((url) => {
                    offrampDepositQrDataUrl = url;
                })
                .catch(() => {});
        } else {
            offrampDepositQrDataUrl = '';
        }
    });

    let filteredOnrampAssets = $derived(
        treasury.registry.filter((a) => {
            if (a.ticker === 'USD') return false;
            const q = targetSearchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!q) return true;
            return (
                a.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                a.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                a.assetClass.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (a.contract && a.contract.toLowerCase().includes(q))
            );
        })
    );

    let offrampAvailableSourceBalance = $derived.by(() => {
        const asset = treasury.getAsset(offrampAssetTicker);
        if (
            offrampSourceMode === 'platform_balance' ||
            offrampSourceMode === 'ledger_kas' ||
            offrampSourceMode === 'ledger_usdc'
        ) {
            return asset.synthetic || 0;
        }
        return asset.onChain || 0;
    });

    export async function checkFiatGatewayStatus() {
        try {
            const requests: Promise<Response | null>[] = [
                fetch('/api/fiat/offramp').catch(() => null),
                fetch('/api/fiat/onramp').catch(() => null)
            ];
            if (identity.activeAddress) {
                requests.push(
                    fetch('/api/state/action', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            action: 'GET_MINER_LOYALTY',
                            payload: {}
                        })
                    }).catch(() => null)
                );
            }
            const [offRes, onRes, loyaltyRes] = await Promise.all(requests);
            if (offRes && offRes.ok) {
                const status = await offRes.json();
                circleDirectActive = Boolean(status.circleConfigured);
                changenowActive = Boolean(status.changenowConfigured);
                if (status.masterTreasuryKasAddress) {
                    masterTreasuryKasAddress = String(
                        status.masterTreasuryKasAddress
                    );
                }
                if (
                    typeof status.spotPrice === 'number' &&
                    status.spotPrice > 0
                ) {
                    treasury.updateAsset('KAS', {
                        spotPrice: status.spotPrice
                    });
                }
                if (status.savedBankRailLast4) {
                    savedBankLast4 = status.savedBankRailLast4;
                } else {
                    showOnrampBankLinker = true;
                }
                if (status.savedBankRail) {
                    savedBankRailMeta = status.savedBankRail;
                    offrampBankLabel =
                        status.savedBankRail.bankLabel ||
                        'Primary Operating Account';
                    offrampAccountType =
                        status.savedBankRail.accountType === 'SAVINGS'
                            ? 'SAVINGS'
                            : 'CHECKING';
                }
                if (Array.isArray(status.recentPayouts)) {
                    recentOfframpPayouts = status.recentPayouts;
                }
            }
            if (onRes && onRes.ok) {
                const onData = await onRes.json();
                stripeDirectActive = Boolean(onData.stripeConfigured);
                if (
                    typeof onData.spotPrice === 'number' &&
                    onData.spotPrice > 0
                ) {
                    treasury.updateAsset('KAS', {
                        spotPrice: onData.spotPrice
                    });
                }
                if (typeof onData.wholesaleFloorActive === 'boolean') {
                    wholesaleFloorActive = onData.wholesaleFloorActive;
                }
                if (Array.isArray(onData.fiatLedgerEvents)) {
                    fiatHistoryEvents = onData.fiatLedgerEvents;
                }
                if (Array.isArray(onData.recentOnrampSessions)) {
                    recentOnrampSessions = onData.recentOnrampSessions;
                }
            }
            if (loyaltyRes && loyaltyRes.ok) {
                const lData = await loyaltyRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (lData?.success && lData?.data) {
                    minerLoyaltyTelemetry = lData.data;
                    if (lData.data.activeMiner) {
                        wholesaleFloorActive = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore transient status sync error
        }
    }

    async function saveBankRailVault() {
        offrampError = null;
        offrampSuccessBanner = null;
        onrampError = null;
        const cleanRouting = offrampRoutingNumber.replace(/\D/g, '').trim();
        const cleanAccount = offrampAccountNumber.replace(/\D/g, '').trim();
        if (cleanRouting.length !== 9 || cleanAccount.length < 4) {
            const msg =
                'Please enter a valid 9-digit routing number and account number.';
            offrampError = msg;
            onrampError = msg;
            return;
        }
        if (!abaTelemetry.checksumValid) {
            const msg = 'Invalid 9-digit bank routing number.';
            offrampError = msg;
            onrampError = msg;
            return;
        }
        isSavingBankRail = true;
        try {
            const resolvedLabel =
                offrampBankLabel.trim() ||
                abaTelemetry.institutionName ||
                'Primary Operating Account';
            const res = await fetch('/api/fiat/offramp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'SAVE_BANK_RAIL',
                    wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                    bankLabel: resolvedLabel,
                    accountType: offrampAccountType,
                    payoutMethod,
                    routingNumber: cleanRouting,
                    accountNumber: cleanAccount
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok) {
                offrampError = data.error || 'Failed to save bank account.';
                onrampError = offrampError;
                return;
            }
            savedBankLast4 = data.savedBankRailLast4 || cleanAccount.slice(-4);
            if (data.savedBankRail) {
                savedBankRailMeta = data.savedBankRail;
            }
            offrampRoutingNumber = '';
            offrampAccountNumber = '';
            isEditingBankRail = false;
            showOnrampBankLinker = false;
            offrampSuccessBanner = `Bank Account Linked (${resolvedLabel} • *${savedBankLast4})`;
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'dex_fiat_btn',
                `BANK *${savedBankLast4} SAVED ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
        } catch (err: any) {
            offrampError = err.message || 'Failed to save bank account.';
            onrampError = offrampError;
        } finally {
            isSavingBankRail = false;
        }
    }

    function handleCryptoOfframpInput(e: Event) {
        const val = (e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement).value;
        otcCryptoAmountInput = val;
        const parsed = parseFloat(val);
        if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > 0 && offrampTargetSpotUsd > 0) {
            offrampTargetUsdInput = (parsed * offrampTargetSpotUsd).toFixed(2);
        }
    }

    async function initiateFiatOnramp() {
        if (!identity.activeAddress) {
            ui.showWalletModal = true;
            return;
        }
        const parsedUsd = parseFloat(onrampFiatAmountUsd) || 0;
        if (parsedUsd < 10) {
            onrampError = 'Minimum purchase amount is $10.00 USD.';
            return;
        }
        const isPushWire =
            onrampGatewayMethod === 'wire' ||
            onrampCostPlusQuote.requiresInstitutionalWire ||
            onrampPaymentRail === 'BRIDGE_VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_WIRE';
        const isCardMethod = onrampGatewayMethod === 'card' && !isPushWire;
        const cleanInlineRouting = offrampRoutingNumber
            .replace(/\D/g, '')
            .trim();
        const cleanInlineAccount = offrampAccountNumber
            .replace(/\D/g, '')
            .trim();
        const hasTypedBankCredentials =
            cleanInlineRouting.length > 0 || cleanInlineAccount.length > 0;
        if (hasTypedBankCredentials && !isCardMethod && !isPushWire) {
            if (
                cleanInlineRouting.length !== 9 ||
                cleanInlineAccount.length < 4
            ) {
                onrampError =
                    'Please enter a complete 9-digit routing number and account number.';
                return;
            }
            if (!abaTelemetry.checksumValid) {
                onrampError = 'Invalid 9-digit routing number.';
                return;
            }
        } else if (
            !savedBankLast4 &&
            !isPushWire &&
            !isCardMethod &&
            parsedUsd < 100_000
        ) {
            showOnrampBankLinker = true;
            activeStep = 2;
            onrampError =
                'Link your bank account below for ACH Direct Debit, or select Card / Bank Wire.';
            return;
        }
        isInitializingOnramp = true;
        onrampError = null;
        onrampSessionData = null;
        const targetTicker = onrampTargetTicker.trim().toUpperCase();
        const isAutoStake =
            targetTicker === DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER &&
            (onrampAutoStakeSilo ||
                onrampSettlementTarget === 'AUTO_STAKE_SILO');
        const resolvedLabel =
            offrampBankLabel.trim() ||
            abaTelemetry.institutionName ||
            savedBankRailMeta?.bankLabel ||
            'Primary Operating Account';
        try {
            const payload: Record<string, any> = {
                walletAddress: identity.activeAddress,
                evmAddress: identity.sovereignKeys?.ethereum?.address,
                solAddress: identity.sovereignKeys?.solana?.address,
                fiatAmountUsd: parsedUsd,
                targetAsset: targetTicker,
                paymentMethod: isPushWire
                    ? 'wire'
                    : isCardMethod
                      ? 'card'
                      : 'ach',
                paymentRail: isPushWire
                    ? 'BRIDGE_VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_WIRE'
                    : isCardMethod
                      ? 'CARD_INSTANT'
                      : 'SOVEREIGN_WIRE_ACH',
                settlementTarget: isAutoStake
                    ? 'AUTO_STAKE_SILO'
                    : onrampSettlementTarget,
                autoStakeSilo: isAutoStake,
                bundledKasOrSilo: isAutoStake,
                instantBankDebit: !isPushWire,
                bankLabel: resolvedLabel,
                accountType: offrampAccountType
            };
            if (
                cleanInlineRouting.length === 9 &&
                cleanInlineAccount.length >= 4
            ) {
                payload.routingNumber = cleanInlineRouting;
                payload.accountNumber = cleanInlineAccount;
            }
            const res = await fetch('/api/fiat/onramp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to execute bank purchase.'
                );
            }
            if (data.bankLast4) {
                savedBankLast4 = data.bankLast4;
                savedBankRailMeta = {
                    bankLabel: data.bankLabel || resolvedLabel,
                    accountType: offrampAccountType,
                    payoutMethod: 'ACH',
                    bankLast4: data.bankLast4,
                    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                offrampRoutingNumber = '';
                offrampAccountNumber = '';
                showOnrampBankLinker = false;
            }
            onrampSessionData = {
                ...data,
                sessionId: data.sessionId || data.orderId,
                orderId: data.orderId || data.sessionId,
                estimatedKas: data.estimatedKas,
                estimatedTokens: data.estimatedTokens ?? data.estimatedKas,
                deliveredTokens:
                    data.deliveredTokens ??
                    data.estimatedTokens ??
                    data.estimatedKas,
                targetAsset: data.targetAsset || targetTicker,
                targetSpotPrice: data.targetSpotPrice ?? data.spotPrice,
                autoStakeSilo: Boolean(data.autoStakeSilo),
                spotPrice: data.spotPrice,
                feeUsd: Number(data.feeUsd ?? onrampCostPlusQuote.feeUsd),
                hardCostUsd: Number(
                    data.hardCostUsd ?? onrampCostPlusQuote.hardCostUsd
                ),
                guaranteedProfitUsd: Number(
                    data.guaranteedProfitUsd ??
                        onrampCostPlusQuote.guaranteedProfitUsd
                ),
                competitorFeeUsd: Number(
                    data.competitorFeeUsd ??
                        onrampCostPlusQuote.competitorFeeUsd
                ),
                guestSavingsUsd: Number(
                    data.guestSavingsUsd ?? onrampCostPlusQuote.guestSavingsUsd
                ),
                netUsdConverted: Number(
                    data.netUsdConverted ?? onrampCostPlusQuote.guestNetUsd
                ),
                totalGrossChargeUsd: Number(
                    data.totalGrossChargeUsd ??
                        onrampCostPlusQuote.totalGrossChargeUsd
                ),
                paymentRail: data.paymentRail,
                settlementTarget: data.settlementTarget,
                routingTopology:
                    data.routingTopology || onrampCostPlusQuote.routingTopology,
                wireMemo: data.wireMemo || data.sessionId,
                wireInstructions:
                    data.wireInstructions ||
                    MERCURY_COLUMN_WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS,
                postTradeAllocation: data.postTradeAllocation,
                status: data.status || 'COMPLETED',
                txHash: data.txHash,
                bankLast4: data.bankLast4 || savedBankLast4
            };
            activeStep = 3;
            onTriggerTileSweep();
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'dex_fiat_btn',
                onrampSessionData.status === 'COMPLETED'
                    ? `${targetTicker} CREDITED ✓`
                    : `ORDER ${onrampSessionData.wireMemo} CREATED ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
            await onSyncUserBalances();
            await checkFiatGatewayStatus();
        } catch (e: any) {
            onrampError = e.message || 'Purchase failed.';
        } finally {
            isInitializingOnramp = false;
        }
    }

    async function settleActiveOnrampOrderNow() {
        if (!onrampSessionData?.orderId && !onrampSessionData?.sessionId)
            return;
        const targetOrderId =
            onrampSessionData.orderId || onrampSessionData.sessionId;
        isSettlingOnrampPass = true;
        onrampError = null;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/fiat/onramp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'SETTLE_ORDER_NOW',
                    orderId: targetOrderId
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to settle on-ramp order.'
                );
            }
            onrampSessionData = {
                ...onrampSessionData,
                status: 'COMPLETED',
                txHash: data.txHash || onrampSessionData.txHash,
                deliveredTokens:
                    data.deliveredTokens ?? onrampSessionData.estimatedTokens
            };
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'dex_fiat_btn',
                `${onrampSessionData.targetAsset} DELIVERED ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
            await onSyncUserBalances();
            await checkFiatGatewayStatus();
        } catch (err: any) {
            onrampError = err.message || 'Failed to settle order.';
        } finally {
            isSettlingOnrampPass = false;
        }
    }

    async function generateOfframpSettlementPass() {
        if (!identity.activeAddress) {
            ui.showWalletModal = true;
            return;
        }
        offrampError = null;
        offrampSuccessBanner = null;
        const grossUsd = parseFloat(offrampTargetUsdInput) || 0;
        const parsedCrypto =
            parseFloat(otcCryptoAmountInput) ||
            (offrampTargetSpotUsd > 0 ? grossUsd / offrampTargetSpotUsd : 0);
        if (grossUsd < 10 || parsedCrypto <= 0) {
            offrampError = 'Minimum sale amount is $10.00 USD.';
            return;
        }
        if (
            !savedBankLast4 &&
            (!abaTelemetry.checksumValid ||
                offrampAccountNumber.replace(/\D/g, '').length < 4)
        ) {
            offrampError =
                'Link or enter your 9-digit routing number and account number first.';
            return;
        }
        const isLedgerSale =
            offrampSourceMode === 'platform_balance' ||
            offrampSourceMode === 'ledger_kas' ||
            offrampSourceMode === 'ledger_usdc';
        if (isLedgerSale && parsedCrypto > offrampAvailableSourceBalance + 1e-8) {
            offrampError = `Insufficient ${offrampAssetTicker} in Platform Balance (${offrampAvailableSourceBalance.toFixed(4)} available).`;
            return;
        }
        try {
            const resolvedSourceMode = isLedgerSale
                ? offrampAssetTicker === 'USDC'
                    ? 'ledger_usdc'
                    : 'platform_balance'
                : 'direct_wholesale_deposit';
            const extBasisParsed = parseFloat(externalCostBasisUsdInput);
            const payload: Record<string, any> = {
                wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                amountKas: parsedCrypto,
                kasAmount: parsedCrypto,
                amountAsset: parsedCrypto,
                grossUsd,
                sourceMode: resolvedSourceMode,
                sourceAsset: offrampAssetTicker,
                payoutMethod,
                bankLabel:
                    offrampBankLabel.trim() || 'Primary Operating Account',
                accountType: offrampAccountType,
                ...(Number.isFinite(extBasisParsed) && extBasisParsed >= 0
                    ? { externalCostBasisUsd: extBasisParsed }
                    : {})
            };
            if (offrampRoutingNumber.trim() && offrampAccountNumber.trim()) {
                payload.routingNumber = offrampRoutingNumber.trim();
                payload.accountNumber = offrampAccountNumber.trim();
            }
            const res = await fetch('/api/fiat/offramp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok) {
                offrampError = data.error || 'Off-Ramp order rejected.';
                return;
            }
            activeOfframpPass = {
                ...data,
                payoutId: data.payoutId || data.wireReferenceId,
                sourceAsset: data.sourceAsset || offrampAssetTicker,
                amountCrypto: data.amountCrypto ?? parsedCrypto,
                grossUsd: data.grossUsd ?? offrampCostPlusQuote.grossUsd,
                feeUsd: data.feeUsd ?? offrampCostPlusQuote.feeUsd,
                hardCostUsd:
                    data.hardCostUsd ?? offrampCostPlusQuote.hardCostUsd,
                guaranteedProfitUsd:
                    data.guaranteedProfitUsd ??
                    offrampCostPlusQuote.guaranteedProfitUsd,
                guestSavingsUsd:
                    data.guestSavingsUsd ??
                    offrampCostPlusQuote.guestSavingsUsd,
                netFiatUsd:
                    data.netFiatPayout ??
                    data.netFiatUsd ??
                    offrampCostPlusQuote.guestNetUsd,
                depositAddress:
                    data.depositAddress ||
                    offrampDepositPreview.address ||
                    `bc1qperenniawholesale${offrampAssetTicker.toLowerCase()}`,
                depositRouteType:
                    data.depositRouteType || offrampDepositPreview.routeLabel,
                confirmationsRequired:
                    data.confirmationsRequired ||
                    offrampDepositPreview.confirmationsRequired,
                confirmationsCurrent: data.confirmationsCurrent ?? 0,
                status: data.status || 'AWAITING_ONCHAIN_CONFIRMATIONS'
            };
            activeStep = 3;
            offrampSuccessBanner = isLedgerSale
                ? `Sold ${parsedCrypto.toFixed(4)} ${offrampAssetTicker} → $${Number(activeOfframpPass.netFiatUsd).toFixed(2)} USD Queued (${activeOfframpPass.payoutId})`
                : `Payout Order Created (${activeOfframpPass.payoutId} • $${Number(activeOfframpPass.netFiatUsd).toFixed(2)} USD)`;
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'dex_fiat_btn',
                `OFF-RAMP ${activeOfframpPass.payoutId} ARMED ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
            await onSyncUserBalances();
            await checkFiatGatewayStatus();
        } catch (err: any) {
            offrampError = err.message || 'Unable to generate Off-Ramp order.';
        }
    }

    async function simulateOfframpConfirmNow() {
        if (!activeOfframpPass?.payoutId) return;
        activeOfframpPass = {
            ...activeOfframpPass,
            confirmationsCurrent:
                activeOfframpPass.confirmationsRequired || 6,
            status: 'DISPATCHED_BY_DIRECTOR',
            traceId: `ACH-TRACE-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`
        };
        offrampSuccessBanner = `Bank Payout Dispatched (${activeOfframpPass.payoutId}) ✓`;
        await onSyncUserBalances();
    }

    function signAndBroadcastOfframpFromWallet() {
        if (!activeOfframpPass) return;
        const dest =
            activeOfframpPass.depositAddress || masterTreasuryKasAddress;
        if (!dest) {
            offrampError = 'Deposit address unavailable for wallet signing.';
            return;
        }
        txState.lastTxId = '';
        txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
        awaitingWalletOfframpSign = true;
        requestUniversalL1Signature({
            intentType: 'FIAT_OFFRAMP',
            payAsset: activeOfframpPass.sourceAsset || offrampAssetTicker,
            payAmount:
                activeOfframpPass.amountCrypto || otcCryptoAmountInput || '0',
            fiatAmountUsd: Number(activeOfframpPass.netFiatUsd || 0).toFixed(2),
            destinationAddress: dest,
            payoutMethod,
            bankLabel: offrampBankLabel,
            accountType: offrampAccountType,
            orderId: activeOfframpPass.payoutId
        });
    }

    async function pollActiveOnrampSession() {
        if (!onrampSessionData?.sessionId) return;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(
                `/api/fiat/onramp?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(onrampSessionData.sessionId)}`
            );
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.session) {
                    onrampSessionData = {
                        ...onrampSessionData,
                        status: data.session.status || onrampSessionData.status,
                        txHash: data.session.txHash || onrampSessionData.txHash
                    };
                    if (data.session.status === 'COMPLETED') {
                        onSyncUserBalances();
                        checkFiatGatewayStatus();
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore transient poll error
        }
    }

    function handleLiveFiatSseEvent(e: Event) {
        const customEvt = e as CustomEvent;
        const payload = customEvt.detail;
        if (!payload) return;
        const myClean = (identity.activeAddress || '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/^kaspa:/i, '')
            .trim();
        const evtClean = String(payload.wallet || '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/^kaspa:/i, '')
            .trim();
        if (myClean && evtClean === myClean) {
            if (payload.eventType === 'FIAT_ONRAMP') {
                if (
                    onrampSessionData &&
                    payload.sessionId === onrampSessionData.sessionId
                ) {
                    onrampSessionData = {
                        ...onrampSessionData,
                        status: payload.status || 'COMPLETED',
                        txHash: payload.txHash || onrampSessionData.txHash
                    };
                }
            } else if (payload.eventType === 'FIAT_DISPATCHED') {
                offrampSuccessBanner = `Bank Transfer Dispatched (${payload.payoutId} • Trace: ${payload.traceId || 'CONFIRMED'})`;
                if (
                    activeOfframpPass &&
                    activeOfframpPass.payoutId === payload.payoutId
                ) {
                    activeOfframpPass = {
                        ...activeOfframpPass,
                        status: 'DISPATCHED_BY_DIRECTOR',
                        traceId: payload.traceId
                    };
                }
            }
            onSyncUserBalances();
            checkFiatGatewayStatus();
        }
    }

    onMount(() => {
        checkFiatGatewayStatus();
        if (browser) {
            window.addEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleLiveFiatSseEvent
            );
        }
        onrampPollInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (
                onrampSessionData?.sessionId &&
                onrampSessionData.status !== 'COMPLETED'
            ) {
                pollActiveOnrampSession();
            }
        }, 6000);
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        clearTimeout(discoverTimer);
        if (browser) {
            window.removeEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleLiveFiatSseEvent
            );
        }
        if (onrampPollInterval) clearInterval(onrampPollInterval);
    });
</script>

            feeRateCap: number;
            tierLabel: string;
            positions: SiloStakePosition[];
        };
        isProvidingLiquidity: boolean;
        isWithdrawingLp: string | null;
        isStakingSilo: boolean;
        isMutatingSiloId: string | null;
        swapError: string | null;
        ambientPrimaryHex: string;
        ambientSecondaryHex: string;
        onOpenTokenModal: (
            mode:
                | 'pay'
                | 'receive'
                | 'lpA'
                | 'lpB'
                | 'lpExtra'
                | 'p2pSell'
                | 'p2pBuy',
            extraIdx?: number
        ) => void;
        onSetLpPercentageA: (pct: number) => void;
        onSetLpPercentageB: (pct: number) => void;
        onHandleLpInputA: (e: Event) => void;
        onHandleLpInputB: (e: Event) => void;
        onAddSecondaryPlantLeg: (defaultTicker?: string) => void;
        onRemoveSecondaryPlantLeg: (idx: number) => void;
        onAdjustDexPlantSecondaryWeights: (

    let tokenBHex = $derived(lpTokenB.theme?.hex || ambientSecondaryHex || '#3B82F6');
    let siloHex = $derived(siloAsset.theme?.hex || '#18C6A5');

    let activeFeePct = $derived(
        (
            (siloStakingTelemetry.feeRateCap > 0
                ? siloStakingTelemetry.feeRateCap
                : 0.015) * 100
        ).toFixed(2)
    );

    let lpTotalUsdValue = $derived.by(() => {
        const kasQty = parseFloat(lpAmountA) || 0;
        const kasUsd = kasQty * (lpTokenA.spotPrice || 0);
        return kasUsd > 0 ? kasUsd * 2 : 0;
    });

    function formatSpotDisplay(price: number): string {
        if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return '$0.00';
        if (price < 0.01) return `$${price.toFixed(6)}`;
        if (price < 1) return `$${price.toFixed(4)}`;
        return `$${price.toLocaleString(undefined, {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2
        })}`;
    }

    function setSiloPercentage(pct: number) {
        const avail = Number(siloAsset.availableBalance || 0);
        siloStakeAmountInput =
            avail > 0 ? Number((avail * pct).toFixed(2)).toString() : '0';
    }

    function formatCooldownTag(endsAt?: string | number | null): string {
        if (!endsAt) return '7d Cooldown';
        const endMs =
            typeof endsAt === 'number' ? endsAt : new Date(endsAt).getTime();
        const diffMs = endMs - Date.now();
        if (!Number.isFinite(diffMs) || diffMs <= 0) return 'Ready to Claim';
        const days = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        const hours = Math.floor(
            (diffMs % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60)
        );
        return `${days}d ${hours}h left`;
    }

    function handleIconError(e: Event) {
        const target = e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement;
        target.style.display = 'none';
        if (target.nextElementSibling) {
            (target.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement).style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }
</script>

<!-- WINDOWS (FRONTEND): C:\Users\send2\perennia-v5\perennia-frontend\src\lib\components\dex\P2pOrderbookPanel.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
    import { fade } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { treasury, type UnifiedAsset } from '$lib/stores/treasury.svelte';

    let {
        p2pSellAmount = $bindable(''),
        p2pBuyAmount = $bindable(''),
        p2pSellToken,
        p2pBuyToken,
        p2pOrders = [],
        isExecuting = false,
        isCancellingP2pId = null,
        swapError = null,
        ambientPrimaryHex = '#18C6A5',
        ambientSecondaryHex = '#3B82F6',
        onOpenTokenModal,
        onCreateP2pOffer,
        onFillP2pOrder,
        onCancelP2pOrder
    }: {
        p2pSellAmount: string;
        p2pBuyAmount: string;
        p2pSellToken: UnifiedAsset;
        p2pBuyToken: UnifiedAsset;
        p2pOrders: Array<{
            id: string;
            seller: string;
            sellToken: string;
            sellAmount: number;
            buyToken: string;
            buyAmount: number;
            rate: string;
            status: string;
        }>;
        isExecuting: boolean;
        isCancellingP2pId: string | null;
        swapError: string | null;
        ambientPrimaryHex: string;
        ambientSecondaryHex: string;
        onOpenTokenModal: (
            mode:
                | 'pay'
                | 'receive'
                | 'lpA'
                | 'lpB'
                | 'lpExtra'
                | 'p2pSell'
                | 'p2pBuy',
            extraIdx?: number
        ) => void;
        onCreateP2pOffer: () => Promise<void>;
        onFillP2pOrder: (order: any) => Promise<void>;
        onCancelP2pOrder: (orderId: string) => Promise<void>;
    } = $props();

    let sellHex = $derived(
        p2pSellToken?.theme?.hex || ambientPrimaryHex || '#18C6A5'
    );
    let buyHex = $derived(
        p2pBuyToken?.theme?.hex || ambientSecondaryHex || '#3B82F6'
    );

    let sellUsdValue = $derived(
        (parseFloat(p2pSellAmount) || 0) * (p2pSellToken?.spotPrice || 0)
    );
    let buyUsdValue = $derived(
        (parseFloat(p2pBuyAmount) || 0) * (p2pBuyToken?.spotPrice || 0)
    );

    let impliedRate = $derived.by(() => {
        const s = parseFloat(p2pSellAmount) || 0;
        const b = parseFloat(p2pBuyAmount) || 0;
        if (s <= 0 || b <= 0) return '0.0000';
        const r = b / s;
        return r < 0.01 ? r.toFixed(6) : r.toFixed(4);
    });

    function formatSpotDisplay(price: number): string {
        if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return '$0.00';
        if (price < 0.01) return `$${price.toFixed(6)}`;
        if (price < 1) return `$${price.toFixed(4)}`;
        return `$${price.toLocaleString(undefined, {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2
        })}`;
    }

    function setSellPercentage(pct: number) {
        const avail = Number(p2pSellToken?.availableBalance || 0);
        if (avail <= 0) {
            p2pSellAmount = '0';
            return;
        }
        p2pSellAmount = Number((avail * pct).toFixed(4)).toString();
    }

    function matchSpotAskAmount() {
        const sellQty = parseFloat(p2pSellAmount) || 0;
        const sellSpot = p2pSellToken?.spotPrice || 0;
        const buySpot = p2pBuyToken?.spotPrice || 0;
        if (sellQty > 0 && sellSpot > 0 && buySpot > 0) {
            const targetBuy = (sellQty * sellSpot) / buySpot;
            p2pBuyAmount = Number(
                targetBuy.toFixed(targetBuy < 1 ? 6 : 4)
            ).toString();
        }
    }

    function isOwnOrder(sellerWallet: string): boolean {
        const me = (identity.activeAddress || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const maker = (sellerWallet || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        return Boolean(me && maker && me === maker);
    }

    function handleIconError(e: Event) {
        const target = e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement;
        target.style.display = 'none';
        if (target.nextElementSibling) {
            (target.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement).style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }
</script>

<div
    data-testid="p2p-orderbook-panel"

<!-- WINDOWS (FRONTEND): C:\Users\send2\perennia-v5\perennia-frontend\src\lib\components\director\DirectorSystemHealthTab.svelte -->
<script lang="ts">
    import { onMount } from 'svelte';
    import { browser } from '$app/environment';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { i18n } from '$lib/stores/i18n.svelte';

    let {
        healthData = null,
        shieldData = null,
        whitelist = [],
        onRefresh = undefined
    }: {
        healthData?: any;
        shieldData?: any;
        whitelist?: any[];
        onRefresh?: () => void;
    } = $props();

    interface ReadinessCheck {
        id: string;
        category: string;
        label: string;
        status: 'ONLINE' | 'SANDBOX_READY' | 'ACTION_REQUIRED';
        detail: string;
        envVar: string;
    }

    let readinessReport = $state<{
        timestamp: string;
        summary: {
            totalChecks: number;
            onlineCount: number;
            sandboxCount: number;
            actionRequiredCount: number;
            readyForMainnet: boolean;
            overallStatus: string;
        };
        checks: ReadinessCheck[];
        nodeAirlock: Record<string, any>;
        fiatFloat: Record<string, any>;
    } | null>(null);

    let isAuditingReadiness = $state(false);
    let auditError = $state<string | null>(null);

    // Editable System Treasury & Airlock Controls
    let hotCeilingKas = $state(5000);
    let minRunwayKas = $state(250);
    let fppsMaxFloatKas = $state(50);
    let poolFeeRatePct = $state(1.0);
    let outflowBreakerTripped = $state(false);
    let coldKasAddress = $state('');
    let coldBtcAddress = $state('');
    let coldEthAddress = $state('');
    let coldSolAddress = $state('');
    let isSavingSysConfig = $state(false);
    let sysConfigBanner = $state<{
        type: 'success' | 'error';
        message: string;
    } | null>(null);

    // Stratum 10-Strike Shield & Whitelist State
    let localBannedIps = $state<any[]>([]);
    let localActiveStrikes = $state<any[]>([]);
    let localWhitelist = $state<any[]>([]);
    let manualIpInput = $state('');
    let newWhitelistWallet = $state('');
    let newWhitelistLabel = $state('Sovereign Miner');
    let isMutatingShield = $state(false);
    let isTriggeringBell = $state(false);
    let bellStatusBanner = $state<string | null>(null);

    $effect(() => {
        if (shieldData?.bannedIps) {
            localBannedIps = shieldData.bannedIps;
        }
        if (shieldData?.activeStrikeCounters) {
            localActiveStrikes = shieldData.activeStrikeCounters;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(whitelist) && whitelist.length > 0) {
            localWhitelist = whitelist;
        }
    });

    async function runReadinessAudit() {
        if (!browser) return;
        isAuditingReadiness = true;
        auditError = null;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/health/readiness', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to run mainnet readiness audit.'
                );
            }
            readinessReport = data;
            if (data.nodeAirlock) {
                hotCeilingKas = Number(
                    data.nodeAirlock.hotCeilingKas ?? hotCeilingKas
                );
                minRunwayKas = Number(
                    data.nodeAirlock.minRunwayKas ?? minRunwayKas
                );
                fppsMaxFloatKas = Number(
                    data.nodeAirlock.fppsMaxFloatKas ?? fppsMaxFloatKas
                );
                poolFeeRatePct = Number(
                    data.nodeAirlock.poolFeeRatePct ??
                        (data.nodeAirlock.poolFeeRate ?? 0.01) * 100
                );
                outflowBreakerTripped = Boolean(
                    data.nodeAirlock.outflowBreakerTripped
                );
                coldKasAddress =
                    data.nodeAirlock.coldVaultAddress || coldKasAddress;
                coldBtcAddress =
                    data.nodeAirlock.coldBtcAddress || coldBtcAddress;
                coldEthAddress =
                    data.nodeAirlock.coldEthAddress || coldEthAddress;
                coldSolAddress =
                    data.nodeAirlock.coldSolAddress || coldSolAddress;
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            auditError =
                err.message || 'Unable to reach /api/health/readiness.';
        } finally {
            isAuditingReadiness = false;
        }
    }

    async function loadShieldAndWhitelist() {
        if (!browser) return;
        try {
            const [shieldRes, wlRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch('/api/admin?target=shield'),
                fetch('/api/admin?target=whitelist')
            ]);
            if (shieldRes.ok) {
                const sData = await shieldRes.json();
                localBannedIps = sData.bannedIps || [];
                localActiveStrikes = sData.activeStrikeCounters || [];
            }
            if (wlRes.ok) {
                const wData = await wlRes.json();
                localWhitelist = wData.wallets || [];
            }
        } catch {
            // Non-blocking if admin shield endpoint is offline
        }
    }

    async function saveSystemTreasuryConfig() {
        if (!browser) return;
        isSavingSysConfig = true;
        sysConfigBanner = null;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    wallet:
                        identity.activeAddress ||
                        identity.masterTreasuryAddress,
                    action: 'UPDATE_SYSTEM_TREASURY_CONFIG',
                    payload: {
                        hotCeilingKas: Number(hotCeilingKas),
                        minRunwayKas: Number(minRunwayKas),
                        fppsMaxFloatKas: Number(fppsMaxFloatKas),
                        poolFeeRatePct: Number(poolFeeRatePct),
                        outflowBreakerTripped: Boolean(outflowBreakerTripped),
                        coldKasAddress: coldKasAddress.trim(),
                        coldBtcAddress: coldBtcAddress.trim(),
                        coldEthAddress: coldEthAddress.trim(),
                        coldSolAddress: coldSolAddress.trim()
                    }
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to update system treasury config.'
                );
            }
            sysConfigBanner = {
                type: 'success',
                message:
                    'System Treasury Ceilings, Pool Fee & Cold Vault Addresses Saved ✓'
            };
            await runReadinessAudit();
        } catch (err: any) {
            sysConfigBanner = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    err.message || 'Failed to save system treasury parameters.'
            };
        } finally {
            isSavingSysConfig = false;
        }
    }

    async function handleToggleOutflowBreaker() {
        outflowBreakerTripped = !outflowBreakerTripped;
        await saveSystemTreasuryConfig();
    }

    async function handleForce2200UtcBell() {
        if (!browser || isTriggeringBell) return;
        isTriggeringBell = true;
        bellStatusBanner = null;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    wallet:
                        identity.activeAddress ||
                        identity.masterTreasuryAddress,
                    action: 'FORCE_EPOCH_BELL',
                    payload: {}
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to execute 22:00 UTC Bell settlement.'
                );
            }
            bellStatusBanner =
                '22:00 UTC Global Settlement Bell & Forge Vesting Sweep Executed ✓';
            await runReadinessAudit();
            if (onRefresh) onRefresh();
        } catch (err: any) {
            bellStatusBanner = `Error: ${err.message || 'Bell trigger failed'}`;
        } finally {
            isTriggeringBell = false;
        }
    }

    async function modifyShieldIp(ip: string, action: 'BAN' | 'UNBAN') {
        const cleanIp = ip.trim();
        if (!cleanIp) return;
        isMutatingShield = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/admin', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    target: 'shield',
                    ip: cleanIp,
                    action
                })
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                manualIpInput = '';
                await loadShieldAndWhitelist();
            }
        } finally {
            isMutatingShield = false;
        }
    }

    async function addWhitelistWallet() {
        const clean = newWhitelistWallet.trim();
        if (!clean) return;
        isMutatingShield = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/admin', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    target: 'whitelist',
                    wallet: clean,
                    label: newWhitelistLabel.trim() || 'Sovereign Miner'
                })
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                newWhitelistWallet = '';
                await loadShieldAndWhitelist();
            }
        } finally {
            isMutatingShield = false;
        }
    }

    onMount(() => {
        runReadinessAudit();
        loadShieldAndWhitelist();
    });
