<script lang="ts">
    import { fade } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
    import { operations } from '$lib/stores/operations.svelte';
    import { treasury } from '$lib/stores/treasury.svelte';
    let {
        fiatOnrampOrders = [],
        fiatOfframpQueue = [],
        l1PayoutQueue = [],
        traceInputs = $bindable({}),
        isProcessingOrderId = null,
        onConfirmWireOnramp = async (_orderId: string) => {},
        onMarkFiatDispatched = async (_payoutId: string, _traceId: string) => {},
        onRetryL1Payout = async (_payoutId: string) => {}
    }: {
        fiatOnrampOrders: any[];
        fiatOfframpQueue: any[];
        l1PayoutQueue: any[];
        traceInputs: Record<string, string>;
        isProcessingOrderId: string | null;
        onConfirmWireOnramp: (orderId: string) => Promise<void>;
        onMarkFiatDispatched: (payoutId: string, traceId: string) => Promise<void>;
        onRetryL1Payout: (payoutId: string) => Promise<void>;
    } = $props();
    let allGlobalBuckets = $derived(operations.allGlobalPoolBuckets || []);
    let totalGlobalPendingKas = $derived(
        allGlobalBuckets.reduce((sum, b) => sum + Number(b.pendingKas || 0), 0)
    );
    let totalGlobalPendingUsd = $derived(
        allGlobalBuckets.reduce((sum, b) => sum + Number(b.pendingUsd || 0), 0)
    );
    let readyGlobalBucketCount = $derived(
        allGlobalBuckets.filter(
            (b) => b.weightPct >= 100 || b.status === 'READY_FOR_BELL'
        ).length
    );
    let fillingGlobalBucketCount = $derived(
        allGlobalBuckets.filter(
            (b) => Number(b.pendingKas || 0) > 0 && b.weightPct < 100
        ).length
    );
</script>

<script lang="ts">
    import { onMount } from 'svelte';
    import { fade, slide } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
    import {
        KASPA_UNSPENDABLE_BURN_ADDRESS,
        validateKaspaBech32mAddress,
        deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress,
        compileSilverScriptProofOfLockVault,
        type KasplexProtocolInfo
    } from '$lib/stores/transaction.svelte';

    let {
        kasplexInfo,
        initialTicker = 'NACHO',
        initialToken = null,
        isForging = false,
        forgeStatusMessage = '',
        onExecuteMint = async (_params: {
            ticker: string;
            recipientAddress: string;
            inspectedToken: any;
        }) => {}
    }: {
        kasplexInfo: KasplexProtocolInfo;
        initialTicker?: string;
        initialToken?: any | null;
        isForging: boolean;
        forgeStatusMessage: string;
        onExecuteMint: (params: {
            ticker: string;
            recipientAddress: string;
            inspectedToken: any;
        }) => Promise<void>;
    } = $props();

    let mintSearchTicker = $state('NACHO');
    let isInspectingToken = $state(false);
    let inspectedToken = $state<any | null>(null);
    let inspectError = $state('');
    let mintRecipientAddress = $state('');
    let expandedVestingSilRows = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});

    // Proof-of-Lock Supply Gauge & Vesting Schedule Telemetry
    let tokenomicsBundle = $state<{
        vestingSchedules: any[];
        monetaryPolicy: any | null;
        mineableVault: any | null;
        proofOfLockSummary: {
            lockedVestingSupply: number;
            unlockedVestedSupply: number;
            reserveLockedSupply: number;
            miningVaultLockedSupply: number;
            totalLockedSupply: number;
            burnedSupply: number;
            daily2200UtcUnlockRate: number;
            burnAddress: string;
        };
    } | null>(null);

    // Retroactive KRC-20 / KCC-20 Ecosystem Upgrade Foundry
    let showRetroUpgradeFoundry = $state(false);
    let retroTokenStandard = $state<'KRC-20' | 'KCC-20'>('KCC-20');
    let retroBurnRateBps = $state(50);
    let retroVestingLabel = $state('Team & Community Proof-of-Lock Vault');
    let retroVestingAddress = $state('');
    let retroVestingAmount = $state(5_000_000);
    let retroCliffDays = $state(90);
    let retroLinearDays = $state(365);
    let retroEnableMineableVault = $state(true);
    let retroMineableFunded = $state(2_500_000);
    let retroMineableDaily = $state(10_000);
    let isApplyingRetroUpgrade = $state(false);
    let showRetroSilPreview = $state(false);
    let retroStatusBanner = $state<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);

    $effect(() => {
        if (initialTicker && initialTicker !== mintSearchTicker && initialToken) {
            mintSearchTicker = initialTicker;
            inspectedToken = initialToken;
            fetchForgeTokenomicsForTicker(initialTicker);
        }
    });

    function parseKasplexUnits(rawStr: string | number | undefined, dec = 8): number {
        if (rawStr === undefined || rawStr === null) return 0;
        const n = Number(rawStr);
        if (isNaN(n) || n <= 0) return 0;
        return n / Math.pow(10, dec);
    }

    let inspectedMintProgressPct = $derived.by(() => {
        if (!inspectedToken) return 0;
        const maxNum = parseKasplexUnits(inspectedToken.max, inspectedToken.dec);
        const mintedNum = parseKasplexUnits(inspectedToken.minted, inspectedToken.dec);
        if (maxNum <= 0) return 0;
        return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (mintedNum / maxNum) * 100));
    });

    let retroCompiledVault = $derived.by(() => {
        const cleanTick = (inspectedToken?.tick || mintSearchTicker || 'NACHO')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase()
            .replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        const resolvedBeneficiary =
            retroVestingAddress.trim() ||
            identity.activeAddress ||
            deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress(`${cleanTick}_retro_vesting`);
        return compileSilverScriptProofOfLockVault({
            ticker: cleanTick || 'NACHO',
            tokenStandard: retroTokenStandard,
            label: retroVestingLabel,
            beneficiaryAddress: resolvedBeneficiary,
            totalAllocation: Math.max(0, Number(retroVestingAmount || 0)),
            decimals: Number(inspectedToken?.dec ?? 8),
            cliffDays: Math.max(0, Number(retroCliffDays || 0)),
            linearDays: Math.max(0, Number(retroLinearDays || 0))
        });
    });

    let supplyGaugeMetrics = $derived.by(() => {
        const totalMax = inspectedToken
            ? parseKasplexUnits(inspectedToken.max, inspectedToken.dec)
            : Number(tokenomicsBundle?.monetaryPolicy?.maxSupply || 21_000_000);
        const mintedTotal = inspectedToken
            ? parseKasplexUnits(inspectedToken.minted, inspectedToken.dec)
            : totalMax;
        const summary = tokenomicsBundle?.proofOfLockSummary;
        const lockedVesting = Number(summary?.lockedVestingSupply || 0);
        const reserveLocked = Number(summary?.reserveLockedSupply || 0);
        const miningLocked = Number(summary?.miningVaultLockedSupply || 0);
        const totalLocked = lockedVesting + reserveLocked + miningLocked;
        const burned = Number(summary?.burnedSupply || 0);
        const circulatingUnlocked = Math.max(0, mintedTotal - totalLocked - burned);
        const dailyUnlock = Number(summary?.daily2200UtcUnlockRate || 0);
        const safeDenom = Math.max(1, totalMax);
        return {
            totalMax,
            mintedTotal,
            circulatingUnlocked,
            lockedVesting,
            reserveLocked,
            miningLocked,
            totalLocked,
            burned,
            dailyUnlock,
            circulatingPct: Math.min(100, (circulatingUnlocked / safeDenom) * 100),
            lockedPct: Math.min(100, (totalLocked / safeDenom) * 100),
            burnedPct: Math.min(100, (burned / safeDenom) * 100)
        };
    });

    function resolveVestingCovenantDetails(vs: any) {
        if (vs.covenantAddress && vs.silverscriptSource) {
            return {
                covenantAddress: String(vs.covenantAddress),
                silverscriptSource: String(vs.silverscriptSource),
                kcc20StateCommitment: String(
                    vs.kcc20StateCommitment || vs.vprogStateRoot || ''
                ),
                tokenStandard: String(vs.tokenStandard || 'KRC-20')
            };
        }
        const compiled = compileSilverScriptProofOfLockVault({
            ticker: String(vs.tokenTicker || inspectedToken?.tick || mintSearchTicker || 'NACHO'),
            tokenStandard: vs.tokenStandard === 'KCC-20' ? 'KCC-20' : 'KRC-20',
            label: String(vs.label || 'Genesis Tranche'),
            beneficiaryAddress: String(vs.beneficiaryAddress || ''),
            totalAllocation: Number(vs.totalAllocated || 0),
            cliffDays: Number(vs.cliffDays || 0),
            linearDays: Number(vs.linearDays || 0)
        });
        return {
            covenantAddress: compiled.covenantAddress,
            silverscriptSource: compiled.silverscriptSource,
            kcc20StateCommitment: String(
                vs.kcc20StateCommitment ||
                    vs.vprogStateRoot ||
                    compiled.kcc20State.stateRootHex
            ),
            tokenStandard: compiled.tokenStandard
        };
    }

    function toggleVestingSilDrawer(vestingId: string) {
        expandedVestingSilRows = {
            ...expandedVestingSilRows,
            [vestingId]: !expandedVestingSilRows[vestingId]
        };
    }

    async function fetchKasplexTokenTelemetry(rawTicker: string) {
        const clean = rawTicker.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!clean) return null;
        const res = await fetch(
            `https://api.kasplex.org/v1/krc20/token/${encodeURIComponent(clean)}`,
            {
                headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000)
            }
        );
        if (!res.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Kasplex API returned HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        const entry = Array.isArray(data?.result) ? data.result[0] : data?.result;
        if (!entry || !entry.tick) return null;
        const rawState = String(entry.state || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const rawMax = String(entry.max || '0').trim();
        if (
            rawState === 'unused' ||
            rawState === 'not_found' ||
            (rawMax === '0' && !entry.hashRev && !entry.deployHash)
        ) {
            return null;
        }
        let priceUsd = 0;
        try {
            const mktRes = await fetch(
                `/api/krc20/market?ticker=${encodeURIComponent(clean)}`,
                { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000) }
            );
            if (mktRes.ok) {
                const mktData = await mktRes.json();
                priceUsd = Number(
                    mktData?.price?.usd ?? mktData?.priceUsd ?? mktData?.price ?? 0
                );
            }
        } catch {
            priceUsd = 0;
        }
        return {
            tick: String(entry.tick || clean).toUpperCase(),
            max: String(entry.max || '0'),
            lim: String(entry.lim || '0'),
            pre: String(entry.pre || '0'),
            to: String(entry.to || ''),
            dec: Number(entry.dec ?? 8),
            minted: String(entry.minted || '0'),
            opScoreAdd: String(entry.opScoreAdd || ''),
            opScoreMod: String(entry.opScoreMod || ''),
            state: String(entry.state || 'deployed'),
            hashRev: String(entry.hashRev || entry.deployHash || ''),
            mtsAdd: String(entry.mtsAdd || ''),
            holderTotal: Number(entry.holderTotal ?? entry.holders ?? 0),
            transferTotal: Number(entry.transferTotal ?? 0),
            mintTotal: Number(entry.mintTotal ?? 0),
            priceUsd
        };
    }

    async function fetchForgeTokenomicsForTicker(rawTicker: string) {
        const clean = rawTicker.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!clean) return;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'GET_FORGE_TOKENOMICS',
                    payload: {
                        ticker: clean,
                        includeAllMineableVaults: true
                    }
                })
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success && data.data) {
                    tokenomicsBundle = data.data;
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore offline telemetry fetch error
        }
    }

    export async function inspectKrc20TokenForMint() {
        const clean = mintSearchTicker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        mintSearchTicker = clean;
        if (clean.length < 4 || clean.length > 6) {
            inspectError = 'Enter a valid 4–6 character KRC-20 ticker (e.g. NACHO, SILO, PERX).';
            inspectedToken = null;
            return;
        }
        isInspectingToken = true;
        inspectError = '';
        try {
            const [token] = await Promise.all([
                fetchKasplexTokenTelemetry(clean),
                fetchForgeTokenomicsForTicker(clean)
            ]);
            if (!token) {
                inspectError = `Ticker "${clean}" is unclaimed on Kaspa (State: UNUSED). Switch to Mode 01 to deploy it!`;
                inspectedToken = null;
                return;
            }
            inspectedToken = token;
            if (!retroVestingAddress) {
                retroVestingAddress =
                    identity.activeAddress &&
                    validateKaspaBech32mAddress(identity.activeAddress).valid
                        ? identity.activeAddress
                        : deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress(`${clean}_team_lock`);
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            inspectError = err.message || 'Unable to query Kasplex indexer.';
            inspectedToken = null;
        } finally {
            isInspectingToken = false;
        }
    }

    async function submitRetroactiveUpgrade() {
        retroStatusBanner = null;
        const cleanTick = (inspectedToken?.tick || mintSearchTicker)
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase()
            .replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        if (cleanTick.length < 4 || cleanTick.length > 6) {
            retroStatusBanner = {
                type: 'error',
                message: 'Inspect a valid 4–6 character KRC-20 ticker first.'
            };
            return;
        }
        const resolvedLockAddr =
            retroVestingAddress.trim() ||
            identity.activeAddress ||
            deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress(`${cleanTick}_retro_vesting`);
        isApplyingRetroUpgrade = true;
        try {
            const maxSup = inspectedToken
                ? parseKasplexUnits(inspectedToken.max, inspectedToken.dec)
                : 28_700_000_000;
            const compiled = retroCompiledVault;
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'RETROACTIVE_FORGE_UPGRADE',
                    payload: {
                        ticker: cleanTick,
                        tokenStandard: retroTokenStandard,
                        maxSupply: maxSup,
                        isRetroactiveUpgrade: true,
                        protocolFeeKas: 1.5,
                        capTable:
                            retroVestingAmount > 0
                                ? [
                                      {
                                          address: resolvedLockAddr,
                                          covenantAddress: compiled.covenantAddress,
                                          silverscriptSource: compiled.silverscriptSource,
                                          redeemScriptHex: compiled.redeemScriptHex,
                                          kcc20StateCommitment:
                                              compiled.kcc20State.stateRootHex,
                                          vprogStateRoot:
                                              compiled.kcc20State.stateRootHex,
                                          tokenStandard: retroTokenStandard,
                                          amount: retroVestingAmount,
                                          label: retroVestingLabel,
                                          cliffDays: retroCliffDays,
                                          linearDays: retroLinearDays
                                      }
                                  ]
                                : [],
                        monetaryPolicy: {
                            burnRateBps: retroBurnRateBps,
                            burnAddress: KASPA_UNSPENDABLE_BURN_ADDRESS,
                            emissionScheduleType: 'CHROMATIC_HALVING',
                            dailyEmissionRate: 0,
                            halvingIntervalDays: 365,
                            reserveLockedTokens: 0,
                            zeroRugLpPct: 0,
                            zeroRugLockDays: 365
                        },
                        mineableVault: retroEnableMineableVault
                            ? {
                                  enabled: true,
                                  vaultLabel: `${cleanTick} Proof-of-Hashrate Syndicate Vault`,
                                  totalFundedTokens: retroMineableFunded,
                                  dailyEmissionTokens: retroMineableDaily,
                                  minHashrateThs: 0.1,
                                  syndicateSectorEnabled: true
                              }
                            : null
                    }
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (res.ok && data.success) {
                if (data.data?.tokenomics) {
                    tokenomicsBundle = data.data.tokenomics;
                } else {
                    await fetchForgeTokenomicsForTicker(cleanTick);
                }
                retroStatusBanner = {
                    type: 'success',
                    message: `✓ Retroactive ${retroTokenStandard} SilverScript Upgrade bound to ${cleanTick} (Vault: ${compiled.covenantAddress.slice(0, 22)}... • ${retroBurnRateBps} bps 22:00 UTC Auto-Burn + ${retroVestingAmount.toLocaleString()} Proof-of-Lock).`
                };
                ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                    'forge_header_badge',
                    `${cleanTick} RETRO UPGRADE ARMED ✓`,
                    '#18C6A5'
                );
            } else {
                retroStatusBanner = {
                    type: 'error',
                    message: data.error || 'Failed to register retroactive ecosystem upgrade.'
                };
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            retroStatusBanner = {
                type: 'error',
                message: err.message || 'Network error registering retroactive upgrade.'
            };
        } finally {
            isApplyingRetroUpgrade = false;
        }
    }

    onMount(() => {
        retroVestingAddress =
            identity.activeAddress &&
            validateKaspaBech32mAddress(identity.activeAddress).valid
                ? identity.activeAddress
                : deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress('nacho_community_lock');
        fetchForgeTokenomicsForTicker(mintSearchTicker);
    });
</script>

<script lang="ts">
    import { fade, slide } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { browser } from '$app/environment';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER } from '$lib/stores/treasury.svelte';
    import {
        KASPA_UNSPENDABLE_BURN_ADDRESS,
        validateKaspaBech32mAddress,
        parseCapTableCsv,
        deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress,
        compileSilverScriptProofOfLockVault,
        type CapTableEntry,
        type ForgeTokenStandard,
        type KasplexProtocolInfo
    } from '$lib/stores/transaction.svelte';

    let {
        kasplexInfo,
        isForging = false,
        forgeStatusMessage = '',
        onInspectExistingTicker = (_ticker: string, _token: any) => {},
        onExecuteDeploy = async (_config: any) => {}
    }: {
        kasplexInfo: KasplexProtocolInfo;
        isForging: boolean;
        forgeStatusMessage: string;
        onInspectExistingTicker?: (ticker: string, token: any) => void;
        onExecuteDeploy: (config: any) => Promise<void>;
    } = $props();

    // Token Standard Selector: Standard KRC-20 vs. KCC-20 + SilverScript Covenant
    let tokenStandard = $state<ForgeTokenStandard>('KRC-20');

    // Core KRC-20 / KCC-20 Deploy Parameters (Defaults to SILO for baseline verification)
    let deployTicker = $state(DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER);
    let deployMaxSupply = $state(21_000_000);
    let deployMintLimit = $state(1_000);
    let deployDecimals = $state(8);
    let deployPreAllocation = $state(0);
    let isCheckingTicker = $state(false);
    let tickerAvailability = $state<{
        checkedTicker: string;
        available: boolean;
        existingToken: any | null;
        error?: string;
    } | null>(null);

    // Unlimited Multi-Wallet Genesis Cap Table & Proof-of-Lock SilverScript Covenants
    let capTable = $state<CapTableEntry[]>([]);
    let expandedSilDrawers = $state<Record<string, boolean>>({});
    let showCsvImportDrawer = $state(false);
    let csvRawText = $state('');
    let csvImportFeedback = $state<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);
    let csvFileInputRef = $state<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

    let enableMonetaryCharter = $state(true);
    let burnRateBps = $state(50);
    let emissionScheduleType = $state<'CHROMATIC_HALVING' | 'PERIODIC_HALVING' | 'FLAT_TAIL'>(
        'CHROMATIC_HALVING'
    );
    let dailyEmissionRate = $state(5_000);
    let halvingIntervalDays = $state(365);
    let reserveLockedTokens = $state(2_100_000);
    let enableZeroRugLp = $state(true);
    let zeroRugLpPct = $state(85);
    let zeroRugInitialKas = $state(500);
    let zeroRugInitialTokens = $state(1_050_000);
    let enableMineableVault = $state(false);
    let mineableVaultLabel = $state('Perennia Proof-of-Hashrate Mining Vault');
    let mineableFundedTokens = $state(3_150_000);
    let mineableDailyEmission = $state(8_630);
    let mineableMinHashrateThs = $state(0.1);
    let syndicateSectorEnabled = $state(true);
    let charterSha256 = $state('');

    let totalCapTableTokens = $derived(
        capTable.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (Number(row.amount) || 0), 0)
    );
    let totalCapTablePct = $derived(
        deployMaxSupply > 0 ? (totalCapTableTokens / deployMaxSupply) * 100 : 0
    );
    let lockedCovenantTokens = $derived(
        capTable
            .filter((r) => r.cliffDays > 0 || r.linearDays > 0)
            .reduce((sum, r) => sum + (Number(r.amount) || 0), 0)
    );
    let allCapRowsValid = $derived(
        capTable.every((r) => r.checksumValid && r.amount > 0)
    );

    function enrichCapRowWithSilverScript(row: CapTableEntry): CapTableEntry {
        const cleanTicker = deployTicker.trim().toUpperCase() || DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER;
        const chk = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(row.address);
        const valid = chk.valid && row.amount > 0;
        const cliff = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.cliffDays) || 0));
        const linear = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.linearDays) || 0));

        if (!valid) {
            return {
                ...row,
                cliffDays: cliff,
                linearDays: linear,
                checksumValid: false,
                checksumError: chk.valid ? 'Amount must be > 0' : chk.error,
                tokenStandard
            };
        }

        const compiled = compileSilverScriptProofOfLockVault({
            ticker: cleanTicker,
            tokenStandard,
            label: row.label,
            beneficiaryAddress: chk.normalized,
            totalAllocation: row.amount,
            decimals: deployDecimals,
            cliffDays: cliff,
            linearDays: linear,
            charterSha256Hex: charterSha256 || undefined
        });

        return {
            ...row,
            address: chk.normalized,
            cliffDays: cliff,
            linearDays: linear,
            checksumValid: true,
            checksumError: undefined,
            covenantAddress: compiled.covenantAddress,
            silverscriptSource: compiled.silverscriptSource,
            redeemScriptHex: compiled.redeemScriptHex,
            kcc20StateCommitment: compiled.kcc20State.stateRootHex,
            vprogStateRoot: compiled.kcc20State.stateRootHex,
            tokenStandard
        };
    }

    function setTokenStandard(nextStandard: ForgeTokenStandard) {
        tokenStandard = nextStandard;
        if (capTable.length > 0) {
            capTable = capTable.map((r) => enrichCapRowWithSilverScript(r));
        }
    }

    function toggleSilDrawer(rowId: string) {
        expandedSilDrawers = {
            ...expandedSilDrawers,
            [rowId]: !expandedSilDrawers[rowId]
        };
    }

    // Synchronize deployPreAllocation with Cap Table + Reserve + Mining Vault
    $effect(() => {
        const capSum = totalCapTableTokens;
        const vaultSum = enableMineableVault ? Number(mineableFundedTokens || 0) : 0;
        if (capSum > 0 || vaultSum > 0) {
            deployPreAllocation = Math.min(deployMaxSupply, Math.round(capSum + vaultSum));
        }
    });

    // Compute live SHA-256 Monetary Policy Charter digest
    $effect(() => {
        const canonical = JSON.stringify({
            standard: tokenStandard,
            ticker: deployTicker.trim().toUpperCase() || DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER,
            maxSupply: deployMaxSupply,
            capTable: capTable.map((r) => ({
                address: r.address,
                covenantAddress: r.covenantAddress,
                amount: r.amount,
                label: r.label,
                cliffDays: r.cliffDays,
                linearDays: r.linearDays
            })),
            burnRateBps: enableMonetaryCharter ? burnRateBps : 0,
            burnAddress: KASPA_UNSPENDABLE_BURN_ADDRESS,
            emissionScheduleType,
            dailyEmissionRate: enableMonetaryCharter ? dailyEmissionRate : 0,
            halvingIntervalDays,
            reserveLockedTokens: enableMonetaryCharter ? reserveLockedTokens : 0,
            zeroRugLpPct: enableZeroRugLp ? zeroRugLpPct : 0,
            mineableVaultTokens: enableMineableVault ? mineableFundedTokens : 0
        });
        if (browser && window.crypto?.subtle) {
            window.crypto.subtle
                .digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(canonical))
                .then((buf) => {
                    const hex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf))
                        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
                        .join('');
                    charterSha256 = hex;
                })
                .catch(() => {});
        }
    });

    // Interactive 5-Year (60-Month) Supply Curve SVG Coordinates
    let supplyCurveTelemetry = $derived.by(() => {
        const width = 520;
        const height = 160;
        const months = 60;
        const maxSup = Math.max(1, Number(deployMaxSupply || 21_000_000));
        const initialUnlocked = Math.max(
            0,
            totalCapTableTokens - lockedCovenantTokens + (enableZeroRugLp ? zeroRugInitialTokens : 0)
        );
        const dailyVestingSum = capTable.reduce((acc, r) => {
            if (r.cliffDays > 0 || r.linearDays > 0) {
                const lin = Math.max(1, r.linearDays);
                return acc + r.amount / lin;
            }
            return acc;
        }, 0);
        const circulatingPoints: string[] = [];
        const emissionPoints: string[] = [];
        const burnedPoints: string[] = [];
        let cumulativeEmitted = 0;
        let cumulativeBurned = 0;
        let cumulativeVested = 0;
        for (let m = 0; m <= months; m++) {
            const day = m * 30.4375;
            if (m > 0) {
                const daysInStep = 30.4375;
                const vestStep = Math.min(
                    Math.max(0, lockedCovenantTokens - cumulativeVested),
                    dailyVestingSum * daysInStep
                );
                cumulativeVested += vestStep;
                if (enableMonetaryCharter && reserveLockedTokens > cumulativeEmitted) {
                    const decay =
                        emissionScheduleType === 'CHROMATIC_HALVING'
                            ? Math.pow(0.5, day / Math.max(30, halvingIntervalDays))
                            : emissionScheduleType === 'PERIODIC_HALVING'
                              ? Math.pow(0.5, Math.floor(day / Math.max(30, halvingIntervalDays)))
                              : 1.0;
                    const emitStep = Math.min(
                        reserveLockedTokens - cumulativeEmitted,
                        dailyEmissionRate * decay * daysInStep
                    );
                    cumulativeEmitted += emitStep;
                }
                if (enableMineableVault && mineableDailyEmission > 0) {
                    const mineStep = Math.min(
                        Math.max(0, mineableFundedTokens - cumulativeEmitted * 0.25),
                        mineableDailyEmission * daysInStep
                    );
                    cumulativeEmitted += mineStep * 0.5;
                }
                if (enableMonetaryCharter && burnRateBps > 0) {
                    const dailyBurn = maxSup * (burnRateBps / 10_000) * 0.0012;
                    cumulativeBurned = Math.min(
                        maxSup * 0.35,
                        cumulativeBurned + dailyBurn * daysInStep
                    );
                }
            }
            const netCirculating = Math.min(
                maxSup,
                Math.max(0, initialUnlocked + cumulativeVested + cumulativeEmitted - cumulativeBurned)
            );
            const x = (m / months) * width;
            const yCirc = height - Math.min(1, netCirculating / maxSup) * (height - 18) - 8;
            const yEmit =
                height -
                Math.min(1, (initialUnlocked + cumulativeVested + cumulativeEmitted) / maxSup) *
                    (height - 18) -
                8;
            const yBurn = height - Math.min(1, cumulativeBurned / maxSup) * (height - 18) - 8;
            circulatingPoints.push(`${x.toFixed(1)},${yCirc.toFixed(1)}`);
            emissionPoints.push(`${x.toFixed(1)},${yEmit.toFixed(1)}`);
            burnedPoints.push(`${x.toFixed(1)},${yBurn.toFixed(1)}`);
        }
        return {
            circulatingPath: `M ${circulatingPoints.join(' L ')}`,
            emissionPath: `M ${emissionPoints.join(' L ')}`,
            burnedPath: `M ${burnedPoints.join(' L ')}`,
            year5Burned: Math.round(cumulativeBurned),
            year5Emitted: Math.round(cumulativeEmitted)
        };
    });

    function formatTokenBaseUnits(humanAmount: number, decimals: number): string {
        const cleanAmount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(humanAmount) || 0));
        const clampedDec = Math.max(0, Math.min(18, Math.floor(Number(decimals) || 0)));
        const multiplier = 10n ** BigInt(clampedDec);
        return (BigInt(cleanAmount) * multiplier).toString();
    }

    function parseKasplexUnits(rawStr: string | number | undefined, dec = 8): number {
        if (rawStr === undefined || rawStr === null) return 0;
        const n = Number(rawStr);
        if (isNaN(n) || n <= 0) return 0;
        return n / Math.pow(10, dec);
    }

    async function fetchKasplexTokenTelemetry(rawTicker: string) {
        const clean = rawTicker.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!clean) return null;
        const res = await fetch(
            `https://api.kasplex.org/v1/krc20/token/${encodeURIComponent(clean)}`,
            {
                headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000)
            }
        );
        if (!res.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Kasplex API returned HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        const entry = Array.isArray(data?.result) ? data.result[0] : data?.result;
        if (!entry || !entry.tick) return null;
        const rawState = String(entry.state || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const rawMax = String(entry.max || '0').trim();
        if (
            rawState === 'unused' ||
            rawState === 'not_found' ||
            (rawMax === '0' && !entry.hashRev && !entry.deployHash)
        ) {
            return null;
        }
        return {
            tick: String(entry.tick || clean).toUpperCase(),
            max: String(entry.max || '0'),
            lim: String(entry.lim || '0'),
            pre: String(entry.pre || '0'),
            dec: Number(entry.dec ?? 8),
            minted: String(entry.minted || '0'),
            state: String(entry.state || 'deployed'),
            hashRev: String(entry.hashRev || entry.deployHash || ''),
            holderTotal: Number(entry.holderTotal ?? entry.holders ?? 0),
            transferTotal: Number(entry.transferTotal ?? 0),
            mintTotal: Number(entry.mintTotal ?? 0)
        };
    }

    async function checkDeployTickerAvailability() {
        const clean = deployTicker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        deployTicker = clean;
        if (clean.length < 4 || clean.length > 6) {
            tickerAvailability = {
                checkedTicker: clean,
                available: false,
                existingToken: null,
                error: 'KRC-20 / KCC-20 tickers must be 4 to 6 alphabetic characters (A–Z).'
            };
            return;
        }
        isCheckingTicker = true;
        try {
            const existing = await fetchKasplexTokenTelemetry(clean);
            if (existing) {
                tickerAvailability = {
                    checkedTicker: clean,
                    available: false,
                    existingToken: existing
                };
            } else {
                tickerAvailability = {
                    checkedTicker: clean,
                    available: true,
                    existingToken: null
                };
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            tickerAvailability = {
                checkedTicker: clean,
                available: false,
                existingToken: null,
                error: err.message || 'Kasplex indexer check failed.'
            };
        } finally {
            isCheckingTicker = false;
        }
    }

    function addCapTableRow(preset?: Partial<CapTableEntry>) {
        const defaultAddr =
            preset?.address ||
            deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress(`tranche_${capTable.length + 1}`);
        const check = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(defaultAddr);
        const amount = preset?.amount ?? Math.round(deployMaxSupply * 0.05);
        const pct = deployMaxSupply > 0 ? Number(((amount / deployMaxSupply) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 5;
        const baseRow: CapTableEntry = {
            id: `cap_${Date.now()}_${capTable.length}`,
            label: preset?.label || `Tranche #${capTable.length + 1}`,
            address: check.normalized || defaultAddr,
            amount,
            pctOfSupply: pct,
            cliffDays: preset?.cliffDays ?? 90,
            linearDays: preset?.linearDays ?? 365,
            checksumValid: check.valid && amount > 0,
            checksumError: check.error,
            tokenStandard
        };
        capTable = [...capTable, enrichCapRowWithSilverScript(baseRow)];
    }

    function loadInstitutionalCapTableTemplate() {
        const foundersAddr = deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress('perennia_founders_vault');
        const treasuryAddr =
            identity.activeAddress && validateKaspaBech32mAddress(identity.activeAddress).valid
                ? identity.activeAddress
                : deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress('perennia_treasury_vault');
        const investorsAddr = deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress('perennia_early_investors');
        const lpReserveAddr = deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress('perennia_lp_reserve');
        const templates = [
            {
                label: 'Founders & Core Architects',
                address: foundersAddr,
                pct: 15,
                cliffDays: 180,
                linearDays: 730
            },
            {
                label: 'Protocol Treasury Reserve',
                address: treasuryAddr,
                pct: 20,
                cliffDays: 90,
                linearDays: 365
            },
            {
                label: 'Early Syndicate Investors',
                address: investorsAddr,
                pct: 10,
                cliffDays: 30,
                linearDays: 180
            },
            {
                label: 'DEX Zero-Rug LP Vault',
                address: lpReserveAddr,
                pct: 25,
                cliffDays: 365,
                linearDays: 365
            }
        ];
        capTable = templates.map((t, idx) => {
            const amt = Math.round(deployMaxSupply * (t.pct / 100));
            const chk = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(t.address);
            return enrichCapRowWithSilverScript({
                id: `cap_tpl_${idx}`,
                label: t.label,
                address: chk.normalized,
                amount: amt,
                pctOfSupply: t.pct,
                cliffDays: t.cliffDays,
                linearDays: t.linearDays,
                checksumValid: chk.valid,
                checksumError: chk.error,
                tokenStandard
            });
        });
    }

    function removeCapTableRow(id: string) {
        capTable = capTable.filter((r) => r.id !== id);
    }

    function updateCapRowAddress(idx: number, rawAddr: string) {
        capTable = capTable.map((row, i) =>
            i === idx
                ? enrichCapRowWithSilverScript({
                      ...row,
                      address: rawAddr.trim().toLowerCase()
                  })
                : row
        );
    }

    function updateCapRowAmount(idx: number, rawAmtStr: string) {
        const amt = Math.max(0, parseFloat(rawAmtStr) || 0);
        const pct =
            deployMaxSupply > 0 ? Number(((amt / deployMaxSupply) * 100).toFixed(4)) : 0;
        capTable = capTable.map((row, i) => {
            if (i !== idx) return row;
            return enrichCapRowWithSilverScript({
                ...row,
                amount: amt,
                pctOfSupply: pct
            });
        });
    }

    function updateCapRowPct(idx: number, rawPctStr: string) {
        const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parseFloat(rawPctStr) || 0));
        const amt = Math.round(deployMaxSupply * (pct / 100));
        capTable = capTable.map((row, i) => {
            if (i !== idx) return row;
            return enrichCapRowWithSilverScript({
                ...row,
                pctOfSupply: pct,
                amount: amt
            });
        });
    }

    function updateCapRowLockSchedule(idx: number, nextCliff: number, nextLinear: number) {
        capTable = capTable.map((row, i) => {
            if (i !== idx) return row;
            return enrichCapRowWithSilverScript({
                ...row,
                cliffDays: Math.max(0, Math.floor(nextCliff || 0)),
                linearDays: Math.max(0, Math.floor(nextLinear || 0))
            });
        });
    }

    function handleImportCsvText() {
        csvImportFeedback = null;
        if (!csvRawText.trim()) {
            const addr1 = deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress('csv_founders_1');
            const addr2 = deriveDeterministicKaspaAddress('csv_treasury_2');
            csvRawText = `address,amount,label,cliff_days,linear_days\n${addr1},2100000,Founders Vault,180,365\n${addr2},1050000,Ecosystem Grants,90,180`;
        }
        const parsed = parseCapTableCsv(
            csvRawText,
            deployMaxSupply,
            deployTicker.trim().toUpperCase() || DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER,
            tokenStandard
        );
        if (parsed.entries.length > 0) {
            capTable = parsed.entries.map((r) => enrichCapRowWithSilverScript(r));
        }
        if (parsed.invalidCount > 0) {
            csvImportFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message: `Imported ${parsed.validCount} valid rows, ${parsed.invalidCount} failed Bech32m checksum: ${parsed.errors[0]}`
            };
        } else {
            csvImportFeedback = {
                type: 'success',
                message: `✓ Verified & imported ${parsed.validCount} Bech32m Cap Table rows (${parsed.totalAllocatedTokens.toLocaleString()} ${deployTicker}) with SilverScript P2SH vaults.`
            };
        }
    }

    async function handleCsvFileUpload(e: Event) {
        const input = e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement;
        const file = input.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;
        csvRawText = await file.text();
        showCsvImportDrawer = true;
        handleImportCsvText();
        input.value = '';
    }

    async function submitTokenomicsDeploy() {
        const enrichedCapTable = capTable.map((r) => enrichCapRowWithSilverScript(r));
        capTable = enrichedCapTable;
        await onExecuteDeploy({
            tokenStandard,
            ticker: deployTicker.trim().toUpperCase(),
            maxSupply: deployMaxSupply,
            mintLimit: deployMintLimit,
            decimals: deployDecimals,
            preAllocation: deployPreAllocation,
            capTable: enrichedCapTable,
            monetaryPolicy: enableMonetaryCharter
                ? {
                      burnRateBps,
                      burnAddress: KASPA_UNSPENDABLE_BURN_ADDRESS,
                      emissionScheduleType,
                      dailyEmissionRate,
                      halvingIntervalDays,
                      reserveLockedTokens,
                      zeroRugLpPct: enableZeroRugLp ? zeroRugLpPct : 0,
                      zeroRugLockDays: 365,
                      zeroRugInitialKas: enableZeroRugLp ? zeroRugInitialKas : 0,
                      zeroRugInitialTokens: enableZeroRugLp ? zeroRugInitialTokens : 0,
                      charterSha256
                  }
                : null,
            mineableVault: enableMineableVault
                ? {
                      enabled: true,
                      vaultLabel: mineableVaultLabel,
                      totalFundedTokens: mineableFundedTokens,
                      dailyEmissionTokens: mineableDailyEmission,
                      minHashrateThs: mineableMinHashrateThs,
                      syndicateSectorEnabled
                  }
                : null,
            charterSha256
        });
    }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { operations } from '$lib/stores/operations.svelte';
    import { treasury } from '$lib/stores/treasury.svelte';
    import type { AssetBucketTelemetry } from '$lib/stores/type';
    let {
        displayHashrate = 0,
        effortData = { segments: [], totalHash: 0 },
        displayedBuckets = []
    }: {
        displayHashrate: number;
        effortData: {
            segments: Array<{
                id: string;
                name: string;
                pct: number;
                offset: number;
                hex: string;
            }>;
            totalHash: number;
        };
        displayedBuckets: AssetBucketTelemetry[];
    } = $props();
    let userRoutedAssets = $derived.by(() => {
        const routed = new Set<string>();
        for (const sec of operations.sectors || []) {
            if (
                (sec.allocationPercentage || 0) <= 0 &&
                (sec.pendingKaspa || 0) <= 0
            ) {
                continue;
            }
            const primary = sec.settlementConfig?.targetAsset?.ticker;
            if (primary && primary.trim().toUpperCase() !== 'KAS') {
                routed.add(primary.trim().toUpperCase());
            }
            if (Array.isArray(sec.settlementConfig?.targetAssets)) {
                for (const t of sec.settlementConfig.targetAssets) {
                    const tick = t?.ticker?.trim().toUpperCase();
                    if (tick && tick !== 'KAS') {
                        routed.add(tick);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (
                sec.settlementConfig?.plantWeights &&
                typeof sec.settlementConfig.plantWeights === 'object'
            ) {
                for (const k of Object.keys(sec.settlementConfig.plantWeights)) {
                    const tick = k.trim().toUpperCase();
                    if (tick && tick !== 'KAS') {
                        routed.add(tick);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return routed;
    });
    let userActiveBuckets = $derived(
        displayedBuckets.filter((b) => {
            const ticker = String(b.asset || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            return ticker !== 'KAS' && userRoutedAssets.has(ticker);
        })
    );
</script>

export function captureTutorialSnapshot(): TutorialStateSnapshot {
    return {
        activeTab: ui.activeTab || 'OPERATIONS',
        sectors: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(ops.sectors || [])),
        workers: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(ops.workers || []))
    };
}

export function restoreTutorialSnapshot(
    snapshot: TutorialStateSnapshot | null
): void {
    if (!snapshot) return;
    if (snapshot.activeTab) {
        ui.activeTab = snapshot.activeTab as any;
    }
}

export function measureTargetBoundingRect(
    targetSelector?: string,
    fallbackSelector?: string,
    padding = 8
): TutorialBoundingBox {
    if (!browser) {
        return { top: 0, left: 0, width: 0, height: 0, found: false };
    }

    let el: Element | null = null;
    if (targetSelector) {
        el = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
    }
    if (!el && fallbackSelector) {
        el = document.querySelector(fallbackSelector);
    }

    if (!el) {
        return { top: 0, left: 0, width: 0, height: 0, found: false };
    }

    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) {
        return { top: 0, left: 0, width: 0, height: 0, found: false };
    }

    return {
        top: Math.max(8, rect.top - padding),
        left: Math.max(8, rect.left - padding),
        width: Math.min(window.innerWidth - 16, rect.width + padding * 2),
        height: Math.min(window.innerHeight - 16, rect.height + padding * 2),
        found: true
    };
}

export async function syncTutorialStepDom(
    step: TutorialStep
): Promise<TutorialBoundingBox> {
    if (!browser) {
        return { top: 0, left: 0, width: 0, height: 0, found: false };
    }

    if (step.tab && ui.activeTab !== step.tab) {
        ui.activeTab = step.tab as any;
    }

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 120));

    const targetEl =
        (step.targetSelector
            ? document.querySelector(step.targetSelector)
            : null) ||
        (step.fallbackSelector
            ? document.querySelector(step.fallbackSelector)
            : null);

    if (
        targetEl &&
        typeof (targetEl as HTMLElement).scrollIntoView === 'function'
    ) {
        try {
            (targetEl as HTMLElement).scrollIntoView({
                behavior: 'smooth',
                block: 'nearest'
            });
        } catch {
            // Ignore scrollIntoView notice
        }
    }

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 140));

    return measureTargetBoundingRect(
        step.targetSelector,
        step.fallbackSelector,
        step.highlightPadding ?? 8
    );
}

<script lang="ts">
    import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
    import { browser } from '$app/environment';
    import { fade, scale } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
    import { ops } from '$lib/stores/operations.svelte';
    import { treasury } from '$lib/stores/treasury.svelte';
    import {
        TUTORIAL_STEPS,
        TUTORIAL_WIRE_PREVIEW,
        captureTutorialSnapshot,
        restoreTutorialSnapshot,
        syncTutorialStepDom,
        measureTargetBoundingRect,
        type TutorialStep,
        type TutorialBoundingBox,
        type TutorialStateSnapshot
    } from '$lib/components/tutorial/tutorialDomSync';

    let {
        isOpen = undefined,
        onClose = undefined
    }: {
        isOpen?: boolean;
        onClose?: () => void;
    } = $props();

    let currentStepIndex = $state(0);
    let isTransitioning = $state(false);
    let snapshotBeforeTutorial = $state<TutorialStateSnapshot | null>(null);
    let spotlightRect = $state<TutorialBoundingBox>({
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        width: 0,
        height: 0,
        found: false
    });

    let isTutorialActive = $derived(
        typeof isOpen === 'boolean'
            ? isOpen
            : Boolean((ui as any).showTutorial || (ui as any).isTutorialOpen)
    );

    let activeStep = $derived<TutorialStep>(
        TUTORIAL_STEPS[currentStepIndex] || TUTORIAL_STEPS[0]
    );

    let progressPct = $derived(
        ((currentStepIndex + 1) / TUTORIAL_STEPS.length) * 100
    );

    let kasSpotUsd = $derived(treasury.getAsset('KAS').spotPrice || 0.15);

    let sampleUsdcBucket = $derived(
        (ops as any).epochTelemetry?.buckets?.['USDC'] ||
            ((ops as any).allGlobalBuckets || (ops as any).displayedBuckets || []).find(
                (b: any) => b.asset === 'USDC'
            ) ||
            null
    );

    async function activateStep(index: number) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= TUTORIAL_STEPS.length) return;
        isTransitioning = true;
        currentStepIndex = index;
        const step = TUTORIAL_STEPS[index];
        try {
            spotlightRect = await syncTutorialStepDom(step);
        } finally {
            isTransitioning = false;
        }
    }

    function handleNextStep() {
        if (currentStepIndex < TUTORIAL_STEPS.length - 1) {
            activateStep(currentStepIndex + 1);
        } else {
            handleCloseTutorial(false);
        }
    }

    function handlePrevStep() {
        if (currentStepIndex > 0) {
            activateStep(currentStepIndex - 1);
        }
    }

    function handleCloseTutorial(restorePreviousTab = false) {
        if (restorePreviousTab && snapshotBeforeTutorial) {
            restoreTutorialSnapshot(snapshotBeforeTutorial);
        }
        if (typeof (ui as any).showTutorial === 'boolean') {
            (ui as any).showTutorial = false;
        }
        if (typeof (ui as any).isTutorialOpen === 'boolean') {
            (ui as any).isTutorialOpen = false;
        }
        if (typeof (ui as any).closeTutorial === 'function') {
            (ui as any).closeTutorial();
        }
        if (typeof onClose === 'function') {
            onClose();
        }
        if (browser) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('perennia_tutorial_completed', 'true');
            } catch {
                // Ignore storage quota notice
            }
        }
    }

    function refreshSpotlightPosition() {
        if (!browser || !isTutorialActive) return;
        const step = TUTORIAL_STEPS[currentStepIndex];
        if (!step) return;
        spotlightRect = measureTargetBoundingRect(
            step.targetSelector,
            step.fallbackSelector,
            step.highlightPadding ?? 8
        );
    }

    function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
        if (!isTutorialActive) return;
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleCloseTutorial(true);
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleNextStep();
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
            e.preventDefault();
            handlePrevStep();
        }
    }

    $effect(() => {
        if (browser && isTutorialActive) {
            if (!snapshotBeforeTutorial) {
                snapshotBeforeTutorial = captureTutorialSnapshot();
            }
            activateStep(currentStepIndex);
        }
    });

    onMount(() => {
        if (!browser) return;
        window.addEventListener('resize', refreshSpotlightPosition);
        window.addEventListener('scroll', refreshSpotlightPosition, true);
        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        if (!browser) return;
        window.removeEventListener('resize', refreshSpotlightPosition);
        window.removeEventListener('scroll', refreshSpotlightPosition, true);
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
    });
</script>

// WINDOWS (FRONTEND): C:\Users\send2\perennia-v5\perennia-frontend\src\lib\stores\tutorialRegistry.ts
import type { Worker, Sector } from './type';

export type TutorialInteractionMode = 'ACTION' | 'READ';
export type ChevronPlacement = 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';

export interface TutorialRelayStepSpec {
    id: string;
    chapter: number;
    stepIndex: number;
    totalChapterSteps: number;
    tab: string;

    targetSelector: string;

}

import { json, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';

import { dbPool } from '$lib/server/db';



export const POST = async ({ request }: RequestEvent) => {

    try {

        const { code } = await request.json();

        if (!code) return json({ error: 'ACCESS PROTOCOL REQUIRED' }, { status: 400 });



        const client = await dbPool.connect();

        try {

            const res = await client.query('SELECT * FROM invite_codes WHERE code = $1 AND is_used = false', [code.trim()]);

            if (res.rows.length === 0) {

                return json({ error: 'INVALID OR BURNED PROTOCOL CODE' }, { status: 403 });

            }

            return json({ success: true });

        } finally {

            client.release();

        }

    } catch (e) {

        return json({ error: 'DATABASE ROUTING FAULT' }, { status: 500 });

    }

};

export interface ReadinessCheckItem {
    id: string;

        | 'INFRASTRUCTURE'
        | 'CONSENSUS_STRATUM'
        | 'ORACLE_FX'
        | 'FIAT_GATEWAYS'
        | 'TREASURY_SECURITY';

function resolveRustBackendBase(): string {
    return (
        env.RUST_BACKEND_URL ||
        env.BACKEND_URL ||
        'http://127.0.0.1:8002'
    ).replace(/\/+$/, '');
}
function buildInternalAuthHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
    const token = (
        env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN ||
        env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY ||
        ''
    ).trim();
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    };
    if (token) {
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    return headers;
}
function isValidHexPrivateKey(raw: string | undefined): boolean {
    if (!raw) return false;
    const clean = raw.trim().replace(/^0x/i, '');
    return /^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(clean);
}
function isValidKaspaAddress(raw: string | undefined): boolean {
    if (!raw) return false;
    const clean = raw.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^kaspa:/, '');
    return clean.length >= 55 && clean.length <= 75;
}
async function executeDbQuery(sql: string): Promise<{ rows?: any[] }> {
    const mod = dbMod as Record<string, any>;
    if (typeof mod.dbPool?.query === 'function') {
        return mod.dbPool.query(sql);
    }
    if (typeof mod.pool?.query === 'function') {
        return mod.pool.query(sql);
    }
    if (typeof mod.query === 'function') {
        return mod.query(sql);
    }
    if (typeof mod.db?.query === 'function') {
        return mod.db.query(sql);
    }
    if (typeof mod.default?.query === 'function') {
        return mod.default.query(sql);
    }
    throw new Error('No query function exported from $lib/server/db');
}

                    'fiat_payout_queue',

        const blocksCount = Number(row.blocks_count || 0);
        pgOnline = coreTables >= 5;

    } catch (err: any) {

        pgDetail = `PostgreSQL error: ${err?.message || 'connection failed'}`;

File: src/routes/api/sor/l1_dispatch/+server.ts

import { json, type RequestHandler, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import { env } from '$env/dynamic/private';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import {
    executeOrQueueL1Dispatch,
    normalizeKaspaBase32
} from '$lib/server/l1Dispatcher';

async function isAuthorizedDispatcherCall(
    request: Request,
    cookies: RequestEvent['cookies']
): Promise<{ authorized: boolean; callerWallet: string }> {
    const providedAuth = request.headers.get('authorization') || '';
    const validCandidates = [
        env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY ? `Bearer ${env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY.trim()}` : '',
        env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN ? `Bearer ${env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN.trim()}` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);

    if (providedAuth && validCandidates.length > 0) {
        const providedBuffer = Buffer.from(providedAuth);
        const matched = validCandidates.some((expected) => {
            const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expected);
            return (
                expectedBuffer.length === providedBuffer.length &&
                crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, providedBuffer)
            );
        });
        if (matched) {
            return { authorized: true, callerWallet: 'kaspa:internal_daemon' };
        }
    }

    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    if (sessionId) {
        const sessionWallet = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);
        if (sessionWallet) {
            return { authorized: true, callerWallet: sessionWallet };
        }
    }

    return { authorized: false, callerWallet: '' };
}

export const POST: RequestHandler = async ({ request, cookies }: RequestEvent) => {
    const auth = await isAuthorizedDispatcherCall(request, cookies);
    if (!auth.authorized) {
        return json(
            {
                error: 'UNAUTHORIZED: Valid INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN or Sovereign session required.'
            },
            { status: 401 }
        );
    }

    try {
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const rawWallet = String(body.wallet || auth.callerWallet || '').trim();
        const asset = String(body.asset || body.targetAsset || 'KAS')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase();
        const amount = Number(body.amount || body.amountTokens || 0);
        const destinationAddress = String(
            body.destination ||
                body.destinationAddress ||
                body.payoutAddress ||
                rawWallet
        ).trim();
        const sourceType = String(body.sourceType || 'ledger_withdrawal').trim();
        const spotPrice = Number(body.spotPrice || 0);

        if (!rawWallet || !destinationAddress || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) {
            return json(
                {
                    error: 'INVALID_DISPATCH_PAYLOAD: wallet, destinationAddress, and positive amount are required.'
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        if (
            auth.callerWallet !== 'kaspa:internal_daemon' &&
            normalizeKaspaBase32(auth.callerWallet) !== normalizeKaspaBase32(rawWallet)
        ) {
            return json(
                { error: 'FORBIDDEN: Cannot dispatch L1 payout for another wallet.' },
                { status: 403 }
            );
        }

        const result = await executeOrQueueL1Dispatch({
            wallet: rawWallet,
            destinationAddress,
            asset,
            amount,
            sourceType,
            spotPrice: spotPrice > 0 ? spotPrice : undefined
        });

        return json(result, { status: 200 });
    } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('🚨 [L1 DISPATCHER FAULT]:', err);
        const message = err?.message || 'Multi-chain L1 settlement dispatch failed.';
        const status =
            message.includes('ORACLE_HALT') ||
            message.includes('CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIPPED') ||
            message.includes('CRITICAL_SECURITY_LOCKDOWN')
                ? 503
                : message.includes('WALLET_QUARANTINED') ||
                    message.includes('SOLVENCY_INVARIANT_VIOLATION') ||
                    message.includes('LEDGER_HMAC_VIOLATION')
                  ? 403
                  : 500;
        return json({ error: message }, { status });
    }
};

File: src/routes/api/state/stats/+server.ts

import { json, type RequestHandler, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import { dbPool } from '$lib/server/db';
import {
    isWalletMasterAdmin,
    normalizeKaspaBase32Strict
} from '$lib/server/kms';

const KASPA_DIFF_CONSTANT = 4_294_967_296.0;

export const GET: RequestHandler = async ({ cookies, url }: RequestEvent) => {
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    if (!sessionId) {
        return json({ error: 'UNAUTHORIZED_MATRIX_ACCESS' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const sessionWalletRaw = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);
    if (!sessionWalletRaw) {
        return json({ error: 'SESSION_EXPIRED' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const isDirector = isWalletMasterAdmin(sessionWalletRaw);
    const requestedTarget = url.searchParams.get('target');
    const effectiveWallet =
        isDirector && requestedTarget && requestedTarget.trim()
            ? requestedTarget.trim()
            : sessionWalletRaw;

    const cleanSessionWallet = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(effectiveWallet);
    const timeframe = String(url.searchParams.get('timeframe') || '1H')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    try {
        const workerKeys = await redis.smembers('pool:workers');
        const workers = [];
        let isolatedHashrate = 0;

        for (const fullIdentity of workerKeys) {
            const nameParts = fullIdentity.split('.');
            const rawWalletAddress = nameParts[0];
            const cleanWorkerWallet = rawWalletAddress
                .toLowerCase()
                .replace(/kaspa:/i, '')
                .trim();
            const workerName =
                nameParts.length > 1
                    ? nameParts.slice(1).join('.')
                    : fullIdentity;

            if (
                cleanWorkerWallet !== cleanSessionWallet &&
                !fullIdentity.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSessionWallet)
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            const [hashRateStr, blocksStr, sharesStr] = await Promise.all([
                redis.get(`worker:${fullIdentity}:hashrate`),
                redis.get(`worker:${fullIdentity}:blocks`),
                redis.get(`worker:${fullIdentity}:shares`)
            ]);

            const rate = parseFloat(hashRateStr || '0');
            isolatedHashrate += rate;

            workers.push({
                name: workerName,
                walletAddress: rawWalletAddress,
                fullIdentity,
                trackingRate: rate,
                blocksFound: parseInt(blocksStr || '0', 10),
                sharesContributed: parseInt(sharesStr || '0', 10)
            });
        }

        const currentThs = Number((isolatedHashrate / 1e12).toFixed(4));
        const nowSec = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        const windowSec =
            timeframe === '1H'
                ? 3600
                : timeframe === '7D'
                  ? 7 * 86400
                  : timeframe === '30D'
                    ? 30 * 86400
                    : 86400;
        const cutoffSec = nowSec - windowSec;

        const rawWalletHistory = await redis
            .lrange(`perennia:hashrate:history:${cleanSessionWallet}`, 0, -1)
            .catch(() => [] as string[]);

        let historyPoints: number[] = rawWalletHistory
            .map((s) => {
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(s);
                } catch {
                    return null;
                }
            })
            .filter((p) => p && Number(p.ts || 0) >= cutoffSec)
            .map((p) => Number(p.hashrateThs || 0));

        if (historyPoints.length < 2) {
            try {
                const bucketSeconds =
                    timeframe === '1H'
                        ? 120
                        : timeframe === '24H'
                          ? 1800
                          : timeframe === '7D'
                            ? 14400
                            : 86400;
                const dbRes = await dbPool.query(
                    `SELECT
                        FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM recorded_at) / $1) * $1 AS bucket_ts,
                        SUM(difficulty) AS total_diff
                     FROM micro_shares
                     WHERE is_valid = TRUE
                       AND LOWER(worker_identity) LIKE $2
                       AND recorded_at >= NOW() - ($3::text || ' seconds')::interval
                     GROUP BY bucket_ts
                     ORDER BY bucket_ts ASC
                     LIMIT 60`,
                    [
                        bucketSeconds,
                        `%${cleanSessionWallet}%`,
                        windowSec.toString()
                    ]
                );
                if (dbRes.rows.length >= 2) {
                    historyPoints = dbRes.rows.map((r) => {
                        const totalDiff = Number(r.total_diff || 0);
                        const hashes = totalDiff * KASPA_DIFF_CONSTANT;
                        return Number(
                            (hashes / bucketSeconds / 1e12).toFixed(4)
                        );
                    });
                }
            } catch {
                // Fall back to global Redis series or live worker rate
            }
        }

        if (historyPoints.length < 2) {
            const rawGlobal = await redis
                .lrange('perennia:hashrate:history:global', 0, -1)
                .catch(() => [] as string[]);
            const globalFiltered = rawGlobal
                .map((s) => {
                    try {
                        return JSON.parse(s);
                    } catch {
                        return null;
                    }
                })
                .filter((p) => p && Number(p.ts || 0) >= cutoffSec)
                .map((p) => Number(p.hashrateThs || 0));

            if (globalFiltered.length >= 2 && currentThs > 0) {
                historyPoints = globalFiltered;
            } else if (currentThs > 0) {
                const sampleCount =
                    timeframe === '1H'
                        ? 15
                        : timeframe === '24H'
                          ? 24
                          : timeframe === '7D'
                            ? 28
                            : 30;
                historyPoints = Array.from(
                    { length: sampleCount },
                    () => currentThs
                );
            }
        }

        if (currentThs > 0) {
            historyPoints = [...historyPoints.slice(-59), currentThs];
        }

        return json({
            status: 'ONLINE',
            timeframe,
            pool: { totalHashrate: isolatedHashrate },
            workers,
            hashrateHistoryThs: historyPoints
        });
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Redis Telemetry Fetch Error:', error);
        return json(
            {
                error: 'Failed to read node telemetry.',
                timeframe,
                pool: { totalHashrate: 0 },
                workers: [],
                hashrateHistoryThs: []
            },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    }
};

import { json, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';

import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';



export const GET = async ({ url, cookies, setHeaders }: RequestEvent) => {

    // ⚡ ZERO-TRUST: Require and decode the encrypted HTTP-only session cookie

    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');

    if (!sessionId) {

        return json({ error: 'UNAUTHORIZED_MATRIX_ACCESS' }, { status: 401 });

    }



    const rawAddress = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);

    if (!rawAddress) {

        return json({ error: 'SESSION_EXPIRED_OR_INVALID' }, { status: 401 });

    }



    const sessionWallet = rawAddress.toLowerCase().replace('kaspa:', '').trim();

    const requestedWallet = url.searchParams.get('wallet')?.toLowerCase().replace('kaspa:', '').trim();



    // Prevent cross-wallet snooping

    if (sessionWallet !== requestedWallet) {

        return json({ error: 'FORBIDDEN_ADDRESS_QUERY' }, { status: 403 });

    }



    setHeaders({

        'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'

    });



    try {

        const raw = await redis.get(`dev:treasury:preferences:${sessionWallet}`);

        if (raw) {

            return json({ preferences: JSON.parse(raw) });

        }

        return json({ preferences: null });

    } catch (e: any) {

        console.warn('Treasury preferences Redis read fault:', e.message);

        return json({ preferences: null });

    }

};



export const POST = async ({ request, cookies }: RequestEvent) => {

    // ⚡ ZERO-TRUST: Require the session cookie for writes

    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');

    if (!sessionId) {

        return json({ error: 'UNAUTHORIZED_STATE_MUTATION' }, { status: 401 });

    }



    const rawAddress = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);

    if (!rawAddress) {

        return json({ error: 'SESSION_EXPIRED_OR_INVALID' }, { status: 401 });

    }



    const sessionWallet = rawAddress.toLowerCase().replace('kaspa:', '').trim();



    try {

        const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));

        const { walletAddress, preferences } = body;



        if (!walletAddress || !preferences) {

            return json({ error: 'Missing walletAddress or preferences' }, { status: 400 });

        }



        const requestWallet = walletAddress.toLowerCase().replace('kaspa:', '').trim();



        // Prevent cross-wallet state corruption

        if (sessionWallet !== requestWallet) {

            return json({ error: 'FORBIDDEN_STATE_MUTATION' }, { status: 403 });

        }



        await redis.set(`dev:treasury:preferences:${sessionWallet}`, JSON.stringify(preferences));



        return json({ success: true });

    } catch (e: any) {

        console.error('Treasury preferences Redis write fault:', e.message);

        return json({ error: 'Internal Server Error' }, { status: 500 });

    }

};
