    { countryCode: 'US', stateRegion: 'TX', entityType: 'LLC', filingStatus: 'SINGLE', rate: 15.0 },
    { countryCode: 'US', stateRegion: 'FL', entityType: 'S-CORP', filingStatus: 'MFJ', rate: 14.2 },
    { countryCode: 'US', stateRegion: 'WY', entityType: 'LLC', filingStatus: 'SINGLE', rate: 15.0 },
    { countryCode: 'PR', stateRegion: 'TX', entityType: 'LLC', filingStatus: 'SINGLE', rate: 4.0 }
] as const;

interface SimulatedMinerSeat {
    seatIndex: number;
    privateKeyBytes: Uint8Array;
    privateKeyHex: string;
    pubKeyX: Uint8Array;
    kaspaAddress: string;
    sessionCookie?: string;
}

function bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    return Array.from(bytes)
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('');
}

function encodeKaspaAddressFromPubkey(pubKeyX: Uint8Array): string {
    const polymod = (values: number[]) => {
        let c = 1n;
        for (const v of values) {
            const c0 = c >> 35n;
            c = ((c & 0x07ffffffffn) << 5n) ^ BigInt(v);
            if (c0 & 1n) c ^= 0x98f2bc8e61n;
            if (c0 & 2n) c ^= 0x79b76d99e2n;
            if (c0 & 4n) c ^= 0xf33e5fb3c4n;
            if (c0 & 8n) c ^= 0xae2eabe2a8n;
            if (c0 & 16n) c ^= 0x1e4f43e470n;
        }
        return c ^ 1n;
    };
    const prefix = 'kaspa';
    const prefixValues = prefix
        .split('')
        .map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 31)
        .concat([0]);
    const payload = [0, ...pubKeyX];
    let acc = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    const payload5: number[] = [];
    for (const byte of payload) {
        acc = (acc << 8) | byte;
        bits += 8;
        while (bits >= 5) {
            bits -= 5;
            payload5.push((acc >> bits) & 31);
        }
    }
    if (bits > 0) payload5.push((acc << (5 - bits)) & 31);
    const mod = polymod([...prefixValues, ...payload5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
    const checksum = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((i) =>
        Number((mod >> BigInt(5 * (7 - i))) & 31n)
    );
    return (
        prefix +
        ':' +
        [...payload5, ...checksum].map((v) => KASPA_CHARSET[v]).join('')
    );
}

function deriveDeterministicMinerSeat(seatIndex: number): SimulatedMinerSeat {
    const seedMaterial = `perennia-v4-zero-fee-rehearsal-seat-${seatIndex
        .toString()
        .padStart(4, '0')}`;
    const privBytes = blake2b(new TextEncoder().encode(seedMaterial), { dkLen: 32 });
    const pubKeyX = schnorr.getPublicKey(privBytes);
    const kaspaAddress = encodeKaspaAddressFromPubkey(pubKeyX);
    return {
        seatIndex,
        privateKeyBytes: privBytes,
        privateKeyHex: bytesToHex(privBytes),
        pubKeyX,
        kaspaAddress
    };
}

async function authenticateSeatViaSchnorr(
    request: APIRequestContext,
    seat: SimulatedMinerSeat
): Promise<string> {
    const challengeRes = await request.post('/api/auth/challenge', {
        data: { address: seat.kaspaAddress }
    });
    expect(challengeRes.ok()).toBeTruthy();
    const { message } = await challengeRes.json();
    expect(message).toContain(seat.kaspaAddress);

    const msgHash = blake2b(new TextEncoder().encode(message), { dkLen: 32 });
    const sigBytes = schnorr.sign(msgHash, seat.privateKeyBytes);
    const signatureHex = bytesToHex(sigBytes);

    const authRes = await request.post('/api/auth', {
        data: {
            address: seat.kaspaAddress,
            signature: signatureHex,
            message,
            provider: 'sovereign'
        }
    });
    expect(authRes.ok()).toBeTruthy();
    const setCookieHeader = authRes.headers()['set-cookie'] || '';
    const match = setCookieHeader.match(/perennia_session=([^;]+)/);
    const sessionToken = match ? match[1] : '';
    expect(sessionToken.length).toBeGreaterThan(16);
    seat.sessionCookie = `perennia_session=${sessionToken}`;
    return seat.sessionCookie;
}

async function executeZeroFeeMinerWorkflow(
    request: APIRequestContext,
    seat: SimulatedMinerSeat
) {
    const cookieHeader = await authenticateSeatViaSchnorr(request, seat);
    const headers = { Cookie: cookieHeader };

    const asic = ASIC_CATALOG_ROTATION[seat.seatIndex % ASIC_CATALOG_ROTATION.length];
    const targetAsset =
        TARGET_ASSET_ROTATION[seat.seatIndex % TARGET_ASSET_ROTATION.length];
    const bankSpec = VALID_ABA_BANKS[seat.seatIndex % VALID_ABA_BANKS.length];
    const taxSpec =
        TAX_JURISDICTION_ROTATION[seat.seatIndex % TAX_JURISDICTION_ROTATION.length];

    const workerId = `REHEARSAL-W-${seat.seatIndex.toString().padStart(3, '0')}`;
    const workerName = `RIG-${seat.seatIndex.toString().padStart(3, '0')}`;
    const cleanAddr = seat.kaspaAddress.replace(/^kaspa:/i, '');

    // 1. Provision ASIC Worker
    const workerRes = await request.post('/api/state/action', {
        headers,
        data: {
            action: 'ADD_WORKER',
            payload: {
                id: workerId,
                type: 'physical',
                name: workerName,
                stratumUrl: `${STRATUM_BASE}:${asic.port}`,
                walletWorker: `kaspa:${cleanAddr}.${workerName}`,
                hashRate: 0,
                isOnline: false,
                hardwareType: asic.model,
                sharesContributed: 0,
                validShares: 0,
                rejectedShares: 0,
                acceptancePct: 100.0,
                blocksFound: 0
            }
        }
    });
    expect(workerRes.ok()).toBe(true);

    // 2. Deploy 22:00 UTC Settlement Silo (pendingKaspa: 0 -> $0.00 L1 Spend)
    const sectorId = `REHEARSAL-S-${seat.seatIndex.toString().padStart(3, '0')}`;
    const sectorRes = await request.post('/api/state/action', {
        headers,
        data: {
            action: 'ADD_SECTOR',
            payload: {
                id: sectorId,
                name: `SILO-${targetAsset.ticker}-${seat.seatIndex}`,
                allocationPercentage: 50.0,
                routeMode: targetAsset.ticker === 'KAS' ? 'hold' : 'swap',
                settlementConfig: {
                    targetAsset: {
                        ticker: targetAsset.ticker,
                        name: targetAsset.name,
                        assetClass: targetAsset.assetClass,
                        spotPrice: ({KAS:0.15,USDC:1,BTC:95000,ETH:3200,SOL:180,USD:1}[targetAsset.ticker] || 1),
                        theme: { hex: targetAsset.hex, pastel: '#99f6e4' }
                    },
                    payoutAddress: seat.kaspaAddress,
                    autoPayout: true,
                    mode: 'epoch',
                    threshold: 50.0,
                    appointmentDate: '',
                    appointmentTime: '17:00'
                },
                pendingKaspa: 0.0,
                width: 6
            }
        }
    });
    expect(sectorRes.ok()).toBe(true);

    // 3. Save AES-256-GCM Bank Rail Vault ($0.00 Local Cipher)
    const accountNum = `880011${seat.seatIndex.toString().padStart(4, '0')}`;
    const saveRailRes = await request.post('/api/fiat/offramp', {
        headers,
        data: {
            action: 'SAVE_BANK_RAIL',
            wallet: seat.kaspaAddress,
            bankLabel: bankSpec.label,
            accountType: 'CHECKING',
            payoutMethod: 'ACH',
            routingNumber: bankSpec.routing,
            accountNumber: accountNum
        }
    });
    expect(saveRailRes.ok()).toBe(true);

    // 4. Pre-Flight Fiat Off-Ramp Quote ($0.00, No Debit, No L1 TX)
    const preFlightRes = await request.post('/api/fiat/offramp', {
        headers,
        data: {
            wallet: seat.kaspaAddress,
            grossUsd: 500, routingNumber: bankSpec.routing, accountNumber: accountNum,
            sourceMode: 'onchain_kas',
            sourceAsset: 'KAS',
            payoutMethod: 'ach',
            bankLabel: bankSpec.label,
            accountType: 'CHECKING',
            preFlightOnly: true
        }
    });
    expect(preFlightRes.ok(), await preFlightRes.text()).toBe(true);
    const preFlightJson = await preFlightRes.json();
    expect(preFlightJson.preFlightVerified).toBe(true);

    // 5. Save Zero-PII 2026 Tax Fortress Profile ($0.00 Local Sync)
    const kycRes = await request.post('/api/treasury/kyc', {
        headers,
        data: {
            walletAddress: seat.kaspaAddress,
            countryCode: taxSpec.countryCode,
            stateRegion: taxSpec.stateRegion,
            entityType: taxSpec.entityType,
            filingStatus: taxSpec.filingStatus,
            effectiveTaxRate: taxSpec.rate
        }
    });
    expect(kycRes.ok()).toBe(true);

    // 6. Clean up temporary worker/sector
    await request.post('/api/state/action', {
        headers,
        data: { action: 'DELETE_SECTOR', payload: { id: sectorId } }
    });
    await request.post('/api/state/action', {
        headers,
        data: { action: 'DELETE_WORKER', payload: { id: workerId } }
    });
}

import { test, expect, type APIResponse } from '@playwright/test';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

function loadLocalDotEnv(): Record<string, string> {
    const parsed: Record<string, string> = {};
    const candidates = [
        path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
        path.resolve(process.cwd(), '..', '.env')
    ];

    for (const envPath of candidates) {
        if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) continue;
        const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
        for (const rawLine of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
            const trimmed = rawLine.trim();
            if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
            const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
            if (eqIdx <= 0) continue;
            const key = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
            const val = trimmed
                .slice(eqIdx + 1)
                .trim()
                .replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
            if (key && !(key in parsed)) {
                parsed[key] = val;
            }
        }
    }
    return parsed;
}

const dotEnv = loadLocalDotEnv();

const ADMIN_TOKEN = (
    process.env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY ||
    dotEnv.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY ||
    process.env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN ||
    dotEnv.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN ||
    ''
).trim();

const TEST_WALLET = (
    process.env.PERENNIA_MASTER_TREASURY_KAS ||
    dotEnv.PERENNIA_MASTER_TREASURY_KAS ||
    'kaspa:qq0ynpnnhsna9rmdz2gvyjenpe7ygcruc4ldx58nruer60wr0m4uv22zne3rx'
).trim();

function buildAuthHeaders(baseURL?: string): Record<string, string> {
    const resolvedOrigin = new URL(baseURL || 'http://localhost:5173').origin;
    return {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}`,
        Origin: resolvedOrigin,
        Referer: `${resolvedOrigin}/`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'x-perennia-sandbox': 'true'
    };
}

async function assertResponseOk(res: APIResponse, label: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!res.ok()) {
        const bodyText = await res.text().catch(() => '<unreadable body>');
        throw new Error(`${label} failed (${res.status()}): ${bodyText}`);
    }
    await expect(res).toBeOK();
}

                '/api/sor/swap?payAsset=KAS&receiveAsset=HONEYPOTX&amount=100',
                { headers }
            );
            expect(blockedSwap.status()).toBe(403);
        } finally {
            // Always restore KAS to AUTO_BALANCE and revoke test blacklist entry
            await request.post('/api/admin', {
                headers,
                data: {
                    action: 'SET_TOKEN_STEERING_STATE',
                    ticker: 'KAS',
                    steeringState: 'AUTO_BALANCE'
                }
            });
            await request.post('/api/admin', {
                headers,
                data: {
                    action: 'REVOKE_FIREWALL_BLACKLIST',
                    entityType: 'TOKEN_CONTRACT',
                    targetValue: 'HONEYPOTX'
                }
            });
        }
    });

    test('4. Pillar 3: Zone 4 Maintenance Grace Shield, Subsystem Kill-Switches & Zone 5 Firewall', async ({
        request,
        baseURL
    }) => {
        const headers = buildAuthHeaders(baseURL);

        try {
            // 4A. Toggle Maintenance Grace Shield ON then OFF
            const shieldOn = await request.post('/api/admin', {
                headers,
                data: {
                    action: 'TOGGLE_MAINTENANCE_GRACE_SHIELD',
                    enabled: true
                }
            });
            await assertResponseOk(shieldOn, 'POST Maintenance Grace Shield ON');
            expect((await shieldOn.json()).maintenanceGraceShield).toBe(true);

            const shieldOff = await request.post('/api/admin', {
                headers,
                data: {
                    action: 'TOGGLE_MAINTENANCE_GRACE_SHIELD',
                    enabled: false
                }
            });
            await assertResponseOk(shieldOff, 'POST Maintenance Grace Shield OFF');
            expect((await shieldOff.json()).maintenanceGraceShield).toBe(false);

            // 4B. Toggle Fiat On-Ramp Kill-Switch -> Verify on-ramp status reports subsystemPaused
            const ksPause = await request.post('/api/admin', {
                headers,
                data: {
                    action: 'TOGGLE_SUBSYSTEM_KILLSWITCH',
                    subsystem: 'fiat_onramp',
                    paused: true
                }
            });
            await assertResponseOk(ksPause, 'POST Pause fiat_onramp kill-switch');

            const statusPaused = await request.get('/api/fiat/onramp', {
                headers
            });
            await assertResponseOk(statusPaused, 'GET /api/fiat/onramp paused status');
            expect((await statusPaused.json()).subsystemPaused).toBe(true);
        } finally {
            // Guarantee fiat_onramp is left unpaused and grace shield is disarmed
            await request.post('/api/admin', {
                headers,
                data: {
                    action: 'TOGGLE_SUBSYSTEM_KILLSWITCH',
                    subsystem: 'fiat_onramp',
                    paused: false
                }
            });
            await request.post('/api/admin', {
                headers,
                data: {
                    action: 'TOGGLE_MAINTENANCE_GRACE_SHIELD',
                    enabled: false
                }
            });
        }

        // 4C. Verify 5-Zone Director GET payload contains all 5 zones
        const adminGet = await request.get('/api/admin', { headers });
        await assertResponseOk(adminGet, 'GET /api/admin 5-Zone payload');
        const adminPayload = await adminGet.json();
        expect(adminPayload.triageExceptions).toBeDefined();
        expect(Array.isArray(adminPayload.tokenSteeringMatrix)).toBe(true);
        expect(
            adminPayload.fiatSettlementDesk.mercuryCheckingAccount.routingNumber
        ).toBe('121145433');
        expect(adminPayload.stratumAndGovernor).toBeDefined();
        expect(Array.isArray(adminPayload.directorAuditLog)).toBe(true);
    });
});

                                        }
                                    }

                        if (bodyObj.action === 'GET_LP_POSITIONS') {

                                JSON.stringify({
                                    success: true,
                                    data: [
                                        {
                                            id: 'TUT-LP-365',

                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }

                    }
                }
                return originalFetch!(input, init);
            };
        }
    }

    function restoreUnifiedSandboxInterceptors() {
        if (!browser) return;
        if (originalPrompt) {
            window.prompt = originalPrompt;
            originalPrompt = null;
        }
        if (originalFetch) {
            window.fetch = originalFetch;
            originalFetch = null;
        }
    }

    function setNativeInputValue(inputEl: HTMLInputElement, value: string) {
        if (inputEl.value === value) return;
        const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(
            window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,
            'value'
        )?.set;
        if (setter) {
            setter.call(inputEl, value);
        } else {
            inputEl.value = value;
        }
        inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    }

    function clearAllTourAttributes() {
        if (!browser) return;
        const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('[data-tour-target]');
        for (const el of Array.from(nodes)) {
            el.removeAttribute('data-tour-target');
        }
    }

        installUnifiedSandboxInterceptors();
        clearAllTourAttributes();

        if (chapter !== 7 && settingsStore.showSettingsModal) {
            settingsStore.showSettingsModal = false;
        }

            if (operations.workers.length > 0) operations.workers = [];
            if (operations.sectors.length > 0) operations.sectors = [];

                        'mod1-unlock-vault-btn'

            if ((stepIdx === 1 || stepIdx === 2) && menuEl) {

                ) as HTMLElement | null;

            if (stepIdx >= 3 && stepIdx <= 6 && !menuEl && targetOptionsBtn) {

            }
            if (menuEl) {
                const menuButtons = Array.from(
                    menuEl.querySelectorAll('button')
                ) as HTMLButtonElement[];
                const renameBtn = menuButtons.find((b) =>
                    (b.textContent || '')
                        .toUpperCase()
                        .includes('RENAME WORKER')

                if (renameBtn) {
                    renameBtn.setAttribute(
                        'data-tour-target',
                        'mod2-rename-worker-btn'

    function resolveTargetElement(): HTMLElement | null {
        if (!browser || !ui.isTutorialActive || !currentSpec) return null;
        synchronizeActiveChapterDom(
            activeChapterNum,
            Number(ui.tutorialSubStep || 0)
        );
        const primaryList = document.querySelectorAll(currentSpec.targetSelector);
        for (const node of Array.from(primaryList)) {
            const el = node as HTMLElement;
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
                return el;
            }
        }
        if (currentSpec.fallbackSelector) {
            const fallbackList = document.querySelectorAll(
                currentSpec.fallbackSelector
            );
            for (const node of Array.from(fallbackList)) {
                const el = node as HTMLElement;
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
                    return el;
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function updateSpotlightRect(shouldScroll = false) {
        if (!browser || !ui.isTutorialActive || !currentSpec) {
            spotlightRect = null;
            return;
        }
        viewportW = window.innerWidth;
        viewportH = window.innerHeight;
        const el = resolveTargetElement();
        if (!el) {
            spotlightRect = null;
            return;
        }
        if (shouldScroll) {
            const rawRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            const outOfBounds =
                rawRect.top < 70 ||
                rawRect.bottom > window.innerHeight - 70 ||
                rawRect.left < 0 ||
                rawRect.right > window.innerWidth;
            if (outOfBounds) {
                el.scrollIntoView({
                    behavior: 'smooth',
                    block: 'center',
                    inline: 'nearest'
                });
            }
        }
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const pad = isActionStep ? 6 : 8;
        const top = Math.max(4, rect.top - pad);
        const left = Math.max(4, rect.left - pad);
        const width = Math.min(window.innerWidth - left - 4, rect.width + pad * 2);
        const height = Math.min(window.innerHeight - top - 4, rect.height + pad * 2);
        spotlightRect = {
            top,
            left,
            width: Math.max(24, width),
            height: Math.max(24, height)
        };
    }

    let resolvedChevronPlacement = $derived.by((): ChevronPlacement => {
        if (currentSpec?.chevronPlacement) {
            return currentSpec.chevronPlacement;
        }
        if (!spotlightRect) return 'top';
        if (spotlightRect.top > 60) return 'top';
        if (spotlightRect.top + spotlightRect.height < viewportH - 60) return 'bottom';
        if (spotlightRect.left > 60) return 'left';
        return 'right';
    });

    let cardPositionClass = $derived.by(() => {
        if (!spotlightRect) return 'bottom-6 right-6';
        const cardW = 460;
        const cardH = 330;
        const overlapsBottomRight =
            spotlightRect.left + spotlightRect.width > viewportW - cardW - 36 &&
            spotlightRect.top + spotlightRect.height > viewportH - cardH - 36;
        if (overlapsBottomRight) {
            const overlapsBottomLeft =
                spotlightRect.left < cardW + 36 &&
                spotlightRect.top + spotlightRect.height > viewportH - cardH - 36;
            if (overlapsBottomLeft) {
                return 'top-24 right-6';
            }
            return 'bottom-6 left-6';
        }
        return 'bottom-6 right-6';
    });

    $effect(() => {
        if (browser && ui.isTutorialActive && currentSpec) {
            const timer = setTimeout(() => {
                updateSpotlightRect(true);
            }, 65);
            return () => clearTimeout(timer);
        } else if (!ui.isTutorialActive) {
            spotlightRect = null;
            hasResetWalletModalToMenu = false;
            settingsStore.showSettingsModal = false;
            restoreStashedVaultAfterTutorial();
            restoreUnifiedSandboxInterceptors();
            clearAllTourAttributes();
        }
    });

    function handleViewportChange() {
        if (!ui.isTutorialActive) return;
        if (rafId !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updateSpotlightRect(false);
        });
    }

    function handleGlobalCaptureClick(e: MouseEvent) {
        if (!browser || !ui.isTutorialActive || !currentSpec) return;
        if (currentSpec.mode !== 'ACTION') return;
        const clickedNode = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
        if (!clickedNode) return;
        if (clickedNode.closest('[data-testid="tutorial-floating-card"]')) {
            return;
        }
        const targetEl = resolveTargetElement();
        const isInsideDomTarget = Boolean(
            targetEl && (targetEl === clickedNode || targetEl.contains(clickedNode))
        );
        const isInsideCutoutBounds = Boolean(
            spotlightRect &&
                e.clientX >= spotlightRect.left - 4 &&
                e.clientX <= spotlightRect.left + spotlightRect.width + 4 &&
                e.clientY >= spotlightRect.top - 4 &&
                e.clientY <= spotlightRect.top + spotlightRect.height + 4
        );
        if (isInsideDomTarget || isInsideCutoutBounds) {
            const stepIdAtClick = currentSpec.id;
            const totalStepsAtClick = currentSpec.totalChapterSteps;
            const delayMs = currentSpec.advanceDelayMs ?? 240;
            if (stepIdAtClick === 'settlement_step0_click_break_off') {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const initBtn = document.querySelector(
                        '[data-testid="initialize-sector-btn"]'
                    ) as HTMLButtonElement | null;
                    if (initBtn) initBtn.click();
                }, 30);
            }
            if (advanceTimeout) clearTimeout(advanceTimeout);
            advanceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                if (
                    ui.isTutorialActive &&
                    ui.activeTourStepSpec?.id === stepIdAtClick
                ) {
                    ui.advanceTutorialSubStep(totalStepsAtClick);
                }
            }, delayMs);
        }
    }

    onMount(() => {
        if (!browser) return;
        ui.bindSandboxStores({ identity, operations, treasury });
        viewportW = window.innerWidth;
        viewportH = window.innerHeight;
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleViewportChange, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('scroll', handleViewportChange, {
            passive: true,
            capture: true
        });
        window.addEventListener('click', handleGlobalCaptureClick, true);
        pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
            if (ui.isTutorialActive) {
                synchronizeActiveChapterDom(
                    activeChapterNum,
                    Number(ui.tutorialSubStep || 0)
                );
                updateSpotlightRect(false);
            }
        }, 160);
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        if (!browser) return;
        window.removeEventListener('resize', handleViewportChange);
        window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleViewportChange, true);
        window.removeEventListener('click', handleGlobalCaptureClick, true);
        if (rafId !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
        if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
        if (advanceTimeout) clearTimeout(advanceTimeout);
        settingsStore.showSettingsModal = false;
        restoreStashedVaultAfterTutorial();
        restoreUnifiedSandboxInterceptors();
        clearAllTourAttributes();
    });

    function handleLaunchChapter(chapter: number) {
        hasResetWalletModalToMenu = false;
        settingsStore.showSettingsModal = false;
        ui.bindSandboxStores({ identity, operations, treasury });
        ui.startTutorial(chapter);
    }

    function handleJumpChapter(chapter: number) {
        hasResetWalletModalToMenu = false;
        settingsStore.showSettingsModal = false;
        ui.bindSandboxStores({ identity, operations, treasury });
        ui.startChapter(chapter, 0);
    }

    function handleContinueStep() {
        if (!currentSpec) return;
        ui.advanceTutorialSubStep(currentSpec.totalChapterSteps);
    }

    function handleBackStep() {
        ui.prevTutorialSubStep();
    }
</script>

// WINDOWS (FRONTEND): C:\Users\send2\perennia-v5\perennia-frontend\src\lib\stores\settings.svelte.ts
import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import {
    i18n,
    SUPPORTED_LOCALES,
    SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES,
    type SupportedLocale,
    type SupportedCurrency
} from './i18n.svelte';

class SettingsStore {
    showSettingsModal = $state(false);
    theme = $state<'dark' | 'light'>('dark');
    bgIntensity = $state(0);
    fiatDecimals = $state(2);
    tokenDecimals = $state(8);
    locale = $state<SupportedLocale>('EN');
    currency = $state<SupportedCurrency>('USD');

    constructor() {
        if (browser) {
            const stored = localStorage.getItem('perennia_ui_settings');
            if (stored) {
                try {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
                    if (parsed.theme === 'dark' || parsed.theme === 'light') {
                        this.theme = parsed.theme;
                    }
                    if (parsed.bgIntensity !== undefined) {
                        this.bgIntensity = Number(parsed.bgIntensity) || 0;
                    }
                    if (parsed.fiatDecimals !== undefined) {
                        this.fiatDecimals = Number(parsed.fiatDecimals) ?? 2;
                    }
                    if (parsed.tokenDecimals !== undefined) {
                        this.tokenDecimals = Number(parsed.tokenDecimals) ?? 8;
                    }
                    if (
                        parsed.locale &&
                        SUPPORTED_LOCALES.some((l) => l.code === parsed.locale)
                    ) {
                        this.locale = parsed.locale as SupportedLocale;
                        i18n.setLocale(this.locale);
                    }
                    if (
                        parsed.currency &&
                        SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.some(
                            (c) => c.code === parsed.currency
                        )
                    ) {
                        this.currency = parsed.currency as SupportedCurrency;
                        i18n.setCurrency(this.currency);
                    }
                } catch {
                    // Ignore malformed settings payload
                }
            }
            this.applyTheme();
        }
    }

    setLocale(nextLocale: SupportedLocale) {
        this.locale = nextLocale;
        i18n.setLocale(nextLocale);
        this.save();
    }

    setCurrency(nextCurrency: SupportedCurrency) {
        this.currency = nextCurrency;
        i18n.setCurrency(nextCurrency);
        const spec = SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.find((c) => c.code === nextCurrency);
        if (spec && nextCurrency === 'JPY' && this.fiatDecimals === 2) {
            this.fiatDecimals = 0;
        } else if (spec && nextCurrency !== 'JPY' && this.fiatDecimals === 0) {
            this.fiatDecimals = spec.defaultDecimals;
        }
        this.save();
    }

    save() {
        if (browser) {
            i18n.setLocale(this.locale);
            i18n.setCurrency(this.currency);
            localStorage.setItem(
                'perennia_ui_settings',
                JSON.stringify({
                    theme: this.theme,
                    bgIntensity: this.bgIntensity,
                    fiatDecimals: this.fiatDecimals,
                    tokenDecimals: this.tokenDecimals,
                    locale: this.locale,
                    currency: this.currency
                })
            );
            this.applyTheme();
        }
    }

    applyTheme() {
        if (!browser) return;
        const doc = document.documentElement;
        const body = document.body;
        const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, this.bgIntensity)) / 100;

        if (this.theme === 'dark') {
            doc.classList.remove('theme-light');
            doc.classList.add('theme-dark');
            // Locked calibrated dark mode base (#06080b -> subtle charcoal #0e1218)
            const r = Math.round(6 + ratio * 8);
            const g = Math.round(8 + ratio * 10);
            const b = Math.round(11 + ratio * 13);
            const bgApp = `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
            doc.style.setProperty('--bg-app', bgApp);
            body.style.backgroundColor = bgApp;
        } else {
            doc.classList.remove('theme-dark');
            doc.classList.add('theme-light');
            // Warm Eggshell (#F6F3E9 / 246, 243, 233) -> Rich Warm Vanilla (#EAE4D3 / 234, 228, 211)
            const r = Math.round(246 - ratio * 12);
            const g = Math.round(243 - ratio * 15);
            const b = Math.round(233 - ratio * 22);
            const bgApp = `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
            doc.style.setProperty('--bg-app', bgApp);
            body.style.backgroundColor = bgApp;
        }
    }
}

export const settingsStore = new SettingsStore();

// WINDOWS (FRONTEND): C:\Users\send2\perennia-v5\perennia-frontend\src\lib\stores\treasury.svelte.ts
import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import type { AssetClass, ThemeColors } from './type';

export const DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER = 'SILO';
export const DEFAULT_RWA_INDEX_TICKER = 'PERX';

export const SUPPORTED_RWA_TICKERS = [

export const SUPPORTED_ASSETS = [

export class UnifiedAsset {
    id: string;
    ticker: string;
    name: string;
    assetClass: AssetClass;
    network: string;
    theme: ThemeColors;
    imgUrl: string;
    contract = $state<string | undefined>(undefined);
    address = $state('Awaiting Decryption');
    onChain = $state(0);
    synthetic = $state(0);
    lpStaked = $state(0);
    spotPrice = $state(0);
    delta = $state(0);
    apy = $state<number | undefined>(undefined);
    accruedYield = $state<number | undefined>(undefined);
    siloVolume = $state<number | undefined>(undefined);
    validator = $state<string | undefined>(undefined);

    constructor(init: Partial<UnifiedAsset>) {
        this.id = init.ticker || 'UNKNOWN';
        this.ticker = init.ticker || 'UNKNOWN';
        this.name = init.name || 'Unknown Asset';
        this.assetClass = init.assetClass || 'Ecosystem';
        this.network = init.network || 'KAS';
        this.theme = init.theme || { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' };
        this.imgUrl = init.imgUrl || '';
        this.contract = init.contract;
        if (init.address !== undefined) this.address = init.address;
        if (init.spotPrice !== undefined) this.spotPrice = init.spotPrice;
        if (init.onChain !== undefined) this.onChain = init.onChain;
        if (init.synthetic !== undefined) this.synthetic = init.synthetic;
        if (init.lpStaked !== undefined) this.lpStaked = init.lpStaked;
        if (init.delta !== undefined) this.delta = init.delta;
    }

    // --- UI COMPATIBILITY ALIASES ---
    get symbol() {
        return this.ticker;
    }
    get hex() {
        return this.theme?.hex || '#18C6A5';
    }
    get icon() {
        return this.imgUrl;
    }
    get type() {
        return this.assetClass;
    }
    get badge() {
        return this.assetClass === 'Native L1'
            ? `${this.ticker} [L1]`
            : String(this.assetClass || 'TOKEN').toUpperCase();
    }
    get availableBalance() {
        return this.onChain + this.synthetic;
    }
    get ledgerBalance() {
        return this.synthetic;
    }
    get stakedBalance() {
        return this.lpStaked;
    }
    get totalBalance() {
        return this.onChain + this.synthetic + this.lpStaked;
    }
}

class TreasuryStore {
    registry = $state<UnifiedAsset[]>([]);
    discoveredTickers = $state<string[]>([]);
    rwaOracleOnline = $state<boolean>(false);
    rwaOracleError = $state<string | null>(null);

    constructor() {
        this.seedCoreRegistry();
        if (browser) {
            this.syncRwaOraclePrices();
        }
    }

    get visibleAssets() {
        const targeted = new Set<string>([
            ...operations.targetedAssets,
            ...this.discoveredTickers
        ]);
        for (const sector of operations.sectors) {
            if (sector.settlementConfig?.targetAssets) {
                for (const t of sector.settlementConfig.targetAssets) {
                    if (t?.ticker) targeted.add(t.ticker.toUpperCase());
                }
            }
            if (sector.settlementConfig?.plantWeights) {
                for (const k of Object.keys(sector.settlementConfig.plantWeights)) {
                    targeted.add(k.toUpperCase());
                }
            }
        }
        return this.registry.filter(
            (asset) =>
                asset.ticker === 'KAS' ||
                asset.ticker === DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER ||
                asset.onChain > 0 ||
                asset.synthetic > 0 ||
                asset.lpStaked > 0 ||
                targeted.has(asset.ticker)
        );
    }

    get totalVaultValue() {
        return this.visibleAssets.reduce(
            (sum, a) => sum + a.totalBalance * a.spotPrice,
            0
        );
    }

    getAsset(ticker: string): UnifiedAsset {
        const clean = String(ticker || 'KAS').trim().toUpperCase();
        const asset = this.registry.find((a) => a.ticker === clean);
        if (!asset) {
            return new UnifiedAsset({
                ticker: clean,
                name: clean,
                assetClass: 'Ecosystem',
                network: clean,
                spotPrice: 0,
                theme: { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' }
            });
        }
        return asset;
    }

    updateAsset(ticker: string, updates: Partial<UnifiedAsset>) {
        const clean = String(ticker || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!clean) return;
        const asset = this.registry.find((a) => a.ticker === clean);
        if (asset) {
            if (updates.name !== undefined) asset.name = updates.name;
            if (updates.assetClass !== undefined)
                asset.assetClass = updates.assetClass;
            if (updates.network !== undefined) asset.network = updates.network;
            if (updates.theme !== undefined) asset.theme = updates.theme;
            if (updates.imgUrl !== undefined) asset.imgUrl = updates.imgUrl;
            if (updates.onChain !== undefined) asset.onChain = updates.onChain;
            if (updates.synthetic !== undefined)
                asset.synthetic = updates.synthetic;
            if (updates.lpStaked !== undefined)
                asset.lpStaked = updates.lpStaked;
            if (updates.spotPrice !== undefined)
                asset.spotPrice = updates.spotPrice;
            if (updates.delta !== undefined) asset.delta = updates.delta;
            if (updates.address !== undefined) asset.address = updates.address;
            if (updates.contract !== undefined)
                asset.contract = updates.contract;
            if (updates.apy !== undefined) asset.apy = updates.apy;
            if (updates.accruedYield !== undefined)
                asset.accruedYield = updates.accruedYield;
            if (updates.siloVolume !== undefined)
                asset.siloVolume = updates.siloVolume;
            if (updates.validator !== undefined)
                asset.validator = updates.validator;
        } else {
            const newAsset = new UnifiedAsset({
                ticker: clean,
                name: updates.name || clean,
                assetClass: updates.assetClass || 'Ecosystem',
                network: updates.network || clean,
                spotPrice: updates.spotPrice ?? 0,
                theme: updates.theme || { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' },
                imgUrl: updates.imgUrl || '',
                contract: updates.contract
            });
            if (updates.onChain !== undefined)
                newAsset.onChain = updates.onChain;
            if (updates.synthetic !== undefined)
                newAsset.synthetic = updates.synthetic;
            if (updates.lpStaked !== undefined)
                newAsset.lpStaked = updates.lpStaked;
            if (updates.delta !== undefined) newAsset.delta = updates.delta;
            if (updates.address !== undefined)
                newAsset.address = updates.address;
            this.registry.push(newAsset);
        }
    }

    registerDiscoveredAsset(
        meta: {
            ticker: string;
            name?: string;
            assetClass?: AssetClass;
            network?: string;
            spotPrice?: number;
            change24h?: number;
            delta?: number;
            contract?: string;
            imgUrl?: string;
            theme?: ThemeColors;
        },
        pinVisible = true
    ): UnifiedAsset {
        const clean = String(meta.ticker || '')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase()
            .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '')
            .slice(0, 12);
        if (!clean) {
            return this.getAsset('KAS');
        }
        this.updateAsset(clean, {
            name: meta.name || clean,
            assetClass: meta.assetClass || 'DeFi',
            network: (meta.network || 'ETH').toUpperCase(),
            spotPrice:
                typeof meta.spotPrice === 'number' && meta.spotPrice > 0
                    ? meta.spotPrice
                    : undefined,
            delta:
                typeof meta.change24h === 'number'
                    ? meta.change24h
                    : typeof meta.delta === 'number'
                      ? meta.delta
                      : undefined,
            contract: meta.contract || clean,
            imgUrl: meta.imgUrl,
            theme: meta.theme || { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' }
        });
        if (pinVisible && !this.discoveredTickers.includes(clean)) {
            this.discoveredTickers = [...this.discoveredTickers, clean];
        }
        return this.getAsset(clean);
    }

    async discoverAndRegisterToken(
        rawQuery: string,
        persistOnServer = true
    ): Promise<{
        primary: UnifiedAsset | null;
        matches: UnifiedAsset[];
    }> {
        if (!browser) return { primary: null, matches: [] };
        const trimmed = String(rawQuery || '').trim();
        if (trimmed.length < 2) return { primary: null, matches: [] };

        try {
            const res = await fetch(
                `/api/prices?discover=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}${persistOnServer ? '&register=1' : ''}`
            );
            if (!res.ok) return { primary: null, matches: [] };
            const data = await res.json();
            const matches: UnifiedAsset[] = [];
            if (Array.isArray(data?.matches)) {
                for (const m of data.matches) {
                    if (m?.ticker) {
                        matches.push(this.registerDiscoveredAsset(m, true));
                    }
                }
            }
            let primary: UnifiedAsset | null = null;
            if (data?.asset?.ticker) {
                primary = this.registerDiscoveredAsset(data.asset, true);
                if (!matches.some((m) => m.ticker === primary!.ticker)) {
                    matches.unshift(primary);
                }
            } else if (matches.length > 0) {
                primary = matches[0];
            }
            return { primary, matches };
        } catch {
            return { primary: null, matches: [] };
        }
    }

    async syncRwaOraclePrices(): Promise<boolean> {
        if (!browser) return false;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/prices/rwa');
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (res.ok && data.success && Array.isArray(data.assets)) {
                let updatedCount = 0;
                for (const item of data.assets) {
                    const ticker = String(item.ticker || '')
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase();
                    const spot = Number(item.spotPrice ?? item.price ?? 0);
                    const delta = Number(item.change24h ?? 0);
                    if (ticker && spot > 0) {
                        this.updateAsset(ticker, {
                            spotPrice: spot,
                            delta: isFinite(delta) ? delta : 0
                        });
                        updatedCount++;
                    }
                }
                this.rwaOracleOnline = updatedCount > 0;
                this.rwaOracleError =
                    updatedCount > 0
                        ? null
                        : 'Pyth Hermes returned 0 active RWA feeds.';
                return updatedCount > 0;
            } else {
                this.rwaOracleOnline = false;
                this.rwaOracleError =
                    data.error || `Pyth Hermes Oracle HTTP ${res.status}`;
                return false;
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            this.rwaOracleOnline = false;
            this.rwaOracleError =
                err.message || 'Pyth Hermes Oracle network error.';
            return false;
        }
    }

interface LiveStateSnapshot {
    hasEntered: boolean;
    activeTab: string;
    showWalletModal: boolean;
    isWalletConnected: boolean;
    activeAddress: string | null;
    activeWalletType: 'sovereign' | null;
    sovereignKeys: any;
    isVaultUnlocked: boolean;
    workers: Worker[];
    sectors: Sector[];
    globalNetworkHashrate: number;
    globalNodeStatus: 'offline' | 'syncing' | 'connected' | 'unreachable';

        synthetic: number;
        lpStaked: number;
        spotPrice: number;
        delta: number;
    }>;
}

interface SandboxStoreRefs {
    identity: any;
    operations: any;
    treasury: any;
}

class UiStore {
    hasEntered = $state(false);
    activeTab = $state('OPERATIONS');
    showWalletModal = $state(false);
    systemMode = $state<SystemMode>('base');
    adminModeActive = $state(false);
    adminTargetWallet = $state('');
    taxEvents = $state<any[]>([]);
    swapIntent = $state<DexSwapIntent | null>(null);

    // Global In-Context Fiat Purchase Modal State
    showFiatModal = $state(false);
    fiatModalTargetTicker = $state('KAS');
    fiatModalAutoStakeSilo = $state(false);
    fiatModalDefaultUsd = $state('250');

    showTutorialPrompt = $state(false);
    isTutorialActive = $state(false);
    isTutorialSandbox = $state(false);
    tutorialStep = $state<number>(1);
    tutorialChapter = $state<number>(1);
    tutorialSubStep = $state<number>(0);
    activeTourStepSpec = $state<TutorialRelayStepSpec | null>(null);
    hasCheckedTourPrompt = $state(false);
    microBadges = $state<Record<string, MicroConfirmationBadge>>({});

    private liveSnapshot: LiveStateSnapshot | null = null;
    private stores: SandboxStoreRefs | null = null;

    bindSandboxStores(refs: SandboxStoreRefs) {
        this.stores = refs;
    }

    get currentTourTargetSelector(): string {
        if (this.activeTourStepSpec?.targetSelector) {
            return this.activeTourStepSpec.targetSelector;
        }
        return '[data-tour="workers-panel"]';
    }

    openFiatModal(
        targetTicker: string = 'KAS',
        autoStakeSilo: boolean = false,
        defaultUsd: string = '250'
    ) {
        const cleanTicker = String(targetTicker || 'KAS')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase();
        this.fiatModalTargetTicker = cleanTicker === 'USD' ? 'KAS' : cleanTicker;
        this.fiatModalAutoStakeSilo =
            this.fiatModalTargetTicker === 'SILO' ? Boolean(autoStakeSilo) : false;
        this.fiatModalDefaultUsd = String(defaultUsd || '250');
        this.showFiatModal = true;
    }

    closeFiatModal() {
        this.showFiatModal = false;
    }

    enterNexus() {
        this.hasEntered = true;
        this.activeTab = 'OPERATIONS';
        this.showWalletModal = false;
    }

    checkFirstTimeTutorialPrompt() {
        if (!browser || this.hasCheckedTourPrompt) return;
        this.hasCheckedTourPrompt = true;
        const completed = localStorage.getItem('perennia_tour_completed');
        if (!completed) {
            this.showTutorialPrompt = true;
        }
    }

    enterTutorialSandbox(forChapter: number = 1) {
        if (!this.stores) return;
        const { identity, operations, treasury } = this.stores;
        if (!this.isTutorialSandbox) {
            this.liveSnapshot = {
                hasEntered: this.hasEntered,
                activeTab: this.activeTab,
                showWalletModal: this.showWalletModal,
                isWalletConnected: identity.isWalletConnected,
                activeAddress: identity.activeAddress,
                activeWalletType: identity.activeWalletType,
                sovereignKeys: identity.sovereignKeys
                    ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(identity.sovereignKeys))
                    : null,
                isVaultUnlocked: identity.isVaultUnlocked,
                workers: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(operations.workers || [])),
                sectors: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(operations.sectors || [])),
                globalNetworkHashrate: operations.globalNetworkHashrate,
                globalNodeStatus: operations.globalNodeStatus,
                networkDifficulty: operations.networkDifficulty,
                blockRewardKas: operations.blockRewardKas,
                taxEvents: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.taxEvents || [])),
                assets: (treasury.registry || []).map((a: any) => ({
                    ticker: a.ticker,
                    address: a.address,
                    onChain: a.onChain,
                    synthetic: a.synthetic,
                    lpStaked: a.lpStaked,
                    spotPrice: a.spotPrice,
                    delta: a.delta
                }))
            };
            this.isTutorialSandbox = true;
        }
        this.hasEntered = true;
        this.seedSandboxPricesAndBalances();
        this.taxEvents = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SANDBOX_TAX_EVENTS));
        if (forChapter === 1) {
            this.setSandboxPreWalletState();
            operations.workers = [];
            operations.sectors = [];
        } else if (forChapter === 2 || forChapter === 3) {
            this.activateSandboxWalletSession();
            operations.workers = [];
            operations.sectors = [];
        } else if (forChapter === 4) {
            this.activateSandboxWalletSession();
            operations.workers = [JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SANDBOX_ONLINE_WORKER))];
            operations.sectors = [];
        } else {
            this.activateSandboxWalletSession();
            operations.workers = [JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SANDBOX_ONLINE_WORKER))];
            operations.sectors = [JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SANDBOX_DEMO_SECTOR))];
        }
    }

    seedSandboxPricesAndBalances() {
        if (!this.stores) return;
        const { operations, treasury } = this.stores;
        operations.globalNetworkHashrate = 1_180_000_000;
        operations.globalNodeStatus = 'connected';
        operations.networkDifficulty = 580_000_000_000_000;
        operations.blockRewardKas = 65.4;
        for (const item of SANDBOX_TREASURY_PRICES) {
            treasury.updateAsset(item.ticker, {
                spotPrice: item.spotPrice,
                delta: item.delta,
                onChain: item.onChain,
                synthetic: item.synthetic,
                lpStaked: item.lpStaked,
                address: item.address
            });
        }
    }

    seedSandboxFixtures() {
        this.seedSandboxPricesAndBalances();
    }

    setSandboxPreWalletState() {
        if (!this.stores) return;
        const { identity, operations } = this.stores;
        this.showWalletModal = false;
        identity.isConnecting = false;
        identity.walletMessage = '';
        identity.isWalletConnected = false;
        identity.activeAddress = null;
        identity.activeWalletType = null;
        identity.isVaultUnlocked = false;
        identity.isVaultUnlockPending = false;
        identity.pendingTransactionDetails = null;
        operations.workers = [];
        operations.sectors = [];
    }

    activateSandboxWalletSession() {
        if (!this.stores) return;
        const { identity } = this.stores;
        identity.isConnecting = false;
        identity.walletMessage = '';
        identity.sovereignKeys = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SANDBOX_WALLETS));
        identity.activeAddress = SANDBOX_WALLETS.kaspa.address;
        identity.activeWalletType = 'sovereign';
        identity.isVaultUnlocked = true;
        identity.isWalletConnected = true;
        identity.isVaultUnlockPending = false;
        identity.pendingTransactionDetails = null;
    }

    simulateSandboxWorkerOnline() {
        if (!this.stores) return;
        const { operations } = this.stores;
        if (!operations.workers || operations.workers.length === 0) {
            operations.workers = [JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SANDBOX_ONLINE_WORKER))];
            return;
        }
        operations.workers = operations.workers.map((w: Worker, idx: number) =>
            idx === operations.workers.length - 1
                ? {
                      ...w,
                      isOnline: true,
                      hashRate: 4.2,
                      blocksFound: 2,
                      sharesContributed: 14820,
                      validShares: 14820,
                      hardwareType:
                          w.hardwareType && w.hardwareType !== 'Select Miner Type'
                              ? w.hardwareType
                              : 'IceRiver KS7 Lite',
                      stratumUrl: 'stratum+tcp://pool.perennia.io:3334'
                  }
                : w
        );
    }

    exitTutorialSandbox() {
        if (!this.isTutorialSandbox || !this.liveSnapshot || !this.stores) {
            this.isTutorialSandbox = false;
            return;
        }
        const { identity, operations, treasury } = this.stores;
        const snap = this.liveSnapshot;
        this.liveSnapshot = null;
        this.isTutorialSandbox = false;
        this.showWalletModal = false;
        identity.isConnecting = false;
        identity.walletMessage = '';
        identity.isVaultUnlockPending = false;
        identity.pendingTransactionDetails = null;
        identity.isWalletConnected = snap.isWalletConnected;
        identity.activeAddress = snap.activeAddress;
        identity.activeWalletType = snap.activeWalletType;
        identity.sovereignKeys = snap.sovereignKeys;
        identity.isVaultUnlocked = snap.isVaultUnlocked;
        operations.workers = snap.workers;
        operations.sectors = snap.sectors;
        operations.globalNetworkHashrate = snap.globalNetworkHashrate;
        operations.globalNodeStatus = snap.globalNodeStatus;
        operations.networkDifficulty = snap.networkDifficulty;
        operations.blockRewardKas = snap.blockRewardKas;
        this.taxEvents = snap.taxEvents;
        for (const savedAsset of snap.assets) {
            treasury.updateAsset(savedAsset.ticker, {
                address: savedAsset.address,
                onChain: savedAsset.onChain,
                synthetic: savedAsset.synthetic,
                lpStaked: savedAsset.lpStaked,
                spotPrice: savedAsset.spotPrice,
                delta: savedAsset.delta
            });
        }
        this.hasEntered = snap.hasEntered;
        this.activeTab = snap.activeTab;
    }

    private syncActiveSpecFromRegistry() {
        const chapSteps =
            CHAPTER_STEPS_REGISTRY[this.tutorialChapter] ||
            CHAPTER_STEPS_REGISTRY[1];
        const clampedIdx = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(chapSteps.length - 1, this.tutorialSubStep)
        );
        this.tutorialSubStep = clampedIdx;
        const spec = chapSteps[clampedIdx];
        this.activeTourStepSpec = spec;
        if (spec.tab && this.activeTab !== spec.tab) {
            this.activeTab = spec.tab;
        }
    }

    startTutorial(chapter: number = 1) {
        this.showTutorialPrompt = false;
        this.isTutorialActive = true;
        this.startChapter(chapter, 0);
    }

    startChapter(chapter: number, subStep: number = 0) {
        const clampedChapter = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, chapter));
        this.enterTutorialSandbox(clampedChapter);
        this.tutorialChapter = clampedChapter;
        this.tutorialStep = clampedChapter;
        this.tutorialSubStep = Math.max(0, subStep);
        this.syncActiveSpecFromRegistry();
    }

    registerActiveStepSpec(spec: TutorialRelayStepSpec) {
        this.activeTourStepSpec = spec;
        if (spec.tab && this.activeTab !== spec.tab) {
            this.activeTab = spec.tab;
        }
    }

    advanceTutorialSubStep(totalStepsInChapter?: number) {
        const chapSteps =
            CHAPTER_STEPS_REGISTRY[this.tutorialChapter] ||
            CHAPTER_STEPS_REGISTRY[1];
        const total = totalStepsInChapter ?? chapSteps.length;
        if (this.tutorialSubStep + 1 < total) {
            this.tutorialSubStep += 1;
            this.syncActiveSpecFromRegistry();
        } else if (this.tutorialChapter < 7) {
            this.startChapter(this.tutorialChapter + 1, 0);
        } else {
            this.completeTutorial();
        }
    }

    prevTutorialSubStep() {
        if (this.tutorialSubStep > 0) {
            this.tutorialSubStep -= 1;
            this.syncActiveSpecFromRegistry();
        } else if (this.tutorialChapter > 1) {
            const prevChap = this.tutorialChapter - 1;
            const prevSteps = CHAPTER_STEPS_REGISTRY[prevChap] || [];
            this.startChapter(prevChap, Math.max(0, prevSteps.length - 1));
        }
    }

    setTutorialStep(step: number) {
        const clamped = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, step));
        this.startChapter(clamped, 0);
    }

    toggleTutorialMode() {
        if (this.isTutorialActive) {
            this.completeTutorial();
        } else {
            this.showTutorialPrompt = true;
        }
    }

    dismissTutorialPrompt() {
        this.showTutorialPrompt = false;
        if (browser) {
            localStorage.setItem('perennia_tour_completed', 'true');
        }
    }

    completeTutorial() {
        this.isTutorialActive = false;
        this.showTutorialPrompt = false;
        this.activeTourStepSpec = null;
        this.exitTutorialSandbox();
        if (browser) {
            localStorage.setItem('perennia_tour_completed', 'true');
        }
    }

    triggerMicroBadge(targetKey: string, label: string, accentHex: string = '#18C6A5') {
        const id = `${targetKey}_${Date.now()}`;
        this.microBadges = {
            ...this.microBadges,
            [targetKey]: {
                id,
                label,
                accentHex,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            }
        };
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (this.microBadges[targetKey]?.id === id) {
                const next = { ...this.microBadges };
                delete next[targetKey];
                this.microBadges = next;
            }
        }, 1700);
    }

    triggerBucketBoost(targetTicker: string, neededKasAmount?: number) {
        const cleanTarget = targetTicker.trim().toUpperCase();
        const formattedKas =
            typeof neededKasAmount === 'number' && neededKasAmount > 0
                ? Math.max(0.1, Number(neededKasAmount.toFixed(4))).toString()
                : '';
        this.swapIntent = {
            payTicker: 'KAS',
            receiveTicker: cleanTarget === 'KAS' ? 'USDC' : cleanTarget,
            payAmount: formattedKas,
            reason: 'bucket_boost',
            timestamp: Date.now()
        };
        this.activeTab = 'DEX';
    }

    routeToDexSwap(
        payTicker: string,
        receiveTicker: string,
        payAmount: string = '',
        reason: 'bucket_boost' | 'manual_route' | 'phase2_kas_exit' = 'manual_route'
    ) {
        this.swapIntent = {
            payTicker: payTicker.trim().toUpperCase(),
            receiveTicker: receiveTicker.trim().toUpperCase(),
            payAmount,
            reason,
            timestamp: Date.now()
        };
        this.activeTab = 'DEX';
    }

    clearSwapIntent() {
        this.swapIntent = null;
    }
}

export const ui = new UiStore();

    async function loadDirectorDashboard() {
        if (!browser) return;
        isLoading = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/admin');
            if (!res.ok) {
                const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
                showBanner(err.error || 'Failed to load Director telemetry.', 'red');
                return;
            }
            const data = await res.json();
            adminData = { ...adminData, ...data };
            if (data.stratumAndGovernor?.maxGasCeilingUsd !== undefined) {
                gasCeilingInput = Number(data.stratumAndGovernor.maxGasCeilingUsd).toFixed(2);
            }
            if (data.systemConfig) {
                hotCeilingKasInput = String(data.systemConfig.hot_ceiling_kas ?? 5000);
                minRunwayKasInput = String(data.systemConfig.min_runway_kas ?? 250);
                fppsMaxFloatKasInput = String(data.systemConfig.fpps_max_float_kas ?? 50);
                poolFeeRatePctInput = Number(
                    (Number(data.systemConfig.pool_fee_rate ?? 0.01) * 100).toFixed(2)
                ).toString();
                coldKasAddressInput = String(data.systemConfig.cold_kas_address || '');
                outflowBreakerTrippedInput = Boolean(data.systemConfig.outflow_breaker_tripped);
            }
        } catch (e: any) {
            showBanner(e.message || 'Director connection error.', 'red');
        } finally {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    async function dispatchDirectorAction(
        payload: Record<string, any>,
        busyKey: string,
        successMsg?: string
    ) {
        actionBusyKey = busyKey;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/admin', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok) {
                showBanner(data.error || `Action ${payload.action} failed.`, 'red');
                return null;
            }
            if (successMsg) {
                showBanner(successMsg, 'emerald');
            }
            await loadDirectorDashboard();
            return data;
        } catch (err: any) {
            showBanner(err.message || 'Director command failed.', 'red');
            return null;
        } finally {
            actionBusyKey = null;
        }
    }

    async function updateSystemTreasuryConfig() {
        actionBusyKey = 'SAVE_SYS_CONFIG';
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                    action: 'UPDATE_SYSTEM_TREASURY_CONFIG',
                    payload: {
                        hotCeilingKas: parseFloat(hotCeilingKasInput) || 5000,
                        minRunwayKas: parseFloat(minRunwayKasInput) || 250,
                        fppsMaxFloatKas: parseFloat(fppsMaxFloatKasInput) || 50,
                        poolFeeRatePct: parseFloat(poolFeeRatePctInput) || 1.0,
                        coldKasAddress: coldKasAddressInput.trim(),
                        outflowBreakerTripped: outflowBreakerTrippedInput
                    }
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.success === false) {
                showBanner(data.error || 'Failed to update system treasury config.', 'red');
                return;
            }
            showBanner('System Treasury & Airlock Ceiling Configuration Updated ✓', 'emerald');
            await loadDirectorDashboard();
        } catch (e: any) {
            showBanner(e.message || 'System config update failed.', 'red');
        } finally {
            actionBusyKey = null;
        }
    }

    async function decryptPayoutBankRail(payoutId: string, walletAddress: string) {
        const key = `DECRYPT_${payoutId}`;
        actionBusyKey = key;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/admin', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'DECRYPT_BANK_RAIL',
                    payoutId,
                    wallet: walletAddress
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok) {
                showBanner(data.error || 'Failed to decrypt bank rail.', 'red');
                return;
            }
            if (data.bankRail) {
                decryptedRailsByPayout = {
                    ...decryptedRailsByPayout,
                    [payoutId]: data.bankRail
                };
                showBanner(`Decrypted ABA & Account for ${payoutId} ✓`, 'emerald');
            }
        } finally {
            actionBusyKey = null;
        }
    }

    async function downloadCsvAction(actionName: 'EXPORT_BATCH_ACH_CSV' | 'EXPORT_1099_DA_AUDIT_CSV', filenamePrefix: string) {
        actionBusyKey = actionName;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/admin', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: actionName })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || !data.csvContent) {
                showBanner(data.error || 'CSV export failed.', 'red');
                return;
            }
            if (browser) {
                const blob = new Blob([data.csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `${filenamePrefix}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                a.remove();
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                showBanner(`Exported ${data.count || 0} rows to ${filenamePrefix}.csv ✓`, 'emerald');
            }
        } finally {
            actionBusyKey = null;
        }
    }

    async function inspectDatabaseTable(tableName: string) {
        selectedDbTable = tableName;
        isLoadingTable = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/admin?table=${encodeURIComponent(tableName)}`);
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (res.ok && Array.isArray(data.rows)) {
                dbTableRows = data.rows;
            } else {
                dbTableRows = [];
            }
        } catch {
            dbTableRows = [];
        } finally {
            isLoadingTable = false;
        }
    }

    function activateMinerImpersonation(targetWallet: string) {
        const clean = targetWallet.trim();
        if (!clean) return;
        ui.adminTargetWallet = clean.startsWith('kaspa:') ? clean : `kaspa:${clean}`;
        ui.adminModeActive = true;
        ui.activeTab = 'OPERATIONS';
    }

    onMount(() => {
        loadDirectorDashboard();
        inspectDatabaseTable(selectedDbTable);
        refreshTimer = setInterval(() => {
            loadDirectorDashboard();
        }, 12000);
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        if (refreshTimer) clearInterval(refreshTimer);
    });
</script>

const LUA_CLAMPED_FEE_REVERSAL = `
local cur = tonumber(redis.call('GET', KEYS[1]) or '0')
local rev = tonumber(ARGV[1] or '0')
local next_val = math.max(0, cur - rev)
redis.call('SET', KEYS[1], tostring(next_val))
return tostring(next_val)

function roundCents(val: number): number {
    return Math.round(val * 100) / 100;
}

function safeNormalizeBase32(walletRaw: string): string {
    try {
        return normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(walletRaw);
    } catch {
        return '';
    }
}

function matchesConfiguredAdminBearer(authHeader: string): boolean {
    if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) return false;
    try {
        if (perenniaKMS.verifyMasterAdminKey(authHeader)) {
            return true;
        }
    } catch {
        // Fall through to explicit constant-time env token comparison
    }
    const cleanAdminKey = String(env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY || '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
    const cleanInternalToken = String(env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN || '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
    const candidates = [
        cleanAdminKey ? `Bearer ${cleanAdminKey}` : '',
        cleanInternalToken ? `Bearer ${cleanInternalToken}` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);

    const providedBuf = Buffer.from(authHeader.trim());
    return candidates.some((expected) => {
        const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected);
        return (
            expectedBuf.length === providedBuf.length &&
            crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, providedBuf)
        );
    });
}

async function logDirectorAuditEvent(
    directorWallet: string,
    zone: string,
    actionType: string,
    targetEntity: string,
    details: Record<string, any>
): Promise<void> {
    try {
        await dbPool.query(
            `INSERT INTO director_audit_log (director_wallet, zone, action_type, target_entity, details_json)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)`,
            [
                directorWallet || 'kaspa:director_master',
                zone,
                actionType,
                targetEntity,
                JSON.stringify(details || {})
            ]
        );
    } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Director audit log insert notice:', err);
    }
}

async function resolveDecryptedBankRailForWallet(walletRaw: string) {
    getKycMasterKeyStrict();
    const cleanWallet = safeNormalizeBase32(walletRaw);
    if (!cleanWallet) return null;
    const prefixedWallet = `kaspa:${cleanWallet}`;
    try {
        const dbRes = await dbPool.query(
            `SELECT bank_label, account_type, payout_method, bank_last4, encrypted_rail_payload, updated_at
             FROM fiat_bank_rails
             WHERE wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2
             ORDER BY updated_at DESC
             LIMIT 1`,
            [prefixedWallet, cleanWallet]
        );
        if (dbRes.rows.length > 0) {
            const row = dbRes.rows[0];
            const dec = decryptBankRailRecordStrict(
                String(row.encrypted_rail_payload || '')
            );
            if (dec) {
                return {
                    walletAddress: prefixedWallet,
                    bankLabel: String(row.bank_label || dec.bankLabel),
                    accountType: String(row.account_type || dec.accountType),
                    payoutMethod: String(row.payout_method || dec.payoutMethod),
                    routingNumber: dec.routingNumber,
                    accountNumber: dec.accountNumber,
                    bankLast4: String(
                        row.bank_last4 || dec.accountNumber.slice(-4)
                    )
                };
            }
        }
    } catch {
        // Fallback to Redis
    }
    const cachedRail = await redis
        .get(`perennia:fiat:bank_rail:${cleanWallet}`)
        .catch(() => null);
    if (cachedRail) {
        const dec = decryptBankRailRecordStrict(cachedRail);
        if (dec) {
            return {
                walletAddress: prefixedWallet,
                bankLabel: dec.bankLabel,
                accountType: dec.accountType,
                payoutMethod: dec.payoutMethod,
                routingNumber: dec.routingNumber,
                accountNumber: dec.accountNumber,
                bankLast4: dec.accountNumber.slice(-4)
            };
        }
    }
    try {
        const kycRes = await dbPool.query(
            `SELECT legal_name, bank_data_hash FROM entity_kyc WHERE wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2 LIMIT 1`,
            [prefixedWallet, cleanWallet]
        );
        if (kycRes.rows.length > 0 && kycRes.rows[0].bank_data_hash) {
            const dec = decryptBankRailRecordStrict(
                String(kycRes.rows[0].bank_data_hash)
            );
            if (dec) {
                return {
                    walletAddress: prefixedWallet,
                    bankLabel: String(
                        kycRes.rows[0].legal_name || dec.bankLabel
                    ),
                    accountType: dec.accountType,
                    payoutMethod: dec.payoutMethod,
                    routingNumber: dec.routingNumber,
                    accountNumber: dec.accountNumber,
                    bankLast4: dec.accountNumber.slice(-4)
                };
            }
        }
    } catch {
        // Ignore KYC lookup error
    }
    return null;
}

async function verifyDirectorClearance(
    request: Request,
    cookies: RequestEvent['cookies']
): Promise<{ authorized: boolean; adminWallet: string }> {
    const masterAddress =
        resolveMasterTreasuryKasAddressOptional() ||
        resolveMasterTreasuryKasAddress();
    const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization') || '';
    if (matchesConfiguredAdminBearer(authHeader)) {
        return { authorized: true, adminWallet: masterAddress };
    }
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    if (!sessionId) {
        return { authorized: false, adminWallet: '' };
    }
    const sessionWallet = await redis
        .get(`session:${sessionId}`)
        .catch(() => null);
    if (!sessionWallet) {
        return { authorized: false, adminWallet: '' };
    }
    if (isWalletMasterAdmin(sessionWallet)) {
        const cleanSession = safeNormalizeBase32(sessionWallet);
        return {
            authorized: true,
            adminWallet: cleanSession
                ? `kaspa:${cleanSession}`
                : masterAddress
        };
    }
    return { authorized: false, adminWallet: '' };
}

        await client.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS whitelisted_wallets (

        `);
        await client.query(`

        await client.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fiat_bank_rails (
                wallet_address VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,

                account_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CHECKING',

            );
        `);
        await client.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fiat_onramp_orders (
                order_id VARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY,

                payment_rail VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SOVEREIGN_WIRE_ACH',

                tier_bps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 85,
                settlement_target VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEDGER_KAS',
                target_asset VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'KAS',
                quoted_principal_cents BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                perennia_fee_cents BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 250,
                stripe_gateway_fee_cents BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

                settled_net_cents BIGINT,

        const onrampAlters = [
            `ALTER TABLE fiat_onramp_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS payment_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ach';`,
            `ALTER TABLE fiat_onramp_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tier_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RETAIL';`,
            `ALTER TABLE fiat_onramp_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tier_bps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 85;`,

            `ALTER TABLE fiat_onramp_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripe_gateway_fee_cents BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;`,
            `ALTER TABLE fiat_onramp_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gross_charge_cents BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;`,
            `ALTER TABLE fiat_onramp_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS settled_net_cents BIGINT;`,
            `ALTER TABLE fiat_onramp_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fulfilled_principal_cents BIGINT;`,

        `);
        await client.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS token_steering_matrix (

                asset_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

                is_whitelisted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
                target_weight_pct DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 10.0,
                actual_weight_pct DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
                accumulated_fee_tokens DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
                accumulated_fee_usd DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
                updated_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SYSTEM_BOOT',
                updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );
        `);
        for (const item of DEFAULT_RESERVE_WHITELIST_ASSETS) {
            await client.query(
                `INSERT INTO token_steering_matrix
                 (ticker, asset_name, network, steering_state, is_whitelisted, target_weight_pct)
                 VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                 ON CONFLICT (ticker) DO NOTHING`,
                [
                    item.ticker,
                    item.name,
                    item.network,
                    item.steeringState,
                    item.isWhitelisted,
                    item.targetWeightPct
                ]
            );
        }
        await client.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS security_firewall_blacklist (
                entry_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
                entity_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WALLET',
                target_value VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Director Firewall Block',
                active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
                added_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DIRECTOR',
                created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );
        `);
        await client.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS director_audit_log (
                audit_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
                director_wallet VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                zone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ZONE_5',
                action_type VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL,
                target_entity VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                details_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
                created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );
        `);
    } finally {
        client.release();
    }
}

async function syncSteeringMatrixToRedis(rows: any[]): Promise<void> {
    try {
        const pipe = redis.pipeline();
        for (const r of rows) {
            const ticker = String(r.ticker || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            if (!ticker) continue;
            const state = String(r.steering_state || 'AUTO_BALANCE')
                .trim()
                .toUpperCase();
            const isWl =
                Boolean(r.is_whitelisted) &&
                state !== 'PASS_THROUGH' &&
                state !== 'BLACKLISTED';
            pipe.hset('perennia:steering:token_states', ticker, state);
            pipe.hset(
                'perennia:steering:target_weights',
                ticker,
                String(Number(r.target_weight_pct || 0))
            );
            pipe.hset(
                'perennia:steering:actual_weights',
                ticker,
                String(Number(r.actual_weight_pct || 0))
            );
            if (isWl) {
                pipe.sadd('perennia:steering:whitelist', ticker);
            } else {
                pipe.srem('perennia:steering:whitelist', ticker);
            }
            if (state === 'BLACKLISTED') {
                pipe.sadd('perennia:firewall:blacklisted_tokens', ticker);
            } else {
                pipe.srem('perennia:firewall:blacklisted_tokens', ticker);
            }
        }
        await pipe.exec();
    } catch {
        // Ignore transient Redis sync error
    }
}

export const GET: RequestHandler = async ({
    request,
    cookies,
    url
}: RequestEvent) => {
    try {
        getKycMasterKeyStrict();
        resolveMasterTreasuryKasAddress();
    } catch (keyErr: any) {
        return json({ error: keyErr.message }, { status: 503 });
    }
    const clearance = await verifyDirectorClearance(request, cookies);
    if (!clearance.authorized) {
        return json(
            { error: 'FORBIDDEN: Master Director clearance required.' },
            { status: 403 }
        );
    }

    const rustBackendUrl =
        env.RUST_BACKEND_URL ||
        `http://${env.UBUNTU_NODE_IP || '127.0.0.1'}:8002`;
    const internalToken = String(
        env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN || env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY || ''
    )
        .trim()
        .replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');

    const requestedTarget = url.searchParams.get('target');
    if (requestedTarget === 'shield') {
        try {
            const shieldRes = await fetch(
                `${rustBackendUrl}/v1/admin/shield`,
                {
                    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${internalToken}` },
                    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2500)
                }
            );
            if (shieldRes.ok) {
                return json(await shieldRes.json());
            }
        } catch {
            // Fall through
