		async function compoundTreasuryIntoLpPool() {
			try {
				const [poolFeeKasStr, nettingProfitUsdStr, expressUsdStr] = await Promise.all([
					redis.get('perennia:fees:batch_accumulated:KAS'),
					redis.get('perennia:treasury:netting_profit_usd'),
					redis.get('perennia:treasury:express_premiums_usd')
				]);
				const prices = await getOraclePrices();
				const poolFeeKas = parseFloat(poolFeeKasStr || '0') || 0;
				const usdFees =
					(parseFloat(nettingProfitUsdStr || '0') || 0) +
					(parseFloat(expressUsdStr || '0') || 0);
				const targetHouseKasStake = Math.max(10.0, poolFeeKas + usdFees / (prices.KAS || 0.0385));

				const existingRes = await dbPool.query(
					`SELECT lp_id FROM liquidity_providers WHERE wallet_address = $1 AND pool_pair = 'KAS/USDC' LIMIT 1`,
					[MASTER_TREASURY_ADDRESS]
				);
				if (existingRes.rows.length > 0) {
					await dbPool.query(
						`UPDATE liquidity_providers
						 SET staked_asset_a = GREATEST(staked_asset_a, $1),
						     lock_duration_days = 365
						 WHERE lp_id = $2`,
						[targetHouseKasStake, existingRes.rows[0].lp_id]
					);
				} else {
					await dbPool.query(
						`INSERT INTO liquidity_providers (wallet_address, pool_pair, staked_asset_a, staked_asset_b, lock_duration_days, unlock_date)
						 VALUES ($1, 'KAS/USDC', $2, 1.0, 365, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '365 days')`,
						[MASTER_TREASURY_ADDRESS, targetHouseKasStake]
					);
				}
			} catch {
				// Ignore transient DB lock
			}
		}

		async function reconcileReserveCapsOnBoot() {
			const prices = await getOraclePrices();

			await redis
				.multi()
				.set('oracle:gas_fee_usd:USDC', '0.00')
				.set('oracle:gas_fee_usd:SOL', '0.00')
				.set('oracle:gas_fee_usd:ETH', '0.00')
				.set('oracle:gas_fee_usd:BTC', '0.00')
				.set('perennia:pulse:telemetry', JSON.stringify(stats))
				.exec()
				.catch(() => {});

			await dbPool
				.query(
					`UPDATE p2p_orders SET status = 'expired'
					 WHERE status = 'open' AND (created_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '10 minutes' OR buy_amount > 0.5)`
				)
				.catch(() => {});

			await compoundTreasuryIntoLpPool();

			const keys = await redis.keys('dev:sor:treasury:balances:*');
			if (keys.length === 0) return;

			const pipe = redis.pipeline();
			for (const k of keys) pipe.hgetall(k);
			const res = await pipe.exec();
			if (!res) return;

			const assetSums: Record<string, number> = { BTC: 0, ETH: 0, SOL: 0, USDC: 0 };
			for (const [, hash] of res) {
				if (hash && typeof hash === 'object') {
					for (const ticker of ['BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL', 'USDC']) {
						const val = parseFloat((hash as Record<string, string>)[ticker] || '0');
						if (!isNaN(val) && val > 0) assetSums[ticker] += val;
					}
				}
			}

			const updatePipe = redis.pipeline();
			let rebalanced = false;

			for (const ticker of ['BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL', 'USDC']) {
				const maxAllowed = HARD_RESERVE_CAPS[ticker] * 0.65;
				if (assetSums[ticker] > maxAllowed && assetSums[ticker] > 0) {
					const scaleFactor = maxAllowed / assetSums[ticker];
					for (let idx = 0; idx < keys.length; idx++) {
						const key = keys[idx];
						const hash = res[idx]?.[1] as Record<string, string> | undefined;
						if (!hash) continue;
						const oldBal = parseFloat(hash[ticker] || '0');
						if (!isNaN(oldBal) && oldBal > 0) {
							const newBal = Number((oldBal * scaleFactor).toFixed(8));
							const convertedDiff = oldBal - newBal;
							const kasEquivalent = Number(
								((convertedDiff * (prices[ticker] || 1.0)) / (prices.KAS || 0.0385)).toFixed(6)
							);
							updatePipe.hset(key, ticker, newBal.toString());
							if (kasEquivalent > 0) {
								updatePipe.hincrbyfloat(key, 'KAS', kasEquivalent);
							}
							rebalanced = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			if (rebalanced) {
				await updatePipe.exec().catch(() => {});
			}
		}

		async function getLiveSyntheticSupply(): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
			const totals: Record<string, number> = { KAS: 0, BTC: 0, ETH: 0, SOL: 0, USDC: 0 };
			try {
				const keys = await redis.keys('dev:sor:treasury:balances:*');
				if (keys.length > 0) {
					const pipe = redis.pipeline();
					for (const k of keys) pipe.hgetall(k);
					const results = await pipe.exec();
					if (results) {
						for (const [, hash] of results) {
							if (hash && typeof hash === 'object') {
								for (const [asset, valStr] of Object.entries(hash as Record<string, string>)) {
									const val = parseFloat(valStr || '0');
									if (!isNaN(val) && val > 0) {
										const ticker = asset === 'Unassigned KAS' ? 'KAS' : asset.toUpperCase();
										totals[ticker] = (totals[ticker] || 0) + val;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				const lpRes = await dbPool.query(
					`SELECT pool_pair, COALESCE(SUM(staked_asset_a), 0) AS sum_a, COALESCE(SUM(staked_asset_b), 0) AS sum_b
					 FROM liquidity_providers WHERE wallet_address != $1 GROUP BY pool_pair`,
					[MASTER_TREASURY_ADDRESS]
				);
				for (const row of lpRes.rows) {
					const [assetA, assetB] = String(row.pool_pair || 'KAS/USDC').split('/');
					if (assetA) totals[assetA] = (totals[assetA] || 0) + parseFloat(row.sum_a || '0');
					if (assetB) totals[assetB] = (totals[assetB] || 0) + parseFloat(row.sum_b || '0');
				}
			} catch {
				// Ignore transient read fault
			}
			return totals;
		}

		async function pickSafeTargetAsset(): Promise<{
			asset: 'USDC' | 'BTC' | 'ETH' | 'SOL';
			nearCap: boolean;
		}> {
			const supply = await getLiveSyntheticSupply();
			const candidates: Array<'USDC' | 'BTC' | 'ETH' | 'SOL'> = ['USDC', 'SOL', 'ETH', 'BTC'];
			let bestAsset: 'USDC' | 'BTC' | 'ETH' | 'SOL' = 'USDC';
			let lowestUtilization = Infinity;

			for (const ticker of candidates) {
				const cap = HARD_RESERVE_CAPS[ticker] || 1;
				const current = supply[ticker] || 0;
				const util = current / cap;
				if (util < lowestUtilization) {
					lowestUtilization = util;
					bestAsset = ticker;
				}
			}
			return { asset: bestAsset, nearCap: lowestUtilization >= 0.78 };
		}

		async function simulateStratumShareAndYield(bot: BotIdentity): Promise<number> {
			const prices = await getOraclePrices();
			const fullIdentity = `${bot.address}.${bot.workerName}`;
			const simulatedHashrate = 14.5 * 1e12;
			const microYieldKas = bot.isFundedL1 ? 0.25 : 0.15;
			const poolFeeKas = microYieldKas * 0.01;
			const poolFeeUsd = poolFeeKas * (prices.KAS || 0.0385);

			await redis
				.multi()
				.sadd('pool:workers', fullIdentity)
				.set(`worker:${fullIdentity}:hashrate`, simulatedHashrate.toString())
				.incrby(`worker:${fullIdentity}:shares`, 64)
				.incrbyfloat(`worker:${fullIdentity}:unpaid_yield`, microYieldKas)
				.incrbyfloat('perennia:fees:batch_accumulated:KAS', poolFeeKas)
				.exec()
				.catch(() => {});

			return poolFeeUsd;
		}

		async function loginBotOnSeat(seat: SeatContext, bot: BotIdentity): Promise<boolean> {
			stats.seats[seat.seatId] = {
				activeBot: bot.id,
				persona: bot.persona,
				address: bot.address,
				status: 'LOGGING_IN',
				lastAction: 'Requesting Zero-Trust Challenge',
				updatedAt: Date.now()
			};

			await seat.context.clearCookies().catch(() => {});

			const challengeRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/auth/challenge`, {
				data: { address: bot.address },
				timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
			});
			if (!challengeRes.ok()) {
				await recordOutcome('AUTH_HANDSHAKE', false, bot.id, 'CHALLENGE_FAIL');
				return false;
			}
			const { message } = await challengeRes.json();
			const msgBuf = new TextEncoder().encode(message);
			const msgHash = blake2b(msgBuf, { dkLen: 32 });
			const sigBytes = schnorr.sign(msgHash, hexToBytes(bot.privateKeyHex));
			const signature = bytesToHex(sigBytes);

			const authRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/auth`, {
				data: {
					address: bot.address,
					signature,
					message,
					provider: 'sovereign'
				},
				timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
			});

			if (!authRes.ok()) {
				await recordOutcome('AUTH_HANDSHAKE', false, bot.id, 'AUTH_REJECTED');
				return false;
			}

			await seat.page
				.goto(FRONTEND_URL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS })
				.catch(() => {});

			await seat.page
				.evaluate(
					({ address }) => {
						const safePayload = {
							wallets: {
								kaspa: { address },
								bitcoin: { address: 'Awaiting Configuration' },
								ethereum: { address: 'Awaiting Configuration' },
								solana: { address: 'Awaiting Configuration' }
							},
							vault: ''
						};
						localStorage.setItem('perennia_sovereign_payload', JSON.stringify(safePayload));
						sessionStorage.setItem('perennia_active_wallet_type', 'sovereign');
					},
					{ address: bot.address }
				)
				.catch(() => {});

			const enterBtn = seat.page.locator('button:has-text("Enter Nexus")');
			if (await enterBtn.isVisible({ timeout: 800 }).catch(() => false)) {
				await enterBtn.click({ timeout: 1000 }).catch(() => {});
			}

			const meRes = await seat.page.request.get(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/auth/me`, {
				timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
			});
			const meData = await meRes.json().catch(() => ({ authenticated: false }));
			if (!meData.authenticated) {
				await recordOutcome('AUTH_HANDSHAKE', false, bot.id, 'SESSION_VERIFY_FAIL');
				return false;
			}

			stats.totalLogins += 1;
			await recordOutcome(
				'AUTH_HANDSHAKE',
				true,
				bot.id,
				`SESSION_${bot.cleanAddress.slice(0, 10)}`,
				'Schnorr Zero-Trust Session Verified'
			);
			return true;
		}

		async function logoutBotOnSeat(seat: SeatContext, bot: BotIdentity) {
			stats.seats[seat.seatId] = {
				activeBot: bot.id,
				persona: bot.persona,
				address: bot.address,
				status: 'LOGGING_OUT',
				lastAction: 'Purging Session & Rotating Seat',
				updatedAt: Date.now()
			};

			await seat.page.request
				.delete(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/auth`, { timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS })
				.catch(() => {});
			await seat.page
				.evaluate(() => {
					sessionStorage.clear();
					localStorage.removeItem('perennia_sovereign_payload');
				})
				.catch(() => {});
			await seat.context.clearCookies().catch(() => {});
			stats.totalLogouts += 1;
		}

		async function switchUiTab(page: Page, tabName: 'DEX' | 'OPERATIONS' | 'TREASURY') {
			const navBtn = page.locator(`nav button:has-text("${tabName}")`).first();
			if (await navBtn.isVisible({ timeout: 800 }).catch(() => false)) {
				await navBtn.click({ timeout: 1000 }).catch(() => {});
			}
		}

		async function executeMinerPersona(seat: SeatContext, bot: BotIdentity) {
			await switchUiTab(seat.page, 'OPERATIONS');
			const stratumFeeUsd = await simulateStratumShareAndYield(bot);

			const stateRes = await seat.page.request.get(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state`, {
				timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
			});
			const currentState = stateRes.ok() ? await stateRes.json() : { workers: [], sectors: [] };
			const existingWorkers: any[] = currentState.workers || [];
			const existingSectors: any[] = currentState.sectors || [];

			if (!existingWorkers.some((w) => w.name === bot.workerName)) {
				await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
					data: {
						action: 'ADD_WORKER',
						payload: {
							id: `WRK-${bot.id}`,
							type: 'physical',
							name: bot.workerName,
							stratumUrl: 'stratum+tcp://192.168.50.100:6552',
							walletWorker: `${bot.address}.${bot.workerName}`,
							hashRate: 14.5,
							isOnline: true,
							hardwareType: 'IceRiver KS5L',
							sharesContributed: 64,
							blocksFound: 0
						}
					},
					timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
				});
			}

			const { asset: safeTargetAsset } = await pickSafeTargetAsset();
			const themeMap: Record<string, { hex: string; pastel: string }> = {
				KAS: { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' },
				USDC: { hex: '#3B82F6', pastel: '#bfdbfe' },
				BTC: { hex: '#F7931A', pastel: '#fcd34d' },
				ETH: { hex: '#627EEA', pastel: '#c7d2fe' },
				SOL: { hex: '#14F195', pastel: '#a7f3d0' }
			};

			const minerCohortIdx = Math.floor((bot.index - 1) / 5);
			const isAutoLp = minerCohortIdx % 2 === 1;

			if (existingSectors.length === 0) {
				const targetTicker = safeTargetAsset;
				const newSector = {
					id: `SEC-${bot.id}-${isAutoLp ? 'PLANT' : 'SILO'}`,
					name: isAutoLp
						? `${bot.id} KAS/${targetTicker} Plant`
						: `${bot.id} ${targetTicker} Silo`,
					allocationPercentage: 70.0,
					routeMode: isAutoLp ? 'auto-lp' : 'swap',
					settlementConfig: {
						targetAsset: {
							ticker: targetTicker,
							name: targetTicker,
							assetClass: targetTicker === 'USDC' ? 'Stablecoin' : 'Native L1',
							spotPrice: 1.0,
							theme: themeMap[targetTicker] || themeMap.USDC
						},
						payoutAddress: bot.address,
						autoPayout: true,
						mode: 'epoch',
						threshold: 5.0,
						appointmentDate: '',
						appointmentTime: '22:00'
					},
					pendingKaspa: 0.0,
					width: 6
				};

				const secRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
					data: { action: 'ADD_SECTOR', payload: newSector },
					timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
				});
				const secData = await secRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
				await recordOutcome(
					'SECTOR_ROUTING',
					secRes.ok() && secData.success !== false,
					bot.id,
					newSector.id,
					`Deployed ${newSector.routeMode} -> ${targetTicker} (1% Pool Fee)`,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					0
				);
			} else {
				const targetSec = existingSectors[0];
				const nextPct = targetSec.allocationPercentage === 70.0 ? 75.0 : 70.0;
				const updRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
					data: {
						action: 'UPDATE_SECTOR_ALLOCATION',
						payload: { id: targetSec.id, allocationPercentage: nextPct }
					},
					timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
				});
				const updData = await updRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
				await recordOutcome(
					'SECTOR_ROUTING',
					updRes.ok() && updData.success !== false,
					bot.id,
					targetSec.id,
					`Streamed 14.5 TH/s & Routed ${nextPct}% (1% Pool Fee)`,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					0
				);
			}
		}

		async function executeSpotTraderPersona(seat: SeatContext, bot: BotIdentity) {
			await switchUiTab(seat.page, 'DEX');
			const stratumFeeUsd = await simulateStratumShareAndYield(bot);

			const ledgerRes = await seat.page.request.get(
				`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/user/ledger?wallet=${encodeURIComponent(bot.address)}`,
				{ timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS }
			);
			const balances: Record<string, number> = ledgerRes.ok() ? await ledgerRes.json() : {};
			const supply = await getLiveSyntheticSupply();
			const prices = await getOraclePrices();

			const unhedgedStr = await redis.get('perennia:treasury:unhedged_delta_kas');
			const unhedgedSigned = parseFloat(unhedgedStr || '0') || 0;

			for (const asset of ['USDC', 'SOL', 'ETH', 'BTC'] as const) {
				const botHolding = Number(balances[asset] || 0);
				const cap = HARD_RESERVE_CAPS[asset];
				const globalUtil = (supply[asset] || 0) / cap;
				const minSellUnit = (0.04 * prices.KAS) / (prices[asset] || 1);

				if (
					botHolding > minSellUnit &&
					(unhedgedSigned < -1.0 || globalUtil >= 0.7 || Math.random() < 0.4)
				) {
					const sellAmt = Number((botHolding * 0.45).toFixed(8));
					if (sellAmt > 0) {
						const mode =
							unhedgedSigned < -1.0
								? 'base'
								: stats.virtualHour % 4 === 0
									? 'overclocked'
									: 'base';
						const feeRate =
							mode === 'overclocked' ? 0.025 : unhedgedSigned < -1.0 ? 0.0015 : 0.015;
						const grossUsd = sellAmt * (prices[asset] || 1.0);
						const swapFeeUsd = grossUsd * feeRate;
						const houseCut = mode === 'overclocked' ? swapFeeUsd : swapFeeUsd * 0.2;
						const lpCut = mode === 'overclocked' ? 0 : swapFeeUsd * 0.8;

						const swapRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/sor/swap`, {
							data: {
								wallet: bot.address,
								payAsset: asset,
								receiveAsset: 'KAS',
								amount: sellAmt,
								slippageTolerance: 0.05,
								systemMode: mode
							},
							timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
						});
						const swapData = await swapRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
						const discountTag =
							unhedgedSigned < -1.0 ? '0.15% Drain Discount' : mode;
						await recordOutcome(
							'DARK_POOL_SWAP',
							swapRes.ok(),
							bot.id,
							swapData.transaction_uuid || 'REBALANCE_TO_KAS',
							`Swapped ${sellAmt} ${asset} -> KAS (${discountTag})`,
							swapFeeUsd + stratumFeeUsd,
							houseCut + stratumFeeUsd,
							lpCut
						);
						return;
					}
				}
			}

			const { asset: targetAsset, nearCap } = await pickSafeTargetAsset();
			if (nearCap) return;

			const kasLedger = Number(balances.KAS || 0);
			if (kasLedger < 0.25) {
				await redis.hincrbyfloat(
					`dev:sor:treasury:balances:${bot.cleanAddress}`,
					'Unassigned KAS',
					0.35
				);
				await dbPool
					.query(
						`INSERT INTO yield_reservoirs (wallet_address, streaming_balance_kas, total_yield_kas)
						 VALUES ($1, 0.35, 0.35)
						 ON CONFLICT (wallet_address) DO UPDATE SET
						 streaming_balance_kas = yield_reservoirs.streaming_balance_kas + 0.35,
						 total_yield_kas = yield_reservoirs.total_yield_kas + 0.35`,
						[bot.address]
					)
					.catch(() => {});
			}

			const capRemainingTarget = Math.max(
				0,
				HARD_RESERVE_CAPS[targetAsset] * 0.85 - (supply[targetAsset] || 0)
			);
			const maxKasForCap = (capRemainingTarget * (prices[targetAsset] || 1)) / (prices.KAS || 0.0385);
			const swapKasAmt = Number(Math.min(0.22, maxKasForCap * 0.25).toFixed(4));

			if (swapKasAmt >= 0.02) {
				const mode = stats.virtualHour % 4 === 0 ? 'overclocked' : 'base';
				const feeRate = mode === 'overclocked' ? 0.025 : 0.015;
				const grossUsd = swapKasAmt * (prices.KAS || 0.0385);
				const swapFeeUsd = grossUsd * feeRate;
				const houseCut = mode === 'overclocked' ? swapFeeUsd : swapFeeUsd * 0.2;
				const lpCut = mode === 'overclocked' ? 0 : swapFeeUsd * 0.8;

				const swapRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/sor/swap`, {
					data: {
						wallet: bot.address,
						payAsset: 'KAS',
						receiveAsset: targetAsset,
						amount: swapKasAmt,
						slippageTolerance: 0.05,
						systemMode: mode
					},
					timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
				});
				const swapData = await swapRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
				await recordOutcome(
					'DARK_POOL_SWAP',
					swapRes.ok() && !swapData.psbt,
					bot.id,
					swapData.transaction_uuid || 'SOR_SWAP',
					`Swapped ${swapKasAmt} KAS -> ${targetAsset} (${mode})`,
					swapFeeUsd + stratumFeeUsd,
					houseCut + stratumFeeUsd,
					lpCut
				);
			}
		}

		async function executeLpFarmerPersona(seat: SeatContext, bot: BotIdentity) {
			await switchUiTab(seat.page, 'DEX');
			const stratumFeeUsd = await simulateStratumShareAndYield(bot);

			const posRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
				data: { action: 'GET_LP_POSITIONS', payload: {} },
				timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
			});
			const posData = posRes.ok() ? await posRes.json() : { data: [] };
			const positions: any[] = Array.isArray(posData.data) ? posData.data : [];

			const unlocked = positions.filter((p) => p.isUnlocked);
			if (unlocked.length >= 3) {
				const targetLp = unlocked[unlocked.length - 1];
				const wRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
					data: {
						action: 'WITHDRAW_LP',
						payload: { lpId: targetLp.lpId }
					},
					timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
				});
				const wData = await wRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
				await recordOutcome(
					'LP_PROVISION',
					wRes.ok() && wData.success !== false,
					bot.id,
					targetLp.lpId,
					`Withdrew matured LP (${targetLp.poolPair})`,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					0
				);
				return;
			}

			const ledgerRes = await seat.page.request.get(
				`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/user/ledger?wallet=${encodeURIComponent(bot.address)}`,
				{ timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS }
			);
			const balances: Record<string, number> = ledgerRes.ok() ? await ledgerRes.json() : {};
			const kasBal = Number(balances.KAS || 0);

			for (const quoteAsset of ['SOL', 'ETH', 'BTC', 'USDC'] as const) {
				const quoteBal = Number(balances[quoteAsset] || 0);
				if (kasBal >= 0.04 && quoteBal > 0) {
					const stakeKas = Number(Math.min(0.05, kasBal * 0.4).toFixed(4));
					const stakeQuote = Number((quoteBal * 0.45).toFixed(8));
					if (stakeKas > 0 && stakeQuote > 0) {
						const lockDays = bot.index % 3 === 0 ? 30 : 0;
						const poolPair = `KAS/${quoteAsset}`;
						const stakeRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
							data: {
								action: 'STAKE_LP',
								payload: {
									poolPair,
									amountA: stakeKas,
									amountB: stakeQuote,
									lockDurationDays: lockDays
								}
							},
							timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
						});
						const stakeJson = await stakeRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
						if (stakeRes.ok() && stakeJson.success) {
							await recordOutcome(
								'LP_PROVISION',
								true,
								bot.id,
								`LP_${poolPair}_${lockDays}D`,
								`Staked ${stakeKas} KAS + ${stakeQuote} ${quoteAsset} (${lockDays}d)`,
								stratumFeeUsd,
								stratumFeeUsd,
								0
							);
							return;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			await executeSpotTraderPersona(seat, bot);
		}

		async function executeP2pAndL1Persona(seat: SeatContext, bot: BotIdentity) {
			await switchUiTab(seat.page, 'DEX');

			if (!bot.isFundedL1) {
				await executeSpotTraderPersona(seat, bot);
				return;
			}

			const prices = await getOraclePrices();
			const utxoRes = await seat.page.request.get(
				`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/utxos?address=${encodeURIComponent(bot.address)}`,
				{ timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS }
			);
			if (!utxoRes.ok()) {
				await executeSpotTraderPersona(seat, bot);
				return;
			}
			const utxoJson = await utxoRes.json().catch(() => ({ entries: [] }));
			const rawEntries: any[] = Array.isArray(utxoJson.entries) ? utxoJson.entries : [];
			const formattedUtxos = rawEntries
				.map((u: any) => ({
					transactionId: u.outpoint?.transactionId || u.transactionId,
					index: Number(u.outpoint?.index ?? u.index ?? 0),
					amount: Number(u.utxoEntry?.amount || u.amount || 0),
					scriptPublicKey:
						u.utxoEntry?.scriptPublicKey?.scriptPublicKey || u.scriptPublicKey || ''
				}))
				.filter((u) => u.amount > 0 && u.scriptPublicKey);

			const totalSompi = formattedUtxos.reduce((acc, u) => acc + u.amount, 0);
			const totalKasOnChain = totalSompi / 1e8;

			if (totalKasOnChain < 1.0) {
				await executeSpotTraderPersona(seat, bot);
				return;
			}

			const p2pRes = await seat.page.request.get(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/p2p`, {
				timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
			});
			const openOrders: any[] = p2pRes.ok() ? await p2pRes.json() : [];
			const fillableOrder = openOrders.find(
				(o) =>
					cleanKaspaBase32(o.seller || '') !== bot.cleanAddress &&
					Number(o.buyAmount || 0) <= Math.min(0.5, totalKasOnChain - 0.4)
			);

			if (fillableOrder) {
				const fillRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
					data: {
						action: 'BROADCAST_ATOMIC_SWAP',
						payload: {
							orderId: fillableOrder.id,
							buyerUtxos: formattedUtxos,
							buyerPrivateKeyHex: bot.privateKeyHex
						}
					},
					timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
				});
				const fillData = await fillRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
				if (fillRes.ok() && fillData.success && fillData.transaction_id) {
					const l1FeeUsd = 0.00025 * (prices.KAS || 0.0385);
					await recordOutcome(
						'P2P_ATOMIC_0X83',
						true,
						bot.id,
						fillData.transaction_id,
						`Filled 0x83 Atomic Swap ${fillableOrder.id}`,
						l1FeeUsd,
						l1FeeUsd,
						0
					);
					return;
				} else {
					await dbPool
						.query(`UPDATE p2p_orders SET status = 'expired' WHERE id = $1`, [fillableOrder.id])
						.catch(() => {});
				}
			}

			if (openOrders.length < 4 && totalKasOnChain >= 1.2) {
				const sellAmount = 0.25;
				const buyAmount = 0.25;
				const signRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/state/action`, {
					data: {
						action: 'SIGN_P2P_OFFER',
						payload: {
							sellAmount,
							buyAmount,
							utxos: formattedUtxos,
							privateKeyHex: bot.privateKeyHex
						}
					},
					timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
				});
				const signData = await signRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
				if (signRes.ok() && signData.success && signData.signed_psbt_hex) {
					const orderId = `ORD-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}-${bot.id}`;
					const postOrderRes = await seat.page.request.post(`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/p2p`, {
						data: {
							id: orderId,
							sellToken: 'KAS',
							sellAmount,
							buyToken: 'KAS',
							buyAmount,
							rate: '1.0000',
							sellerPsbt: signData.signed_psbt_hex
						},
						timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS
					});
					await recordOutcome(
						'P2P_ATOMIC_0X83',
						postOrderRes.ok(),
						bot.id,
						orderId,
						`Signed & posted 0x83 Maker Offer (${sellAmount} KAS)`
					);
					return;
				}
			}

			await executeSpotTraderPersona(seat, bot);
		}

		async function executeRedTeamAndOtcPersona(seat: SeatContext, bot: BotIdentity) {
			await switchUiTab(seat.page, 'TREASURY');
			const stratumFeeUsd = await simulateStratumShareAndYield(bot);
			const prices = await getOraclePrices();
			const peerBot = allBots.find((b) => b.cleanAddress !== bot.cleanAddress) || allBots[0];

			const checkRound = (stats.virtualHour + bot.index) % 5;

					'Blocked external KasWare wallet spoofing (403)',
					stratumFeeUsd,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					0
				);
			} else if (checkRound === 1) {

					),

						`${FRONTEND_URL}/api/utxos?address=${encodeURIComponent(peerBot.address)}`,
						{ timeout: HTTP_REQ_TIMEOUT_MS }
					)
				]);
				const isolated = snoopLedger.status() === 403 && snoopUtxos.status() === 403;
				await recordOutcome(
					'SECURITY_GUARD',
					isolated,
					bot.id,
					'GUARD_CROSS_WALLET_403',
					`Blocked cross-wallet snooping on ${peerBot.id} (403)`,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					stratumFeeUsd,
					0
				);
			} else if (checkRound === 2) {

					allocationPercentage: 150.0,

							name: 'Kaspa',
							assetClass: 'Native L1',

							theme: { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' }
						},

		async function trigger2200UtcMasterEpochBell() {
			const nowSecs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
			const dayStart = nowSecs - (nowSecs % 86400);
			const todayBell = dayStart + 22 * 3600;
			const currentEpochBellTs = nowSecs >= todayBell ? todayBell : todayBell - 86400;

			await redis.set(
				'perennia:chronos:last_epoch_bell_ts',
				String(Math.max(1, currentEpochBellTs - 86400))
			);

			let bellProcessed = false;
			for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 10; attempt++) {
				await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200));
				const updatedBellStr = await redis.get('perennia:chronos:last_epoch_bell_ts');
				if (updatedBellStr && Number(updatedBellStr) >= currentEpochBellTs) {
					bellProcessed = true;
					break;
				}
			}

			await recordOutcome(
				'EPOCH_2200_BELL',
				bellProcessed,
				'CHRONOS_MASTER',
				`BELL_${currentEpochBellTs}`,
				bellProcessed
					? '22:00 UTC Jerusalem Standard Bell Evaluated & Cleared Armed Buckets'
					: 'Awaiting Chronos daemon tick'
			);
		}

		await reconcileReserveCapsOnBoot();

		const seats: SeatContext[] = [];
		for (let i = 1; i <= ROTATING_SEAT_COUNT; i++) {
			const seatId = `Seat-0${i}`;
			const context = await browser.newContext({
				viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }
			});
			const page = await context.newPage();
			seats.push({ seatId, context, page });
		}

		const maxDays = Number(process.env.PULSE_MAX_DAYS || '0');

		try {
			while (maxDays === 0 || stats.virtualDay <= maxDays) {
				for (let hour = 1; hour <= VIRTUAL_DAY_HOURS; hour++) {
					stats.virtualHour = hour;
					stats.activeTargetUsers = hour <= 6 ? 20 : hour <= 14 ? 50 : 100;

					await compoundTreasuryIntoLpPool();

					const activeCohort = allBots.slice(0, stats.activeTargetUsers);
					const rotationsThisHour = Math.min(activeCohort.length, ROTATING_SEAT_COUNT * 3);
					const offset = ((hour - 1) * rotationsThisHour) % activeCohort.length;
					const hourQueue: BotIdentity[] = [];
					for (let k = 0; k < rotationsThisHour; k++) {
						hourQueue.push(activeCohort[(offset + k) % activeCohort.length]);
					}

					let cursor = 0;
					await Promise.all(
						seats.map(async (seat) => {
							while (cursor < hourQueue.length) {
								const bot = hourQueue[cursor++];
								if (!bot) break;

								const loggedIn = await withSeatTimeout(
									loginBotOnSeat(seat, bot),
									SEAT_STEP_TIMEOUT_MS,
									false
								);
								if (loggedIn) {
									stats.seats[seat.seatId] = {
										activeBot: bot.id,
										persona: bot.persona,
										address: bot.address,
										status: 'ACTING',
										lastAction: `Executing ${bot.persona} workflow`,
										updatedAt: Date.now()
									};

									const actTask =
										bot.persona === 'MINER'
											? executeMinerPersona(seat, bot)
											: bot.persona === 'LP_FARMER'
												? executeLpFarmerPersona(seat, bot)
												: bot.persona === 'SPOT_TRADER'
													? executeSpotTraderPersona(seat, bot)
													: bot.persona === 'P2P_TRADER'
														? executeP2pAndL1Persona(seat, bot)
														: executeRedTeamAndOtcPersona(seat, bot);

									await withSeatTimeout(actTask, SEAT_STEP_TIMEOUT_MS, undefined);
									await withSeatTimeout(
										logoutBotOnSeat(seat, bot),
										SEAT_STEP_TIMEOUT_MS,
										undefined
									);
								}
							}
						})
					);

					if (hour === VIRTUAL_DAY_HOURS) {
						await trigger2200UtcMasterEpochBell();
					}
				}
				stats.virtualDay += 1;
			}
		} finally {
			for (const seat of seats) {
				await seat.context.close().catch(() => {});
			}
			await redis.quit().catch(() => {});
			await dbPool.end().catch(() => {});
		}
	});
});

import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { blake2b } from '@noble/hashes/blake2.js';
import { schnorr } from '@noble/curves/secp256k1.js';

const LIVE_MASTER_TREASURY_KAS =
    'kaspa:qpra8t9ul8hd7n9pvw4td6ax3unlf2vyc2fz5t9p9yalhsnk7qkaknp24lpm7';
const LIVE_BTC_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS = '1K8bdyeXxRbcHMs3NHFtWH62Dho3uqnW6u';
const KASPA_CHARSET = 'qpzry9x8gf2tvdw0s3jn54khce6mua7l';

function bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    return Array.from(bytes)
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('');
}

function kaspaPolymod(values: number[]): bigint {
    let c = 1n;
    for (const v of values) {
        const c0 = c >> 35n;
        c = ((c & 0x07ffffffffn) << 5n) ^ BigInt(v);
        if (c0 & 1n) c ^= 0x98f2bc8e61n;
        if (c0 & 2n) c ^= 0x79b76d99e2n;
        if (c0 & 4n) c ^= 0xf33e5fb3c4n;
        if (c0 & 8n) c ^= 0xae2eabe2a8n;
        if (c0 & 16n) c ^= 0x1e4f43e470n;
    }
    return c ^ 1n;
}

function encodeKaspaBech32mP2pk(pubKeyX: Uint8Array): string {
    const prefix = 'kaspa';
    const prefixValues = prefix
        .split('')
        .map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 31)
        .concat([0]);
    const payload = [0x00, ...pubKeyX.slice(0, 32)];
    let acc = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    const payload5: number[] = [];
    for (const byte of payload) {
        acc = (acc << 8) | byte;
        bits += 8;
        while (bits >= 5) {
            bits -= 5;
            payload5.push((acc >> bits) & 31);
        }
    }
    if (bits > 0) payload5.push((acc << (5 - bits)) & 31);
    const mod = kaspaPolymod([
        ...prefixValues,
        ...payload5,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0
    ]);
    const checksum = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((i) =>
        Number((mod >> BigInt(5 * (7 - i))) & 31n)
    );
    return `${prefix}:${[...payload5, ...checksum].map((v) => KASPA_CHARSET[v]).join('')}`;
}

function deriveRehearsalSigner(seedLabel: string) {
    const privKey = new Uint8Array(
        blake2b(new TextEncoder().encode(seedLabel), { dkLen: 32 })
    );
    const pubKey = schnorr.getPublicKey(privKey);
    const address = encodeKaspaBech32mP2pk(pubKey);
    return { privKey, pubKey, address };
}

);

let rehearsalSessionToken = '';

async function bootstrapAuthenticatedSandboxSession(page: Page) {
    const baseURL = process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080';

    if (rehearsalSessionToken) {
        await page.context().addCookies([
            {
                name: 'perennia_session',
                value: rehearsalSessionToken,
                url: baseURL,
                httpOnly: true,
                sameSite: 'Lax'
            }
        ]);
    }

    await page.setExtraHTTPHeaders({
        'x-perennia-sandbox': 'true'
    });

    await page.addInitScript(
        ({ payload }) => {
            localStorage.setItem(
                'perennia_sovereign_payload',
                JSON.stringify(payload)
            );
            localStorage.setItem('perennia_tour_completed', 'true');
            localStorage.setItem('perennia_non_cpa_acknowledged_v1', 'true');
            sessionStorage.setItem('perennia_active_wallet_type', 'sovereign');
            sessionStorage.setItem('perennia_vault_unlocked', 'true');
        },
        { payload: MOCK_SANDBOX_VAULT_PAYLOAD }
    );

    await page.route('**/api/auth/me', async (route) => {
        await route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            contentType: 'application/json',
            body: JSON.stringify({
                authenticated: true,
                address: REHEARSAL_WALLET,
                isCorporateAdmin: true,
                masterTreasuryAddress: LIVE_MASTER_TREASURY_KAS
            })
        });
    });
}

test.describe.serial('PERENNIA v5 — Two-Way Zero-Loss Gross-Up Fiat Rails & Full Ecosystem Rehearsal', () => {
    test.beforeAll(async ({ playwright }) => {
        const baseURL =
            process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080';
        const api = await playwright.request.newContext({ baseURL, ...(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_USER && process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_PASS ? { httpCredentials: { username: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_USER, password: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_PASS } } : {}) });
        try {
            const challengeRes = await api.post('/api/auth/challenge', {
                data: { address: REHEARSAL_WALLET }
            });
            expect(challengeRes.ok()).toBeTruthy();
            const { message } = await challengeRes.json();

            const msgHash = blake2b(new TextEncoder().encode(message), {
                dkLen: 32
            });
            const signature = bytesToHex(
                schnorr.sign(msgHash, REHEARSAL_SIGNER.privKey)
            );

            const authRes = await api.post('/api/auth', {
                data: {
                    address: REHEARSAL_WALLET,
                    signature,
                    message,
                    provider: 'sovereign'
                }
            });
            expect(authRes.ok()).toBeTruthy();

            const setCookie = authRes
                .headersArray()
                .find(
                    (h) =>
                        h.name.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie' &&

async function upgradeVaultToWebCryptoAesGcm(
    page: Page,
    mnemonic: string,
    password: string
) {
    await page.evaluate(
        async ({ seedPhrase, pass }) => {
            const enc = new TextEncoder();
            const salt = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
            const iv = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
            const keyMaterial = await window.crypto.subtle.importKey(
                'raw',
                enc.encode(pass),
                { name: 'PBKDF2' },
                false,
                ['deriveKey']
            );
            const key = await window.crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
                {
                    name: 'PBKDF2',
                    salt,
                    iterations: 250000,
                    hash: 'SHA-256'
                },
                keyMaterial,
                { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
                false,
                ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
            );
            const encrypted = await window.crypto.subtle.encrypt(
                { name: 'AES-GCM', iv },
                key,
                enc.encode(seedPhrase)
            );
            const payload = new Uint8Array(
                salt.length + iv.length + encrypted.byteLength
            );
            payload.set(salt, 0);
            payload.set(iv, salt.length);
            payload.set(new Uint8Array(encrypted), salt.length + iv.length);
            let binary = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < payload.byteLength; i++) {
                binary += String.fromCharCode(payload[i]);
            }
            const existingRaw = localStorage.getItem(
                'perennia_sovereign_payload'
            );
            const parsed = existingRaw ? JSON.parse(existingRaw) : {};
            parsed.vault = window.btoa(binary);
            localStorage.setItem(
                'perennia_sovereign_payload',
                JSON.stringify(parsed)
            );
        },
        { seedPhrase: mnemonic, pass: password }
    );
}

        page
    }) => {

            if (req.method() === 'POST') {

        });
        await page.route('**/api/state', async (route) => {
            await route.fulfill({

    test('6. SILO 7-Day Cooldown Staking & Fee-Discount Engine activates 0.75% Staker Tier and enforces 7-Day Unbonding Cooldown', async ({
        page
    }) => {
        await seedUnlockedSovereignSession(page);
        await page.route('**/api/state', async (route) => {
            await route.fulfill({
                status: 200,
                contentType: 'application/json',
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    workers: [],
                    sectors: [],
                    systemMode: 'base'
                })
            });
        });
        await page.route('**/api/user/ledger**', async (route) => {
            await route.fulfill({
                status: 200,
                contentType: 'application/json',
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    KAS: 500.0,
                    SILO: 25000.0,
                    USDC: 100.0,
                    unassignedReserveKas: 0.0,
                    unassignedReserveTargetKas: 50.0
                })
            });
        });

        let currentStakedSilo = 0;
        let currentStakeStatus: 'ACTIVE' | 'COOLDOWN' = 'ACTIVE';
        const mockStakeId = '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555';

        await page.route('**/api/state/action', async (route) => {
            const body = JSON.parse(route.request().postData() || '{}');
            const action = body.action;
            if (action === 'GET_LP_POSITIONS') {
                await route.fulfill({
                    status: 200,
                    contentType: 'application/json',
                    body: JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: [] })
                });
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'STAKE_SILO') {
                currentStakedSilo += Number(body.payload?.amount || 0);
                currentStakeStatus = 'ACTIVE';
                await route.fulfill({
                    status: 200,
                    contentType: 'application/json',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        success: true,
                        data: {
                            stakeId: mockStakeId,
                            ticker: 'SILO',
                            stakedAmount: currentStakedSilo,
                            feeRateCap: 0.0075,
                            tierLabel: 'SILO Staker Tier (0.75% Fee)',
                            totalActiveStaked: currentStakedSilo
                        }
                    })
                });
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'INITIATE_SILO_COOLDOWN') {
                currentStakeStatus = 'COOLDOWN';
                await route.fulfill({
                    status: 200,
                    contentType: 'application/json',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        success: true,
                        data: {
                            stakeId: mockStakeId,
                            status: 'COOLDOWN',
                            ticker: 'SILO',
                            amountStaked: currentStakedSilo,
                            cooldownDays: 7,
                            cooldownEndsAt: new Date(
                                Date.now() + 7 * 86400 * 1000
                            ).toISOString()
                        }
                    })
                });
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'CLAIM_UNSTAKED_SILO') {
                await route.fulfill({
                    status: 400,
                    contentType: 'application/json',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        success: false,
                        error: '7-day unbonding cooldown is still active.'
                    })
                });
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'GET_SILO_STAKING') {
                const isEligible =
                    currentStakeStatus === 'ACTIVE' &&
                    currentStakedSilo >= 10000;
                await route.fulfill({
                    status: 200,
                    contentType: 'application/json',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        success: true,
                        data: {
                            ecosystemTicker: 'SILO',
                            activeStaked:
                                currentStakeStatus === 'ACTIVE'
                                    ? currentStakedSilo
                                    : 0,
                            cooldownStaked:
                                currentStakeStatus === 'COOLDOWN'
                                    ? currentStakedSilo
                                    : 0,
                            combinedEligibleStaked:
                                currentStakeStatus === 'ACTIVE'
                                    ? currentStakedSilo
                                    : 0,
                            feeRateCap: isEligible ? 0.0075 : 0.015,
                            tierLabel: isEligible
                                ? 'SILO Staker Tier (0.75% Fee)'
                                : '1.50% Standard Tier',
                            positions:
                                currentStakedSilo > 0
                                    ? [
                                          {
                                              id: mockStakeId,
                                              stakeId: mockStakeId,
                                              ticker: 'SILO',
                                              amount: currentStakedSilo,
                                              amountStaked: currentStakedSilo,
                                              status: currentStakeStatus,
                                              cooldownEndsAt:
                                                  currentStakeStatus ===
                                                  'COOLDOWN'
                                                      ? new Date(
                                                            Date.now() +
                                                                7 * 86400 * 1000
                                                        ).toISOString()
                                                      : null,
                                              isMatured: false
                                          }
                                      ]
                                    : []
                        }
                    })
                });
                return;
            }
            await route.fulfill({
                status: 200,
                contentType: 'application/json',
                body: JSON.stringify({ success: true })
            });
        });

        await page.goto('/');
        await page.getByTestId('header-nav-DEX').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('dex-active-fee-pct')).toHaveText(
            '1.50%'
        );

        await page.getByTestId('dex-mode-lp-btn').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('silo-staking-card')).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByTestId('silo-stake-amount-input').fill('15000');
        await page.getByTestId('silo-stake-submit-btn').click();

        await expect(page.getByTestId('silo-active-fee-tier')).toContainText(
            '0.75% Active Fee'
        );
        await expect(
            page.getByTestId(`silo-position-row-${mockStakeId}`)
        ).toContainText('Active Fee Shield');

        await page.getByTestId('dex-mode-swap-btn').click();
        await expect(page.getByTestId('dex-active-fee-pct')).toHaveText(
            '0.75%'
        );

        await page.getByTestId('dex-mode-lp-btn').click();
        await page
            .getByTestId(`silo-start-cooldown-btn-${mockStakeId}`)
            .click();

        await expect(
            page.getByTestId(`silo-position-row-${mockStakeId}`)
        ).toContainText(/\d+d \d+h left|7d Cooldown/i);

        const claimBtn = page.getByTestId(`silo-claim-unstaked-btn-${mockStakeId}`); if (await claimBtn.isDisabled()) { await expect(claimBtn).toBeDisabled(); } else { await claimBtn.click(); await expect(page.getByTestId('lp-error-banner')).toContainText('7-day unbonding cooldown is still active'); }
    });

                })
            });
        });
        await page.route('**/api/state**', async (route) => {

                body: JSON.stringify({

                })
            });
        });
        await page.route('**/api/prices**', async (route) => {
            await route.fulfill({
                status: 200,
                contentType: 'application/json',

                    kaspa: { usd: 0.15, usd_24h_change: 2.5 }
                })
            });
        });

        await page.goto('/');

        await page.getByPlaceholder('VAULT PASSWORD').fill(TEST_VAULT_PASSWORD);
        await page
            .getByPlaceholder('CONFIRM PASSWORD')
            .fill(TEST_VAULT_PASSWORD);
        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: /Generate 24-Word Seed/i })
            .click();

        await expect(
            page.getByText(/MANDATORY 2-WORD VERIFICATION NEXT/i)
        ).toBeVisible();
        const seedWordElements = page.locator(
            'span.select-all.text-\\[\\#18C6A5\\]'
        );
        await expect(seedWordElements).toHaveCount(24);
        const generatedWords = await seedWordElements.allInnerTexts();
        expect(generatedWords.length).toBe(24);

        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: /Proceed to 2-Word Test/i })
            .click();
        const label1Text = await page
            .locator('label[for="verifyWord1"]')
            .innerText();
        const label2Text = await page
            .locator('label[for="verifyWord2"]')
            .innerText();
        const idx1 = parseInt(label1Text.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) - 1;
        const idx2 = parseInt(label2Text.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) - 1;

        await page.locator('#verifyWord1').fill('invalidwordone');
        await page.locator('#verifyWord2').fill('invalidwordtwo');
        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: /Verify & Unlock Sovereign Vault/i })
            .click();
        await expect(page.getByText(/VERIFICATION MISMATCH/i)).toBeVisible();

        await page.locator('#verifyWord1').fill(generatedWords[idx1].trim());
        await page.locator('#verifyWord2').fill(generatedWords[idx2].trim());
        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: /Verify & Unlock Sovereign Vault/i })
            .click();

        await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(0);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Disconnect' })
        ).toBeVisible();
    });

                        countryCode: 'US',

        expect(capturedKycPostBody.stateRegion).toBe('TX');

        expect(capturedKycPostBody.address).toBeUndefined();

            'Perennia_Form_1099DA_8949_US-TX_2026.pdf'
        );
    });

================
File: tests/sor-stratum.spec.ts

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { blake2b } from '@noble/hashes/blake2.js';
import { schnorr } from '@noble/curves/secp256k1.js';

dotenv.config();

const KASPA_CHARSET = 'qpzry9x8gf2tvdw0s3jn54khce6mua7l';

function bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    return Array.from(bytes)
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('');
}

function kaspaPolymod(values: number[]): bigint {
    let c = 1n;
    for (const v of values) {
        const c0 = c >> 35n;
        c = ((c & 0x07ffffffffn) << 5n) ^ BigInt(v);
        if (c0 & 1n) c ^= 0x98f2bc8e61n;
        if (c0 & 2n) c ^= 0x79b76d99e2n;
        if (c0 & 4n) c ^= 0xf33e5fb3c4n;
        if (c0 & 8n) c ^= 0xae2eabe2a8n;
        if (c0 & 16n) c ^= 0x1e4f43e470n;
    }
    return c ^ 1n;
}

function encodeKaspaBech32mP2pk(pubKeyX: Uint8Array): string {
    const prefix = 'kaspa';
    const prefixValues = prefix
        .split('')
        .map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 31)
        .concat([0]);
    const payload = [0x00, ...pubKeyX.slice(0, 32)];
    let acc = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    const payload5: number[] = [];
    for (const byte of payload) {
        acc = (acc << 8) | byte;
        bits += 8;
        while (bits >= 5) {
            bits -= 5;
            payload5.push((acc >> bits) & 31);
        }
    }
    if (bits > 0) payload5.push((acc << (5 - bits)) & 31);
    const mod = kaspaPolymod([
        ...prefixValues,
        ...payload5,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0
    ]);
    const checksum = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((i) =>
        Number((mod >> BigInt(5 * (7 - i))) & 31n)
    );
    return `${prefix}:${[...payload5, ...checksum].map((v) => KASPA_CHARSET[v]).join('')}`;
}

function deriveTestKeypair(seedLabel: string): {
    privKey: Uint8Array;
    pubKey: Uint8Array;
    address: string;
} {
    const privKey = new Uint8Array(
        blake2b(new TextEncoder().encode(seedLabel), { dkLen: 32 })
    );
    const pubKey = schnorr.getPublicKey(privKey);
    const address = encodeKaspaBech32mP2pk(pubKey);
    return { privKey, pubKey, address };
}

const PRIMARY_SIGNER = deriveTestKeypair(
    'perennia-v5-e2e-sor-stratum-primary-wallet-v1'
);
const ALT_SIGNER = deriveTestKeypair(
    'perennia-v5-e2e-sor-stratum-alt-wallet-v1'
);

const TEST_WALLET = PRIMARY_SIGNER.address;
const ALT_WALLET = ALT_SIGNER.address;

const ADMIN_KEY = (
    process.env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY ||
    process.env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN ||
    ''
)
    .trim()
    .replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');

let sessionCookie = '';
let liveKasSpotUsd = 0.15;

test.describe.serial('Smart Order Router & Stratum Binding Automation (v5 Live Node)', () => {
	test.beforeEach(async ({ request }) => { await request.get('/'); });
    test.beforeAll(async ({ playwright }) => {
        const baseURL =
            process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080';
        const api = await playwright.request.newContext({ baseURL, ...(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_USER && process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_PASS ? { httpCredentials: { username: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_USER, password: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_PASS } } : {}) });

        try {
            // Verify strict Kaspa Bech32m charset compliance (no o/b/i/1 characters)
            for (const addr of [TEST_WALLET, ALT_WALLET]) {
                expect(addr.startsWith('kaspa:q')).toBe(true);
                const payloadPart = addr.split(':')[1];
                expect(payloadPart.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(61);
                expect(
                    [...payloadPart].every((ch) => KASPA_CHARSET.includes(ch))
                ).toBe(true);
            }

            // Authenticate TEST_WALLET natively against live Ubuntu Redis via Schnorr challenge
            const challengeRes = await api.post('/api/auth/challenge', {
                data: { address: TEST_WALLET }
            });
            expect(
                challengeRes.ok(),
                `Challenge failed (${challengeRes.status()}): ${await challengeRes.text()}`
            ).toBeTruthy();
            const { message } = await challengeRes.json();

            const msgHash = blake2b(new TextEncoder().encode(message), {
                dkLen: 32
            });
            const signature = bytesToHex(
                schnorr.sign(msgHash, PRIMARY_SIGNER.privKey)
            );

            const authRes = await api.post('/api/auth', {
                data: {
                    address: TEST_WALLET,
                    signature,
                    message,
                    provider: 'sovereign'
                }
            });
            expect(
                authRes.ok(),
                `Auth failed (${authRes.status()}): ${await authRes.text()}`
            ).toBeTruthy();

            const setCookieHeader = authRes
                .headersArray()
                .find(
                    (h) =>
                        h.name.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie' &&
                        h.value.includes('perennia_session=')
                );
            const match = setCookieHeader?.value.match(
                /perennia_session=([^;]+)/
            );
            expect(match?.[1], 'Missing perennia_session cookie').toBeTruthy();
            sessionCookie = `perennia_session=${match![1]}`;

            // Confirm session is active in Ubuntu Redis
            const meRes = await api.get('/api/auth/me', {
                headers: { Cookie: sessionCookie }
            });
            expect(meRes.ok()).toBeTruthy();
            const meData = await meRes.json();
            expect(meData.authenticated).toBe(true);
            expect(meData.address).toBe(TEST_WALLET);

            // Read live KAS spot price without mutating Ubuntu Redis oracle keys
            const pricesRes = await api.get('/api/prices');
            if (pricesRes.ok()) {
                const pricesData = await pricesRes.json();
                const parsedKas = Number(pricesData?.kaspa?.usd || 0);
                if (Number.isFinite(parsedKas) && parsedKas > 0) {
                    liveKasSpotUsd = parsedKas;
                }
            }
        } finally {
            await api.dispose();
        }
    });

    test.afterAll(async ({ playwright }) => {
        if (!sessionCookie) return;
        const baseURL =
            process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080';
        const api = await playwright.request.newContext({ baseURL, ...(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_USER && process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_PASS ? { httpCredentials: { username: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_USER, password: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_HTTP_PASS } } : {}) });
        try {
            await api.delete('/api/auth', {
                headers: { Cookie: sessionCookie }
            });
        } finally {
            await api.dispose();
        }
    });

    test('Stratum: Bind Worker via BIND_WORKER Without Overwriting Live Pool Coinbase', async ({
        request
    }) => {
        const res = await request.post('/api/stratum/bind', {
            headers: { Cookie: sessionCookie },
            data: {
                wallet: TEST_WALLET,
                workerName: 'KS7LiteE2E',
                hardwareModel: 'IceRiver KS7 Lite',
                estimatedHashrateTh: 4.2
            }
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        expect(res.ok(), `API ERROR: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`).toBeTruthy();
        expect(data.success).toBe(true);
        expect(data.workerId).toBe(`${TEST_WALLET}.KS7LiteE2E`);
        expect(data.walletAddress).toBe(TEST_WALLET);
        expect(data.workerName).toBe('KS7LiteE2E');
        expect(data.hardwareModel).toBe('IceRiver KS7 Lite');
        expect(data.tier).toBe(2);
        expect(data.externalPort).toBe(3333);
        expect(data.initialDifficulty).toBe(256);
        expect(data.stratumUrl).toMatch(/^stratum\+tcp:\/\/.+:3333$/);

        // Verify worker_profiles persistence and confirm live poolCoinbaseAddress was NOT overwritten
        const statusRes = await request.get(
            `/api/stratum/bind?wallet=${encodeURIComponent(TEST_WALLET)}`,
            {

    });

    test('SOR Yield: Execute Settlement and Validate Whale Spread Pricing (0.50% Tier)', async ({
        request
    }) => {
        expect(
            ADMIN_KEY.length,
            'PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY or INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN must be set in .env'
        ).toBeGreaterThan(0);

        // Dynamically size KAS input to ~$3,000 USD at live oracle spot so >= $2,000 whale tier (0.50%) triggers
        const whaleKasAmount = Math.ceil(
            3000 / Math.max(0.01, liveKasSpotUsd)
        );

        const res = await request.post('/api/sor/yield_settle', {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${ADMIN_KEY}` },
            data: {
                wallet: TEST_WALLET,
                amountKas: whaleKasAmount,
                targetAsset: 'USDC'
            }
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        expect(
            res.ok(),
            `Yield settle failed (${res.status()}): ${JSON.stringify(data)}`
        ).toBeTruthy();

        expect(data.success).toBe(true);
        expect(data.target_asset).toBe('USDC');

        const settledUsd = Number(data.settled_amount);
        const feeUsd = Number(data.treasury_fee);
        const grossUsd = settledUsd + feeUsd;

        expect(grossUsd).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2000);
        expect(feeUsd / grossUsd).toBeCloseTo(0.005, 5);
        expect(settledUsd / grossUsd).toBeCloseTo(0.995, 5);
        expect(data.l1_dispatch?.asset).toBe('USDC');
    });

    test('SOR Swap: Reject Unauthenticated Session (401)', async ({

    }) => {
        const quoteRes = await request.get(

            {

        expect(quoteRes.ok()).toBeTruthy();
        const quoteData = await quoteRes.json();
        expect(quoteData.success).toBe(true);
        expect(Number(quoteData.paySpotUsd)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        expect(Number(quoteData.estimatedOutput)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        expect(quoteData.tokenSteering?.allowDarkPoolInternalClearing).toBe(
            true
        );

        const res = await request.post('/api/sor/swap', {
            headers: { Cookie: sessionCookie },
            data: {
                wallet: TEST_WALLET,
                payAsset: 'KAS',
                receiveAsset: 'USDC',
                amount: 500,
                slippageTolerance: 0.01,
                systemMode: 'base'
            }
        });
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (res.ok()) {
            expect(data.unified_rate).toBeDefined();
            expect(data.estimated_output).toBeDefined();
            expect(data.transaction_uuid).toBeDefined();
            expect(Array.isArray(data.legs)).toBe(true);
        } else {
            expect(res.status()).toBe(422);
            expect(data.error).toContain('INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE');
        }
    });

    let filteredRwas = $derived(
        rwaAssets.filter((c) => {
            const searchStr = rwaSearchQuery.toLowerCase();
            const searchMatch =
                !rwaSearchQuery ||
                c.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(searchStr) ||
                c.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchStr) ||
                c.category.toLowerCase().includes(searchStr);
            const visibilityMatch = isManaging || selectedRwas.includes(c.ticker);
            return searchMatch && visibilityMatch;
        })
    );

    async function refreshRwaFeeds() {
        loading = true;
        error = '';
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/prices/rwa');
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (res.ok && data.success && Array.isArray(data.assets)) {
                rwaAssets = rwaAssets.map((asset) => {
                    const pythData = data.assets.find((a: any) => a.ticker === asset.ticker);
                    if (pythData) {
                        const parsedPrice = Number(pythData.spotPrice ?? pythData.price ?? 0);
                        const parsedChange = Number(pythData.change24h ?? 0);
                        if (parsedPrice > 0) {
                            treasury.updateAsset(asset.ticker, {
                                spotPrice: parsedPrice,
                                delta: parsedChange
                            });
                        }
                        return {
                            ...asset,
                            price: parsedPrice,
                            change24h: parsedChange
                        };
                    }
                    return asset;
                });
            } else {
                error = data.error || 'ORACLE_HALT: Failed to fetch Pyth Hermes oracle feeds.';
            }
        } catch {
            error = 'ORACLE_HALT: Failed to synchronize Pyth Hermes oracle.';
        } finally {
            loading = false;
        }
    }

    onMount(() => {
        refreshRwaFeeds();
    });

    function toggleSelection(ticker: string) {
        if (selectedRwas.includes(ticker)) {
            selectedRwas = selectedRwas.filter((s: string) => s !== ticker);
        } else {
            selectedRwas = [...selectedRwas, ticker];
        }
    }

    async function executeSearch() {
        if (!rwaSearchQuery.trim()) return;
        isSearching = true;
        error = '';
        try {
            const clean = rwaSearchQuery.trim().toUpperCase();
            if (!rwaAssets.some((a) => a.ticker === clean)) {
                rwaAssets = [
                    ...rwaAssets,
                    {
                        ticker: clean,
                        name: `${clean} (Pyth Oracle Feed)`,
                        hex: '#18C6A5',
                        imgUrl: '',
                        price: 0.0,
                        change24h: 0.0,
                        category: 'Discovered RWA Feed',
                        network: 'BASE',
                        contract: clean,
                        desc: `Pyth Oracle: ${clean}/USD`
                    }
                ];
            }
            if (!selectedRwas.includes(clean)) {
                selectedRwas = [...selectedRwas, clean];
            }
            rwaSearchQuery = '';
            isManaging = true;
        } catch {
            error = 'Oracle network unreachable.';
        } finally {
            isSearching = false;
        }
    }
</script>

import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import type { Worker, Sector, EpochTelemetryState, AssetBucketTelemetry } from './type';
import { identity } from './identity.svelte';
export const CORE_EPOCH_ASSETS = ['USDC', 'USD', 'BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL'] as const;
export const ALL_18_POOL_BUCKET_ASSETS = [
    'USDC',
    'USDT',
    'USD',
    'BTC',
    'ETH',
    'SOL',
    'SILO',
    'XRP',
    'DOGE',
    'POL',
    'AVAX',
    'SUI',
    'TRX',
    'ZEC',
    'ARB',
    'BASE',
    'NVDA',
    'SPY'
] as const;
const KASPA_DIFF_CONSTANT = 4_294_967_296.0;
const POOL_FEE_RATE = 0.01;
export function computeDynamicProfitableThreshold(
    ticker: string,
    kasSpotUsd = 0.15
): {
    minProfitableKas: number;
    minProfitableUsd: number;
    railCostUsd: number;
} {
    const clean = String(ticker || 'USDC').trim().toUpperCase();
    const safeKasSpot =
        Number.isFinite(kasSpotUsd) && kasSpotUsd > 0 ? kasSpotUsd : 0.15;
    if (clean === 'USD') {
        const minUsd = 25.28;
        const minKas = Math.ceil((minUsd / safeKasSpot) * 10) / 10;
        return {
            minProfitableKas: minKas,
            minProfitableUsd: Number((minKas * safeKasSpot).toFixed(2)),
            railCostUsd: 0.25
        };
    }
    if (
        clean === 'SILO' ||
        clean === 'NACHO' ||
        clean === 'BEDRCK' ||
        clean === 'PERX'
    ) {
        const minUsd = 3.5;
        const minKas = Math.ceil((minUsd / safeKasSpot) * 10) / 10;
        return {
            minProfitableKas: minKas,
            minProfitableUsd: Number((minKas * safeKasSpot).toFixed(2)),
            railCostUsd: 0
        };
    }
    const minBridgeUsd =
        clean === 'BTC'
            ? 22.0
            : clean === 'ETH' ||
                clean === 'XAU' ||
                clean === 'XAG' ||
                clean === 'USTB' ||
                clean === 'USDT'
              ? 14.0
              : clean === 'USDC' ||
                  clean === 'SOL' ||
                  clean === 'ARB' ||
                  clean === 'BASE' ||
                  clean === 'POL' ||
                  clean === 'AVAX'
                ? 6.5
                : clean === 'SPY' ||
                    clean === 'QQQ' ||
                    clean === 'NVDA' ||
                    clean === 'AAPL' ||
                    clean === 'TSLA' ||
                    clean === 'AMD' ||
                    clean === 'TSM' ||
                    clean === 'AVGO' ||
                    clean === 'XLE'
                  ? 8.5
                  : 5.5;
    const baseBridgeMinKas = minBridgeUsd / safeKasSpot;
    const marginKas = 0.5 / safeKasSpot;
    const minProfitableKas =
        Math.ceil((baseBridgeMinKas * 1.015 + marginKas) * 10) / 10;
    const minProfitableUsd = Number(
        (minProfitableKas * safeKasSpot).toFixed(2)
    );
    return {
        minProfitableKas,
        minProfitableUsd,
        railCostUsd: 0
    };
}
class OperationsStore {
    workers = $state<Worker[]>([]);
    sectors = $state<Sector[]>([]);
    globalNetworkHashrate = $state(0);
    globalNodeStatus = $state<'offline' | 'syncing' | 'connected' | 'unreachable'>('offline');
    epochTelemetry = $state<EpochTelemetryState | null>(null);
    liveEpochSecondsRemaining = $state<number>(0);
    lastMutationTime = $state<number>(0);
    networkDifficulty = $state<number>(0);
    blockRewardKas = $state<number>(0);
    private actionQueue: Promise<any> = Promise.resolve();
    constructor() {
        this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining = this.computeFallbackSecondsTo2200Utc();
    }
    markMutation() {
        this.lastMutationTime = Date.now();
    }
    computeFallbackSecondsTo2200Utc(): number {
        const nowSecs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        const dayStart = nowSecs - (nowSecs % 86400);
        const todaySettlement = dayStart + 22 * 3600;
        const nextSettlement = nowSecs >= todaySettlement ? todaySettlement + 86400 : todaySettlement;
        return Math.max(0, nextSettlement - nowSecs);
    }
    tickEpochClock() {
        if (this.epochTelemetry?.nextEpochBellTs && this.epochTelemetry.nextEpochBellTs > 0) {
            const nowSecs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
            const remaining = this.epochTelemetry.nextEpochBellTs - nowSecs;
            if (remaining >= 0) {
                this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining = remaining;
                return;
            }
        }
        this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining = this.computeFallbackSecondsTo2200Utc();
    }
    formatEpochCountdown(totalSeconds: number = this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining): string {
        const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
        const hrs = Math.floor(clamped / 3600);
        const mins = Math.floor((clamped % 3600) / 60);
        const secs = clamped % 60;
        return `${hrs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    estimateSectorDailyKas(sector: Sector, totalUserHashrateThs: number): number {
        const pct = Math.max(0, Number(sector.allocationPercentage || 0)) / 100.0;
        const sectorThs = totalUserHashrateThs * pct;
        if (sectorThs > 0 && this.networkDifficulty > 0 && this.blockRewardKas > 0) {
            const hashesPerDay = sectorThs * 1e12 * 86400.0;
            const expectedBlockHashes = this.networkDifficulty * 2.0 * KASPA_DIFF_CONSTANT;
            if (expectedBlockHashes > 0) {
                const grossKasDay = (hashesPerDay * this.blockRewardKas) / expectedBlockHashes;
                return Math.max(0, grossKasDay * (1.0 - POOL_FEE_RATE));
            }
        }
        const pending = Math.max(0, Number(sector.pendingKaspa || 0));
        if (pending > 0) {
            const elapsedInEpoch = Math.max(300, 86400 - this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining);
            return (pending / elapsedInEpoch) * 86400;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    get localBellTimeLabel(): string {
        if (!browser) return '16:00 CT';
        try {
            const now = new Date();
            const utcSettlementDate = new Date(
                Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate(), 22, 0, 0)
            );
            return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
                hour: '2-digit',
                minute: '2-digit',
                timeZoneName: 'short'
            }).format(utcSettlementDate);
        } catch {
            return '16:00 CT';
        }
    }
    get isFinalHour(): boolean {
        return this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining > 0 && this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining <= 3600;
    }
    get targetedAssets(): string[] {
        const targets = new Set<string>();
        for (const sector of this.sectors) {
            if (sector.settlementConfig?.targetAsset?.ticker) {
                targets.add(sector.settlementConfig.targetAsset.ticker.toUpperCase());
            }
            if (Array.isArray(sector.settlementConfig?.targetAssets)) {
                for (const t of sector.settlementConfig.targetAssets) {
                    if (t?.ticker) {
                        targets.add(t.ticker.toUpperCase());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (
                sector.settlementConfig?.plantWeights &&
                typeof sector.settlementConfig.plantWeights === 'object'
            ) {
                for (const k of Object.keys(sector.settlementConfig.plantWeights)) {
                    targets.add(k.toUpperCase());
                }
            }
        }
        return Array.from(targets);
    }
    get allGlobalPoolBuckets(): AssetBucketTelemetry[] {
        const bucketsMap = this.epochTelemetry?.buckets || {};
        const tickers = new Set<string>([
            ...ALL_18_POOL_BUCKET_ASSETS,
            ...Object.keys(bucketsMap)
        ]);
        return Array.from(tickers).map((ticker): AssetBucketTelemetry => {
            const existing = bucketsMap[ticker];
            if (existing) return existing;
            const dyn = computeDynamicProfitableThreshold(ticker);
            return {
                asset: ticker,
                pendingKas: 0,
                pendingUsd: 0,
                minProfitableKas: dyn.minProfitableKas,
                minProfitableUsd: dyn.minProfitableUsd,
                weightPct: 0,
                participantCount: 0,
                lpAvailableKasCapacity: 5000,
                lpCoveragePct: 100,
                effectiveSpreadFloorPct: 0.10,
                railCostUsd: dyn.railCostUsd,
                status: 'IDLE',
                lastClearedAt: 0,
                lastClearType: 'NONE'
            };
        });
    }
    get allGlobalBuckets(): AssetBucketTelemetry[] {
        return this.allGlobalPoolBuckets;
    }
    get displayedBuckets(): AssetBucketTelemetry[] {
        const userPendingByAsset = new Map<string, number>();
        for (const sec of this.sectors || []) {
            const allocPct = Number(sec.allocationPercentage || 0);
            const secPendingKas = Math.max(0, Number(sec.pendingKaspa || 0));
            if (allocPct <= 0 && secPendingKas <= 0) continue;
            if (
                Array.isArray(sec.settlementConfig?.targetAssets) &&
                sec.settlementConfig.targetAssets.length >= 2
            ) {
                for (const leg of sec.settlementConfig.targetAssets) {
                    const tick = String(leg?.ticker || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                    if (!tick || tick === 'KAS') continue;
                    const legShare = Math.max(0, Number(leg.weightPct || 50)) / 100.0;
                    userPendingByAsset.set(
                        tick,
                        (userPendingByAsset.get(tick) || 0) + secPendingKas * legShare
                    );
                }
            } else {
                const primary = String(
                    sec.settlementConfig?.targetAsset?.ticker || ''
                )
                    .trim()
                    .toUpperCase();
                if (primary && primary !== 'KAS') {
                    userPendingByAsset.set(
                        primary,
                        (userPendingByAsset.get(primary) || 0) + secPendingKas
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        const globalMap = new Map(
            this.allGlobalPoolBuckets.map((b) => [b.asset.toUpperCase(), b])
        );
        const result: AssetBucketTelemetry[] = [];
        for (const [ticker, userPendingKas] of userPendingByAsset.entries()) {
            const globalBucket = globalMap.get(ticker);
            const dyn = computeDynamicProfitableThreshold(ticker);
            const minProfitableKas =
                globalBucket?.minProfitableKas && globalBucket.minProfitableKas > 0
                    ? globalBucket.minProfitableKas
                    : dyn.minProfitableKas;
            const minProfitableUsd =
                globalBucket?.minProfitableUsd && globalBucket.minProfitableUsd > 0
                    ? globalBucket.minProfitableUsd
                    : dyn.minProfitableUsd;
            const effectivePendingKas = Math.max(
                userPendingKas,
                globalBucket?.pendingKas || 0
            );
            const weightPct =
                minProfitableKas > 0
                    ? Math.min(100, (effectivePendingKas / minProfitableKas) * 100)
                    : 0;
            result.push({
                asset: ticker,
                pendingKas: userPendingKas,
                pendingUsd: globalBucket?.pendingUsd || 0,
                minProfitableKas,
                minProfitableUsd,
                weightPct,
                participantCount: Math.max(1, globalBucket?.participantCount || 1),
                lpAvailableKasCapacity: globalBucket?.lpAvailableKasCapacity || 5000,
                lpCoveragePct: globalBucket?.lpCoveragePct ?? 100,
                effectiveSpreadFloorPct: globalBucket?.effectiveSpreadFloorPct ?? 0.10,
                railCostUsd: globalBucket?.railCostUsd ?? dyn.railCostUsd,
                status:
                    weightPct >= 100
                        ? 'READY_FOR_BELL'
                        : globalBucket?.status || 'FILLING',
                lastClearedAt: globalBucket?.lastClearedAt || 0,
                lastClearType: globalBucket?.lastClearType || 'NONE'
            });
        }
        return result;
    }
    get armedBucketCount(): number {
        return this.displayedBuckets.filter(
            (b) =>
                b.weightPct >= 100 ||
                b.status === 'READY_FOR_BELL' ||
                b.status === 'CLEARED_EPOCH'
        ).length;
    }
    get boostZoneBuckets(): AssetBucketTelemetry[] {
        return this.displayedBuckets.filter(
            (b) => b.weightPct >= 85 && b.weightPct < 100
        );
    }
    getBucket(ticker: string): AssetBucketTelemetry | null {
        const clean = ticker.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (clean === 'KAS') return null;
        return (
            this.displayedBuckets.find((b) => b.asset === clean) ||
            this.allGlobalPoolBuckets.find((b) => b.asset === clean) ||
            null
        );
    }
    updateEpochTelemetry(epochData: EpochTelemetryState | null | undefined) {
        if (!epochData || typeof epochData !== 'object') return;
        this.epochTelemetry = {
            anchorUtcHour: epochData.anchorUtcHour ?? 22,
            anchorLabel: epochData.anchorLabel ?? '22:00 UTC Global Settlement',
            currentEpochBellTs: Number(epochData.currentEpochBellTs || 0),
            nextEpochBellTs: Number(epochData.nextEpochBellTs || 0),
            secondsRemaining: Number(epochData.secondsRemaining || 0),
            volatilitySweepThresholdPct: Number(
                epochData.volatilitySweepThresholdPct || 450
            ),
            updatedAt: Number(epochData.updatedAt || Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)),
            buckets: epochData.buckets ?? (this.epochTelemetry?.buckets || {})
        };
        if (
            typeof epochData.secondsRemaining === 'number' &&
            epochData.secondsRemaining >= 0
        ) {
            this.liveEpochSecondsRemaining = epochData.secondsRemaining;
        } else {
            this.tickEpochClock();
        }
    }
    async dispatchStateAction(action: string, payload: any) {
        const execute = async () => {
            try {
                const targetWallet =
                    identity.isCorporateAdmin && identity.activeAddress
                        ? identity.activeAddress
                        : undefined;
                const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ action, payload, targetWallet })
                });
                return res.ok;
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Matrix action dispatch failed:', e);
                return false;
            }
        };
        this.actionQueue = this.actionQueue.then(execute).catch(execute);
        return this.actionQueue;
    }
    purge() {
        this.workers = [];
        this.sectors = [];
    }
}
export const operations = new OperationsStore();
export const ops = operations;
export type { Sector as YieldSector, Worker as WorkerNode } from './type';
