import { json, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { dbPool } from '$lib/server/db';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';

export interface HifoTaxLotRecord {
    lotId: string;
    assetTicker: string;
    acquiredAt: string;
    kasSompi: number;
    initialTokens: number;
    remainingSompi: number;
    remainingTokens: number;
    fmvUsdPerToken: number;
    totalCostBasisUsd: number;
    remainingCostBasisUsd: number;
    sourceEventType: string;
    sourceTxHash: string;
    status: 'OPEN' | 'DEPLETED';
    holdingDays: number;
    isLongTerm: boolean;
}

export interface HifoDisposalMatchRecord {
    matchId: string;
    lotId: string;
    assetTicker: string;
    disposedSompi: number;
    disposedTokens: number;
    acquiredAt: string;
    disposedAt: string;
    holdingPeriodDays: number;
    isLongTerm: boolean;
    costBasisUsd: number;
    grossProceedsUsd: number;
    realizedGainLossUsd: number;
    disposalTxHash: string;
}

function buildExplorerTxUrl(asset: string, txHash: string): string {
    const cleanAsset = String(asset || 'KAS')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const cleanTx = String(txHash || '').trim();
    if (!cleanTx) return '#';
    switch (cleanAsset) {
        case 'KAS':
            return `https://kas.fyi/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'BTC':
            return `https://mempool.space/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'ETH':
        case 'USDC':
        case 'USDT':
            return `https://etherscan.io/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'SOL':
            return `https://solscan.io/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'POL':
            return `https://polygonscan.com/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'AVAX':
            return `https://snowtrace.io/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'ARB':
            return `https://arbiscan.io/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'BASE':
            return `https://basescan.org/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'XRP':
            return `https://xrpscan.com/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'DOGE':
            return `https://blockchair.com/dogecoin/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'SUI':
            return `https://suiscan.xyz/mainnet/tx/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'TRX':
            return `https://tronscan.org/#/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        case 'ZEC':
            return `https://blockchair.com/zcash/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
        default:
            return `https://kas.fyi/transaction/${cleanTx}`;
    }
}

function buildAddressExplorerUrl(asset: string, address: string): string {
    const cleanAsset = String(asset || 'KAS')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const cleanAddr = String(address || '').trim();
    if (!cleanAddr || cleanAddr.includes('Awaiting')) return '#';
    switch (cleanAsset) {
        case 'KAS':
            return `https://kas.fyi/address/${cleanAddr.startsWith('kaspa:') ? cleanAddr : `kaspa:${cleanAddr}`}`;
        case 'BTC':
            return `https://mempool.space/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'ETH':
        case 'USDC':
        case 'USDT':
            return `https://etherscan.io/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'SOL':
            return `https://solscan.io/account/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'DOGE':
            return `https://blockchair.com/dogecoin/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'XRP':
            return `https://xrpscan.com/account/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'POL':
            return `https://polygonscan.com/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'AVAX':
            return `https://snowtrace.io/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'ARB':
            return `https://arbiscan.io/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'BASE':
            return `https://basescan.org/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'SUI':
            return `https://suiscan.xyz/mainnet/account/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'TRX':
            return `https://tronscan.org/#/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        case 'ZEC':
            return `https://blockchair.com/zcash/address/${cleanAddr}`;
        default:
            return `https://kas.fyi/address/${cleanAddr}`;
    }
}

function computePassiveHifoFromEvents(
    chronologicalEvents: any[],
    existingDbLots: any[],
    existingDbMatches: any[]
): {
    lots: HifoTaxLotRecord[];
    disposalMatches: HifoDisposalMatchRecord[];
    eventHifoOverlay: Map<
        string,
        {
            costBasisUsd: number;
            realizedGainLossUsd: number;
            holdingPeriod: 'SHORT_TERM' | 'LONG_TERM' | 'MIXED_TERM';
        }
    >;
} {
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    const eventHifoOverlay = new Map<
        string,
        {
            costBasisUsd: number;
            realizedGainLossUsd: number;
            holdingPeriod: 'SHORT_TERM' | 'LONG_TERM' | 'MIXED_TERM';
        }
    >();

    if (existingDbLots.length > 0) {
        const mappedLots: HifoTaxLotRecord[] = existingDbLots.map((r) => {
            const acqMs = new Date(r.acquired_at).getTime();
            const holdingDays = Math.max(
                0,
                Math.floor((nowMs - acqMs) / (1000 * 86400))
            );
            const remTokens = Number(r.remaining_tokens || 0);
            const fmv = Number(r.fmv_usd_per_token || 0);
            return {
                lotId: String(r.lot_id),
                assetTicker: String(r.asset_ticker || 'KAS').toUpperCase(),
                acquiredAt: new Date(r.acquired_at).toISOString(),
                kasSompi: Number(r.kas_sompi || 0),
                initialTokens: Number(r.initial_tokens || 0),
                remainingSompi: Number(r.remaining_sompi || 0),
                remainingTokens: remTokens,
                fmvUsdPerToken: fmv,
                totalCostBasisUsd: Number(r.total_cost_basis_usd || 0),
                remainingCostBasisUsd: remTokens * fmv,
                sourceEventType: String(r.source_event_type || 'YIELD'),
                sourceTxHash: String(r.source_tx_hash || ''),
                status:
                    r.status === 'DEPLETED' || remTokens <= 1e-8
                        ? 'DEPLETED'
                        : 'OPEN',
                holdingDays,
                isLongTerm: holdingDays > 365
            };
        });

        const mappedMatches: HifoDisposalMatchRecord[] = existingDbMatches.map((m) => ({
            matchId: String(m.match_id),
            lotId: String(m.lot_id),
            assetTicker: String(m.asset_ticker || 'KAS').toUpperCase(),
            disposedSompi: Number(m.disposed_sompi || 0),
            disposedTokens: Number(m.disposed_tokens || 0),
            acquiredAt: new Date(m.acquired_at).toISOString(),
            disposedAt: new Date(m.disposed_at).toISOString(),
            holdingPeriodDays: Number(m.holding_period_days || 0),
            isLongTerm: Boolean(m.is_long_term),
            costBasisUsd: Number(m.cost_basis_usd || 0),
            grossProceedsUsd: Number(m.gross_proceeds_usd || 0),
            realizedGainLossUsd: Number(m.realized_gain_loss_usd || 0),
            disposalTxHash: String(m.disposal_tx_hash || '')
        }));

        return {
            lots: mappedLots,
            disposalMatches: mappedMatches,
            eventHifoOverlay
        };
    }

    const simulatedLots: HifoTaxLotRecord[] = [];
    const simulatedMatches: HifoDisposalMatchRecord[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < chronologicalEvents.length; i++) {
        const ev = chronologicalEvents[i];
        const evId = String(ev.event_id || `ev_${i}`);
        const evType = String(ev.event_type || '').toUpperCase();
        const ticker = String(ev.asset_ticker || 'KAS').toUpperCase();
        const qty = Math.max(0, Number(ev.amount_tokens || 0));
        const grossUsd = Math.max(0, Number(ev.gross_proceeds_usd || 0));
        const spot =
            Number(ev.spot_price_at_execution || 0) > 0
                ? Number(ev.spot_price_at_execution)
                : qty > 0
                  ? grossUsd / qty
                  : 0;
        const recordedIso = ev.recorded_at
            ? new Date(ev.recorded_at).toISOString()
            : new Date().toISOString();
        const recordedMs = new Date(recordedIso).getTime();
        const txHash = String(ev.tx_hash || evId.slice(0, 12));

        if ((evType === 'YIELD' || evType === 'FIAT_ONRAMP') && qty > 0) {
            const holdingDays = Math.max(
                0,
                Math.floor((nowMs - recordedMs) / (1000 * 86400))
            );
            const sompi = Math.round(qty * 1e8);
            simulatedLots.push({
                lotId: `LOT-${evId.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
                assetTicker: ticker,
                acquiredAt: recordedIso,
                kasSompi: sompi,
                initialTokens: qty,
                remainingSompi: sompi,
                remainingTokens: qty,
                fmvUsdPerToken: spot,
                totalCostBasisUsd: grossUsd,
                remainingCostBasisUsd: grossUsd,
                sourceEventType: evType,
                sourceTxHash: txHash,
                status: 'OPEN',
                holdingDays,
                isLongTerm: holdingDays > 365
            });
            eventHifoOverlay.set(evId, {
                costBasisUsd: grossUsd,
                realizedGainLossUsd: 0,
                holdingPeriod: holdingDays > 365 ? 'LONG_TERM' : 'SHORT_TERM'
            });
        } else if (
            (evType === 'DEX_SWAP' ||
                evType === 'FIAT_OFFRAMP' ||
                evType === 'PASSTHROUGH_SETTLED' ||
                evType === 'OTC_SETTLEMENT') &&
            qty > 0
        ) {
            const candidateLots = simulatedLots
                .filter((l) => l.status === 'OPEN' && l.remainingTokens > 1e-8)
                .sort((a, b) => {
                    if (Math.abs(b.fmvUsdPerToken - a.fmvUsdPerToken) > 1e-9) {
                        return b.fmvUsdPerToken - a.fmvUsdPerToken;
                    }
                    return (
                        new Date(a.acquiredAt).getTime() -
                        new Date(b.acquiredAt).getTime()
                    );
                });

            let remToDispose = qty;
            let matchedBasisUsd = 0;
            let hasLt = false;
            let hasSt = false;

            for (const lot of candidateLots) {
                if (remToDispose <= 1e-8) break;
                const consumed = Math.min(remToDispose, lot.remainingTokens);
                const consumedSompi = Math.round(consumed * 1e8);
                lot.remainingTokens = Math.max(0, lot.remainingTokens - consumed);
                lot.remainingSompi = Math.round(lot.remainingTokens * 1e8);
                lot.remainingCostBasisUsd = lot.remainingTokens * lot.fmvUsdPerToken;
                if (lot.remainingTokens <= 1e-8) {
                    lot.status = 'DEPLETED';
                }

                const holdDays = Math.max(
                    0,
                    Math.floor(
                        (recordedMs - new Date(lot.acquiredAt).getTime()) /
                            (1000 * 86400)
                    )
                );
                const isLt = holdDays > 365;
                if (isLt) hasLt = true;
                else hasSt = true;

                const sliceBasisUsd = consumed * lot.fmvUsdPerToken;
                const sliceProceedsUsd =
                    qty > 0 ? grossUsd * (consumed / qty) : consumed * spot;
                const sliceGainLoss = sliceProceedsUsd - sliceBasisUsd;
                matchedBasisUsd += sliceBasisUsd;
                remToDispose = Math.max(0, remToDispose - consumed);

                simulatedMatches.push({
                    matchId: `MATCH-${evId.slice(0, 6).toUpperCase()}-${lot.lotId.slice(-4)}`,
                    lotId: lot.lotId,
                    assetTicker: lot.assetTicker,
                    disposedSompi: consumedSompi,
                    disposedTokens: consumed,
                    acquiredAt: lot.acquiredAt,
                    disposedAt: recordedIso,
                    holdingPeriodDays: holdDays,
                    isLongTerm: isLt,
                    costBasisUsd: sliceBasisUsd,
                    grossProceedsUsd: sliceProceedsUsd,
                    realizedGainLossUsd: sliceGainLoss,
                    disposalTxHash: txHash
                });
            }

            if (remToDispose > 1e-8) {
                matchedBasisUsd +=
                    qty > 0 ? grossUsd * (remToDispose / qty) : remToDispose * spot;
                hasSt = true;
            }

            const holdingPeriod: 'SHORT_TERM' | 'LONG_TERM' | 'MIXED_TERM' =
                hasLt && !hasSt
                    ? 'LONG_TERM'
                    : hasLt && hasSt
                      ? 'MIXED_TERM'
                      : 'SHORT_TERM';

            eventHifoOverlay.set(evId, {
                costBasisUsd: matchedBasisUsd,
                realizedGainLossUsd: grossUsd - matchedBasisUsd,
                holdingPeriod
            });
        }
    }

    simulatedLots.sort((a, b) => b.fmvUsdPerToken - a.fmvUsdPerToken);
    simulatedMatches.sort(
        (a, b) =>
            new Date(b.disposedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.disposedAt).getTime()
    );

    return {
        lots: simulatedLots,
        disposalMatches: simulatedMatches,
        eventHifoOverlay
    };
}

export const GET = async ({ cookies, url }: RequestEvent) => {
    const wantHifoBundle = url.searchParams.get('bundle') === 'hifo';
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    if (!sessionId) {
        return wantHifoBundle
            ? json({
                  events: [],
                  hifoLots: [],
                  disposalMatches: [],
                  hifoSummary: null
              })
            : json([]);
    }
    const sessionWalletRaw = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);
    if (!sessionWalletRaw) {
        return wantHifoBundle
            ? json({
                  events: [],
                  hifoLots: [],
                  disposalMatches: [],
                  hifoSummary: null
              })
            : json([]);
    }
    const sessionWallet = sessionWalletRaw;
    const cleanWallet = sessionWallet.toLowerCase().replace(/^kaspa:/i, '').trim();
    const prefixedWallet = `kaspa:${cleanWallet}`;
    let client;
    try {
        client = await dbPool.connect();
        await client
            .query(`ALTER TABLE tax_ledger_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tx_hash VARCHAR(255)`)
            .catch(() => {});
        await client
            .query(
                `ALTER TABLE tax_ledger_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS payout_address VARCHAR(255)`
            )
            .catch(() => {});
        await client
            .query(
                `ALTER TABLE tax_ledger_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cost_basis_usd DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0`
            )
            .catch(() => {});
        await client
            .query(
                `ALTER TABLE tax_ledger_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS realized_gain_loss_usd DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0`
            )
            .catch(() => {});
        await client
            .query(
                `ALTER TABLE tax_ledger_events ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS holding_period VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SHORT_TERM'`
            )
            .catch(() => {});

        const [res, l1QueueRes, dbLotsRes, dbMatchesRes] = await Promise.all([
            client.query(
                `SELECT * FROM tax_ledger_events
                 WHERE wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2
                 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
                 LIMIT 250`,
                [cleanWallet, prefixedWallet]
            ),
            client
                .query(
                    `SELECT payout_id, tx_hash, explorer_url, destination_address, status
                     FROM l1_payout_queue
                     WHERE wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2
                     ORDER BY created_at DESC
                     LIMIT 100`,
                    [prefixedWallet, cleanWallet]
                )
                .catch(() => ({ rows: [] as any[] })),
            client
                .query(
                    `SELECT * FROM hifo_tax_lots
                     WHERE wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2
                     ORDER BY fmv_usd_per_token DESC, acquired_at ASC
                     LIMIT 500`,
                    [cleanWallet, prefixedWallet]
                )
                .catch(() => ({ rows: [] as any[] })),
            client
                .query(
                    `SELECT * FROM hifo_disposal_matches
                     WHERE wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2
                     ORDER BY disposed_at DESC
                     LIMIT 500`,
                    [cleanWallet, prefixedWallet]
                )
                .catch(() => ({ rows: [] as any[] }))
        ]);

        const chronologicalRows = [...res.rows].reverse();
        const { lots, disposalMatches, eventHifoOverlay } =
            computePassiveHifoFromEvents(
                chronologicalRows,
                dbLotsRes.rows,
                dbMatchesRes.rows
            );

        const l1PayoutMap = new Map<string, any>();
        for (const qRow of l1QueueRes.rows) {
            if (qRow.payout_id) {
                l1PayoutMap.set(String(qRow.payout_id), qRow);
            }
            if (qRow.tx_hash) {
                l1PayoutMap.set(String(qRow.tx_hash), qRow);
            }
        }

        const events = res.rows.map((row, idx) => {
            const evId = String(row.event_id || `ev_${idx}`);
            const ticker = String(row.asset_ticker || 'KAS').toUpperCase();
            let color = '#18C6A5';
            if (ticker === 'BTC') color = '#F7931A';
            else if (ticker === 'ETH') color = '#627EEA';
            else if (ticker === 'SOL') color = '#14F195';
            else if (ticker === 'USD') color = '#10B981';
            else if (ticker === 'USDC' || ticker === 'USDT') color = '#3B82F6';
            else if (ticker === 'POL') color = '#8247E5';
            else if (ticker === 'AVAX') color = '#E84142';
            else if (ticker === 'ARB') color = '#28A0F0';
            else if (ticker === 'BASE') color = '#0052FF';

            let displayType = row.event_type;
            if (row.event_type === 'YIELD') displayType = 'Epoch L1 Payout';
            else if (row.event_type === 'L1_WITHDRAWAL') displayType = 'L1 Withdrawal';
            else if (row.event_type === 'L1_REFUND') displayType = 'L1 Payout Refund';
            else if (row.event_type === 'FIAT_ONRAMP') displayType = 'Fiat On-Ramp';
            else if (row.event_type === 'FIAT_OFFRAMP') displayType = 'Fiat Off-Ramp';
            else if (row.event_type === 'FIAT_REFUND') displayType = 'Fiat Refund';
            else if (row.event_type === 'DEX_SWAP') displayType = 'DEX Swap';
            else if (row.event_type === 'PASSTHROUGH_SETTLED')
                displayType = '3rd-Party Pass-Through';
            else if (row.event_type === 'PASSTHROUGH_REFUND')
                displayType = 'Pass-Through Refund';
            else if (row.event_type === 'OTC_SETTLEMENT') displayType = 'OTC Settlement';
            else if (row.event_type === 'TAX_ESCROW_LP')
                displayType = 'Tax Escrow Auto-LP';

            const rawDbTxHash = String(row.tx_hash || '').trim();
            const linkedQueue = rawDbTxHash ? l1PayoutMap.get(rawDbTxHash) : null;
            const resolvedTxHash =
                (linkedQueue?.tx_hash && String(linkedQueue.tx_hash).trim()) ||
                rawDbTxHash ||
                String(row.event_id || '')
                    .split('-')[0]
                    .toUpperCase();
            const payoutAddress =
                row.payout_address ||
                linkedQueue?.destination_address ||
                prefixedWallet;
            const isQueuedId = resolvedTxHash.startsWith('PER-L1-');
            const explorerUrl =
                !isQueuedId && resolvedTxHash.length >= 12
                    ? buildExplorerTxUrl(ticker, resolvedTxHash)
                    : buildAddressExplorerUrl(ticker, payoutAddress);

            const amountTokens = Number(row.amount_tokens || 0);
            const grossUsd = Number(row.gross_proceeds_usd || 0);
            const overlay = eventHifoOverlay.get(evId);
            const dbBasis = Number(row.cost_basis_usd || 0);
            const dbGainLoss = Number(row.realized_gain_loss_usd || 0);
            const resolvedCostBasisUsd =
                dbBasis > 0 ? dbBasis : (overlay?.costBasisUsd ?? grossUsd);
            const resolvedRealizedGainLossUsd =
                dbBasis > 0
                    ? dbGainLoss
                    : (overlay?.realizedGainLossUsd ?? 0);
            const resolvedHoldingPeriod =
                row.holding_period || overlay?.holdingPeriod || 'SHORT_TERM';

            return {
                id: evId,
                timestamp: new Date(row.recorded_at).toLocaleString(),
                recordedAtIso: new Date(row.recorded_at).toISOString(),
                type: displayType,
                rawEventType: row.event_type,
                asset: {
                    ticker,
                    color
                },
                amount: amountTokens,
                kasSompi: Math.round(amountTokens * 1e8),
                usdValueAtTime: grossUsd,
                costBasisUsd: resolvedCostBasisUsd,
                realizedGainLossUsd: resolvedRealizedGainLossUsd,
                holdingPeriod: resolvedHoldingPeriod,
                spotPriceAtExecution: Number(row.spot_price_at_execution || 0),
                txHash: resolvedTxHash,
                payoutAddress,
                explorerUrl,
                l1Status:
                    linkedQueue?.status ||
                    (isQueuedId ? 'QUEUED_FOR_L1_DISPATCH' : 'DISPATCHED_ONCHAIN')
            };
        });

        if (wantHifoBundle) {
            const openCostBasisUsd = lots
                .filter((l) => l.status === 'OPEN')
                .reduce((s, l) => s + l.remainingCostBasisUsd, 0);
            const openKasTokens = lots
                .filter((l) => l.status === 'OPEN' && l.assetTicker === 'KAS')
                .reduce((s, l) => s + l.remainingTokens, 0);
            const shortTermGainLossUsd = disposalMatches
                .filter((m) => !m.isLongTerm)
                .reduce((s, m) => s + m.realizedGainLossUsd, 0);
            const longTermGainLossUsd = disposalMatches
                .filter((m) => m.isLongTerm)
                .reduce((s, m) => s + m.realizedGainLossUsd, 0);
            const totalMatchedCostBasisUsd = disposalMatches.reduce(
                (s, m) => s + m.costBasisUsd,
                0
            );
            const totalMatchedProceedsUsd = disposalMatches.reduce(
                (s, m) => s + m.grossProceedsUsd,
                0
            );

            return json({
                events,
                hifoLots: lots,
                disposalMatches,
                hifoSummary: {
                    accountingMethod: 'PASSIVE_HIFO_NO_WASH',
                    openCostBasisUsd,
                    openKasTokens,
                    totalMatchedCostBasisUsd,
                    totalMatchedProceedsUsd,
                    shortTermGainLossUsd,
                    longTermGainLossUsd,
                    netRealizedGainLossUsd:
                        shortTermGainLossUsd + longTermGainLossUsd
                }
            });
        }

        return json(events);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Tax Events API Fault:', error);
        return wantHifoBundle
            ? json({
                  events: [],
                  hifoLots: [],
                  disposalMatches: [],
                  hifoSummary: null
              })
            : json([]);
    } finally {
        if (client) client.release();
    }
};

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

import dotenv from 'dotenv';



dotenv.config();



// ============================================================================

// SIMULATED TEST DATA

// ============================================================================

const TEST_WALLET = 'kaspa:qtestprototypewalletforash00000000000000000000000000000000000';

const ADMIN_KEY = process.env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY || process.env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN || 'perennia_test_key';



test.describe.serial('Tax Fortress Compliance Pipeline & 1099-DA Generation', () => {
	test.beforeEach(async ({ request }) => { await request.get('/'); });



    test('Phase 1: AES-256-GCM KYC Encryption Loop', async ({ request }) => {

        const kycPayload = {

            walletAddress: TEST_WALLET,

            legalName: 'Perennia Prototype Testing LLC',

            entityType: 'LLC',

            tin: '12-3456789',

            address: '100 Energy Way, Richardson, TX 75082'

        };



        const postKycRes = await request.post('/api/treasury/kyc', { 

            data: kycPayload,

            headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${ADMIN_KEY}` }

        });

        const postData = await postKycRes.json().catch(() => ({}));

        

        expect(postKycRes.ok(), `API ERROR: ${JSON.stringify(postData)}`).toBeTruthy();

        expect(postData.success).toBe(true);



        const getKycRes = await request.get(`/api/treasury/kyc?wallet=${TEST_WALLET}`, {

            headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${ADMIN_KEY}` }

        });



        const getData = await getKycRes.json().catch(() => ({}));

        expect(getKycRes.ok(), `API ERROR: ${JSON.stringify(getData)}`).toBeTruthy();

        

        expect(getData.status).toBe('verified');

        expect(getData.entity.legalName).toBe('Local Browser Vault (Zero-PII)');

        expect(getData.entity.tinLast4).toBe('LOCAL'); 

    });



    test('Phase 2: Internal Sovereign OTC Settlement Ingestion', async ({ request }) => {

        const otcPayload = {

            walletAddress: TEST_WALLET,

            fiatAmount: 5000.00,

            cryptoCurrency: 'KAS',

            cryptoAmount: 31250.00

        };



        const settlementRes = await request.post('/api/otc/settle', {

            data: otcPayload,

            headers: {

                'Authorization': `Bearer ${ADMIN_KEY}`,

                'Content-Type': 'application/json'

            }

        });



        const settlementData = await settlementRes.json().catch(() => ({}));

        expect(settlementRes.ok(), `OTC SETTLEMENT ERROR: ${JSON.stringify(settlementData)}`).toBeTruthy();

        expect(settlementData.success).toBe(true);

    });



    test('Phase 3: 1099-DA PDF Compilation & Verification', async ({ request }) => {

        const pdfRes = await request.post('/api/treasury/1099-da', {

            data: { walletAddress: TEST_WALLET, taxYear: new Date().getFullYear() }

        });



        if (!pdfRes.ok()) {

            const errData = await pdfRes.json().catch(() => ({}));

            throw new Error(`PDF GENERATION FAILED: ${JSON.stringify(errData)}`);

        }



        expect(pdfRes.ok()).toBeTruthy();

        const headers = pdfRes.headers();

        expect(headers['content-type']).toBe('application/pdf');

        

        const pdfBuffer = await pdfRes.body();

        expect(pdfBuffer.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

        

        const magicNumber = pdfBuffer.slice(0, 5).toString('utf-8');

        expect(magicNumber).toBe('%PDF-');

    });



    test('Security Guardrail: Reject Unauthorized OTC Settlement', async ({ request }) => {

        const otcPayload = {

            walletAddress: TEST_WALLET,

            fiatAmount: 1000000.00,

            cryptoCurrency: 'KAS',

            cryptoAmount: 5000000.00

        };



        const settlementRes = await request.post('/api/otc/settle', {

            data: otcPayload,

            headers: {

                'Authorization': `Bearer FORGED_API_KEY`,

                'Content-Type': 'application/json'

            }

        });



        const settlementData = await settlementRes.json().catch(() => ({}));

        expect(settlementRes.status(), `EXPECTED 401, GOT ${settlementRes.status()} - ${JSON.stringify(settlementData)}`).toBe(401);

        expect(settlementData.error).toContain('Unauthorized');

    });

});

    let coldVaultLabelInput = $state('Perennia Cold Vault');
    let coldOverflowCeilingInput = $state(500);
    let coldAutoSweepEnabled = $state(true);
    let coldSweepNowAmount = $state('');
    let isSavingColdRule = $state(false);
    let isSweepingColdNow = $state(false);
    let lastHydratedColdTicker = $state('');

    // Webcam QR Scanner State for Cold Vault Destination
    let isCameraScanningColdQr = $state(false);
    let coldQrVideoElement = $state<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
    let activeColdMediaStream: MediaStream | null = null;
    let coldQrScanTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

    let utxoCount = $state<number>(0);
    let isFetchingUtxos = $state(false);
    let isCompoundingUtxos = $state(false);
    let l1Transactions = $state<
        {
            txId: string;
            timestamp: string;
            amountKas: number;
            direction: 'INBOUND' | 'OUTBOUND';
        }[]
    >([]);
    let isFetchingHistory = $state(false);

    $effect(() => {
        if (!selectedSendTokenTicker) {
            selectedSendTokenTicker = (
                asset.ticker ||
                asset.symbol ||
                'KAS'
            ).toUpperCase();
        }
    });

    let activeSendAssetObj = $derived.by(() => {
        const rootTicker = (asset.ticker || asset.symbol || 'KAS').toUpperCase();
        const target = (selectedSendTokenTicker || rootTicker).toUpperCase();
        if (target === rootTicker) {
            return {
                ticker: rootTicker,
                network: (asset.network || rootTicker).toUpperCase(),
                onChain: Number(asset.onChain || 0),
                synthetic: Number(asset.synthetic || 0),
                contract: asset.contract,
                isSubToken: false
            };
        }
        const subMatch = (subAssets || []).find(
            (s: any) => String(s.symbol || '').toUpperCase() === target
        );
        const regAsset = treasury.getAsset(target);
        return {
            ticker: target,
            network: rootTicker,
            onChain: Number(
                regAsset.onChain || subMatch?.onChain || subMatch?.balance || 0
            ),
            synthetic: Number(regAsset.synthetic || subMatch?.synthetic || 0),
            contract: subMatch?.contract || regAsset.contract,
            isSubToken: true
        };
    });

    let activeTokenColdRule = $derived(
        coldVaultRulesMap?.[activeSendAssetObj.ticker] || null
    );

    let rootTokenColdRule = $derived(
        coldVaultRulesMap?.[(asset.ticker || asset.symbol || 'KAS').toUpperCase()] ||
            null
    );

    $effect(() => {
        const currentTicker = activeSendAssetObj.ticker;
        const savedRule = coldVaultRulesMap?.[currentTicker];
        if (currentTicker !== lastHydratedColdTicker) {
            lastHydratedColdTicker = currentTicker;
            if (savedRule) {
                coldDestinationInput = savedRule.coldDestinationAddress || '';
                coldVaultLabelInput =
                    savedRule.vaultLabel || 'Perennia Cold Vault';
                coldOverflowCeilingInput = Number(
                    savedRule.overflowCeiling ?? 500
                );
                coldAutoSweepEnabled = savedRule.autoSweepEnabled !== false;
            } else {
                coldDestinationInput = '';
                coldVaultLabelInput = `${currentTicker} Cold Storage Vault`;
                coldOverflowCeilingInput =
                    currentTicker === 'BTC'
                        ? 0.05
                        : currentTicker === 'ETH'
                          ? 0.5
                          : currentTicker === 'SOL'
                            ? 10
                            : 500;
                coldAutoSweepEnabled = true;
            }
        } else if (savedRule && !coldDestinationInput.trim()) {
            coldDestinationInput = savedRule.coldDestinationAddress || '';
            coldVaultLabelInput = savedRule.vaultLabel || 'Perennia Cold Vault';
            coldOverflowCeilingInput = Number(savedRule.overflowCeiling ?? 500);
            coldAutoSweepEnabled = savedRule.autoSweepEnabled !== false;
        }
    });

    let coldAddressValidation = $derived(
        coldDestinationInput.trim()
            ? validateColdVaultAddressForChain(
                  activeSendAssetObj.ticker,
                  coldDestinationInput.trim(),
                  activeSendAssetObj.network
              )
            : {
                  valid: false,
                  normalized: '',
                  network: activeSendAssetObj.network,
                  error: undefined
              }
    );

    let filteredLedgerHistory = $derived.by(() => {
        const tickerUpper = (asset.ticker || asset.symbol || 'KAS').toUpperCase();
        const subTickers = new Set<string>(
            (subAssets || []).map((s: any) =>
                String(s.symbol || '').toUpperCase()
            )
        );
        return (ledgerEvents || []).filter((ev: any) => {
            const evTicker = (ev.asset?.ticker || '').toUpperCase();
            return evTicker === tickerUpper || subTickers.has(evTicker);
        });
    });

    function escapeCsvField(val: unknown): string {
        const s = String(val ?? '');
        if (s.includes(',') || s.includes('"') || s.includes('\n')) {
            return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
        }
        return s;
    }

    function exportAssetActivityCsv(e: Event) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (!browser) return;
        const tickerUpper = (asset.ticker || asset.symbol || 'KAS').toUpperCase();
        const rows: string[] = [
            'Timestamp,Source,Event_Type,Asset,Direction,Amount,USD_Value,Reference_Or_TxID,Explorer_URL'
        ];
        for (const ev of filteredLedgerHistory) {
            const evTicker = (ev.asset?.ticker || tickerUpper).toUpperCase();
            const txRef = String(ev.txHash || '');
            const expUrl =
                ev.explorerUrl || getChainExplorerTxUrl(evTicker, txRef);
            rows.push(
                [
                    escapeCsvField(ev.timestamp),
                    'SETTLEMENT_LEDGER',
                    escapeCsvField(ev.type || 'SETTLEMENT'),
                    escapeCsvField(evTicker),
                    'SETTLED',
                    Number(ev.amount || 0).toFixed(8),
                    Number(ev.usdValueAtTime || 0).toFixed(2),
                    escapeCsvField(txRef),
                    escapeCsvField(expUrl)
                ].join(',')
            );
        }
        if (tickerUpper === 'KAS') {
            for (const tx of l1Transactions) {
                const usdEst = tx.amountKas * Number(asset.spotPrice || 0);
                rows.push(
                    [
                        escapeCsvField(tx.timestamp),
                        'KASPA_L1_DAG',
                        `L1_${tx.direction}`,
                        'KAS',
                        tx.direction,
                        tx.amountKas.toFixed(8),
                        usdEst.toFixed(2),
                        escapeCsvField(tx.txId),
                        escapeCsvField(`https://kas.fyi/transaction/${tx.txId}`)
                    ].join(',')
                );
            }
        }
        const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        const blob = new Blob([rows.join('\n')], {
            type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'
        });
        const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `Perennia_${tickerUpper}_Activity_${dateStamp}.csv`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        a.remove();
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            `asset_${asset.ticker}`,
            `${tickerUpper} CSV EXPORTED ✓`,
            asset.hex || '#18C6A5'
        );
    }

    function exportAssetActivityJson(e: Event) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (!browser) return;
        const tickerUpper = (asset.ticker || asset.symbol || 'KAS').toUpperCase();
        const payload = {
            exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            walletAddress: identity.activeAddress || asset.address,
            asset: tickerUpper,
            balances: {
                onChainL1Balance: Number(asset.onChain || 0),
                inBatchSettlementQueue: Number(asset.synthetic || 0),
                stakedLp: Number(asset.stakedBalance || 0),
                totalBalance: Number(asset.totalBalance || 0),
                spotPriceUsd: Number(asset.spotPrice || 0)
            },
            ledgerSettlements: filteredLedgerHistory,
            l1Transactions: tickerUpper === 'KAS' ? l1Transactions : []
        };
        const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], {
            type: 'application/json'
        });
        const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `Perennia_${tickerUpper}_Activity_${dateStamp}.json`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        a.remove();
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            `asset_${asset.ticker}`,
            `${tickerUpper} JSON EXPORTED ✓`,
            asset.hex || '#18C6A5'
        );
    }

    async function saveTokenColdVaultRule() {
        withdrawalFeedback = null;
        if (!coldAddressValidation.valid) {
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    coldAddressValidation.error ||
                    `Enter a valid ${activeSendAssetObj.ticker} (${activeSendAssetObj.network}) Cold Storage address.`
            };
            return;
        }
        isSavingColdRule = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'SAVE_USER_COLD_VAULT_RULE',
                    payload: {
                        assetTicker: activeSendAssetObj.ticker,
                        network: activeSendAssetObj.network,
                        coldDestinationAddress: coldAddressValidation.normalized,
                        vaultLabel:
                            coldVaultLabelInput.trim() || 'Perennia Cold Vault',
                        overflowCeiling: Math.max(
                            0.0001,
                            Number(coldOverflowCeilingInput || 500)
                        ),
                        autoSweepEnabled: coldAutoSweepEnabled
                    }
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error ||
                        `Failed to save ${activeSendAssetObj.ticker} Cold Vault rule.`
                );
            }
            coldDestinationInput = coldAddressValidation.normalized;
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'success',
                message: `✓ ${activeSendAssetObj.ticker} Cold Vault Armed (${coldAddressValidation.normalized.slice(0, 18)}... • Auto-Sweep @ ≥${coldOverflowCeilingInput} ${activeSendAssetObj.ticker})`
            };
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                `asset_${asset.ticker}`,
                `${activeSendAssetObj.ticker} COLD VAULT ARMED ✓`,
                asset.hex || '#18C6A5'
            );
            await onRefreshColdVaultRules();
        } catch (err: any) {
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    err.message || 'Failed to save Cold Storage configuration.'
            };
        } finally {
            isSavingColdRule = false;
        }
    }

    async function triggerImmediateTokenColdSweep() {
        withdrawalFeedback = null;
        if (!coldAddressValidation.valid) {
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message: `Bind a valid ${activeSendAssetObj.ticker} Cold Storage address before executing a sweep.`
            };
            return;
        }
        const amt = parseFloat(coldSweepNowAmount);
        if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message: `Enter a valid ${activeSendAssetObj.ticker} amount greater than 0 to sweep.`
            };
            return;
        }

        const targetInfo = activeSendAssetObj;
        const ledgerBal = Number(targetInfo.synthetic || 0);
        const onChainBal = Number(targetInfo.onChain || 0);

        if (ledgerBal >= amt) {
            isSweepingColdNow = true;
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        action: 'SWEEP_TOKEN_TO_COLD_VAULT_NOW',
                        payload: {
                            assetTicker: targetInfo.ticker,
                            network: targetInfo.network,
                            coldDestinationAddress:
                                coldAddressValidation.normalized,
                            amount: amt
                        }
                    })
                });
                const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        data.error ||
                            `Failed to sweep ${targetInfo.ticker} to Cold Vault.`
                    );
                }
                const txHash =
                    data.transaction_id || data.data?.txHash || '';
                const explorerUrl =
                    data.data?.explorerUrl ||
                    getChainExplorerTxUrl(targetInfo.ticker, txHash);
                coldSweepNowAmount = '';
                const currentSyn = Number(
                    treasury.getAsset(targetInfo.ticker).synthetic || 0
                );
                treasury.updateAsset(targetInfo.ticker, {
                    synthetic: Math.max(0, currentSyn - amt)
                });
                withdrawalFeedback = {
                    type: 'success',
                    message: `✓ Swept ${amt.toFixed(4)} ${targetInfo.ticker} to Cold Vault (${coldAddressValidation.normalized.slice(0, 18)}...)`,
                    txHash,
                    explorerUrl
                };
                ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                    `asset_${asset.ticker}`,
                    `SWEPT ${targetInfo.ticker} TO COLD ✓`,
                    asset.hex || '#18C6A5'
                );
                await onRefreshColdVaultRules();
            } catch (err: any) {
                withdrawalFeedback = {
                    type: 'error',
                    message: err.message || 'Hot-to-Cold sweep failed.'
                };
            } finally {
                isSweepingColdNow = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (onChainBal >= amt) {
            txState.lastTxId = '';
            txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
            isDispatchingWithdrawal = true;
            awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource = 'onchain';
            pendingWithdrawAmount = amt;
            pendingWithdrawTicker = targetInfo.ticker;
            const actionType =
                targetInfo.ticker === 'KAS'
                    ? 'SEND_KAS'
                    : targetInfo.network === 'KAS' &&
                        targetInfo.ticker !== 'KAS'
                      ? 'SEND_KRC20'
                      : 'SEND_L1';
            identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
                actionType,
                payAsset: targetInfo.ticker,
                network: targetInfo.network,
                contractAddress: targetInfo.contract,
                payAmount: amt.toString(),
                destinationAddress: coldAddressValidation.normalized
            });
            coldSweepNowAmount = '';
            return;
        }

        withdrawalFeedback = {
            type: 'error',
            message: `Insufficient ${targetInfo.ticker} balance to sweep ${amt}. Batch Queue: ${ledgerBal.toFixed(4)} ${targetInfo.ticker} | On-Chain L1: ${onChainBal.toFixed(4)} ${targetInfo.ticker}.`
        };
    }

    async function startColdQrCameraScanner() {
        withdrawalFeedback = null;
        if (!browser || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    'CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE: Browser camera access is not available on this device.'
            };
            return;
        }
        try {
            activeColdMediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                video: { facingMode: 'environment' },
                audio: false
            });
            isCameraScanningColdQr = true;
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (coldQrVideoElement && activeColdMediaStream) {
                    coldQrVideoElement.srcObject = activeColdMediaStream;
                    coldQrVideoElement.play().catch(() => {});
                }
            }, 80);

            coldQrScanTimer = setInterval(async () => {
                if (!coldQrVideoElement || !isCameraScanningColdQr) return;
                try {
                    const detectedRaw = await scanVideoFrameForQrPayload(
                        coldQrVideoElement
                    );
                    if (detectedRaw) {
                        const parsed = parseMultiChainColdVaultQrPayload(
                            detectedRaw,
                            activeSendAssetObj.ticker,
                            activeSendAssetObj.network
                        );
                        coldDestinationInput = parsed.coldDestinationAddress;
                        if (parsed.cardLabel) {
                            coldVaultLabelInput = parsed.cardLabel;
                        }
                        stopColdQrCameraScanner();
                        withdrawalFeedback = {
                            type: 'success',
                            message: `✓ Scanned ${activeSendAssetObj.ticker} Cold Vault QR: ${parsed.coldDestinationAddress.slice(0, 22)}...`
                        };
                    }
                } catch (scanErr: any) {
                    stopColdQrCameraScanner();
                    withdrawalFeedback = {
                        type: 'error',
                        message: scanErr.message || 'QR scan failed.'
                    };
                }
            }, 450);
        } catch (err: any) {
            stopColdQrCameraScanner();
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message: `CAMERA_ACCESS_DENIED: ${err.message || 'Unable to open camera stream.'}`
            };
        }
    }

    function stopColdQrCameraScanner() {
        isCameraScanningColdQr = false;
        if (coldQrScanTimer) {
            clearInterval(coldQrScanTimer);
            coldQrScanTimer = null;
        }
        if (activeColdMediaStream) {
            for (const track of activeColdMediaStream.getTracks()) {
                track.stop();
            }
            activeColdMediaStream = null;
        }
    }

    async function refreshKasUtxos() {
        if (
            asset.ticker !== 'KAS' ||
            !identity.isWalletConnected ||
            !identity.activeAddress
        )
            return;
        isFetchingUtxos = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(
                `/api/utxos?address=${encodeURIComponent(identity.activeAddress)}`
            );
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.entries || [];
                utxoCount = list.length;
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore UTXO count fetch error
        } finally {
            isFetchingUtxos = false;
        }
    }

    async function fetchKasL1History() {
        if (
            asset.ticker !== 'KAS' ||
            !asset.address ||
            asset.address.includes('Awaiting')
        )
            return;
        isFetchingHistory = true;
        try {
            const formatted = asset.address.startsWith('kaspa:')
                ? asset.address
                : `kaspa:${asset.address}`;
            const res = await fetch(
                `https://api.kaspa.org/addresses/${encodeURIComponent(formatted)}/full-transactions?limit=10&resolve_previous_outpoints=light`,
                { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000) }
            );
            if (res.ok) {
                const txs = await res.json();
                if (Array.isArray(txs)) {
                    const cleanMyAddr = formatted.toLowerCase();
                    const parsed = txs.map((tx: any) => {
                        let creditedSompi = 0;
                        let debitedSompi = 0;
                        if (Array.isArray(tx.outputs)) {
                            for (const out of tx.outputs) {
                                const outAddr = (
                                    out.script_public_key_address || ''
                                ).toLowerCase();
                                if (outAddr === cleanMyAddr) {
                                    creditedSompi += Number(out.amount || 0);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (Array.isArray(tx.inputs)) {
                            for (const inp of tx.inputs) {
                                const inAddr = (
                                    inp.previous_outpoint_address || ''
                                ).toLowerCase();
                                if (inAddr === cleanMyAddr) {
                                    debitedSompi += Number(
                                        inp.previous_outpoint_amount || 0
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        const netSompi = creditedSompi - debitedSompi;
                        const direction: 'INBOUND' | 'OUTBOUND' =
                            netSompi >= 0 ? 'INBOUND' : 'OUTBOUND';
                        const amountKas = Math.abs(netSompi) / 1e8;
                        const tsMs = Number(tx.block_time || Date.now());
                        return {
                            txId: String(tx.transaction_id || ''),
                            timestamp: new Date(tsMs).toLocaleString(),
                            amountKas,
                            direction
                        };
                    });
                    l1Transactions = parsed;
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore public explorer history timeout
        } finally {
            isFetchingHistory = false;
        }
    }

    function handleSseRefresh() {
        if (asset.ticker === 'KAS' && identity.isWalletConnected) {
            refreshKasUtxos();
            if (isMainOpen && activeRoutingTab === 'history') {
                fetchKasL1History();
            }
        }
    }

    onMount(() => {
        if (browser) {
            window.addEventListener('perennia:yield_update', handleSseRefresh);
            window.addEventListener('perennia:fiat_event', handleSseRefresh);
        }
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        stopColdQrCameraScanner();
        if (browser) {
            window.removeEventListener('perennia:yield_update', handleSseRefresh);
            window.removeEventListener('perennia:fiat_event', handleSseRefresh);
        }
    });

    $effect(() => {
        if (asset.ticker === 'KAS' && identity.isWalletConnected) {
            refreshKasUtxos();
            if (isMainOpen) {
                fetchKasL1History();
            }
        }
    });

    function initiateCompoundKasUtxos(e: Event) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        withdrawalFeedback = null;
        if (utxoCount < 2) {
            withdrawalFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message: `UTXO Compounding requires at least 2 unspent outputs (Current: ${utxoCount} UTXO).`
            };
            return;
        }
        txState.lastTxId = '';
        txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
        isCompoundingUtxos = true;
        awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource = 'compound';
        identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
            actionType: 'COMPOUND_KAS',
            payAsset: 'KAS',
            payAmount: `${utxoCount} UTXOs → 1 UTXO`,
            destinationAddress: identity.activeAddress || asset.address
        });
    }

    $effect(() => {
        if (autoOpenToken) {
            isMainOpen = true;
            activeRoutingTab = 'none';
            expandedSubToken = autoOpenToken;
            selectedSendTokenTicker = String(autoOpenToken).toUpperCase();
        }
    });

    $effect(() => {
        if (!identity.isVaultUnlockPending && awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource) {
            const sourceUsed = awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource;
            const amtUsed = pendingWithdrawAmount;
            const tickerUsed = pendingWithdrawTicker || asset.ticker;
            awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource = null;
            pendingWithdrawAmount = 0;
            isDispatchingWithdrawal = false;
            isCompoundingUtxos = false;
            if (txState.lastTxId) {
                const resolvedExplorerUrl =
                    txState.lastExplorerUrl ||
                    getChainExplorerTxUrl(tickerUsed, txState.lastTxId);
                if (sourceUsed === 'compound') {
                    withdrawalFeedback = {
                        type: 'success',
                        message: `Compounded L1 KAS UTXOs into a single output! TXID: ${txState.lastTxId}`,
                        txHash: txState.lastTxId,
                        explorerUrl: resolvedExplorerUrl
                    };
                    ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                        `asset_${asset.ticker}`,
                        'UTXOS COMPOUNDED ✓',
                        asset.hex || '#18C6A5'
                    );
                    setTimeout(refreshKasUtxos, 2000);
                    setTimeout(fetchKasL1History, 2500);
                } else {
                    const targetObj = treasury.getAsset(tickerUsed);
                    if (sourceUsed === 'ledger') {
                        const currentSynthetic = Number(targetObj.synthetic || 0);
                        treasury.updateAsset(tickerUsed, {
                            synthetic: Math.max(0, currentSynthetic - amtUsed)
                        });
                    } else if (sourceUsed === 'onchain') {
                        const currentOnChain = Number(targetObj.onChain || 0);
                        treasury.updateAsset(tickerUsed, {
                            onChain: Math.max(0, currentOnChain - amtUsed)
                        });
                    }
                    withdrawalFeedback = {
                        type: 'success',
                        message: `Sovereign L1 ${tickerUsed} Transfer Dispatched! TXID: ${txState.lastTxId}`,
                        txHash: txState.lastTxId,
                        explorerUrl: resolvedExplorerUrl
                    };
                    ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                        `asset_${asset.ticker}`,
                        `${tickerUsed} L1 DISPATCHED ✓`,
                        asset.hex || '#18C6A5'
                    );
                    sendAmount = '';
                    if (tickerUsed === 'KAS') {
                        setTimeout(refreshKasUtxos, 2000);
                        setTimeout(fetchKasL1History, 2500);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });

    async function initiateSend() {
        withdrawalFeedback = null;
        const parsedAmount = parseFloat(sendAmount);
        if (
            !sendDestination ||
            !sendAmount ||
            isNaN(parsedAmount) ||
            parsedAmount <= 0
        )
            return;
        const targetInfo = activeSendAssetObj;
        const targetTicker = targetInfo.ticker;
        const targetNetwork = targetInfo.network;
        const onChainBal = Number(targetInfo.onChain || 0);
        const ledgerBal = Number(targetInfo.synthetic || 0);
        const preferOnChain =
            withdrawalSourceMode === 'onchain' ||
            (withdrawalSourceMode === 'auto' && onChainBal >= parsedAmount);
        const preferLedger =
            withdrawalSourceMode === 'ledger' ||
            (withdrawalSourceMode === 'auto' &&
                onChainBal < parsedAmount &&
                ledgerBal >= parsedAmount);
        if (preferOnChain && onChainBal >= parsedAmount) {
            txState.lastTxId = '';
            txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
            isDispatchingWithdrawal = true;
            awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource = 'onchain';
            pendingWithdrawAmount = parsedAmount;
            pendingWithdrawTicker = targetTicker;
            const actionType =
                targetTicker === 'KAS'
                    ? 'SEND_KAS'
                    : targetNetwork === 'KAS' && targetTicker !== 'KAS'
                      ? 'SEND_KRC20'
                      : 'SEND_L1';
            identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
                actionType,
                payAsset: targetTicker,
                network: targetNetwork,
                contractAddress: targetInfo.contract,
                payAmount: sendAmount,
                destinationAddress: sendDestination.trim()
            });
            return;
        }
        if (
            (preferLedger || withdrawalSourceMode === 'ledger') &&
            ledgerBal >= parsedAmount
        ) {
            txState.lastTxId = '';
            txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
            isDispatchingWithdrawal = true;
            awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource = 'ledger';
            pendingWithdrawAmount = parsedAmount;
            pendingWithdrawTicker = targetTicker;
            identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
                actionType: 'WITHDRAW_SYNTHETIC',
                payAsset: targetTicker,
                network: targetNetwork,
                payAmount: sendAmount,
                destinationAddress: sendDestination.trim()
            });
            return;
        }
        if (withdrawalSourceMode === 'onchain') {
            txState.lastTxId = '';
            txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
            isDispatchingWithdrawal = true;
            awaitingVaultWithdrawalSource = 'onchain';
            pendingWithdrawAmount = parsedAmount;
            pendingWithdrawTicker = targetTicker;
            const actionType =
                targetTicker === 'KAS'
                    ? 'SEND_KAS'
                    : targetNetwork === 'KAS' && targetTicker !== 'KAS'
                      ? 'SEND_KRC20'
                      : 'SEND_L1';
            identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
                actionType,
                payAsset: targetTicker,
                network: targetNetwork,
                contractAddress: targetInfo.contract,
                payAmount: sendAmount,
                destinationAddress: sendDestination.trim()
            });
            return;
        }
        withdrawalFeedback = {
            type: 'error',
            message: `Insufficient ${targetTicker} balance in selected source. On-Chain L1: ${onChainBal.toFixed(6)} ${targetTicker} | In Batch Settlement Queue: ${ledgerBal.toFixed(6)} ${targetTicker}.`
        };
    }

    $effect(() => {
        if (!expandedSubToken) isSubRoutingVisible = false;
    });

    $effect(() => {
        if (asset?.address && !asset.address.includes('Awaiting')) {
            QRCode.toDataURL(asset.address, {
                margin: 1,
                color: { dark: '#000000', light: '#ffffff' },
                width: 200
            })
                .then((url: string) => {
                    qrCodeUrl = url;
                })
                .catch((e: unknown) => {
                    console.error(e);
                });
        } else {
            qrCodeUrl = '';
        }
    });

    function generateSparkline(
        seed: string,
        delta: number,
        width = 64,
        height = 24
    ) {
        let hash = 0;
        const seedStr = seed || 'KAS';
        for (let i = 0; i < seedStr.length; i++)
            hash = seedStr.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
        const points = [];
        const segments = 15;
        const clampedDelta = Math.max(-20, Math.min(20, delta || 0));
        const endY = height / 2 - (clampedDelta / 20) * (height / 2 - 2);
        for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            const x = (i / segments) * width;
            const progress = i / segments;
            const baseY = (height / 2) * (1 - progress) + endY * progress;
            const noiseStr = Math.sin(hash + i).toString();
            const noise =
                (parseFloat(noiseStr.substring(noiseStr.length - 2)) / 100 -
                    0.5) *
                8;
            const damp = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI);
            const y = baseY + noise * damp;
            points.push(`${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`);
        }
        return `M ${points.join(' L ')}`;
    }

    let filteredSubAssets = $derived(
        (subAssets || []).filter((t: any) => {
            const contractStr = t.contract ? t.contract.toLowerCase() : '';
            const searchStr = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
            const searchMatch =
                !searchQuery ||
                t.symbol?.toLowerCase().includes(searchStr) ||
                t.name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchStr) ||
                contractStr.includes(searchStr);
            const visibilityMatch =
                isManagingNetworks || (selectedTokens || []).includes(t.symbol);
            return searchMatch && visibilityMatch;
        })
    );

    function copyNativeAddress(e: Event, address: string) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (
            typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
            address &&
            !address.includes('Awaiting')
        ) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(address);
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                `asset_${asset.ticker}`,
                'ADDRESS COPIED ✓',
                asset.hex || '#18C6A5'
            );
        }
    }

    function openQuickAction(
        e: Event,
        tab: 'deposit' | 'withdraw' | 'cold_vault' | 'history',
        overrideTicker?: string
    ) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        withdrawalFeedback = null;
        if (tab !== 'cold_vault') {
            stopColdQrCameraScanner();
        }
        if (overrideTicker) {
            selectedSendTokenTicker = overrideTicker.toUpperCase();
        } else {
            selectedSendTokenTicker = (
                asset.ticker ||
                asset.symbol ||
                'KAS'
            ).toUpperCase();
        }
        if (activeRoutingTab === tab && isMainOpen && !overrideTicker) {
            activeRoutingTab = 'none';
        } else {
            activeRoutingTab = tab;
            isMainOpen = true;
            if (tab === 'history' && asset.ticker === 'KAS') {
                fetchKasL1History();
            }
        }
    }

    function getExplorerUrl(network: string, address: string) {
        return getChainExplorerAddressUrl(network, address);
    }

    function getDestinationPlaceholder(ticker: string, network: string): string {
        const clean = ticker.toUpperCase();
        const net = network.toUpperCase();
        if (clean === 'KAS' || net === 'KAS')
            return 'kaspa:qp... or kaspa:p... (SilverScript P2SH)';
        if (clean === 'BTC' || net === 'BTC') return 'bc1q... or 1...';
        if (clean === 'SOL' || net === 'SOL') return 'Solana base58 address...';
        if (clean === 'XRP' || net === 'XRP') return 'r...';
        if (
            ['ETH', 'USDC', 'USDT', 'POL', 'AVAX', 'ARB', 'BASE'].includes(
                clean
            ) ||
            ['ETH', 'POL', 'AVAX', 'ARB', 'BASE'].includes(net)
        ) {
            return '0x...';
        }
        return `Destination ${clean} L1 address...`;
    }

    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';

        showToast = true;

// src/lib/server/sor.ts

import { env } from '$env/dynamic/private';

export interface SwapPayload {
    payAsset: string;
    receiveAsset: string;
    amount: number;
}

export interface WaterfallLeg {
    tier: number;
    provider: string;
    filledAmount: number;
    executionRate: number;
    marginCaptured: number;
}

export interface SorExecutionPlan {
    totalAmount: number;
    unifiedRate: number;
    legs: WaterfallLeg[];
    estimatedOutput: number;
    transaction_uuid?: string;
    psbt?: any;
}

export class SmartOrderRouter {
    public async calculateSplitFill(req: SwapPayload, wallet: string, utxos?: any[], systemMode: string = "base"): Promise<SorExecutionPlan> {
        
        if (!env.RUST_BACKEND_URL) {
            throw new Error("CRITICAL: RUST_BACKEND_URL is missing. L1 Routing Unavailable.");
        }

        try {
            const res = await fetch(`${env.RUST_BACKEND_URL}/v1/sor/execute`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN || env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY || ''}`
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    wallet,
                    payAsset: req.payAsset,
                    receiveAsset: req.receiveAsset,
                    amount: req.amount,
                    slippageTolerance: 0.05,
                    utxos: utxos || null,
                    systemMode: systemMode
                })
            });

            if (!res.ok) {
                const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
                throw new Error(`Rust SOR Engine Rejected Payload: ${err.error || 'Unknown Error'}`);
            }

            return await res.json();
        } catch (e: any) {
            console.error(`🚨 FATAL: Rust SOR Engine Unreachable/Failed: ${e.message}`);
            throw new Error(`L1 Routing Unavailable: ${e.message}`);
        }
    }
}

export const sorEngine = new SmartOrderRouter();

import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
import { operations } from '$lib/stores/operations.svelte';

class IdentityStore {
    isWalletConnected = $state(false);
    activeAddress = $state<string | null>(null);
    activeWalletType = $state<'sovereign' | null>(null);
    sovereignKeys = $state<any>(null);
    isConnecting = $state(false);
    walletMessage = $state('');
    isVaultUnlockPending = $state(false);
    pendingTransactionDetails = $state<any>(null);
    isVaultUnlocked = $state(false);
    forgePublicEnabled = $state(false);
    masterTreasuryAddress = $state<string>('');
    serverVerifiedAdmin = $state<boolean>(false);
    serverAuthenticatedAddress = $state<string | null>(null);

    get isCorporateAdmin(): boolean {
        if (!this.isWalletConnected || !this.isVaultUnlocked) return false;
        if (!this.serverVerifiedAdmin) return false;
        if (this.activeAddress && this.serverAuthenticatedAddress) {
            return (
                this.normalizeKaspaAddress(this.activeAddress) ===
                this.normalizeKaspaAddress(this.serverAuthenticatedAddress)
            );
        }
        return true;
    }

    get canAccessForge(): boolean {
        return Boolean(this.forgePublicEnabled || this.isCorporateAdmin);
    }

    get isReadOnlySession(): boolean {
        return this.isWalletConnected && !this.isVaultUnlocked;
    }

    normalizeKaspaAddress(addr: string | null | undefined): string | null {
        if (!addr) return null;
        const clean = addr.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!clean) return null;
        if (clean.startsWith('kaspa:')) return clean;
        return `kaspa:${clean}`;
    }

    hexToBytes(hex: string): Uint8Array {
        if (hex.length % 2 !== 0) throw new Error('ERR_INVALID_HEX_LENGTH');
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(hex.length / 2);
        for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
            bytes[i] = parseInt(hex.substring(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
        }
        return bytes;
    }

    bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
        return Array.from(bytes)
            .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join('');
    }

    async syncServerAdminClearance(): Promise<void> {
        if (!browser) return;
        try {
            const [meRes, fiatRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch('/api/auth/me'),
                fetch('/api/fiat/offramp')
            ]);
            if (meRes.ok) {
                const meData = await meRes.json();
                this.serverVerifiedAdmin = Boolean(
                    meData.authenticated && meData.isCorporateAdmin
                );
                this.serverAuthenticatedAddress =
                    meData.authenticated && meData.address
                        ? this.normalizeKaspaAddress(meData.address)
                        : null;
                if (meData.masterTreasuryAddress) {
                    this.masterTreasuryAddress =
                        this.normalizeKaspaAddress(meData.masterTreasuryAddress) || '';
                }
            } else if (meRes.status === 401 || meRes.status === 403) {
                this.serverVerifiedAdmin = false;
        this.serverAuthenticatedAddress = null;
        if (ui.activeTab === 'DIRECTOR') {
            ui.activeTab = 'OPERATIONS';
        }
                this.serverAuthenticatedAddress = null;
            }
            if (fiatRes.ok) {
                const fiatData = await fiatRes.json();
                if (fiatData.masterTreasuryKasAddress) {
                    this.masterTreasuryAddress =
                        this.normalizeKaspaAddress(
                            fiatData.masterTreasuryKasAddress
                        ) || this.masterTreasuryAddress;
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore transient network errors during clearance sync
        }
    }

    authorizeSovereignVault(vaultPayload: any) {
        this.sovereignKeys = vaultPayload.wallets;
        this.activeAddress = this.normalizeKaspaAddress(
            vaultPayload.wallets.kaspa.address
        );
        this.activeWalletType = 'sovereign';
        this.isVaultUnlocked = true;
        if (browser) {
            sessionStorage.setItem('perennia_active_wallet_type', 'sovereign');
            sessionStorage.setItem('perennia_vault_unlocked', 'true');
            localStorage.setItem(
                'perennia_sovereign_payload',
                JSON.stringify(vaultPayload)
            );
        }
        this.isWalletConnected = true;
        this.syncServerAdminClearance();
        ui.checkFirstTimeTutorialPrompt();
    }

    hydrateStoredSovereignSession(authenticatedAddress?: string | null): boolean {
        if (!browser) return false;
        const normalizedAuth = this.normalizeKaspaAddress(authenticatedAddress);
        const rawPayload = localStorage.getItem('perennia_sovereign_payload');
        const unlockedInTab =
            sessionStorage.getItem('perennia_vault_unlocked') === 'true';
        if (rawPayload) {
            try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(rawPayload);
                const vaultKaspaAddr = this.normalizeKaspaAddress(
                    parsed?.wallets?.kaspa?.address
                );
                if (
                    vaultKaspaAddr &&
                    (!normalizedAuth || vaultKaspaAddr === normalizedAuth)
                ) {
                    this.sovereignKeys = parsed.wallets;
                    this.activeAddress = vaultKaspaAddr;
                    this.activeWalletType = 'sovereign';
                    this.syncServerAdminClearance();
                    if (unlockedInTab) {
                        this.isVaultUnlocked = true;
                        this.isWalletConnected = true;
                        sessionStorage.setItem(
                            'perennia_active_wallet_type',
                            'sovereign'
                        );
                        ui.checkFirstTimeTutorialPrompt();
                        return true;
                    } else {
                        this.isVaultUnlocked = false;
                        this.isWalletConnected = false;
                        ui.showWalletModal = true;
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore malformed local payload
            }
        }
        if (normalizedAuth) {
            this.activeAddress = normalizedAuth;
            this.activeWalletType = 'sovereign';
            this.syncServerAdminClearance();
            if (unlockedInTab) {
                this.isVaultUnlocked = true;
                this.isWalletConnected = true;
                sessionStorage.setItem('perennia_active_wallet_type', 'sovereign');
                ui.checkFirstTimeTutorialPrompt();
                return true;
            } else {
                this.isVaultUnlocked = false;
                this.isWalletConnected = false;
                ui.showWalletModal = true;
                return false;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    requestVaultAuthorization(transactionDetails: any) {
        this.pendingTransactionDetails = transactionDetails;
        this.isVaultUnlockPending = true;
        ui.showWalletModal = true;
    }

    disconnect() {
        fetch('/api/auth', { method: 'DELETE' }).catch(() => {});
        this.activeAddress = null;
        this.isWalletConnected = false;
        this.activeWalletType = null;
        this.sovereignKeys = null;
        this.isVaultUnlocked = false;
        this.isVaultUnlockPending = false;
        this.pendingTransactionDetails = null;
        this.serverVerifiedAdmin = false;
        operations.purge();
        if (browser) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem('perennia_active_wallet_type');
            sessionStorage.removeItem('perennia_vault_unlocked');
        }
    }
}
