    const symbol = `${ticker}USDT`;
    const res = await fetch(
        `https://api.bitget.com/api/v2/spot/market/tickers?symbol=${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}`,
        { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3200) }
    );
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const payload = await res.json();
    const item = Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data[0] : null;
    const lastPrice = parseFloat(String(item?.lastPr || '0'));
    if (!Number.isFinite(lastPrice) || lastPrice <= 0) return null;

    const usdtVolume = parseFloat(
        String(item?.usdtVolume || item?.quoteVolume || '0')
    );
    if (!Number.isFinite(usdtVolume) || usdtVolume < MIN_CEX_24H_VOLUME_USD) {
        return null;
    }

    const bidPr = parseFloat(String(item?.bidPr || '0'));
    const askPr = parseFloat(String(item?.askPr || '0'));
    let spreadRatio = 0;
    if (bidPr > 0 && askPr >= bidPr) {
        spreadRatio = (askPr - bidPr) / askPr;
        if (spreadRatio > MAX_CEX_SPREAD_RATIO) return null;
    }

    const change24h = parseFloat(String(item?.change24h || '0'));
    return {
        exchange: 'Bitget',
        priceUsd: lastPrice,
        change24hPct: Number.isFinite(change24h) ? change24h * 100 : 0,
        volume24hUsd: usdtVolume,
        spreadRatio
    };
}

async function queryCoinexSpot(ticker: string): Promise<ExchangeQuote | null> {
    const market = `${ticker}USDT`;
    const res = await fetch(
        `https://api.coinex.com/v2/spot/ticker?market=${encodeURIComponent(market)}`,
        { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3200) }
    );
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const payload = await res.json();
    const item = Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data[0] : null;
    const lastPrice = parseFloat(String(item?.last || '0'));
    if (!Number.isFinite(lastPrice) || lastPrice <= 0) return null;

    const quoteVal = parseFloat(String(item?.value || '0'));
    if (!Number.isFinite(quoteVal) || quoteVal < MIN_CEX_24H_VOLUME_USD) {
        return null;
    }

    const openPrice = parseFloat(String(item?.open || '0'));
    const change24hPct =
        Number.isFinite(openPrice) && openPrice > 0
            ? ((lastPrice - openPrice) / openPrice) * 100
            : 0;
    return {
        exchange: 'CoinEx',
        priceUsd: lastPrice,
        change24hPct,
        volume24hUsd: quoteVal
    };
}

async function queryDexScreenerUniversal(
    rawQuery: string,
    canonicalAnchorPriceUsd = 0
): Promise<DiscoveredAssetPayload[]> {
    const trimmed = String(rawQuery || '').trim();
    if (trimmed.length < 2) return [];

    const isAddress = isContractOrMintAddress(trimmed);
    const endpoint = isAddress
        ? `https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}`
        : `https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}`;

    try {
        const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
            headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000)
        });
        if (!res.ok) return [];
        const data = await res.json();
        const rawPairs = Array.isArray(data?.pairs) ? data.pairs : [];
        if (rawPairs.length === 0) return [];

        const upperQuery = trimmed.toUpperCase();
        const sortedPairs = [...rawPairs]
            .filter((p: any) => {
                const priceUsd = parseFloat(String(p?.priceUsd || '0'));
                const liqUsd = parseFloat(String(p?.liquidity?.usd || '0'));
                const vol24h = parseFloat(String(p?.volume?.h24 || '0'));
                if (!Number.isFinite(priceUsd) || priceUsd <= 0) return false;
                if (!isAddress && liqUsd < 2_500 && vol24h < 5_000) return false;
                if (
                    !isAddress &&
                    canonicalAnchorPriceUsd > 0 &&
                    String(p?.baseToken?.symbol || '').toUpperCase() ===
                        upperQuery &&
                    Math.abs(priceUsd - canonicalAnchorPriceUsd) /
                        canonicalAnchorPriceUsd >
                        MAX_CANONICAL_DEVIATION_RATIO
                ) {
                    return false;
                }
                return true;
            })
            .sort((a: any, b: any) => {
                const aExact =
                    String(a?.baseToken?.symbol || '').toUpperCase() === upperQuery
                        ? 1
                        : 0;
                const bExact =
                    String(b?.baseToken?.symbol || '').toUpperCase() === upperQuery
                        ? 1
                        : 0;
                if (aExact !== bExact) return bExact - aExact;
                const scoreA =
                    (parseFloat(String(a?.liquidity?.usd || '0')) || 0) +
                    (parseFloat(String(a?.volume?.h24 || '0')) || 0);
                const scoreB =
                    (parseFloat(String(b?.liquidity?.usd || '0')) || 0) +
                    (parseFloat(String(b?.volume?.h24 || '0')) || 0);
                return scoreB - scoreA;
            });

        const seenBySymbolChain = new Map<string, DiscoveredAssetPayload>();
        for (const pair of sortedPairs) {
            const chainId = String(pair?.chainId || '').toLowerCase();
            const chainSpec = DEXSCREENER_CHAIN_MAP[chainId] || {
                network: 'ETH',
                hex: '#18C6A5',
                pastel: '#99f6e4'
            };
            const sym = sanitizeTicker(pair?.baseToken?.symbol || '');
            if (!sym) continue;
            const dedupeKey = `${sym}:${chainSpec.network}`;
            if (seenBySymbolChain.has(dedupeKey)) continue;

            const priceUsd = parseFloat(String(pair?.priceUsd || '0'));
            const change24h = parseFloat(String(pair?.priceChange?.h24 || '0'));
            const liquidityUsd = parseFloat(String(pair?.liquidity?.usd || '0'));
            const contractAddr = String(pair?.baseToken?.address || sym).trim();
            const tokenName = String(pair?.baseToken?.name || sym).trim();
            const imageUrl =
                String(pair?.info?.imageUrl || '').trim() ||
                `https://cryptologos.cc/logos/${sym.toLowerCase()}-${sym.toLowerCase()}-logo.svg`;

            seenBySymbolChain.set(dedupeKey, {
                ticker: sym,
                name: `${tokenName} (${chainSpec.network})`,
                assetClass: 'DeFi',
                network: chainSpec.network,
                spotPrice: priceUsd,
                change24h: Number.isFinite(change24h)
                    ? Number(change24h.toFixed(2))
                    : 0,
                sources: [`DexScreener (${chainId.toUpperCase()})`],
                quorumCount: 1,
                isKrc20: false,
                contract: contractAddr,
                liquidityUsd: Number.isFinite(liquidityUsd)
                    ? Math.round(liquidityUsd)
                    : undefined,
                theme: {
                    hex: chainSpec.hex,
                    pastel: chainSpec.pastel
                },
                imgUrl: imageUrl
            });

            if (seenBySymbolChain.size >= 8) break;
        }

        return Array.from(seenBySymbolChain.values());
    } catch {
        return [];
    }
}

async function queryKrc20Indexer(
    ticker: string,
    kasUsdPrice: number
): Promise<{
    existsOnKasplex: boolean;
    spotPriceUsd: number;
    change24hPct: number;
    maxSupply: number;
    mintedSupply: number;
    holders: number;
    state: string;
} | null> {
    if (ticker.length < 4 || ticker.length > 6 || !/^[A-Z]+$/.test(ticker)) {
        return null;
    }
    const [kasplexRes, kasFyiRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        fetch(
            `https://api.kasplex.org/v1/krc20/token/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}`,
            {
                headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3500)
            }
        ),
        fetch(
            `https://api.kas.fyi/v1/tokens/krc20/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}/market`,
            {
                headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3500)
            }
        )
    ]);
    let existsOnKasplex = false;
    let maxSupply = 0;
    let mintedSupply = 0;
    let holders = 0;
    let state = 'unused';
    if (kasplexRes.status === 'fulfilled' && kasplexRes.value.ok) {
        try {
            const kpData = await kasplexRes.value.json();
            const entry = Array.isArray(kpData?.result)
                ? kpData.result[0]
                : kpData?.result;
            const rawState = String(entry?.state || '').toLowerCase();
            if (
                entry &&
                entry.tick &&
                rawState !== 'unused' &&
                rawState !== 'not_found'
            ) {
                existsOnKasplex = true;
                const dec = Number(entry.dec ?? 8);
                maxSupply = Number(entry.max || 0) / Math.pow(10, dec);
                mintedSupply = Number(entry.minted || 0) / Math.pow(10, dec);
                holders = Number(entry.holderTotal ?? entry.holders ?? 0);
                state = String(entry.state || 'deployed');
            }
        } catch {
            existsOnKasplex = false;
        }
    }
    let spotPriceUsd = 0;
    let change24hPct = 0;
    if (kasFyiRes.status === 'fulfilled' && kasFyiRes.value.ok) {
        try {
            const mkt = await kasFyiRes.value.json();
            const usdVal = Number(
                mkt?.price?.usd ?? mkt?.priceUsd ?? mkt?.price ?? 0
            );
            const kasVal = Number(mkt?.price?.kas ?? mkt?.priceKas ?? 0);
            if (Number.isFinite(usdVal) && usdVal > 0) {
                spotPriceUsd = usdVal;
            } else if (
                Number.isFinite(kasVal) &&
                kasVal > 0 &&
                kasUsdPrice > 0
            ) {
                spotPriceUsd = kasVal * kasUsdPrice;
            }
            const chg = Number(
                mkt?.change24h ?? mkt?.priceChange24h ?? mkt?.change_24h ?? 0
            );
            if (Number.isFinite(chg)) {
                change24hPct = chg;
            }
        } catch {
            spotPriceUsd = 0;
        }
    }
    if (ticker === 'SILO' && spotPriceUsd <= 0 && kasUsdPrice > 0) {
        existsOnKasplex = true;
        spotPriceUsd = Number((kasUsdPrice / 23.809524).toFixed(6));
    }
    if (!existsOnKasplex && spotPriceUsd <= 0) {
        return null;
    }
    return {
        existsOnKasplex,
        spotPriceUsd,
        change24hPct,
        maxSupply,
        mintedSupply,
        holders,
        state
    };
}

async function persistDiscoveredAssetInRedisAndPostgres(
    discovered: DiscoveredAssetPayload,
    persistInDynamicSet = true
) {
    const cleanTicker = sanitizeTicker(discovered.ticker);
    if (!cleanTicker) return;
    const pipe = redis.pipeline();
    if (persistInDynamicSet) {
        pipe.sadd('oracle:dynamic_tickers', cleanTicker);
    }
    if (discovered.coingeckoId) {
        pipe.set(
            `oracle:cg_id:${cleanTicker}`,
            discovered.coingeckoId,
            'EX',
            86400
        );
    }
    pipe.set(
        `oracle:dynamic_meta:${cleanTicker}`,
        JSON.stringify(discovered),
        'EX',
        3600
    );
    if (discovered.spotPrice > 0) {
        pipe.set(
            `oracle:spot:${cleanTicker}_USDC`,
            String(discovered.spotPrice),
            'EX',
            SPOT_ORACLE_TTL_SECS
        );
        pipe.set(
            `oracle:change24h:${cleanTicker}_USDC`,
            String(discovered.change24h || 0),
            'EX',
            CHANGE_24H_TTL_SECS
        );
    }
    await pipe.exec().catch(() => {});

    if (discovered.spotPrice > 0) {
        await dbPool
            .query(
                `INSERT INTO rwa_oracle_feeds (ticker, asset_class, price_usd, change_24h_pct, oracle_source, updated_at)
                 VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                 ON CONFLICT (ticker) DO UPDATE SET
                    asset_class = EXCLUDED.asset_class,
                    price_usd = EXCLUDED.price_usd,
                    change_24h_pct = EXCLUDED.change_24h_pct,
                    oracle_source = EXCLUDED.oracle_source,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`,
                [
                    cleanTicker,
                    discovered.assetClass || 'DeFi',
                    discovered.spotPrice,
                    discovered.change24h || 0,
                    discovered.coingeckoId
                        ? `COINGECKO_RANK_${discovered.marketCapRank || 'VERIFIED'}`
                        : 'DYNAMIC_QUORUM'
                ]
            )
            .catch(() => {});
    }
}

async function discoverUniversalAssets(
    rawQuery: string,
    persistInDynamicSet = true
): Promise<{
    primary: DiscoveredAssetPayload | null;
    matches: DiscoveredAssetPayload[];
}> {
    const trimmed = String(rawQuery || '').trim();
    if (trimmed.length < 2) {
        return { primary: null, matches: [] };
    }

    if (isContractOrMintAddress(trimmed)) {
        const dexMatches = await queryDexScreenerUniversal(trimmed);
        if (dexMatches.length > 0) {
            await persistDiscoveredAssetInRedisAndPostgres(
                dexMatches[0],
                persistInDynamicSet
            );
            return { primary: dexMatches[0], matches: dexMatches };
        }
    }

    const ticker = sanitizeTicker(trimmed);
    if (ticker.length < 2) {
        return { primary: null, matches: [] };
    }

    const [cachedSpotStr, cachedChangeStr, cachedMetaRaw, kasSpotStr] =
        await Promise.all([
            redis.get(`oracle:spot:${ticker}_USDC`).catch(() => null),
            redis.get(`oracle:change24h:${ticker}_USDC`).catch(() => null),
            redis.get(`oracle:dynamic_meta:${ticker}`).catch(() => null),
            redis.get('oracle:spot:KAS_USDC').catch(() => null)
        ]);
    const kasUsdPrice = kasSpotStr ? parseFloat(kasSpotStr) || 0 : 0;

    if (cachedSpotStr && cachedMetaRaw) {
        const cachedSpot = parseFloat(cachedSpotStr);
        if (Number.isFinite(cachedSpot) && cachedSpot > 0) {
            try {
                const meta = JSON.parse(cachedMetaRaw) as DiscoveredAssetPayload;
                if (meta.coingeckoId || meta.isKrc20 || meta.quorumCount >= 2) {
                    meta.spotPrice = cachedSpot;
                    if (cachedChangeStr) {
                        const chg = parseFloat(cachedChangeStr);
                        if (Number.isFinite(chg)) meta.change24h = chg;
                    }
                    if (persistInDynamicSet) {
                        await persistDiscoveredAssetInRedisAndPostgres(
                            meta,
                            true
                        );
                    }
                    return { primary: meta, matches: [meta] };
                }
            } catch {
                // Fall through to live multi-source discovery
            }
        }
    }

    const [
        cgAnchorRes,
        mexcRes,
        gateRes,
        kucoinRes,
        bitgetRes,
        coinexRes,
        krc20Res,
        yahooRes
    ] = await Promise.allSettled([
        queryCoinGeckoCanonicalAnchor(trimmed, ticker),
        queryMexcSpot(ticker),
        queryGateSpot(ticker),
        queryKucoinSpot(ticker),
        queryBitgetSpot(ticker),
        queryCoinexSpot(ticker),
        queryKrc20Indexer(ticker, kasUsdPrice),
        queryYahooFinanceQuote(ticker)
    ]);

    const cgAnchor =
        cgAnchorRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? cgAnchorRes.value : null;
    const canonicalPriceUsd =
        cgAnchor && cgAnchor.priceUsd > 0 ? cgAnchor.priceUsd : 0;

    const dexScreenerMatches = await queryDexScreenerUniversal(
        trimmed,
        canonicalPriceUsd
    );

    const exchangeQuotes: ExchangeQuote[] = [];
    if (cgAnchor && cgAnchor.priceUsd > 0) {
        exchangeQuotes.push({
            exchange: cgAnchor.marketCapRank
                ? `CoinGecko (#${cgAnchor.marketCapRank})`
                : 'CoinGecko',
            priceUsd: cgAnchor.priceUsd,
            change24hPct: cgAnchor.change24hPct,
            volume24hUsd: cgAnchor.volume24hUsd
        });
    }

    for (const r of [mexcRes, gateRes, kucoinRes, bitgetRes, coinexRes]) {
        if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && r.value && r.value.priceUsd > 0) {
            if (
                canonicalPriceUsd > 0 &&
                Math.abs(r.value.priceUsd - canonicalPriceUsd) /
                    canonicalPriceUsd >
                    MAX_CANONICAL_DEVIATION_RATIO
            ) {
                continue;
            }
            exchangeQuotes.push(r.value);
        }
    }

    const krc20Info =
        krc20Res.status === 'fulfilled' ? krc20Res.value : null;
    const yahooQuote =
        yahooRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? yahooRes.value : null;

    const {
        spotPrice: cexMedianSpot,
        change24h: cexChange,
        sources: cexSources
    } = filterOutliersAndComputeMedian(exchangeQuotes, canonicalPriceUsd);

    const hasCanonicalRankLeader = Boolean(
        cgAnchor &&
            cgAnchor.priceUsd > 0 &&
            cgAnchor.marketCapRank !== null &&
            cgAnchor.marketCapRank <= 500
    );
    const hasValidCexQuorum =
        cexSources.length >= MIN_DISCOVERY_CEX_QUORUM && cexMedianSpot > 0;
    const hasSingleVerifiedQuote =
        cexSources.length === 1 && cexMedianSpot > 0;

    const isGenuineKrc20 = Boolean(
        krc20Info?.existsOnKasplex &&
            !hasCanonicalRankLeader &&
            (KNOWN_KRC20_ECOSYSTEM_TICKERS.has(ticker) ||
                (!hasValidCexQuorum && krc20Info.spotPriceUsd > 0))
    );

    const discoveredList: DiscoveredAssetPayload[] = [];

    if (isGenuineKrc20 && krc20Info) {
        const krcSpot =
            krc20Info.spotPriceUsd > 0
                ? krc20Info.spotPriceUsd
                : hasValidCexQuorum
                  ? cexMedianSpot
                  : 0;
        if (krcSpot > 0) {
            const krcChange =
                krc20Info.change24hPct !== 0
                    ? krc20Info.change24hPct
                    : cexChange;
            const krcSources = [
                ...(krc20Info.existsOnKasplex ? ['Kasplex L1'] : []),
                ...cexSources
            ];
            discoveredList.push({
                ticker,
                name: `${ticker} (KRC-20 L1)`,
                assetClass: 'Ecosystem',
                network: 'KAS',
                spotPrice: krcSpot,
                change24h: Number(krcChange.toFixed(2)),
                sources: krcSources.length > 0 ? krcSources : ['Kasplex L1'],
                quorumCount: Math.max(1, krcSources.length),
                isKrc20: true,
                contract: ticker,
                maxSupply: krc20Info.maxSupply || undefined,
                mintedSupply: krc20Info.mintedSupply || undefined,
                holders: krc20Info.holders || undefined,
                theme: { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' },
                imgUrl: `https://storage.googleapis.com/kasfyi/token-icons/${ticker.toLowerCase()}.png`
            });
        }
    }

    if (hasCanonicalRankLeader || hasValidCexQuorum || hasSingleVerifiedQuote) {
        const resolvedTicker = cgAnchor?.symbol || ticker;
        const matchingDex = dexScreenerMatches.find(
            (d) => d.ticker.toUpperCase() === resolvedTicker
        );
        const resolvedNetwork = matchingDex?.network || 'ETH';
        const resolvedContract = matchingDex?.contract || resolvedTicker;
        const resolvedImg =
            cgAnchor?.thumbUrl ||
            matchingDex?.imgUrl ||
            `https://cryptologos.cc/logos/${resolvedTicker.toLowerCase()}-${resolvedTicker.toLowerCase()}-logo.svg`;
        const displayName = cgAnchor?.name
            ? `${cgAnchor.name} (${cexSources.slice(0, 3).join(' • ')})`
            : `${resolvedTicker} (${cexSources.slice(0, 3).join(' • ')})`;

        if (!isGenuineKrc20) {
            discoveredList.push({
                ticker: resolvedTicker,
                name: displayName,
                assetClass: 'DeFi',
                network: resolvedNetwork,
                spotPrice: cexMedianSpot,
                change24h: cexChange,
                sources: cexSources,
                quorumCount: cexSources.length,
                isKrc20: false,
                contract: resolvedContract,
                coingeckoId: cgAnchor?.coinId,
                marketCapRank: cgAnchor?.marketCapRank ?? null,
                theme: matchingDex?.theme || {
                    hex: '#18C6A5',
                    pastel: '#99f6e4'
                },
                imgUrl: resolvedImg
            });
        }
    }

    if (yahooQuote && yahooQuote.priceUsd > 0 && discoveredList.length === 0) {
        discoveredList.push({
            ticker,
            name: `${yahooQuote.shortName} (PUBLIC EQUITY)`,
            assetClass: 'Tokenized Asset',
            network: 'BASE',
            spotPrice: yahooQuote.priceUsd,
            change24h: yahooQuote.change24hPct,
            sources: ['Yahoo Finance / Pyth RWA'],
            quorumCount: 1,
            isKrc20: false,
            contract: ticker,
            theme: { hex: '#38BDF8', pastel: '#bae6fd' },
            imgUrl: `https://assets.parqet.com/logos/symbol/${ticker}?format=png`
        });
    }

    for (const dexItem of dexScreenerMatches) {
        const alreadyIncluded = discoveredList.some(
            (d) =>
                d.ticker === dexItem.ticker && d.network === dexItem.network
        );
        if (!alreadyIncluded) {
            discoveredList.push(dexItem);
        }
    }

    if (discoveredList.length === 0) {
        return { primary: null, matches: [] };
    }

    const primary = discoveredList[0];
    await persistDiscoveredAssetInRedisAndPostgres(
        primary,
        persistInDynamicSet
    );

    return {
        primary,
        matches: discoveredList
    };
}

export const GET: RequestHandler = async ({ url }: RequestEvent) => {
    try {
        const historyQuery = url.searchParams.get('history');
        if (historyQuery && historyQuery.trim().length > 0) {
            const tf = url.searchParams.get('timeframe') || '24H';
            const series = await fetchHistoricalPriceSeries(historyQuery, tf);
            return json(series, {
                status: 200,
                headers: {
                    'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'
                }
            });
        }

        const discoverQuery = url.searchParams.get('discover');
        if (discoverQuery && discoverQuery.trim().length > 0) {
            const rawTrimmed = discoverQuery.trim();
            if (rawTrimmed.length < 2) {
                return json(
                    {
                        success: false,
                        error: 'Enter at least 2 characters or a contract address to discover a live token.'
                    },
                    { status: 400 }
                );
            }
            const shouldPersist = url.searchParams.get('register') !== '0';
            const { primary, matches } = await discoverUniversalAssets(
                rawTrimmed,
                shouldPersist
            );
            if (!primary) {
                return json(
                    {
                        success: false,
                        ticker: sanitizeTicker(rawTrimmed),
                        error: `No live market feed (CoinGecko, DexScreener, Kasplex KRC-20, or CEX Quorum) found for "${rawTrimmed}".`
                    },
                    { status: 404 }
                );
            }
            return json(
                {
                    success: true,
                    asset: primary,
                    assets: matches,
                    matches
                },
                {
                    status: 200,
                    headers: {
                        'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'
                    }
                }
            );
        }

        let cachedPrices = await redis.get('oracle:spot:prices_json');
        let parsedPrices: Record<
            string,
            { usd: number; usd_24h_change?: number }
        > | null = null;
        if (cachedPrices) {
            try {
                parsedPrices = JSON.parse(cachedPrices);
            } catch {
                parsedPrices = null;
            }
        }
        const dynamicTickers = await redis
            .smembers('oracle:dynamic_tickers')
            .catch(() => [] as string[]);
        if (parsedPrices) {
            let needsChangeHydration = false;
            for (const [cgKey, entry] of Object.entries(parsedPrices)) {
                const ticker = ASSET_KEY_TO_TICKER[cgKey];
                if (
                    ticker &&
                    (!entry.usd_24h_change ||
                        Math.abs(entry.usd_24h_change) < 1e-9)
                ) {
                    const cachedChangeStr = await redis.get(
                        `oracle:change24h:${ticker}_USDC`
                    );
                    const cachedChange = cachedChangeStr
                        ? parseFloat(cachedChangeStr)
                        : 0;
                    if (cachedChange && Math.abs(cachedChange) > 1e-9) {
                        entry.usd_24h_change = cachedChange;
                    } else if (
                        ticker === 'KAS' ||
                        ticker === 'BTC' ||
                        ticker === 'ETH' ||
                        ticker === 'SOL'
                    ) {
                        needsChangeHydration = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dynamicTickers.length > 0) {
                await Promise.all(
                    dynamicTickers.slice(0, 60).map(async (dynTicker) => {
                        const clean = sanitizeTicker(dynTicker);
                        if (!clean) return;
                        const [spotStr, chgStr] = await Promise.all([
                            redis
                                .get(`oracle:spot:${clean}_USDC`)
                                .catch(() => null),
                            redis
                                .get(`oracle:change24h:${clean}_USDC`)
                                .catch(() => null)
                        ]);
                        const spot = spotStr ? parseFloat(spotStr) : 0;
                        const chg = chgStr ? parseFloat(chgStr) : 0;
                        if (Number.isFinite(spot) && spot > 0 && parsedPrices) {
                            parsedPrices[clean.toLowerCase()] = {
                                usd: spot,
                                usd_24h_change: Number.isFinite(chg) ? chg : 0
                            };
                            parsedPrices[clean] = {
                                usd: spot,
                                usd_24h_change: Number.isFinite(chg) ? chg : 0
                            };
                        }
                    })
                );
            }

            // Always hydrate RWA & Public Equities (SPY, QQQ, NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, AMD, TSM, AVGO, XLE, XAU, XAG, USTB)
            await hydrateRwaAndEquitiesPrices(parsedPrices);

            if (needsChangeHydration) {
                const recentCgSync = await redis.get(
                    'oracle:change24h:cg_hydrated_lock'
                );
                if (!recentCgSync) {
                    try {
                        await redis.set(
                            'oracle:change24h:cg_hydrated_lock',
                            '1',
                            'EX',
                            45
                        );
                        const ids = Object.keys(ASSET_KEY_TO_TICKER).join(',');
                        const cgRes = await fetch(
                            `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=${ids}&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true`,
                            { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000) }
                        );
                        if (cgRes.ok) {
                            const cgData = await cgRes.json();
                            const pipe = redis.pipeline();
                            for (const [cgKey, ticker] of Object.entries(
                                ASSET_KEY_TO_TICKER
                            )) {
                                const chg = Number(
                                    cgData?.[cgKey]?.usd_24h_change || 0
                                );
                                if (chg !== 0) {
                                    pipe.set(
                                        `oracle:change24h:${ticker}_USDC`,
                                        String(chg),
                                        'EX',
                                        CHANGE_24H_TTL_SECS
                                    );
                                    if (parsedPrices[cgKey]) {
                                        parsedPrices[cgKey].usd_24h_change = chg;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            pipe.set(
                                'oracle:spot:prices_json',
                                JSON.stringify(parsedPrices),
                                'EX',
                                SPOT_ORACLE_TTL_SECS
                            );
                            await pipe.exec();
                        }
                    } catch {
                        // Ignore CoinGecko rate limit
                    }
                }
            }
            return new Response(JSON.stringify(parsedPrices), {
                status: 200,
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'
                }
            });
        }

        const ids =
            url.searchParams.get('ids') ||
            'kaspa,bitcoin,ethereum,solana,dogecoin,ripple';
        const cgRes = await fetch(
            `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=${ids}&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true`,
            { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) }
        );
        if (cgRes.ok) {
            const data = await cgRes.json();
            await hydrateRwaAndEquitiesPrices(data);
            cachedPrices = JSON.stringify(data);
            const pipe = redis.pipeline();
            pipe.set(
                'oracle:spot:prices_json',
                cachedPrices,
                'EX',
                SPOT_ORACLE_TTL_SECS
            );
            for (const [cgKey, ticker] of Object.entries(ASSET_KEY_TO_TICKER)) {
                const spotUsd = Number(data?.[cgKey]?.usd || 0);
                if (Number.isFinite(spotUsd) && spotUsd > 0) {
                    pipe.set(
                        `oracle:spot:${ticker}_USDC`,
                        String(spotUsd),
                        'EX',
                        SPOT_ORACLE_TTL_SECS
                    );
                }
                if (typeof data?.[cgKey]?.usd_24h_change === 'number') {
                    pipe.set(
                        `oracle:change24h:${ticker}_USDC`,
                        String(data[cgKey].usd_24h_change),
                        'EX',
                        CHANGE_24H_TTL_SECS
                    );
                }
            }
            await pipe.exec();
            return new Response(cachedPrices, {
                status: 200,
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'
                }
            });
        }
        return json(
            {
                error: 'Oracle Sync Pending',
                message: 'Rust Daemon has not published initial spot prices yet.'
            },
            { status: 503 }
        );
    } catch (e: any) {
        console.error('🚨 CRITICAL: Redis Oracle Read Failed -', e.message);
        return json(
            { error: 'Oracle Cache Unreachable', details: e.message },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    }
};

import { json, type RequestHandler, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { dbPool } from '$lib/server/db';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import { env } from '$env/dynamic/private';
import { validateKaspaBech32mAddress } from '$lib/crypto/kaspaAddress';
import {
    isWalletMasterAdmin,
    resolveMasterTreasuryKasAddressOptional,
    normalizeKaspaAddressStrict,
    normalizeKaspaBase32Strict,
    perenniaKMS
} from '$lib/server/kms';

function resolveStratumTierEndpoint(hashrateTh: number): {
    tier: number;
    externalPort: number;
    internalPort: number;
    initialDifficulty: number;
    stratumUrl: string;
} {
    const host = (env.PUBLIC_STRATUM_HOST || 'pool.perennia.io').trim();
    if (hashrateTh > 10.0) {
        return {
            tier: 3,
            externalPort: 3334,
            internalPort: 6553,
            initialDifficulty: 1024.0,
            stratumUrl: `stratum+tcp://${host}:3334`
        };
    }
    if (hashrateTh >= 1.0) {
        return {
            tier: 2,
            externalPort: 3333,
            internalPort: 6552,
            initialDifficulty: 256.0,
            stratumUrl: `stratum+tcp://${host}:3333`
        };
    }
    return {
        tier: 1,
        externalPort: 3332,
        internalPort: 6551,
        initialDifficulty: 1.0,
        stratumUrl: `stratum+tcp://${host}:3332`
    };
}

let workerSchemaVerified = false;

async function ensureWorkerProfilesSchema() {
    if (workerSchemaVerified) return;

    await dbPool.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worker_profiles (
            worker_identity VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
            worker_id VARCHAR(255),
            wallet_address VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
            worker_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Rig01',
            hardware_model VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IceRiver KS',
            hashrate_ths DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
            current_hashrate DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
            valid_shares BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            rejected_shares BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            acceptance_pct DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.0,
            blocks_found BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            stratum_port INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3332,
            last_share_ts BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            streak_started_ts BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            effective_fee_rate DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.01,
            status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'online',
            last_seen TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );
    `);

    const alterMigrations = [
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS worker_identity VARCHAR(255)`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS worker_id VARCHAR(255)`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hardware_model VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IceRiver KS'`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hashrate_ths DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS current_hashrate DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stratum_port INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3332`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_seen TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'online'`,
        `ALTER TABLE worker_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`
    ];

    for (const stmt of alterMigrations) {
        await dbPool.query(stmt).catch(() => {});
    }

    await dbPool
        .query(
            `UPDATE worker_profiles
             SET worker_id = worker_identity
             WHERE worker_id IS NULL AND worker_identity IS NOT NULL`
        )
        .catch(() => {});

    await dbPool
        .query(
            `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_worker_profiles_identity_uniq
             ON worker_profiles (worker_identity)`
        )
        .catch(() => {});

    workerSchemaVerified = true;
}

async function hasDirectorClearance(
    request: Request,
    sessionWallet: string | null
): Promise<boolean> {
    const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization') || '';
    if (authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
        try {
            if (perenniaKMS.verifyMasterAdminKey(authHeader)) {
                return true;
            }
        } catch {
            // Fall through to session check
        }
    }
    return isWalletMasterAdmin(sessionWallet);
}

export const GET: RequestHandler = async ({ cookies, url }: RequestEvent) => {
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    const sessionWallet = sessionId
        ? await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`).catch(() => null)
        : null;
    const requestedWallet =
        url.searchParams.get('wallet') || sessionWallet || '';
    const cleanWallet = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(requestedWallet);
    const boundCoinbaseRaw =
        (await redis
            .get('perennia:stratum:mining_address')
            .catch(() => null)) ||
        (env.PERENNIA_HOT_KAS_ADDRESS || '').trim() ||
        resolveMasterTreasuryKasAddressOptional() ||
        '';
    const poolCoinbaseAddress = boundCoinbaseRaw
        ? normalizeKaspaAddressStrict(boundCoinbaseRaw)
        : null;

    let workers: any[] = [];
    if (cleanWallet && sessionWallet) {
        const cleanSession = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(sessionWallet);
        const isDirector = isWalletMasterAdmin(sessionWallet);
        if (cleanWallet === cleanSession || isDirector) {
            try {
                await ensureWorkerProfilesSchema();
                const res = await dbPool.query(
                    `SELECT COALESCE(worker_id, worker_identity) AS worker_id,
                            worker_identity,
                            wallet_address,
                            worker_name,
                            COALESCE(hardware_model, 'IceRiver KS') AS hardware_model,
                            CASE
                                WHEN COALESCE(current_hashrate, 0) > 0 THEN current_hashrate
                                ELSE COALESCE(hashrate_ths, 0) * 1e12
                            END AS current_hashrate,
                            COALESCE(hashrate_ths, 0) AS hashrate_ths,
                            valid_shares,
                            rejected_shares,
                            blocks_found,
                            COALESCE(stratum_port, 3332) AS stratum_port,
                            COALESCE(last_seen, updated_at) AS last_seen
                     FROM worker_profiles
                     WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(TRIM(wallet_address), 'kaspa:', '')) = $1
                     ORDER BY COALESCE(last_seen, updated_at) DESC NULLS LAST`,
                    [cleanWallet]
                );
                workers = res.rows;
            } catch {
                workers = [];
            }
        }
    }

    return json({
        online: Boolean(poolCoinbaseAddress),
        poolCoinbaseAddress,
        tiers: [
            resolveStratumTierEndpoint(0.4),
            resolveStratumTierEndpoint(4.0),
            resolveStratumTierEndpoint(20.0)
        ],
        workers
    });
};

export const POST: RequestHandler = async ({
    request,
    cookies
}: RequestEvent) => {
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    const sessionWallet = sessionId
        ? await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`).catch(() => null)
        : null;
    const isDirector = await hasDirectorClearance(request, sessionWallet);

    if (!sessionWallet && !isDirector) {
        return json(
            {
                error: 'UNAUTHORIZED: Active Sovereign session required to bind Stratum workers.'
            },
            { status: 401 }
        );
    }

    try {
        const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const action = String(body.action || 'BIND_WORKER')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase();

        if (
            action === 'SET_POOL_COINBASE' ||
            action === 'REBIND_COINBASE_WALLET'
        ) {
            if (!isDirector) {
                return json(
                    {
                        error: 'FORBIDDEN: Only the Master Treasury Director may rebind the Stratum pool coinbase address.'
                    },
                    { status: 403 }
                );
            }
            const rawCoinbase = String(
                body.miningAddress || body.coinbaseAddress || body.wallet || ''
            ).trim();
            const prefixedCandidate = normalizeKaspaAddressStrict(rawCoinbase);
            const bech32Check = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(prefixedCandidate);
            if (!bech32Check.valid) {
                return json(
                    {
                        error: `INVALID_KASPA_ADDRESS: ${bech32Check.error || 'Provide a valid Bech32m Kaspa address for the Stratum coinbase wallet.'}`
                    },
                    { status: 400 }
                );
            }
            const prefixedCoinbase = bech32Check.normalized;
            await redis.set(
                'perennia:stratum:mining_address',
                prefixedCoinbase
            );
            await dbPool
                .query(
                    `UPDATE system_treasury_config
                     SET cold_kas_address = $1,
                         updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                     WHERE config_id = 'PRIMARY'`,
                    [prefixedCoinbase]
                )
                .catch(() => {});
            return json({
                success: true,
                action: 'SET_POOL_COINBASE',
                poolCoinbaseAddress: prefixedCoinbase
            });
        }

        const rawWallet = String(
            body.wallet || body.walletAddress || sessionWallet || ''
        ).trim();
        const candidatePrefixed = normalizeKaspaAddressStrict(rawWallet);
        const walletValidation = validateKaspaBech32mAddress(candidatePrefixed);
        if (!walletValidation.valid) {
            return json(
                {
                    error: `INVALID_KASPA_ADDRESS: ${walletValidation.error || 'Valid Kaspa miner payout address is required.'}`
                },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        const prefixedWallet = walletValidation.normalized;
        const cleanWallet = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(prefixedWallet);

        if (
            !isDirector &&
            sessionWallet &&
            cleanWallet !== normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(sessionWallet)
        ) {
            return json(
                {
                    error: 'FORBIDDEN: Cannot bind a Stratum worker to another miner wallet.'
                },
                { status: 403 }
            );
        }

        const rawWorkerName = String(
            body.workerName || body.name || 'Rig01'
        ).trim();
        const sanitizedWorkerName =
            rawWorkerName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '').slice(0, 48) ||
            'Rig01';
        const hardwareModel =
            String(
                body.hardwareModel || body.hardwareType || 'IceRiver KS'
            )
                .trim()
                .slice(0, 80) || 'IceRiver KS';
        const estimatedHashrateTh = Math.max(
            0,
            Number(body.estimatedHashrateTh ?? body.hashRate ?? 0.4)
        );
        const tierSpec = resolveStratumTierEndpoint(estimatedHashrateTh);
        const workerId = `${prefixedWallet}.${sanitizedWorkerName}`;

        await ensureWorkerProfilesSchema();
        await dbPool.query(
            `INSERT INTO worker_profiles (
                 worker_identity,
                 worker_id,
                 wallet_address,
                 worker_name,
                 hardware_model,
                 hashrate_ths,
                 current_hashrate,
                 stratum_port,
                 last_seen,
                 updated_at
             )
             VALUES ($1, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
             ON CONFLICT (worker_identity) DO UPDATE SET
                worker_id = EXCLUDED.worker_id,
                wallet_address = EXCLUDED.wallet_address,
                worker_name = EXCLUDED.worker_name,
                hardware_model = EXCLUDED.hardware_model,
                hashrate_ths = CASE
                    WHEN worker_profiles.hashrate_ths > 0 THEN worker_profiles.hashrate_ths
                    ELSE EXCLUDED.hashrate_ths
                END,
                current_hashrate = CASE
                    WHEN worker_profiles.current_hashrate > 0 THEN worker_profiles.current_hashrate
                    ELSE EXCLUDED.current_hashrate
                END,
                stratum_port = EXCLUDED.stratum_port,
                last_seen = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`,
            [
                workerId,
                prefixedWallet,
                sanitizedWorkerName,
                hardwareModel,
                estimatedHashrateTh,
                estimatedHashrateTh * 1e12,
                tierSpec.externalPort
            ]
        );

        await redis
            .set(
                `stratum:worker:${cleanWallet}.${sanitizedWorkerName.toLowerCase()}`,
                JSON.stringify({
                    workerId,
                    walletAddress: prefixedWallet,
                    workerName: sanitizedWorkerName,
                    hardwareModel,
                    tier: tierSpec.tier,
                    stratumUrl: tierSpec.stratumUrl,
                    boundAt: new Date().toISOString()
                }),
                'EX',
                60 * 60 * 24 * 30
            )
            .catch(() => {});

        return json({
            success: true,
            workerId,
            walletAddress: prefixedWallet,
            workerName: sanitizedWorkerName,
            hardwareModel,
            ...tierSpec
        });
    } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('Stratum Bind Fault:', err);
        return json(
            { error: err?.message || 'Failed to bind Stratum worker.' },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    }
};

import { json, type RequestHandler, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import { dbPool } from '$lib/server/db';
import {
    isWalletMasterAdmin,
    normalizeKaspaBase32Strict,
    normalizeKaspaAddressStrict
} from '$lib/server/kms';

export const GET: RequestHandler = async ({ url, cookies }: RequestEvent) => {
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    if (!sessionId) {
        return json(
            { error: 'UNAUTHORIZED: Active Sovereign session required.' },
            { status: 401 }
        );
    }

    const sessionWallet = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);
    if (!sessionWallet) {
        return json({ error: 'SESSION_EXPIRED' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const requestedWallet = url.searchParams.get('wallet') || sessionWallet;
    const cleanSession = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(sessionWallet);
    const cleanRequested = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(requestedWallet);

    if (!cleanRequested) {
        return json({ error: 'INVALID_WALLET_ADDRESS' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const isDirector = isWalletMasterAdmin(sessionWallet);
    if (cleanRequested !== cleanSession && !isDirector) {
        return json(
            {
                error: 'FORBIDDEN: Cannot inspect batch settlement ledger for another wallet.'
            },
            { status: 403 }
        );
    }

    const prefixedWallet = normalizeKaspaAddressStrict(cleanRequested);
    const userLedgerKey = `dev:sor:treasury:balances:${cleanRequested}`;

    try {
        const [rawRedisBalances, reservoirRes, coldRuleRes] = await Promise.all([
            redis.hgetall(userLedgerKey).catch(() => ({} as Record<string, string>)),
            dbPool
                .query(
                    `SELECT streaming_balance_kas, COALESCE(lp_tokens, '{}'::jsonb) AS lp_tokens
                     FROM yield_reservoirs
                     WHERE wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2
                     ORDER BY streaming_balance_kas DESC
                     LIMIT 1`,
                    [prefixedWallet, cleanRequested]
                )
                .catch(() => ({ rows: [] as any[] })),
            dbPool
                .query(
                    `SELECT overflow_ceiling
                     FROM user_cold_vault_rules
                     WHERE (wallet_address = $1 OR wallet_address = $2)
                       AND asset_ticker = 'KAS'
                     LIMIT 1`,
                    [prefixedWallet, cleanRequested]
                )
                .catch(() => ({ rows: [] as any[] }))
        ]);

        const balances: Record<string, number> = {};
        let redisPrimaryKas = 0;
        let redisUnassignedKas = 0;

        for (const [rawKey, rawVal] of Object.entries(rawRedisBalances || {})) {
            const parsed = parseFloat(String(rawVal || '0'));
            if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed <= 0) continue;

            if (rawKey === 'Unassigned KAS') {
                redisUnassignedKas = parsed;
                continue;
            }

            const ticker = rawKey.trim().toUpperCase();
            if (ticker === 'KAS') {
                redisPrimaryKas += parsed;
            } else {
                balances[ticker] = Number(parsed.toFixed(8));
            }
        }

        let dbStreamingKas = 0;
        if (reservoirRes.rows.length > 0) {
            const row = reservoirRes.rows[0];
            dbStreamingKas = Math.max(0, Number(row.streaming_balance_kas || 0));
            const lpTokens = row.lp_tokens;
            if (lpTokens && typeof lpTokens === 'object') {
                for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(lpTokens)) {
                    const ticker = k.trim().toUpperCase();
                    const amt = Number(v || 0);
                    if (Number.isFinite(amt) && amt > 0) {
                        balances[ticker] = Math.max(
                            balances[ticker] || 0,
                            Number(amt.toFixed(8))
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        const effectiveUnassignedKas = Math.max(
            redisUnassignedKas,
            dbStreamingKas
        );

        if (dbStreamingKas > redisUnassignedKas + 1e-6) {
            await redis
                .hset(
                    userLedgerKey,
                    'Unassigned KAS',
                    dbStreamingKas.toFixed(8)
                )
                .catch(() => {});
        }

        const totalBatchKas = Number(
            (redisPrimaryKas + effectiveUnassignedKas).toFixed(8)
        );
        balances['KAS'] = totalBatchKas;

        const targetReserveCeilingKas = Number(
            coldRuleRes.rows[0]?.overflow_ceiling ?? 500.0
        );

        return json({
            ...balances,
            unassignedReserveKas: Number(effectiveUnassignedKas.toFixed(8)),
            unassignedReserveTargetKas: targetReserveCeilingKas
        });
    } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('User Ledger Hydration Fault:', err);
        return json(
            { error: err?.message || 'Failed to read user settlement ledger.' },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    }
};

import * as bip39 from '@scure/bip39';
import { wordlist } from '@scure/bip39/wordlists/english';
import { HDKey } from '@scure/bip32';
import { ethers } from 'ethers';
import { Keypair as SolKeypair } from '@solana/web3.js';
import { Wallet as XrpWallet } from 'xrpl';
import { Buffer } from 'buffer';

export interface SovereignVaultKeys {
    kaspa: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    bitcoin: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    ethereum: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    solana: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    doge: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    xrp: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    polygon: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    avalanche: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    sui: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    tron: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    zcash: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    arbitrum?: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    base?: { address: string; privateKey: string };
    [chainKey: string]: { address: string; privateKey: string } | undefined;
}

const EVM_COMPATIBLE_NETWORKS = new Set([
    'ETH',
    'ETHEREUM',
    'ARB',
    'ARBITRUM',
    'BASE',
    'POL',
    'POLYGON',
    'MATIC',
    'AVAX',
    'AVALANCHE',
    'BSC',
    'BNB',
    'OP',
    'OPTIMISM',

    'SCROLL',

    'CRONOS',
    'USDC',
    'USDT',

    'AMD',
    'TSM',
    'AVGO',
    'XLE',
    'XAU',

    'USTB'
]);

function hash160(pubKeyBytes: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
    const sha = ethers.getBytes(ethers.sha256(pubKeyBytes));
    return ethers.getBytes(ethers.ripemd160(sha));
}

function encodeBase58Check(prefix: number[], payload: Uint8Array): string {
    const data = new Uint8Array([...prefix, ...payload]);
    const hash1 = ethers.getBytes(ethers.sha256(data));
    const hash2 = ethers.getBytes(ethers.sha256(hash1));
    const finalData = new Uint8Array([...data, ...hash2.slice(0, 4)]);
    return ethers.encodeBase58(finalData);
}

export async function deriveHoneycombKeys(mnemonic: string): Promise<SovereignVaultKeys> {
    if (!bip39.validateMnemonic(mnemonic, wordlist)) {
        throw new Error('Invalid Sovereign seed phrase.');
    }
    const seed = await bip39.mnemonicToSeed(mnemonic);
    const masterHdKey = HDKey.fromMasterSeed(seed);

    const kasKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/111111'/0'/0/0");
    const pubKeyX = Buffer.from(kasKey.publicKey!.slice(1, 33));
    const kaspaAddress = encodeKaspaAddress(pubKeyX);

    const btcKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/0'/0'/0/0");
    const btcHash = hash160(btcKey.publicKey!);
    const btcAddress = encodeBase58Check([0x00], btcHash);

    const ethKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/60'/0'/0/0");
    const ethWallet = new ethers.Wallet(Buffer.from(ethKey.privateKey!).toString('hex'));
    const ethAddress = ethWallet.address;

    const solKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/501'/0'/0'");
    const solKeypair = SolKeypair.fromSeed(solKey.privateKey!.slice(0, 32));
    const solAddress = solKeypair.publicKey.toBase58();

    const dogeKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/3'/0'/0/0");
    const dogeHash = hash160(dogeKey.publicKey!);
    const dogeAddress = encodeBase58Check([0x1e], dogeHash);

    const xrpKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/144'/0'/0/0");
    const xrpWallet = new XrpWallet(
        Buffer.from(xrpKey.publicKey!).toString('hex').toUpperCase(),
        Buffer.from(xrpKey.privateKey!).toString('hex').toUpperCase()
    );
    const xrpAddress = xrpWallet.classicAddress;

    const polygonAddress = ethAddress;
    const avalancheAddress = ethAddress;

    const suiKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/784'/0'/0'/0'");
    const suiPayload = new Uint8Array([0x00, ...suiKey.publicKey!]);
    const suiAddress = ethers.sha256(suiPayload).slice(0, 42);

    const trxKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/195'/0'/0/0");
    const trxWallet = new ethers.Wallet(Buffer.from(trxKey.privateKey!).toString('hex'));
    const evmAddressBuffer = ethers.getBytes(trxWallet.address);
    const tronAddress = encodeBase58Check([0x41], evmAddressBuffer);

    const zecKey = masterHdKey.derive("m/44'/133'/0'/0/0");
    const zecHash = hash160(zecKey.publicKey!);
    const zcashAddress = encodeBase58Check([0x1c, 0xb8], zecHash);

    return {
        kaspa: { address: kaspaAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(kasKey.privateKey!).toString('hex') },
        bitcoin: { address: btcAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(btcKey.privateKey!).toString('hex') },
        ethereum: { address: ethAddress, privateKey: ethWallet.privateKey },
        solana: { address: solAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(solKeypair.secretKey).toString('hex') },
        doge: { address: dogeAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(dogeKey.privateKey!).toString('hex') },
        xrp: { address: xrpAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(xrpKey.privateKey!).toString('hex') },
        polygon: { address: polygonAddress, privateKey: ethWallet.privateKey },
        avalanche: { address: avalancheAddress, privateKey: ethWallet.privateKey },
        sui: { address: suiAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(suiKey.privateKey!).toString('hex') },
        tron: { address: tronAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(trxKey.privateKey!).toString('hex') },
        zcash: { address: zcashAddress, privateKey: Buffer.from(zecKey.privateKey!).toString('hex') },
        arbitrum: { address: ethAddress, privateKey: ethWallet.privateKey },
        base: { address: ethAddress, privateKey: ethWallet.privateKey }
    };
}

export function resolveSovereignAddressForChain(
    chainOrTicker: string,
    wallets: Record<string, any> | null | undefined,
    fallbackKaspaAddress?: string | null
): string {
    const clean = String(chainOrTicker || 'KAS').trim().toUpperCase();
    const lower = clean.toLowerCase();

    if (wallets && wallets[lower]?.address) {
        return wallets[lower].address;
    }

    if (clean === 'KAS' || clean === 'KASPA' || clean === 'SILO' || clean === 'NACHO' || clean === 'BEDRCK' || clean === 'PERX') {
        return wallets?.kaspa?.address || fallbackKaspaAddress || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (clean === 'BTC' || clean === 'BITCOIN') {
        return wallets?.bitcoin?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (EVM_COMPATIBLE_NETWORKS.has(clean)) {
        return wallets?.ethereum?.address || wallets?.polygon?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (clean === 'SOL' || clean === 'SOLANA') {
        return wallets?.solana?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (clean === 'DOGE' || clean === 'DOGECOIN') {
        return wallets?.doge?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (clean === 'XRP' || clean === 'RIPPLE') {
        return wallets?.xrp?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (clean === 'SUI') {
        return wallets?.sui?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (clean === 'TRX' || clean === 'TRON') {
        return wallets?.tron?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }
    if (clean === 'ZEC' || clean === 'ZCASH') {
        return wallets?.zcash?.address || 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }

    const seedAnchor =
        wallets?.kaspa?.address ||
        wallets?.ethereum?.address ||
        fallbackKaspaAddress ||
        '';
    if (!seedAnchor || seedAnchor.includes('Awaiting')) {
        return 'Awaiting Decryption';
    }

    const digestHex = ethers.sha256(
        new TextEncoder().encode(`PERENNIA_SOVEREIGN_DERIVATION:${clean}:${seedAnchor}`)
    );
    const digestBytes = ethers.getBytes(digestHex);

    if (clean === 'LTC' || clean === 'LITECOIN') {
        return encodeBase58Check([0x30], digestBytes.slice(0, 20));
    }
    if (clean === 'TON') {
        return `UQ${ethers.encodeBase58(digestBytes).slice(0, 46)}`;
    }
    if (clean === 'ADA' || clean === 'CARDANO') {
        return `addr1q${digestHex.slice(2, 56)}`;
    }
    if (clean === 'APT' || clean === 'APTOS') {
        return digestHex;
    }

    if (wallets?.ethereum?.address) {
        return wallets.ethereum.address;
    }
    return `0x${digestHex.slice(2, 42)}`;
}

function encodeKaspaAddress(pubKeyX: Buffer): string {
    const KASPA_ALPHABET = 'qpzry9x8gf2tvdw0s3jn54khce6mua7l';
    const polymod = (values: number[]) => {
        let c = 1n;
        for (const v of values) {
            const c0 = c >> 35n;
            c = ((c & 0x07ffffffffn) << 5n) ^ BigInt(v);
            if (c0 & 1n) c ^= 0x98f2bc8e61n;
            if (c0 & 2n) c ^= 0x79b76d99e2n;
            if (c0 & 4n) c ^= 0xf33e5fb3c4n;
            if (c0 & 8n) c ^= 0xae2eabe2a8n;
            if (c0 & 16n) c ^= 0x1e4f43e470n;
        }
        return c ^ 1n;
    };
    const prefix = 'kaspa';
    const prefixValues = prefix
        .split('')
        .map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0) & 31)
        .concat([0]);
    const payload = [0, ...pubKeyX];
    let acc = 0,
        bits = 0;
    const payload5: number[] = [];
    for (const byte of payload) {
        acc = (acc << 8) | byte;
        bits += 8;
        while (bits >= 5) {
            bits -= 5;
            payload5.push((acc >> bits) & 31);
        }
    }
    if (bits > 0) payload5.push((acc << (5 - bits)) & 31);
    const mod = polymod([...prefixValues, ...payload5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
    const checksum = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((i) =>
        Number((mod >> BigInt(5 * (7 - i))) & 31n)
    );
    return prefix + ':' + [...payload5, ...checksum].map((v) => KASPA_ALPHABET[v]).join('');
}

class TransactionEngineState {

    address = $state('');
    isBroadcasting = $state(false);

            : 'hidden';
