import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
import { treasury } from '$lib/stores/treasury.svelte';
import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
export const MASTER_ADMIN_ADDRESS =
    'kaspa:qpra8t9ul8hd7n9pvw4td6ax3unlf2vyc2fz5t9p9yalhsnk7qkaknp24lpm7';
export const walletState = $state({
    address: '',
    devAdminBypass: false
});
export function getIsCorporateAdmin(): boolean {
    return Boolean(identity.isCorporateAdmin);
}
export interface UniversalL1SigningRequest {
    intentType: 'DEX_SWAP' | 'FIAT_OFFRAMP' | 'L1_TRANSFER';
    payAsset: string;
    network?: string;
    contractAddress?: string;
    decimals?: number;
    payAmount: number | string;
    destinationAddress: string;
    receiveAsset?: string;
    estimatedReceiveAmount?: number | string;
    fiatAmountUsd?: number | string;
    payoutMethod?: 'ach' | 'wire' | 'ACH' | 'WIRE';
    bankLabel?: string;
    accountType?: 'CHECKING' | 'SAVINGS';
    routingNumber?: string;
    accountNumber?: string;
    externalCostBasisUsd?: number;
    orderId?: string;
    psbtData?: any;
}
export function resolveSigningMetadataForAsset(
    rawTicker: string,
    explicitNetwork?: string,
    explicitContract?: string
): {
    ticker: string;
    cleanTicker: string;
    network: string;
    contractAddress?: string;
    decimals: number;
    isNativeKas: boolean;
    actionType: 'SEND_KAS' | 'SEND_KRC20' | 'SEND_L1';
} {
    const cleanTicker = String(rawTicker || 'KAS')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const assetObj = treasury.getAsset(cleanTicker);
    const network = String(
        explicitNetwork || assetObj.network || cleanTicker
    )
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();
    const contractAddress = explicitContract || assetObj.contract;
    const decimals =
        cleanTicker === 'USDC' || cleanTicker === 'USDT'
            ? 6
            : cleanTicker === 'KAS' ||
                cleanTicker === 'BTC' ||
                cleanTicker === 'DOGE' ||
                cleanTicker === 'ZEC' ||
                network === 'KAS'
              ? 8
              : cleanTicker === 'SOL' || cleanTicker === 'SUI'
                ? 9
                : cleanTicker === 'XRP' || cleanTicker === 'TRX'
                  ? 6
                  : 18;
    const actionType: 'SEND_KAS' | 'SEND_KRC20' | 'SEND_L1' =
        cleanTicker === 'KAS'
            ? 'SEND_KAS'
            : network === 'KAS' && cleanTicker !== 'KAS'
              ? 'SEND_KRC20'
              : 'SEND_L1';
    return {
        ticker: cleanTicker,
        cleanTicker,
        network,
        contractAddress,
        decimals,
        isNativeKas: cleanTicker === 'KAS',
        actionType
    };
}
export function requestUniversalL1Signature(
    req: UniversalL1SigningRequest
): void {
    const meta = resolveSigningMetadataForAsset(
        req.payAsset,
        req.network,
        req.contractAddress
    );
    if (req.intentType === 'FIAT_OFFRAMP') {
        identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
            actionType: 'FIAT_OFFRAMP',
            l1SignSubType: meta.actionType,
            payAsset: meta.cleanTicker,
            network: meta.network,
            contractAddress: meta.contractAddress,
            decimals: req.decimals ?? meta.decimals,
            payAmount: String(req.payAmount),
            destinationAddress: req.destinationAddress,
            fiatAmount:
                req.fiatAmountUsd !== undefined
                    ? String(req.fiatAmountUsd)
                    : undefined,
            sourceMode:
                meta.cleanTicker === 'KAS'
                    ? 'onchain_kas'
                    : 'direct_wholesale_deposit',
            payoutMethod: (req.payoutMethod || 'ach').toLowerCase(),
            bankLabel: req.bankLabel || 'Primary Operating Account',
            accountType: req.accountType || 'CHECKING',
            routingNumber: req.routingNumber,
            accountNumber: req.accountNumber,
            externalCostBasisUsd: req.externalCostBasisUsd,
            orderId: req.orderId
        });
        return;
    }
    if (req.intentType === 'DEX_SWAP') {
        const hasKaspaPsbt = Boolean(
            req.psbtData?.psbt &&
                Array.isArray(req.psbtData.psbt.inputs) &&
                req.psbtData.psbt.inputs.length > 0
        );
        identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
            actionType: hasKaspaPsbt ? 'SWAP' : meta.actionType,
            swapContext: {
                isDexSwap: true,
                payAsset: meta.cleanTicker,
                payAmount: Number(req.payAmount),
                receiveAsset: req.receiveAsset || 'USDC',
                estimatedReceiveAmount: Number(
                    req.estimatedReceiveAmount || 0
                ),
                orderId: req.orderId
            },
            payAsset: meta.cleanTicker,
            receiveAsset: req.receiveAsset,
            network: meta.network,
            contractAddress: meta.contractAddress,
            decimals: req.decimals ?? meta.decimals,
            payAmount: String(req.payAmount),
            destinationAddress: req.destinationAddress,
            psbtData: req.psbtData
        });
        return;
    }
    identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
        actionType: meta.actionType,
        payAsset: meta.cleanTicker,
        network: meta.network,
        contractAddress: meta.contractAddress,
        decimals: req.decimals ?? meta.decimals,
        payAmount: String(req.payAmount),
        destinationAddress: req.destinationAddress
    });
    ui.showWalletModal = true;
}

<script lang="ts">
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';

    let { enterNexus = undefined }: { enterNexus?: () => void } = $props();

    function handleEnter() {
        ui.hasEntered = true;
        if (typeof enterNexus === 'function') {
            enterNexus();
        }
        if (typeof (ui as any).enterNexus === 'function') {
            (ui as any).enterNexus();
        }
        ui.activeTab = 'OPERATIONS';
        ui.showWalletModal = true;
    }

    function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && !ui.hasEntered) {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleEnter();
        }
    }
</script>

import { json, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { createRequire } from 'module';
import { env } from '$env/dynamic/private';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import { dbPool } from '$lib/server/db';

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const WebSocket = require('ws');

const LUA_PROMOTE_PENDING_SWAP = `
local order = redis.call('GET', KEYS[1])
if order then
    redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])
    redis.call('RPUSH', KEYS[2], order)
    return order
end
return nil
`;

function normalizeKaspaBase32(addr: string): string {
    return addr.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^kaspa:/i, '').trim();
}

function sanitizeTransactionForRest(rawTx: any) {
    const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rawTx));
    const inputs = (cloned.inputs || []).map((inp: any) => ({
        previousOutpoint: {
            transactionId: inp.previousOutpoint?.transactionId || inp.transactionId,
            index: Number(inp.previousOutpoint?.index ?? inp.index ?? 0)
        },
        signatureScript: inp.signatureScript || '',
        sequence: Number(inp.sequence ?? 0),
        sigOpCount: Number(inp.sigOpCount ?? 1)
    }));
    const outputs = (cloned.outputs || []).map((out: any) => {
        const rawSpk =
            typeof out.scriptPublicKey === 'string'
                ? out.scriptPublicKey
                : out.scriptPublicKey?.scriptPublicKey || '';
        const spkVersion =
            typeof out.scriptPublicKey === 'object' && out.scriptPublicKey !== null
                ? Number(out.scriptPublicKey.version ?? 0)
                : 0;
        return {
            amount: Number(out.amount ?? out.value ?? 0),
            scriptPublicKey: {
                version: spkVersion,
                scriptPublicKey: rawSpk
            }
        };
    });
    return {
        transaction: {
            version: Number(cloned.version ?? 0),
            inputs,
            outputs,
            lockTime: Number(cloned.lockTime ?? 0),
            subnetworkId:
                cloned.subnetworkId || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000',
            gas: Number(cloned.gas ?? 0),
            payload: cloned.payload || ''
        }
    };
}

function sanitizeTransactionForWrpc(rawTx: any) {
    const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rawTx));
    if (Array.isArray(cloned.outputs)) {
        for (const output of cloned.outputs) {
            delete output._metadata;
        }
    }
    return cloned;
}

async function broadcastViaLocalRustNode(
    tx: any,
    rustBackendUrl: string
): Promise<string> {
    const sanitized = sanitizeTransactionForRest(tx);
    const endpoint = `${rustBackendUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/v1/broadcast`;
    const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(sanitized),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000)
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text().catch(() => '');
        throw new Error(
            `Local Rust gRPC broadcast rejected (${res.status}): ${errText}`
        );
    }
    const data = await res.json();
    const txId = data.transactionId || data.id;
    if (!txId) {
        throw new Error('Local Rust gRPC node returned no transactionId');
    }
    return String(txId);
}

async function broadcastViaWrpc(tx: any, wrpcUrl: string): Promise<string> {
    const cleanTx = sanitizeTransactionForWrpc(tx);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        let isResolved = false;
        const ws = new WebSocket(wrpcUrl);
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            if (isResolved) return;
            isResolved = true;
            ws.terminate();
            reject(new Error('wRPC connection timed out'));
        }, 5000);
        ws.on('open', () => {
            const rpcPayload = {
                id: 2,
                method: 'submitTransaction',
                params: { transaction: cleanTx, allowOrphan: false }
            };
            ws.send(JSON.stringify(rpcPayload));
        });
        ws.on('message', (data: any) => {
            if (isResolved) return;
            isResolved = true;
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            ws.terminate();
            try {
                const response = JSON.parse(data.toString());
                if (response.error) {
                    reject(new Error(response.error.message || 'wRPC rejected transaction'));
                    return;
                }
                const txId = response.params?.transactionId || response.transactionId;
                if (!txId) {
                    reject(new Error('wRPC returned no transactionId'));
                    return;
                }
                resolve(String(txId));
            } catch (err: any) {
                reject(new Error(`Failed to parse wRPC response: ${err.message}`));
            }
        });
        ws.on('close', (code: number) => {
            if (isResolved) return;
            isResolved = true;
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(new Error(`Node closed wRPC socket with code ${code}`));
        });
        ws.on('error', (err: Error) => {
            if (isResolved) return;
            isResolved = true;
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(err);
        });
    });
}

async function broadcastViaRest(tx: any, restBaseUrl: string): Promise<string> {
    const restPayload = sanitizeTransactionForRest(tx);
    const endpoint = `${restBaseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/transactions`;
    const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(restPayload),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000)
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
        const errText = await res.text();
        throw new Error(`Kaspa REST node rejected payload (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
    }
    const data = await res.json();
    const txId = data.transactionId || data.id;
    if (!txId) {
        throw new Error('Kaspa REST node returned no transactionId');
    }
    return String(txId);
}

async function finalizeBroadcastAccounting(
    sessionWallet: string,
    transactionId: string,
    fallbackOutputKas: number
): Promise<{ promotedSwap: boolean; swapOrder: any | null }> {
    const cleanWallet = normalizeKaspaBase32(sessionWallet);
    const prefixedWallet = `kaspa:${cleanWallet}`;
    const pendingSwapKey = `perennia:pending_swap:${cleanWallet}`;
    let promotedSwap = false;
    let swapOrder: any | null = null;
    try {
        const promotedRaw = await redis.eval(
            LUA_PROMOTE_PENDING_SWAP,
            2,
            pendingSwapKey,
            'perennia:sor:netting_queue'
        );
        if (promotedRaw && typeof promotedRaw === 'string') {
            promotedSwap = true;
            try {
                swapOrder = JSON.parse(promotedRaw);
            } catch {
                swapOrder = null;
            }
            console.log(
                `🟢 [Sovereign Broadcast Hook] Promoted pending swap for ${prefixedWallet} (TX: ${transactionId}) into Liquidity Pool netting queue.`
            );
        }
    } catch (redisErr) {
        console.error('Failed to promote pending swap in Redis:', redisErr);
    }
    const amountKas =
        swapOrder && typeof swapOrder.amount_kas === 'number' && swapOrder.amount_kas > 0
            ? swapOrder.amount_kas
            : fallbackOutputKas;
    const actionType = promotedSwap ? 'SOVEREIGN_SWAP' : 'SOVEREIGN_TRANSFER';
    let client;
    try {
        client = await dbPool.connect();
        await client.query(
            `INSERT INTO pending_transactions (tx_id, wallet_address, amount_kas, action_type, status)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'PENDING')
             ON CONFLICT (tx_id) DO NOTHING`,
            [transactionId, prefixedWallet, amountKas, actionType]
        );
        if (promotedSwap && swapOrder) {
            const targetAsset = String(swapOrder.target_asset || 'USDC').toUpperCase();
            const estimatedOutput = Number(swapOrder.estimated_output || 0);
            const spotPrice = Number(swapOrder.spot_price || 0);
            const grossUsd =
                targetAsset === 'USDC' || targetAsset === 'USDT' || targetAsset === 'USD'
                    ? estimatedOutput
                    : amountKas * spotPrice;
            if (grossUsd > 0 && estimatedOutput > 0) {
                await client.query(
                    `INSERT INTO tax_ledger_events
                     (wallet_address, asset_ticker, event_type, gross_proceeds_usd, amount_tokens, spot_price_at_execution)
                     VALUES ($1, $2, 'DEX_SWAP', $3, $4, $5)`,
                    [cleanWallet, targetAsset, grossUsd, estimatedOutput, spotPrice]
                );
            }
        }
    } catch (dbErr) {
        console.error('Failed to log transaction in PostgreSQL:', dbErr);
    } finally {
        if (client) client.release();
    }
    return { promotedSwap, swapOrder };
}

export async function POST({ request, cookies }: RequestEvent) {
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    if (!sessionId) {
        return json({ error: 'UNAUTHORIZED_BROADCAST_ATTEMPT' }, { status: 401 });
    }
    const sessionWallet = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);
    if (!sessionWallet) {
        return json({ error: 'SESSION_EXPIRED' }, { status: 401 });
    }
    let payload: any;
    try {
        const rawBody = await request.json();
        payload = typeof rawBody === 'string' ? JSON.parse(rawBody) : rawBody;
    } catch {
        return json({ error: 'INVALID_PAYLOAD_FORMAT' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    let tx = payload?.transaction || payload;
    if (typeof tx === 'string') {
        try {
            tx = JSON.parse(tx);
        } catch {
            return json({ error: 'MALFORMED_TRANSACTION_JSON_STRING' }, { status: 400 });
        }
    }
    if (!tx || !Array.isArray(tx.inputs) || !Array.isArray(tx.outputs)) {
        return json({ error: 'MALFORMED_TRANSACTION_PAYLOAD' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const rustBackendUrl =
        env.RUST_BACKEND_URL || `http://${env.UBUNTU_NODE_IP || '127.0.0.1'}:8002`;
    const kaspaRestUrl = env.KASPA_REST_URL || 'https://api.kaspa.org';
    const wrpcUrl =
        env.KASPA_WRPC_URL ||
        (env.KASPA_NODE_IP ? `ws://${env.KASPA_NODE_IP}:18110` : '');

    let transactionId = '';
    let lastError = '';

    try {
        transactionId = await broadcastViaLocalRustNode(tx, rustBackendUrl);
    } catch (grpcErr: any) {
        lastError = grpcErr.message || 'Local Rust gRPC broadcast failed';
        console.warn(
            `⚠️ [Perennia Proxy] Local Rust gRPC broadcast failed (${lastError}). Checking local wRPC / REST fallback...`
        );
        if (wrpcUrl) {
            try {
                transactionId = await broadcastViaWrpc(tx, wrpcUrl);
            } catch (wrpcErr: any) {
                lastError = `${lastError} | wRPC: ${wrpcErr.message}`;
            }
        }
        if (!transactionId) {
            try {
                transactionId = await broadcastViaRest(tx, kaspaRestUrl);
            } catch (restErr: any) {
                lastError = `${lastError} | REST: ${restErr.message}`;
            }
        }
    }

    if (!transactionId) {
        console.error(
            '❌ [Perennia Proxy] Broadcast failed across all transports:',
            lastError
        );
        return json(
            { error: lastError || 'Node rejected transaction broadcast' },
            { status: 422 }
        );
    }

    const outputAmountSompi = Number(
        tx.outputs[0]?.amount ?? tx.outputs[0]?.value ?? 0
    );
    const outputAmountKas = outputAmountSompi / 1e8;
    const { promotedSwap } = await finalizeBroadcastAccounting(
        sessionWallet,
        transactionId,
        outputAmountKas
    );
    return json(
        {
            success: true,
            transactionId,
            promotedSwap
        },
        { status: 200 }
    );
}

import { json, type RequestHandler, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import { env } from '$env/dynamic/private';
import {
    isWalletMasterAdmin,
    normalizeKaspaAddressStrict,
    normalizeKaspaBase32Strict
} from '$lib/server/kms';

export const GET: RequestHandler = async ({ url, cookies }: RequestEvent) => {
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    const sessionWallet = sessionId
        ? await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`).catch(() => null)
        : null;

    const requestedAddr = url.searchParams.get('address') || sessionWallet || '';
    const cleanRequested = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(requestedAddr);

    if (!cleanRequested || cleanRequested.length < 55) {
        return json(
            {
                error: 'INVALID_KASPA_ADDRESS: A valid Kaspa Bech32m address is required to query UTXOs.'
            },
            { status: 400 }
        );
    }

    if (sessionWallet) {
        const cleanSession = normalizeKaspaBase32Strict(sessionWallet);
        const isDirector = isWalletMasterAdmin(sessionWallet);
        if (cleanRequested !== cleanSession && !isDirector) {
            return json(
                {
                    error: 'FORBIDDEN: Cannot query UTXO set for an unassociated wallet.'
                },
                { status: 403 }
            );
        }
    }

    const formattedAddress = normalizeKaspaAddressStrict(cleanRequested);
    const rustBackendUrl =
        env.RUST_BACKEND_URL ||
        `http://${env.UBUNTU_NODE_IP || '127.0.0.1'}:8002`;

    try {
        const rustRes = await fetch(
            `${rustBackendUrl}/v1/utxos?address=${encodeURIComponent(formattedAddress)}`,
            {
                headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4500)
            }
        );

        if (rustRes.ok) {
            const rustData = await rustRes.json();
            const entries = Array.isArray(rustData)
                ? rustData
                : Array.isArray(rustData?.entries)
                  ? rustData.entries
                  : [];
            return json(entries);
        }
    } catch {
        // Fall through to configured Kaspa REST indexer
    }

    const kaspaRestUrl = (env.KASPA_REST_URL || 'https://api.kaspa.org').replace(
        /\/+$/,
        ''
    );

    try {
        const restRes = await fetch(
            `${kaspaRestUrl}/addresses/${encodeURIComponent(formattedAddress)}/utxos`,
            {
                headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
                signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000)
            }
        );

        if (!restRes.ok) {
            const errText = await restRes.text().catch(() => '');
            return json(
                {
                    error: `UTXO_INDEXER_REJECTED (${restRes.status}): ${errText || 'Upstream Kaspa indexer rejected UTXO query.'}`
                },
                { status: 503 }
            );
        }

        const restData = await restRes.json();
        const entries = Array.isArray(restData)
            ? restData
            : Array.isArray(restData?.entries)
              ? restData.entries
              : [];

        return json(entries);
    } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('UTXO Lookup Fault:', err);
        return json(
            {
                error:
                    err?.message ||
                    'UTXO_INDEXER_OFFLINE: Both local kaspad gRPC and upstream Kaspa REST indexer are unreachable.'
            },
            { status: 503 }
        );
    }
};

File: src/hooks.server.ts

import { json, type Handle } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { chronos } from '$lib/server/chronos';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import { env } from '$env/dynamic/private';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';

const globalNode = globalThis as unknown as { __chronosStarted: boolean };
if (!globalNode.__chronosStarted) {
    try {
        console.log('⚙️ SvelteKit Enterprise Server Bootstrapping...');
        chronos.start();
        globalNode.__chronosStarted = true;
    } catch (bootErr) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Chronos bootstrap notice:', bootErr);
    }
}

const TRUSTED_ORIGINS = new Set([
    'https://perennia.io',
    'https://www.perennia.io',
    'https://pool.perennia.io',
    'http://localhost:3000',
    'http://127.0.0.1:3000',
    'http://localhost:5173',
    'http://localhost:4173',
    'http://127.0.0.1:5173',
    'http://127.0.0.1:4173'
]);

const PUBLIC_API_PREFIXES = [
    '/api/auth/invite/verify',
    '/api/auth/verify',
    '/api/auth/challenge',
    '/api/auth/me',
    '/api/auth',
    '/api/health',
    '/api/webhooks',
    '/api/prices',
    '/api/telemetry'
];

const WEBHOOK_BYPASS_PREFIXES = [
    '/api/webhooks/stripe',
    '/api/webhooks/transak'
];

function resolveAllowedOrigin(
    requestOrigin: string | null,
    currentOrigin: string
): string {
    if (!requestOrigin) {
        return currentOrigin || 'https://perennia.io';
    }
    const clean = requestOrigin.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (
        clean === currentOrigin ||
        TRUSTED_ORIGINS.has(clean) ||
        /^https?:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|192\.168\.\d+\.\d+)(:\d+)?$/i.test(
            clean
        )
    ) {
        return clean;
    }
    return 'https://perennia.io';
}

function isOriginTrustedForCsrf(
    requestOrigin: string | null,
    currentOrigin: string
): boolean {
    if (!requestOrigin) return true;
    const clean = requestOrigin.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return (
        clean === currentOrigin ||
        TRUSTED_ORIGINS.has(clean) ||
        /^https?:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|192\.168\.\d+\.\d+)(:\d+)?$/i.test(
            clean
        )
    );
}

function isPublicApiRoute(pathname: string): boolean {
    return PUBLIC_API_PREFIXES.some(
        (prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`)
    );
}

function isWebhookRoute(pathname: string): boolean {
    return WEBHOOK_BYPASS_PREFIXES.some(
        (prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`)
    );
}

function hasValidInternalBearerToken(authHeader: string | null): boolean {
    if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) return false;
    const candidates = [
        env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN
            ? `Bearer ${env.INTERNAL_ADMIN_TOKEN.trim()}`
            : '',
        env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY ? `Bearer ${env.PERENNIA_ADMIN_KEY.trim()}` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return false;
    const providedBuf = Buffer.from(authHeader);
    return candidates.some((expected) => {
        const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected);
        return (
            expectedBuf.length === providedBuf.length &&
            crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, providedBuf)
        );
    });
}

function resolveClientIp(event: Parameters<Handle>[0]['event']): string {
    const forwarded = event.request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for');
    if (forwarded) {
        const first = forwarded.split(',')[0]?.trim();
        if (first) return first;
    }
    const realIp = event.request.headers.get('x-real-ip')?.trim();
    if (realIp) return realIp;
    try {
        return event.getClientAddress() || '127.0.0.1';
    } catch {
        return '127.0.0.1';
    }
}

export const handle: Handle = async ({ event, resolve }) => {
    event.locals.redis = redis;
    const requestOrigin = event.request.headers.get('origin');
    const allowedOrigin = resolveAllowedOrigin(
        requestOrigin,
        event.url.origin
    );
    const pathname = event.url.pathname;

    if (pathname.startsWith('/api') && event.request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        return new Response(null, {
            status: 204,
            headers: {
                'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': allowedOrigin,
                'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS',
                'Access-Control-Allow-Headers':
                    'Content-Type, Authorization, Stripe-Signature, X-Webhook-Signature, X-Bridge-Signature, X-Perennia-Sandbox',
                'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials': 'true',
                Vary: 'Origin'
            }
        });
    }

    const isMutatingMethod =
        event.request.method === 'POST' ||
        event.request.method === 'PUT' ||
        event.request.method === 'PATCH' ||
        event.request.method === 'DELETE';

    if (
        pathname.startsWith('/api') &&
        isMutatingMethod &&
        !isWebhookRoute(pathname) &&
        requestOrigin &&
        !isOriginTrustedForCsrf(requestOrigin, event.url.origin)
    ) {
        return json(
            {
                error: 'CSRF_ORIGIN_REJECTED',
                message: `Origin ${requestOrigin} is not authorized for https://perennia.io API mutations.`
            },
            { status: 403 }
        );
    }

    const clientIp = resolveClientIp(event);
    if (pathname.startsWith('/api') && !isWebhookRoute(pathname)) {
        try {
            const isIpBlacklisted = await redis.sismember(
                'perennia:firewall:blacklisted_ips',
                clientIp
            );
            if (isIpBlacklisted === 1) {
                return json(
                    {
                        error: 'FIREWALL_BLACKLISTED_IP',
                        message:
                            'Access denied by Perennia Security Firewall: IP address is blacklisted.'
                    },
                    { status: 403 }
                );
            }
        } catch {
            // Continue if Redis check fails transiently
        }
    }

    const sessionId = event.cookies.get('perennia_session');
    const inviteToken = event.cookies.get('perennia_beta_invite');
    const authHeader = event.request.headers.get('authorization');
    let isAuthorized = hasValidInternalBearerToken(authHeader);

    if (sessionId) {
        const sessionWallet = await redis
            .get(`session:${sessionId}`)
            .catch(() => null);
        if (sessionWallet) {
            const cleanWallet = sessionWallet
                .trim()
                .toLowerCase()
                .replace(/^kaspa:/i, '');
            const prefixedWallet = `kaspa:${cleanWallet}`;
            try {
                const [blkClean, blkPrefixed] = await Promise.all([
                    redis.sismember(
                        'perennia:firewall:blacklisted_wallets',
                        cleanWallet
                    ),
                    redis.sismember(
                        'perennia:firewall:blacklisted_wallets',
                        prefixedWallet
                    )
                ]);
                if (blkClean === 1 || blkPrefixed === 1) {
                    return json(
                        {
                            error: 'FIREWALL_BLACKLISTED_WALLET',
                            message:
                                'Access denied by Perennia Security Firewall: Wallet address is blacklisted.'
                        },
                        { status: 403 }
                    );
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore transient Redis error
            }
            event.locals.walletAddress = sessionWallet;
            (event.locals as any).user = { address: sessionWallet };
            isAuthorized = true;
        }
    }

    if (!isAuthorized && inviteToken) {
        const validInvite = await redis
            .get(`beta_invite:${inviteToken}`)
            .catch(() => null);
        if (validInvite) {
            isAuthorized = true;
        }
    }

    const enforceStrictApiGate =
        String(env.ENFORCE_BETA_INVITE_GATE || '').toLowerCase() === 'true';

    if (
        enforceStrictApiGate &&
        pathname.startsWith('/api') &&
        !isPublicApiRoute(pathname) &&
        !isAuthorized
    ) {
        return json(
            {
                error: 'BETA_INVITE_REQUIRED',
                message:
                    'Valid beta invite code or authenticated Sovereign Vault session required.'
            },
            {
                status: 403,
                headers: {
                    'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': allowedOrigin,
                    'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials': 'true',
                    Vary: 'Origin'
                }
            }
        );
    }

    const response = await resolve(event);
    try {
        if (pathname.startsWith('/api')) {
            response.headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', allowedOrigin);
            response.headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
            response.headers.set('Vary', 'Origin');
        }
        response.headers.set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
        response.headers.set('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
        response.headers.set(
            'Referrer-Policy',
            'strict-origin-when-cross-origin'
        );
        if (
            event.url.protocol === 'https:' ||
            process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
        ) {
            response.headers.set(
                'Strict-Transport-Security',
                'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'
            );
        }
    } catch {
        // Ignore immutable headers on static/redirect responses
    }
    return response;
};

File: src/lib/views/ForgeView.svelte

<script lang="ts">
    import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
    import { fade } from 'svelte/transition';
    import { identity } from '$lib/stores/identity.svelte';
    import { treasury } from '$lib/stores/treasury.svelte';
    import { ui } from '$lib/stores/ui.svelte';
    import {
        txState,
        resolveKasplexProtocolInfo,
        computePayloadHash,
        getChainExplorerTxUrl,
        type KasplexProtocolInfo,
        type CapTableFanoutReceipt,
        type ForgeTokenStandard
    } from '$lib/stores/transaction.svelte';
    import ForgeTokenomicsDeployer from '$lib/components/forge/ForgeTokenomicsDeployer.svelte';
    import ForgeCapTableInspector from '$lib/components/forge/ForgeCapTableInspector.svelte';

    type ForgeMode = 'krc20_deploy' | 'krc20_mint';
    let activeMode = $state<ForgeMode>('krc20_deploy');

    let kasplexInfo = $state<KasplexProtocolInfo>({
        online: true,
        feeAddress: '',
        opFeeDeploySompi: 100_000_000_000n,
        opFeeMintSompi: 100_000_000n,
        opFeeDeployKas: 1000,
        opFeeMintKas: 1
    });

    // Shared Execution & Receipt State
    let isForging = $state(false);
    let awaitingVaultSignature = $state(false);
    let forgeSuccess = $state(false);
    let forgeError = $state('');
    let forgeStatusMessage = $state('');
    let confirmedTxId = $state('');
    let confirmedExplorerUrl = $state('');
    let confirmedFanoutReceipts = $state<CapTableFanoutReceipt[]>([]);
    let pendingInspectorTicker = $state('NACHO');
    let pendingInspectorToken = $state<any | null>(null);
    let pendingTokenomicsRegistration = $state<any | null>(null);

    let lastExecutedSummary = $state<{
        mode: ForgeMode;
        tokenStandard: ForgeTokenStandard;
        title: string;
        subtitle: string;
        tickerOrId: string;
        envelopeJson: string;
        payloadHex: string;
        payloadBlake2bHex: string;
        charterSha256?: string;
        preAllocation?: number;
        mintHumanQty?: number;
    } | null>(null);

    let pollInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

    function bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
        return Array.from(bytes)
            .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join('');
    }

    function encodeUtf8ToHex(str: string): string {
        return bytesToHex(new TextEncoder().encode(str));
    }

    function formatTokenBaseUnits(humanAmount: number, decimals: number): string {
        const cleanAmount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(humanAmount) || 0));
        const clampedDec = Math.max(0, Math.min(18, Math.floor(Number(decimals) || 0)));
        const multiplier = 10n ** BigInt(clampedDec);
        return (BigInt(cleanAmount) * multiplier).toString();
    }

    function parseKasplexUnits(rawStr: string | number | undefined, dec = 8): number {
        if (rawStr === undefined || rawStr === null) return 0;
        const n = Number(rawStr);
        if (isNaN(n) || n <= 0) return 0;
        return n / Math.pow(10, dec);
    }

    async function fetchWalletUtxosForEnvelope() {
        if (!identity.isWalletConnected || !identity.activeAddress) {
            ui.showWalletModal = true;
            throw new Error('Connect and unlock your Sovereign Vault to sign L1 envelopes.');
        }
        const utxoRes = await fetch(
            `/api/utxos?address=${encodeURIComponent(identity.activeAddress)}`
        );
        if (!utxoRes.ok) {
            throw new Error('Failed to fetch Kaspa L1 UTXOs for inscription envelope.');
        }
        const utxoData = await utxoRes.json();
        const entries = Array.isArray(utxoData) ? utxoData : utxoData.entries || [];
        return entries.map((u: any) => ({
            transactionId: u.outpoint?.transactionId || u.transactionId,
            index: Number(u.outpoint?.index ?? u.index ?? 0),
            amount: Number(u.utxoEntry?.amount ?? u.amount ?? 0),
            scriptPublicKey:
                u.utxoEntry?.scriptPublicKey?.scriptPublicKey ||
                u.scriptPublicKey?.scriptPublicKey ||
                u.scriptPublicKey ||
                ''
        }));
    }

    async function handleExecuteDeploy(config: any) {
        forgeError = '';
        forgeSuccess = false;
        confirmedFanoutReceipts = [];
        const cleanTick = String(config.ticker || '')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase()
            .replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        if (cleanTick.length < 4 || cleanTick.length > 6) {
            forgeError = 'Ticker symbol must be 4 to 6 letters (A–Z).';
            return;
        }
        const tokenStandard: ForgeTokenStandard =
            config.tokenStandard === 'KCC-20' ? 'KCC-20' : 'KRC-20';
        const maxSupply = Number(config.maxSupply || 0);
        const mintLimit = Number(config.mintLimit || 0);
        const decimals = Number(config.decimals ?? 8);
        const preAllocation = Number(config.preAllocation || 0);
        if (maxSupply <= 0 || mintLimit <= 0 || mintLimit > maxSupply) {
            forgeError = 'Max Supply must be > 0 and Per-Mint Limit cannot exceed Max Supply.';
            return;
        }

        isForging = true;
        forgeStatusMessage = `Assembling Client-Side ${tokenStandard} Deploy & SilverScript Tokenomics Envelope...`;
        try {
            const formattedUtxos = await fetchWalletUtxosForEnvelope();
            const envelopeObj: Record<string, string> = {
                p: tokenStandard === 'KCC-20' ? 'kcc-20' : 'krc-20',
                op: 'deploy',
                tick: cleanTick,
                max: formatTokenBaseUnits(maxSupply, decimals),
                lim: formatTokenBaseUnits(mintLimit, decimals)
            };
            if (decimals !== 8) {
                envelopeObj.dec = String(decimals);
            }
            if (preAllocation > 0) {
                envelopeObj.pre = formatTokenBaseUnits(preAllocation, decimals);
            }
            if (tokenStandard === 'KCC-20') {
                envelopeObj.cov = 'silverscript-v1';
            }
            if (config.charterSha256) {
                envelopeObj.charter = String(config.charterSha256).slice(0, 32);
            }
            const envelopeJson = JSON.stringify(envelopeObj);
            const payloadHex = encodeUtf8ToHex(envelopeJson);
            const payloadBlake2bHex = bytesToHex(
                computePayloadHash('0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', payloadHex)
            );
            const capRows = Array.isArray(config.capTable) ? config.capTable : [];
            lastExecutedSummary = {
                mode: 'krc20_deploy',
                tokenStandard,
                title: `${cleanTick} ${tokenStandard} Token & SilverScript Charter Deployed`,
                subtitle: `Max Supply: ${maxSupply.toLocaleString()} ${cleanTick} • Mint Limit: ${mintLimit.toLocaleString()} ${cleanTick} • Cap Table Wallets: ${capRows.length}`,
                tickerOrId: cleanTick,
                envelopeJson,
                payloadHex,
                payloadBlake2bHex,
                charterSha256: config.charterSha256,
                preAllocation
            };
            pendingTokenomicsRegistration = {
                ticker: cleanTick,
                tokenStandard,
                decimals,
                maxSupply,
                protocolFeeKas: 1.5,
                capTable: capRows,
                monetaryPolicy: config.monetaryPolicy,
                mineableVault: config.mineableVault
            };
            txState.lastTxId = '';
            txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
            txState.lastFanoutReceipts = [];
            awaitingVaultSignature = true;
            forgeStatusMessage = 'Awaiting Local Sovereign Vault Signature...';
            const deployPsbt = {
                version: 0,
                inputs: [],
                outputs: [],
                lockTime: 0,
                subnetworkId: '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000',
                gas: 0,
                payload: payloadHex
            };
            identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
                actionType: capRows.length > 0 ? 'KRC20_DEPLOY_FANOUT' : 'KRC20_DEPLOY',
                ticker: cleanTick,
                decimals,
                capTable: capRows,
                payAsset: 'KAS',
                receiveAsset: cleanTick,
                payAmount: `${kasplexInfo.opFeeDeployKas} KAS Protocol + ${capRows.length} Fan-Out TXs`,
                destinationAddress: identity.activeAddress,
                complianceHash: config.charterSha256 || undefined,
                psbtData: {
                    psbt: deployPsbt,
                    formattedUtxos
                }
            });
        } catch (err: any) {
            forgeError = err.message || 'Failed to prepare KRC-20 / KCC-20 deploy envelope.';
            isForging = false;
            awaitingVaultSignature = false;
            forgeStatusMessage = '';
        }
    }

    async function handleExecuteMint(params: {
        ticker: string;
        recipientAddress: string;
        inspectedToken: any;
    }) {
        forgeError = '';
        forgeSuccess = false;
        confirmedFanoutReceipts = [];
        const cleanTick = String(params.ticker || '')
            .trim()
            .toUpperCase()
            .replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '');
        if (cleanTick.length < 4 || cleanTick.length > 6) {
            forgeError = 'Select a valid 4–6 character KRC-20 ticker to mint.';
            return;
        }
        isForging = true;
        forgeStatusMessage = `Assembling Client-Side ${cleanTick} Mint Inscription...`;
        try {
            const formattedUtxos = await fetchWalletUtxosForEnvelope();
            const recipient = params.recipientAddress.trim() || identity.activeAddress || '';
            const envelopeObj: Record<string, string> = {
                p: 'krc-20',
                op: 'mint',
                tick: cleanTick
            };
            if (
                params.recipientAddress.trim() &&
                params.recipientAddress.trim().toLowerCase() !==
                    (identity.activeAddress || '').toLowerCase()
            ) {
                envelopeObj.to = params.recipientAddress.trim();
            }
            const envelopeJson = JSON.stringify(envelopeObj);
            const payloadHex = encodeUtf8ToHex(envelopeJson);
            const payloadBlake2bHex = bytesToHex(
                computePayloadHash('0000000000000000000000000000000000000000', payloadHex)
            );
            const mintHumanQty = params.inspectedToken
                ? parseKasplexUnits(params.inspectedToken.lim, params.inspectedToken.dec)
                : 1000;
            lastExecutedSummary = {
                mode: 'krc20_mint',
                tokenStandard: 'KRC-20',
                title: `${cleanTick} KRC-20 Mint Inscription Broadcasted`,
                subtitle: `+${mintHumanQty.toLocaleString()} ${cleanTick} Minted to Sovereign Vault`,
                tickerOrId: cleanTick,
                envelopeJson,
                payloadHex,
                payloadBlake2bHex,
                mintHumanQty
            };
            pendingTokenomicsRegistration = null;
            txState.lastTxId = '';
            txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
            awaitingVaultSignature = true;
            forgeStatusMessage = 'Awaiting Local Sovereign Vault Signature...';
            identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
                actionType: 'KRC20_MINT',
                ticker: cleanTick,
                payAsset: 'KAS',
                receiveAsset: cleanTick,
                payAmount: `${kasplexInfo.opFeeMintKas} KAS Protocol + L1 Fee`,
                destinationAddress: recipient,
                recipientAddress: recipient,
                psbtData: {
                    psbt: {
                        version: 0,
                        inputs: [],
                        outputs: [],
                        lockTime: 0,
                        subnetworkId: '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000',
                        gas: 0,
                        payload: payloadHex
                    },
                    formattedUtxos
                }
            });
        } catch (err: any) {
            forgeError = err.message || 'Failed to prepare KRC-20 mint inscription.';
            isForging = false;
            awaitingVaultSignature = false;
            forgeStatusMessage = '';
        }
    }

    async function persistTokenomicsRegistration(deployTxHash: string) {
        if (!pendingTokenomicsRegistration) return;
        const payload = {
            ...pendingTokenomicsRegistration,
            deployTxHash
        };
        pendingTokenomicsRegistration = null;
        try {
            await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'REGISTER_FORGE_TOKENOMICS',
                    payload
                })
            });
        } catch {
            // Non-blocking background persistence
        }
    }

    $effect(() => {
        if (!identity.isVaultUnlockPending && awaitingVaultSignature) {
            awaitingVaultSignature = false;
            isForging = false;
            forgeStatusMessage = '';
            if (txState.lastTxId && lastExecutedSummary) {
                confirmedTxId = txState.lastTxId;
                confirmedExplorerUrl =
                    txState.lastExplorerUrl ||
                    getChainExplorerTxUrl('KAS', txState.lastTxId);
                confirmedFanoutReceipts = [...(txState.lastFanoutReceipts || [])];
                forgeSuccess = true;
                const summary = lastExecutedSummary;
                if (summary.mode === 'krc20_deploy') {
                    treasury.updateAsset(summary.tickerOrId, {
                        name: `${summary.tickerOrId} (${summary.tokenStandard})`,
                        assetClass: 'Ecosystem',
                        network: 'KAS',
                        onChain: summary.preAllocation || 0,
                        contract: confirmedTxId,
                        theme: { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' }
                    });
                    persistTokenomicsRegistration(confirmedTxId);
                } else if (summary.mode === 'krc20_mint') {
                    const existing = treasury.getAsset(summary.tickerOrId);
                    treasury.updateAsset(summary.tickerOrId, {
                        name: `${summary.tickerOrId} (KRC-20)`,
                        assetClass: 'Ecosystem',
                        network: 'KAS',
                        onChain: (existing.onChain || 0) + (summary.mintHumanQty || 1000),
                        contract: confirmedTxId,
                        theme: { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' }
                    });
                }
                ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                    'forge_header_badge',
                    `L1 ENVELOPE BROADCASTED ✓`,
                    '#18C6A5'
                );
            } else if (txState.error) {
                forgeError = txState.error;
            }
        }
    });

    function resetForgeWorkspace() {
        forgeSuccess = false;
        forgeError = '';
        confirmedTxId = '';
        confirmedExplorerUrl = '';
        confirmedFanoutReceipts = [];
        lastExecutedSummary = null;
    }

    onMount(async () => {
        kasplexInfo = await resolveKasplexProtocolInfo();
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        if (pollInterval) clearInterval(pollInterval);
    });
</script>

        Math.max(0, grossBusinessIncomeUsd - totalDeductibleOpexUsd)

    async function syncTaxFortressData() {
        if (!browser) return;
        nonCpaAcknowledged =
            localStorage.getItem(NON_CPA_ACK_STORAGE_KEY) === 'true';

        const activeAddr =
            identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign-tax-fortress';
        const localPii = await loadLocalEncryptedTaxPii(activeAddr);
        if (localPii.legalName) legalName = localPii.legalName;
        if (localPii.tinEin) tinEin = localPii.tinEin;
        if (localPii.businessAddress)
            businessAddress = localPii.businessAddress;

        const escrowStorageKey = `perennia_tax_escrow_cfg_${activeAddr.toLowerCase()}`;
        try {
            const savedEscrowRaw = localStorage.getItem(escrowStorageKey);
            if (savedEscrowRaw) {
                const parsedCfg = JSON.parse(savedEscrowRaw);
                if (
                    parsedCfg.mode === 'KAS_USDC_LP' ||
                    parsedCfg.mode === 'USDC_RESERVE'
                ) {
                    escrowReserveMode = parsedCfg.mode;
                }
                if (typeof parsedCfg.enabled === 'boolean') {
                    taxEscrowEnabled = parsedCfg.enabled;
                }
                if (typeof parsedCfg.ilAck === 'boolean') {
                    impermanentLossAcknowledged = parsedCfg.ilAck;
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore malformed localStorage config
        }

        try {
            const requests: Promise<Response | null>[] = [
                fetch('/api/user/tax-events?bundle=hifo').catch(() => null),
                fetch('/api/treasury/kyc').catch(() => null),
                fetch('/api/state/action', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        action: 'GET_HIFO_TAX_LOTS',
                        payload: {}
                    })
                }).catch(() => null)
            ];

            if (isAdmin) {
                requests.push(
                    fetch(
                        `/api/treasury/corporate?corporate=true&kas=${encodeURIComponent(activeAddr)}`
                    ).catch(() => null)
                );
            }

            const [eventsBundleRes, kycRes, hifoRes, corpRes] =
                await Promise.all(requests);

            if (kycRes && kycRes.ok) {
                const kycData = await kycRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (kycData?.jurisdiction) {
                    countryCode =
                        kycData.jurisdiction.countryCode || countryCode;
                    stateRegion =
                        kycData.jurisdiction.stateRegion || stateRegion;
                    entityType = kycData.jurisdiction.entityType || entityType;
                    filingStatus =
                        kycData.jurisdiction.filingStatus || filingStatus;
                }
            }

            if (corpRes && corpRes.ok) {
                const corpJson = await corpRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (corpJson?.reconciliation) {
                    corporateReconciliation = corpJson.reconciliation;
                }
            }

            let loadedEventsCount = 0;
            let loadedLotsCount = 0;

            if (eventsBundleRes && eventsBundleRes.ok) {
                const bundleData = await eventsBundleRes.json();
                if (Array.isArray(bundleData)) {
                    ui.taxEvents = bundleData;
                    loadedEventsCount = bundleData.length;
                } else if (bundleData && typeof bundleData === 'object') {
                    if (Array.isArray(bundleData.events)) {
                        ui.taxEvents = bundleData.events;
                        loadedEventsCount = bundleData.events.length;
                    }
                    if (
                        Array.isArray(bundleData.hifoLots) &&
                        bundleData.hifoSummary
                    ) {
                        loadedLotsCount = bundleData.hifoLots.length;
                        liveHifoBundle = {
                            accountingMethod:
                                bundleData.hifoSummary.accountingMethod ||
                                'PASSIVE_HIFO_NO_WASH',
                            lots: bundleData.hifoLots,
                            disposalMatches: Array.isArray(
                                bundleData.disposalMatches
                            )
                                ? bundleData.disposalMatches
                                : [],
                            summary: bundleData.hifoSummary
                        };
                    }
                }
            }

            if (hifoRes && hifoRes.ok) {
                const hData = await hifoRes.json();
                if (
                    hData.success &&
                    hData.data &&
                    Array.isArray(hData.data.lots)
                ) {
                    if (hData.data.lots.length > 0 || loadedEventsCount === 0) {
                        liveHifoBundle = hData.data;
                        loadedLotsCount = hData.data.lots.length;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (
                !ui.isTutorialActive &&
                !ui.isTutorialSandbox &&
                loadedEventsCount === 0 &&
                loadedLotsCount === 0
            ) {
                liveHifoBundle = { ...EMPTY_HIFO_BUNDLE };
                escrowLpBalanceUsd = 0.0;
                taxEscrowEnabled = false;
                localStorage.removeItem(escrowStorageKey);
            } else if (taxEscrowEnabled) {
                escrowLpBalanceUsd = estimatedTaxLiabilityUsd;
            }
        } catch {
            // Keep existing reactive state on transient network error
        }
    }

    async function handleSaveJurisdictionProfile(e: Event) {
        e.preventDefault();
        isSavingProfile = true;
        try {
            const activeAddr =
                identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign-tax-fortress';
            const localPii: LocalTaxPiiProfile = {
                legalName: legalName.trim(),
                tinEin: tinEin.trim(),
                businessAddress: businessAddress.trim()
            };
            await saveLocalEncryptedTaxPii(activeAddr, localPii);
            if (browser) {
                const rawStored = localStorage.getItem(
                    `perennia_zero_pii_tax_vault_${activeAddr.toLowerCase()}`
                );
                localStorage.setItem(
                    `perennia_zero_pii_tax_v4_${activeAddr.toLowerCase()}`,
                    JSON.stringify({
                        cipherVersion: 'AES-256-GCM-V1',
                        jurisdictionCode: rateCalculation.jurisdictionCode,
                        effectiveTaxRate: rateCalculation.effectiveRatePct,
                        encryptedPiiAesGcm: rawStored || 'AES_256_GCM_CIPHERTEXT'
                    })
                );
            }
            await fetch('/api/treasury/kyc', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    walletAddress: activeAddr,
                    countryCode,
                    stateRegion,
                    entityType,
                    filingStatus,
                    effectiveTaxRate: rateCalculation.effectiveRatePct
                })
            }).catch(() => {});
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'tax_profile_saved',
                `${rateCalculation.jurisdictionCode} (${rateCalculation.effectiveRatePct.toFixed(2)}%) SAVED ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
            showJurisdictionDrawer = false;
        } finally {
            isSavingProfile = false;
        }
    }

    async function registerExternalDepositCostBasis() {
        extBasisFeedback = null;
        if (!identity.activeAddress) {
            ui.showWalletModal = true;
            return;
        }
        const qty = parseFloat(extAmountTokens);
        const basisUsd = parseFloat(extTotalCostBasisUsd);
        if (!Number.isFinite(qty) || qty <= 0) {
            extBasisFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    'Enter a positive token quantity for the external L1 deposit.'
            };
            return;
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(basisUsd) || basisUsd < 0) {
            extBasisFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    'Enter a valid historical USD cost basis ($0.00 or higher).'
            };
            return;
        }
        isRegisteringExtLot = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/fiat/offramp', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'REGISTER_EXTERNAL_COST_BASIS',
                    assetTicker: extAssetTicker.trim().toUpperCase(),
                    amountTokens: qty,
                    totalCostBasisUsd: basisUsd,
                    acquiredAt: extAcquiredDate
                        ? new Date(extAcquiredDate).toISOString()
                        : new Date().toISOString(),
                    txHash: extSourceTxHash.trim() || undefined
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error ||
                        'Failed to register external L1 deposit cost basis.'
                );
            }
            extBasisFeedback = {
                type: 'success',
                message: `✓ Registered OPEN HIFO Lot: ${qty} ${data.assetTicker} @ $${Number(data.fmvUsdPerToken).toFixed(4)}/unit (Total Basis: $${Number(data.totalCostBasisUsd).toFixed(2)} USD)`
            };
            extAmountTokens = '';
            extTotalCostBasisUsd = '';
            extSourceTxHash = '';
            await syncTaxFortressData();
        } catch (err: any) {
            extBasisFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    err.message || 'Failed to register external deposit lot.'
            };
        } finally {
            isRegisteringExtLot = false;
        }
    }

    async function recordCorporateOutflowVoucher() {
        corpVoucherFeedback = null;
        if (!isAdmin) {
            corpVoucherFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    'FORBIDDEN: Corporate Outflow & Schedule C / 1120 Ledger is restricted to MASTER_ADMIN_ADDRESS.'
            };
            return;
        }
        const amtUsd = parseFloat(corpAmountUsd);
        if (!Number.isFinite(amtUsd) || amtUsd <= 0) {
            corpVoucherFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    'Enter a positive USD amount for the corporate voucher.'
            };
            return;
        }
        isLoggingCorpVoucher = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/treasury/corporate', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    outflowCategory: corpCategory,
                    sourceAsset: corpAsset,
                    amountUsd: amtUsd,
                    vendorOrBeneficiary: corpVendor.trim(),
                    invoiceOrMemo: corpMemo.trim(),
                    logOnly: corpLogOnly
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to record corporate outflow voucher.'
                );
            }
            if (data.reconciliation) {
                corporateReconciliation = data.reconciliation;
            }
            corpVoucherFeedback = {
                type: 'success',
                message: `✓ Recorded ${data.outflow.outflowCategory} Voucher (${data.outflow.outflowId} • $${Number(data.outflow.grossUsd).toFixed(2)} USD)`
            };
            await syncTaxFortressData();
        } catch (err: any) {
            corpVoucherFeedback = {
                type: 'error',
                message:
                    err.message || 'Failed to record corporate outflow voucher.'
            };
        } finally {
            isLoggingCorpVoucher = false;
        }
    }

    async function downloadSingleCorporateVoucherPdf(outflow: any) {
        if (!browser || !outflow) return;
        try {
            const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
            const page = pdfDoc.addPage([612, 520]);
            const fontBold = await pdfDoc.embedFont(
                StandardFonts.HelveticaBold
            );
            const fontMono = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Courier);
            const slateBg = rgb(0.04, 0.05, 0.07);
            const teal = rgb(0.094, 0.776, 0.647);
            const dark = rgb(0.1, 0.12, 0.16);
            const muted = rgb(0.42, 0.46, 0.52);

            const id = String(
                outflow.outflow_id || outflow.outflowId || 'CORP-VOUCHER'
            );
            const category = String(
                outflow.outflow_category ||
                    outflow.outflowCategory ||
                    'ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_OPEX'
            );
            const vendor = String(
                outflow.vendor_or_beneficiary ||
                    outflow.vendorOrBeneficiary ||
                    'Perennia Holdings, LLC'
            );
            const memo = String(
                outflow.invoice_or_memo || outflow.invoiceOrMemo || ''
            );
            const asset = String(
                outflow.source_asset || outflow.sourceAsset || 'USDC'
            );
            const qty = Number(
                outflow.amount_crypto ?? outflow.amountCrypto ?? 0
            );
            const grossUsd = Number(
                outflow.gross_usd ?? outflow.grossUsd ?? 0
            );
            const basisUsd = Number(
                outflow.cost_basis_usd ?? outflow.costBasisUsd ?? grossUsd
            );
            const gainUsd = Number(
                outflow.realized_gain_loss_usd ??
                    outflow.realizedGainLossUsd ??
                    0
            );
            const txHash = String(outflow.tx_hash || outflow.txHash || id);

            page.drawRectangle({
                x: 0,
                y: 440,
                width: 612,
                height: 80,
                color: slateBg
            });
            page.drawText(
                'PERENNIA HOLDINGS, LLC — CORPORATE ACCOUNTING VOUCHER',
                {
                    x: 36,
                    y: 484,
                    size: 12,
                    font: fontBold,
                    color: teal
                }
            );
            page.drawText(
                `VOUCHER ID: ${id} • SIGNER: ${MASTER_ADMIN_ADDRESS}`,
                {
                    x: 36,
                    y: 462,
                    size: 8,
                    font: fontMono,
                    color: rgb(0.9, 0.92, 0.95)
                }
            );

            const rows = [
                ['CLASSIFICATION', category],
                ['VENDOR / PAYEE', vendor],
                ['INVOICE / MEMO', memo],
                ['DISPOSED CRYPTO', `${qty.toFixed(4)} ${asset}`],
                ['GROSS USD VALUE', `$${grossUsd.toFixed(2)} USD`],
                ['HIFO COST BASIS', `$${basisUsd.toFixed(2)} USD`],
                [
                    'REALIZED GAIN / LOSS',
                    `${gainUsd >= 0 ? '+' : ''}$${gainUsd.toFixed(2)} USD`
                ],
                ['TX / TRACE HASH', txHash]
            ];

            let y = 404;
            for (const [label, val] of rows) {
                page.drawRectangle({
                    x: 36,
                    y: y - 8,
                    width: 540,
                    height: 28,
                    borderColor: rgb(0.84, 0.87, 0.9),
                    borderWidth: 1
                });
                page.drawText(label, {
                    x: 46,
                    y: y + 2,
                    size: 8,
                    font: fontBold,
                    color: muted
                });
                page.drawText(String(val).slice(0, 62), {
                    x: 230,
                    y: y + 2,
                    size: 8.5,
                    font: fontMono,
                    color: dark
                });
                y -= 36;
            }

            const pdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
            const blob = new Blob([pdfBytes as any], {
                type: 'application/pdf'
            });
            const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `${id}-Corporate-Voucher.pdf`;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            a.remove();
            window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to compile Corporate Voucher PDF:', err);
        }
    }

    function handleToggleTaxEscrow() {
        if (taxEscrowEnabled) {
            taxEscrowEnabled = false;
            const activeAddr =
                identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign-tax-fortress';
            if (browser) {
                localStorage.setItem(
                    `perennia_tax_escrow_cfg_${activeAddr.toLowerCase()}`,
                    JSON.stringify({
                        enabled: false,
                        mode: escrowReserveMode,
                        ilAck: impermanentLossAcknowledged
                    })
                );
            }
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'tax_escrow_card',
                'TAX ESCROW PAUSED',
                '#F59E0B'
            );
        } else {
            showEscrowModal = true;
        }
    }

    async function confirmActivateTaxEscrowLp() {
        if (!canConfirmEscrowActivation) return;
        taxEscrowEnabled = true;
        showEscrowModal = false;
        escrowLpBalanceUsd = estimatedTaxLiabilityUsd;
        if (!nonCpaAcknowledged) {
            nonCpaAcknowledged = true;
            if (browser) {
                localStorage.setItem(NON_CPA_ACK_STORAGE_KEY, 'true');
            }
        }
        const activeAddr =
            identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign-tax-fortress';
        if (browser) {
            localStorage.setItem(
                `perennia_tax_escrow_cfg_${activeAddr.toLowerCase()}`,
                JSON.stringify({
                    enabled: true,
                    mode: escrowReserveMode,
                    ilAck: impermanentLossAcknowledged
                })
            );
        }
        ui.triggerMicroBadge(
            'tax_escrow_card',
            escrowReserveMode === 'USDC_RESERVE'
                ? '100% USDC ESCROW ARMED ✓'
                : '50/50 KAS/USDC LP ARMED ✓',
            '#18C6A5'
        );
        await fetch('/api/state/action', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                action: 'SET_TAX_ESCROW_AUTO_LP',
                payload: {
                    enabled: true,
                    escrowMode: escrowReserveMode,
                    impermanentLossAcknowledged,
                    effectiveTaxRate: rateCalculation.effectiveRatePct,
                    jurisdictionCode: rateCalculation.jurisdictionCode
                }
            })
        }).catch(() => {});
    }

    async function withdrawTaxEscrowLpNow() {
        if (escrowLpBalanceUsd <= 0 && !taxEscrowEnabled) return;
        isWithdrawingEscrowLp = true;
        try {
            const withdrawnUsd = escrowLpBalanceUsd;
            escrowLpBalanceUsd = 0;
            taxEscrowEnabled = false;
            const activeAddr =
                identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign-tax-fortress';
            if (browser) {
                localStorage.setItem(
                    `perennia_tax_escrow_cfg_${activeAddr.toLowerCase()}`,
                    JSON.stringify({
                        enabled: false,
                        mode: escrowReserveMode,
                        ilAck: impermanentLossAcknowledged
                    })
                );
            }
            if (withdrawnUsd > 0) {
                const currentUsdc = treasury.getAsset('USDC').synthetic || 0;
                treasury.updateAsset('USDC', {
                    synthetic: currentUsdc + withdrawnUsd
                });
            }
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'tax_escrow_card',
                `WITHDREW $${withdrawnUsd.toFixed(2)} ESCROW ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
        } finally {
            isWithdrawingEscrowLp = false;
        }
    }

    async function handleGenerate1099Pdf() {
        isGeneratingPdf = true;
        try {
            await generate1099DaAnd8949Pdf({
                walletAddress:
                    identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign-tax-fortress',
                jurisdictionCode: rateCalculation.jurisdictionCode,
                entityType,
                filingStatus,
                effectiveTaxRate: rateCalculation.effectiveRatePct,
                grossProceedsUsd: grossTaxableProceedsUsd,
                estimatedLiabilityUsd: estimatedTaxLiabilityUsd,
                escrowLpStakedUsd: taxEscrowEnabled
                    ? estimatedTaxLiabilityUsd
                    : escrowLpBalanceUsd,
                escrowReserveMode,
                localPii: {
                    legalName,
                    tinEin,
                    businessAddress
                },
                hifoBundle,
                events: displayedEvents
            });
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'tax_export_btn',
                '1099-DA / 8949 PDF COMPILED ✓',
                '#18C6A5'
            );
        } finally {
            isGeneratingPdf = false;
        }
    }

    function handleExportHifoCsv() {
        exportHifoTaxLedgerCsv({
            walletAddress:
                identity.activeAddress || 'kaspa:sovereign-tax-fortress',
            jurisdictionCode: rateCalculation.jurisdictionCode,
            effectiveTaxRate: rateCalculation.effectiveRatePct,
            escrowReserveMode,
            events: displayedEvents,
            hifoBundle
        });
        ui.triggerMicroBadge('tax_export_btn', 'HIFO CSV EXPORTED ✓', '#18C6A5');
    }

    function handleRealtimeTaxRefresh() {
        syncTaxFortressData();
    }

    onMount(() => {
        syncTaxFortressData();
        if (browser) {
            window.addEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleRealtimeTaxRefresh
            );
            window.addEventListener(
                'perennia:yield_update',
                handleRealtimeTaxRefresh
            );
        }
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        if (browser) {
            window.removeEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleRealtimeTaxRefresh
            );
            window.removeEventListener(
                'perennia:yield_update',
                handleRealtimeTaxRefresh
            );
        }
    });
</script>

import { json, type RequestHandler, type RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
