    function handleLiveSearch() {
        clearTimeout(liveDiscoverTimeout);
        const query = networkSearchQuery.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!query) {
            searchResults = [];
            globalSearchError = '';
            isGlobalSearching = false;
            return;
        }
        const resultsMap = new Map<string, any>();
        for (const regAsset of treasury.registry) {
            if (regAsset.ticker === 'USD') continue;
            if (
                regAsset.ticker.toUpperCase().includes(query) ||
                regAsset.name.toUpperCase().includes(query) ||
                (regAsset.contract &&
                    regAsset.contract.toUpperCase().includes(query))
            ) {
                const key = `${regAsset.ticker}:${regAsset.network}`;
                resultsMap.set(key, {
                    symbol: regAsset.ticker,
                    name: regAsset.name,
                    hex: regAsset.theme?.hex || '#18C6A5',
                    imgUrl: regAsset.imgUrl || '',
                    price: regAsset.spotPrice || 0,
                    contract: regAsset.contract || regAsset.ticker,
                    network: regAsset.network || regAsset.ticker,
                    badge: regAsset.assetClass,
                    isNativeChain: regAsset.ticker === regAsset.network
                });
            }
        }
        const matches = knownTokens.filter(
            (t) =>
                t.tickers.some((tk) => tk.includes(query)) ||
                (t.symbol && t.symbol.toUpperCase().includes(query)) ||
                t.name.toUpperCase().includes(query)
        );
        matches.forEach((match) => {
            const key = `${match.symbol}:${match.network}`;
            if (!resultsMap.has(key)) {
                const liveSpot = treasury.getAsset(match.symbol).spotPrice || 0;
                resultsMap.set(key, {
                    symbol: match.symbol || match.tickers[0],
                    name: match.name,
                    hex: match.hex,
                    imgUrl: match.imgUrl,
                    price: liveSpot,
                    contract: (match as any).contract || query,
                    network: match.network,
                    isNativeChain: Boolean((match as any).isNativeChain)
                });
            }
        });
        if (
            query.length >= 2 &&
            query.length <= 8 &&
            /^[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(query)
        ) {
            const directChainKey = `${query}:${query}`;
            if (!resultsMap.has(directChainKey)) {
                resultsMap.set(directChainKey, {
                    symbol: query,
                    name: `${query} (L1 Chain / Token)`,
                    hex: '#18C6A5',
                    imgUrl: '',
                    price: treasury.getAsset(query).spotPrice || 0,
                    contract: query,
                    network: query,
                    badge: 'Multi-Chain',
                    isNativeChain: true
                });
            }
        }
        searchResults = Array.from(resultsMap.values());
        if (networkSearchQuery.trim().length >= 2) {
            liveDiscoverTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
                try {
                    const rawQ = networkSearchQuery.trim();
                    const res = await fetch(
                        `/api/prices?discover=${encodeURIComponent(rawQ)}&register=1`
                    );
                    if (res.ok) {
                        const data = await res.json();
                        if (data.success && data.asset) {
                            const disc = data.asset;
                            const discEntry = {
                                symbol: disc.ticker,
                                name: disc.name,
                                hex: disc.theme?.hex || '#18C6A5',
                                imgUrl: disc.imgUrl || '',
                                price: Number(disc.spotPrice || 0),
                                change24h: Number(disc.change24h || 0),
                                contract: disc.contract || disc.ticker,
                                network: disc.network || 'ETH',
                                badge: `${disc.assetClass} • ${disc.quorumCount} Feeds`,
                                isNativeChain: false
                            };
                            const filteredExisting = searchResults.filter(
                                (r) =>
                                    !(
                                        r.symbol === discEntry.symbol &&
                                        (r.network === discEntry.network ||
                                            r.badge === 'Multi-Chain')
                                    )
                            );
                            searchResults = [discEntry, ...filteredExisting];
                        }
                    }
                } catch {
                    // Ignore live discover error
                }
            }, 260);
        }
    }

    async function executeGlobalMasterSearch() {
        const query = networkSearchQuery.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (query.length < 2) return;
        isGlobalSearching = true;
        globalSearchError = '';
        try {
            let externalResults: any[] = [];
            try {
                const oracleRes = await fetch(
                    `/api/prices?discover=${encodeURIComponent(networkSearchQuery.trim())}&register=1`
                );
                if (oracleRes.ok) {
                    const oracleData = await oracleRes.json();
                    if (oracleData.success && oracleData.asset) {
                        const disc = oracleData.asset;
                        externalResults.push({
                            symbol: disc.ticker,
                            name: disc.name,
                            hex: disc.theme?.hex || '#18C6A5',
                            imgUrl: disc.imgUrl || '',
                            price: Number(disc.spotPrice || 0),
                            change24h: Number(disc.change24h || 0),
                            contract: disc.contract || disc.ticker,
                            network: disc.network || 'ETH',
                            badge: `LIVE ORACLE (${disc.quorumCount} FEEDS)`
                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore oracle discover fallback
            }
            const dsRes = await fetch(
                `https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
            );
            if (dsRes.ok) {
                const dsData = await dsRes.json();
                if (dsData.pairs && dsData.pairs.length > 0) {
                    let exactPairs = dsData.pairs.filter(
                        (p: any) =>
                            p.baseToken.symbol.toUpperCase() === query ||
                            p.baseToken.name.toUpperCase().includes(query)
                    );
                    if (exactPairs.length === 0) exactPairs = dsData.pairs;
                    let liquidPairs = exactPairs.filter(
                        (p: any) => parseFloat(p.liquidity?.usd || 0) > 1000
                    );
                    let bestPairPerChain: Record<string, any> = {};
                    liquidPairs.forEach((pair: any) => {
                        const chain = pair.chainId;
                        if (
                            !bestPairPerChain[chain] ||
                            parseFloat(pair.liquidity.usd) >
                                parseFloat(
                                    bestPairPerChain[chain].liquidity.usd
                                )
                        ) {
                            bestPairPerChain[chain] = pair;
                        }
                    });
                    for (const [chain, pair] of Object.entries(
                        bestPairPerChain
                    )) {
                        let targetNetwork = '';
                        switch (chain) {
                            case 'ethereum':
                                targetNetwork = 'ETH';
                                break;
                            case 'solana':
                                targetNetwork = 'SOL';
                                break;
                            case 'polygon':
                                targetNetwork = 'POL';
                                break;
                            case 'avalanche':
                                targetNetwork = 'AVAX';
                                break;
                            case 'arbitrum':
                                targetNetwork = 'ARB';
                                break;
                            case 'base':
                                targetNetwork = 'BASE';
                                break;
                            case 'sui':
                                targetNetwork = 'SUI';
                                break;
                        }
                        if (targetNetwork) {
                            const isDup =
                                searchResults.some(
                                    (r) =>
                                        r.symbol ===
                                            pair.baseToken.symbol.toUpperCase() &&
                                        r.network === targetNetwork
                                ) ||
                                externalResults.some(
                                    (r) =>
                                        r.symbol ===
                                            pair.baseToken.symbol.toUpperCase() &&
                                        r.network === targetNetwork
                                );
                            if (!isDup) {
                                externalResults.push({
                                    symbol: pair.baseToken.symbol.toUpperCase(),
                                    name: pair.baseToken.name,
                                    hex: '#18C6A5',
                                    imgUrl:
                                        pair.info?.imageUrl ||
                                        `https://cryptologos.cc/logos/${pair.baseToken.symbol.toLowerCase()}-${pair.baseToken.symbol.toLowerCase()}-logo.svg`,
                                    price: parseFloat(pair.priceUsd || '0'),
                                    contract: pair.baseToken.address,
                                    network: targetNetwork
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            try {
                const kasRes = await fetch(
                    `https://api.kasplex.org/v1/krc20/token/${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
                );
                if (kasRes.ok) {
                    const kasData = await kasRes.json();
                    if (kasData.result && kasData.result.length > 0) {
                        const isDup =
                            searchResults.some(
                                (r) => r.symbol === query && r.network === 'KAS'
                            ) ||
                            externalResults.some(
                                (r) => r.symbol === query && r.network === 'KAS'
                            );
                        if (!isDup) {
                            externalResults.push({
                                symbol: query,
                                name: `${query} (KRC-20)`,
                                hex: '#18C6A5',
                                imgUrl: `https://storage.googleapis.com/kasfyi/token-icons/${query.toLowerCase()}.png`,
                                price: treasury.getAsset(query).spotPrice || 0,
                                contract: query,
                                network: 'KAS'
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore Kasplex lookup fallback
            }
            if (externalResults.length > 0) {
                searchResults = [...externalResults, ...searchResults];
            } else {
                globalSearchError = `No external liquidity found for "${query}". You can still add it directly above.`;
            }
        } catch {
            globalSearchError = 'Global on-chain indexer unreachable.';
        }
        isGlobalSearching = false;
    }

    $effect(() => {
        if (browser && identity.activeAddress && hasLoadedLocalState) {
            const stateToSave = {
                activeNetworks,
                userCustomTokens,
                selectedTokensMap,
                customNetworks
            };
            const stateString = JSON.stringify(stateToSave);
            localStorage.setItem(
                `p_custom_tokens_${identity.activeAddress}`,
                stateString
            );
            clearTimeout(serverSyncTimeout);
            serverSyncTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
                try {
                    await fetch('/api/treasury/preferences', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            walletAddress: identity.activeAddress,
                            preferences: stateToSave
                        })
                    });
                } catch {
                    // Ignore preference sync error
                }
            }, 1500);
        }
    });

    async function loadTreasuryState() {
        if (!browser || !identity.activeAddress) return;
        const localSaved = localStorage.getItem(
            `p_custom_tokens_${identity.activeAddress}`
        );
        if (localSaved) {
            try {
                const data = JSON.parse(localSaved);
                if (data.activeNetworks) {
                    activeNetworks = Array.from(
                        new Set(data.activeNetworks)
                    ).filter((t: any) => t !== 'KAS') as string[];
                }
                if (data.userCustomTokens)
                    userCustomTokens = data.userCustomTokens;
                if (data.selectedTokensMap)
                    selectedTokensMap = data.selectedTokensMap;
                if (Array.isArray(data.customNetworks))
                    customNetworks = data.customNetworks;
            } catch {
                // Ignore local parse error
            }
        }
        try {
            const [prefRes, stateRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch(
                    `/api/treasury/preferences?wallet=${encodeURIComponent(identity.activeAddress)}`
                ),
                fetch('/api/state')
            ]);
            if (prefRes.ok) {
                const { preferences: remoteData } = await prefRes.json();
                if (remoteData) {
                    if (remoteData.activeNetworks) {
                        activeNetworks = Array.from(
                            new Set(remoteData.activeNetworks)
                        ).filter((t: any) => t !== 'KAS') as string[];
                    }
                    if (remoteData.userCustomTokens)
                        userCustomTokens = remoteData.userCustomTokens;
                    if (remoteData.selectedTokensMap)
                        selectedTokensMap = remoteData.selectedTokensMap;
                    if (Array.isArray(remoteData.customNetworks))
                        customNetworks = remoteData.customNetworks;
                }
            }
            if (stateRes.ok) {
                const stateData = await stateRes.json();
                if (Array.isArray(stateData?.customTokens)) {
                    for (const ct of stateData.customTokens) {
                        const sym = String(ct?.ticker || ct?.symbol || '')
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase();
                        const net = String(ct?.network || 'ETH')
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase();
                        if (!sym) continue;
                        treasury.updateAsset(sym, {
                            name: ct.name || sym,
                            assetClass: ct.assetClass || 'DeFi',
                            network: net,
                            spotPrice: Number(ct.spotPrice ?? ct.price ?? 0),
                            delta: Number(ct.delta ?? ct.change24h ?? 0),
                            contract: ct.contract || sym,
                            imgUrl: ct.imgUrl || '',
                            theme: ct.theme || {
                                hex: '#18C6A5',
                                pastel: '#99f6e4'
                            }
                        });
                        addTokenToNetwork(net, {
                            symbol: sym,
                            name: ct.name || sym,
                            hex: ct.theme?.hex || '#18C6A5',
                            imgUrl: ct.imgUrl || '',
                            balance: 0,
                            onChain: 0,
                            synthetic: 0,
                            price: Number(ct.spotPrice ?? ct.price ?? 0),
                            contract: ct.contract || sym,
                            badge: ct.assetClass || 'TOKEN'
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore remote state load error
        }
        bindDerivedAddresses();
        hasLoadedLocalState = true;
    }

    $effect(() => {
        if (identity.isWalletConnected && !hasLoadedLocalState) {
            untrack(() => loadTreasuryState());
        }
    });

    let ringSegments = $derived.by(() => {
        let cumulativePercent = 0;
        const vaultValue = treasury.totalVaultValue;
        return treasury.visibleAssets.map((asset) => {
            const usdValue = asset.totalBalance * asset.spotPrice;
            const percent = vaultValue > 0 ? (usdValue / vaultValue) * 100 : 0;
            const offset = -cumulativePercent;
            cumulativePercent += percent;
            return {
                ...asset,
                usdValue,
                percent,
                dasharray: `${percent} ${100 - percent}`,
                dashoffset: offset
            };
        });
    });

    async function fetchSyntheticLedger() {
        if (!identity.isWalletConnected || !identity.activeAddress) return;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(
                `/api/user/ledger?wallet=${encodeURIComponent(identity.activeAddress)}`
            );
            if (res.ok) {
                const ledgerBalances = await res.json();
                for (const [ticker, amount] of Object.entries(ledgerBalances)) {
                    if (
                        ticker !== 'unassignedReserveKas' &&
                        ticker !== 'unassignedReserveTargetKas'
                    ) {
                        treasury.updateAsset(ticker.toUpperCase(), {
                            synthetic: Number(amount) || 0
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore ledger fetch error
        }
    }

    async function fetchWalletActivity() {
        if (!identity.isWalletConnected || !identity.activeAddress) return;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/user/tax-events');
            if (res.ok) {
                const events = await res.json();
                if (Array.isArray(events)) {
                    walletActivityEvents = events;
                    ui.taxEvents = events;
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore wallet activity error
        }
    }

    async function fetchErc20AndL2Balances(evmAddress: string) {
        if (!evmAddress || evmAddress.includes('Awaiting')) return;
        const cleanHex = evmAddress
            .toLowerCase()
            .replace(/^0x/, '')
            .padStart(64, '0');
        const balanceOfData = `0x70a08231${cleanHex}`;
        const queries = [
            {
                ticker: 'USDC',
                rpc: 'https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com',
                method: 'eth_call',
                params: [
                    {
                        to: '0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48',
                        data: balanceOfData
                    },
                    'latest'
                ],
                decimals: 6
            },
            {
                ticker: 'USDT',
                rpc: 'https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com',
                method: 'eth_call',
                params: [
                    {
                        to: '0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7',
                        data: balanceOfData
                    },
                    'latest'
                ],
                decimals: 6
            },
            {
                ticker: 'ARB',
                rpc: 'https://arbitrum-one-rpc.publicnode.com',
                method: 'eth_getBalance',
                params: [evmAddress, 'latest'],
                decimals: 18
            },
            {
                ticker: 'BASE',
                rpc: 'https://base-rpc.publicnode.com',
                method: 'eth_getBalance',
                params: [evmAddress, 'latest'],
                decimals: 18
            }
        ];
        await Promise.allSettled(
            queries.map(async (q) => {
                const res = await fetch(q.rpc, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0',
                        id: 1,
                        method: q.method,
                        params: q.params
                    }),
                    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4500)
                });
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data.result && data.result !== '0x') {
                        const raw = BigInt(data.result);
                        const divisor = 10 ** q.decimals;
                        const bal = Number(raw) / divisor;
                        treasury.updateAsset(q.ticker, { onChain: bal });
                    }
                }
            })
        );
    }

    async function fetchKrc20OnChainBalances(kasAddress: string) {
        if (!kasAddress || kasAddress.includes('Awaiting')) return;
        const formatted = kasAddress.startsWith('kaspa:')
            ? kasAddress
            : `kaspa:${kasAddress}`;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(
                `https://api.kasplex.org/v1/krc20/address/${encodeURIComponent(formatted)}/tokenlist`,
                { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4500) }
            );
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                if (Array.isArray(data?.result)) {
                    for (const item of data.result) {
                        const tick = String(item.tick || '')
                            .trim()
                            .toUpperCase();
                        const dec = Number(item.dec ?? 8);
                        const rawBal = Number(item.balance || 0);
                        if (tick && rawBal > 0) {
                            const normalizedBal = rawBal / Math.pow(10, dec);
                            treasury.updateAsset(tick, {
                                name: `${tick} (KRC-20)`,
                                assetClass: 'Ecosystem',
                                network: 'KAS',
                                onChain: normalizedBal,
                                address: formatted
                            });
                            addTokenToNetwork('KAS', {
                                symbol: tick,
                                name: `${tick} (KRC-20)`,
                                hex: '#18C6A5',
                                imgUrl: `https://storage.googleapis.com/kasfyi/token-icons/${tick.toLowerCase()}.png`,
                                balance: normalizedBal,
                                onChain: normalizedBal,
                                price: treasury.getAsset(tick).spotPrice || 0,
                                contract: tick,
                                badge: 'KRC-20'
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore Kasplex lookup error
        }
    }

    async function fetchOmniChainInventory() {
        if (!identity.isWalletConnected || !identity.activeAddress) return;
        try {
            bindDerivedAddresses();
            const kasAddr =
                identity.sovereignKeys?.kaspa?.address ||
                identity.activeAddress ||
                '';
            const btcAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.bitcoin?.address || '';
            const ethAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.ethereum?.address || '';
            const solAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.solana?.address || '';
            const dogeAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.doge?.address || '';
            const xrpAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.xrp?.address || '';
            const polAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.polygon?.address || ethAddr;
            const avaxAddr =
                identity.sovereignKeys?.avalanche?.address || ethAddr;
            const suiAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.sui?.address || '';
            const trxAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.tron?.address || '';
            const zecAddr = identity.sovereignKeys?.zcash?.address || '';

            const params = new URLSearchParams({
                kas: kasAddr,
                btc: btcAddr,
                eth: ethAddr,
                sol: solAddr,
                doge: dogeAddr,
                xrp: xrpAddr,
                pol: polAddr,
                avax: avaxAddr,
                sui: suiAddr,
                trx: trxAddr,
                zec: zecAddr
            });
            if (identity.isCorporateAdmin) {
                params.set('corporate', 'true');
            }

            const [corpRes, multiBalRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch(`/api/treasury/corporate?${params.toString()}`).catch(
                    () => null
                ),
                fetch('/api/balance', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        addresses: {
                            kas: kasAddr,
                            btc: btcAddr,
                            eth: ethAddr,
                            sol: solAddr,
                            doge: dogeAddr,
                            xrp: xrpAddr,
                            pol: polAddr,
                            avax: avaxAddr,
                            sui: suiAddr,
                            trx: trxAddr,
                            zec: zecAddr
                        }
                    })
                }).catch(() => null)
            ]);

            if (corpRes && corpRes.ok) {
                const estate = await corpRes.json();
                if (Array.isArray(estate.assets)) {
                    estate.assets.forEach((onChainAsset: any) => {
                        if (
                            onChainAsset.balance !== undefined &&
                            onChainAsset.address &&
                            !onChainAsset.address.includes('Awaiting')
                        ) {
                            treasury.updateAsset(
                                onChainAsset.symbol.toUpperCase(),
                                {
                                    onChain: onChainAsset.balance,
                                    address: onChainAsset.address
                                }
                            );
                        }
                    });
                }
                if (estate.collateralBackedAch) {
                    collateralBackedAch = estate.collateralBackedAch;
                }
                if (identity.isCorporateAdmin && estate.reconciliation) {
                    corporateReconciliation = estate.reconciliation;
                }
            }

            if (multiBalRes && multiBalRes.ok) {
                const balData = await multiBalRes.json();
                if (typeof balData.balanceKas === 'number') {
                    treasury.updateAsset('KAS', {
                        onChain: balData.balanceKas
                    });
                }
                if (balData.chains && typeof balData.chains === 'object') {
                    for (const [chainTick, chainBal] of Object.entries(
                        balData.chains
                    )) {
                        const numBal = Number(chainBal);
                        if (Number.isFinite(numBal) && numBal >= 0) {
                            treasury.updateAsset(chainTick.toUpperCase(), {
                                onChain: numBal
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (balData.tokens && typeof balData.tokens === 'object') {
                    for (const [tokTick, tokBal] of Object.entries(
                        balData.tokens
                    )) {
                        const numBal = Number(tokBal);
                        if (Number.isFinite(numBal) && numBal >= 0) {
                            treasury.updateAsset(tokTick.toUpperCase(), {
                                onChain: numBal
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (ethAddr) {
                fetchErc20AndL2Balances(ethAddr);
            }
            if (kasAddr) {
                fetchKrc20OnChainBalances(kasAddr);
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore inventory fetch error
        }
    }

    function handleRealtimeSseSync() {
        if (!identity.isWalletConnected) return;
        fetchSyntheticLedger();
        fetchWalletActivity();
        fetchOmniChainInventory();
        fetchColdVaultRulesAndSysConfig();
    }

    let refreshInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;

    onMount(() => {
        if (browser) {
            window.addEventListener(
                'perennia:yield_update',
                handleRealtimeSseSync
            );
            window.addEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleRealtimeSseSync
            );
        }
        if (identity.isWalletConnected) {
            fetchOmniChainInventory();
            fetchSyntheticLedger();
            fetchWalletActivity();
            fetchColdVaultRulesAndSysConfig();
        }
        refreshInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (identity.isWalletConnected) {
                fetchOmniChainInventory();
                fetchSyntheticLedger();
                fetchWalletActivity();
                fetchColdVaultRulesAndSysConfig();
            }
        }, 12000);
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        if (browser) {
            window.removeEventListener(
                'perennia:yield_update',
                handleRealtimeSseSync
            );
            window.removeEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleRealtimeSseSync
            );
        }
        if (refreshInterval) clearInterval(refreshInterval);
        clearTimeout(serverSyncTimeout);
        clearTimeout(liveDiscoverTimeout);
    });
</script>

import { produce } from 'sveltekit-sse';
import { redis } from '$lib/server/redis';
import type { RequestEvent } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import type Redis from 'ioredis';

type TelemetryClientListener = (rawMessage: string, parsedMessage: any) => void;

interface TelemetryMultiplexerHub {
    subscriber: Redis | null;
    initPromise: Promise<void> | null;
    listeners: Set<TelemetryClientListener>;
}

const globalHubHolder = globalThis as unknown as {
    __perenniaTelemetryHub?: TelemetryMultiplexerHub;
};

const telemetryHub: TelemetryMultiplexerHub =
    globalHubHolder.__perenniaTelemetryHub || {
        subscriber: null,
        initPromise: null,
        listeners: new Set<TelemetryClientListener>()
    };

globalHubHolder.__perenniaTelemetryHub = telemetryHub;

async function ensureSharedTelemetrySubscriber(): Promise<void> {
    if (telemetryHub.subscriber) {
        return;
    }
    if (telemetryHub.initPromise) {
        return telemetryHub.initPromise;
    }

    telemetryHub.initPromise = (async () => {
        const sub = redis.duplicate();
        sub.on('error', (err) => {
            console.error('SSE Shared Redis Subscriber Error:', err);
        });
        sub.on('message', (channel: string, message: string) => {
            if (channel !== 'telemetry:updates' || telemetryHub.listeners.size === 0) {
                return;
            }
            try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(message);
                for (const listener of telemetryHub.listeners) {
                    try {
                        listener(message, parsed);
                    } catch {
                        // Isolate individual client stream errors
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                console.warn('Failed to parse shared telemetry:updates payload.');
            }
        });
        await sub.subscribe('telemetry:updates');
        telemetryHub.subscriber = sub;
    })().catch((err) => {
        telemetryHub.subscriber = null;
        telemetryHub.initPromise = null;
        throw err;
    });

    return telemetryHub.initPromise;
}

export function GET({ cookies }: RequestEvent) {
    const sessionId = cookies.get('perennia_session');
    return produce(async function start({ emit }) {
        if (!sessionId) {
            emit('message', JSON.stringify({ error: 'UNAUTHORIZED_MATRIX_ACCESS' }));
            return function stop() {};
        }
        const sessionWalletRaw = await redis.get(`session:${sessionId}`);
        if (!sessionWalletRaw) {
            emit('message', JSON.stringify({ error: 'SESSION_EXPIRED' }));
            return function stop() {};
        }
        const sessionWallet = sessionWalletRaw.toLowerCase().trim();
        const cleanSessionWallet = sessionWallet.replace(/kaspa:/i, '').trim();

        try {
            const initialEpochRaw = await redis.get(
                'perennia:settlement:epoch_telemetry'
            );
            if (initialEpochRaw) {
                const parsedEpoch = JSON.parse(initialEpochRaw);
                emit(
                    'message',
                    JSON.stringify({
                        epoch_telemetry_update: true,
                        epoch: parsedEpoch
                    })
                );
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Initial epoch telemetry read bypassed:', e);
        }

        try {
            await ensureSharedTelemetrySubscriber();
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to initialize shared SSE subscriber:', err);
            emit('message', JSON.stringify({ error: 'TELEMETRY_BUS_UNAVAILABLE' }));
            return function stop() {};
        }

        const clientListener: TelemetryClientListener = (rawMessage, parsed) => {
            if (parsed.epoch_telemetry_update) {
                emit('message', rawMessage);
                return;
            }
            if (parsed.yield_update) {
                const payloadWalletClean = (parsed.wallet || '')
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .replace(/kaspa:/i, '')
                    .trim();
                if (payloadWalletClean === cleanSessionWallet) {
                    emit('message', rawMessage);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (parsed.layout_state_update) {
                const payloadWalletClean = (parsed.wallet || '')
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .replace(/kaspa:/i, '')
                    .trim();
                if (payloadWalletClean === cleanSessionWallet) {
                    emit('message', rawMessage);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (parsed.fiat_event || parsed.l1_event) {
                const payloadWalletClean = (parsed.wallet || '')
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .replace(/kaspa:/i, '')
                    .trim();
                if (!payloadWalletClean || payloadWalletClean === cleanSessionWallet) {
                    emit('message', rawMessage);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (parsed.workers && Array.isArray(parsed.workers)) {
                let isolatedHashrate = 0;
                const filteredWorkers = parsed.workers.filter((w: any) => {
                    const rawIdentity = (
                        w.walletAddress ||
                        w.fullIdentity ||
                        ''
                    ).toLowerCase();
                    const cleanWorkerWallet = rawIdentity
                        .split('.')[0]
                        .replace(/kaspa:/i, '')
                        .trim();
                    if (
                        cleanWorkerWallet === cleanSessionWallet ||
                        rawIdentity.includes(cleanSessionWallet)
                    ) {
                        isolatedHashrate +=
                            w.trackingRate || w.hashrate || w.hashRate || 0;
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                });
                const partitionedPayload = {
                    ...parsed,
                    workers: filteredWorkers,
                    ...(parsed.pool
                        ? {
                              pool: {
                                  ...parsed.pool,
                                  totalHashrate: isolatedHashrate
                              }
                          }
                        : { totalHashrate: isolatedHashrate })
                };
                emit('message', JSON.stringify(partitionedPayload));
                return;
            }
            emit('message', rawMessage);
        };

        telemetryHub.listeners.add(clientListener);

        return function stop() {
            telemetryHub.listeners.delete(clientListener);
        };
    });
}

export const POST = GET;

    const CRYPTO_ITERATIONS = 250000;

    async function getDerivationKey(password: string, salt: Uint8Array) {
        const enc = new TextEncoder();
        const keyMaterial = await window.crypto.subtle.importKey(
            'raw',
            enc.encode(password) as any,
            { name: 'PBKDF2' },
            false,
            ['deriveKey']
        );
        return window.crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
            {
                name: 'PBKDF2',
                salt: salt as any,
                iterations: CRYPTO_ITERATIONS,
                hash: 'SHA-256'
            },
            keyMaterial,
            { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
            false,
            ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
        );
    }

    async function encryptVault(
        password: string,
        mnemonic: string
    ): Promise<string> {
        const salt = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
        const iv = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
        const key = await getDerivationKey(password, salt);
        const enc = new TextEncoder();
        const encrypted = await window.crypto.subtle.encrypt(
            { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: iv as any },
            key,
            enc.encode(mnemonic) as any
        );
        const payload = new Uint8Array(
            salt.length + iv.length + encrypted.byteLength
        );
        payload.set(salt, 0);
        payload.set(iv, salt.length);
        payload.set(new Uint8Array(encrypted), salt.length + iv.length);
        let binary = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < payload.byteLength; i++)
            binary += String.fromCharCode(payload[i]);
        return window.btoa(binary);
    }

    async function decryptVault(
        password: string,
        encryptedB64: string
    ): Promise<string> {
        const binary = window.atob(encryptedB64);
        const payload = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++)
            payload[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
        const salt = payload.slice(0, 16);
        const iv = payload.slice(16, 28);
        const ciphertext = payload.slice(28);
        const key = await getDerivationKey(password, salt);
        const dec = new TextDecoder();
        const decryptedBuf = await window.crypto.subtle.decrypt(
            { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: iv as any },
            key,
            ciphertext as any
        );
        return dec.decode(decryptedBuf);
    }

    function pickTwoRandomSeedIndices(totalWords: number): [number, number] {
        const rand = new Uint32Array(2);
        window.crypto.getRandomValues(rand);
        const idx1 = rand[0] % totalWords;
        let idx2 = rand[1] % totalWords;
        if (idx2 === idx1) {
            idx2 = (idx1 + 7) % totalWords;
        }
        return idx1 < idx2 ? [idx1, idx2] : [idx2, idx1];
    }

    async function buildAndSecureVault(
        password: string,
        mnemonic: string,
        isImport = false
    ) {
        identity.isConnecting = true;
        identity.walletMessage = isImport
            ? 'Importing Omni-Chain Matrix...'
            : 'Forging Omni-Chain Matrix...';
        try {
            const keys = await deriveHoneycombKeys(mnemonic);
            const kasAddress = identity.normalizeKaspaAddress(
                keys.kaspa.address
            )!;
            identity.walletMessage = 'Executing Local Handshake...';
            const challengeRes = await fetch('/api/auth/challenge', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ address: kasAddress })
            });
            if (!challengeRes.ok)
                throw new Error('Failed to secure connection challenge.');
            const { message } = await challengeRes.json();
            let privateKeyHex = keys.kaspa.privateKey.replace('0x', '');
            const msgBuf = new TextEncoder().encode(message);
            const hash = blake2b(msgBuf, { dkLen: 32 });
            const signatureBytes = schnorr.sign(
                hash,
                identity.hexToBytes(privateKeyHex)
            );
            const signature = identity.bytesToHex(signatureBytes);
            privateKeyHex = '0'.repeat(64);
            const authBody: Record<string, any> = {
                address: kasAddress,
                signature,
                message,
                provider: 'sovereign'
            };
            const authRes = await fetch('/api/auth', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(authBody)
            });
            if (!authRes.ok) {
                const errData = await authRes.json();
                throw new Error(
                    errData.error || 'Vault Authentication Failed.'
                );
            }
            identity.walletMessage = 'Encrypting Sovereign Vault...';
            const encryptedVault = await encryptVault(password, mnemonic);
            const safeWallets = {
                kaspa: { address: keys.kaspa.address },
                bitcoin: { address: keys.bitcoin.address },
                ethereum: { address: keys.ethereum.address },
                solana: { address: keys.solana.address },
                doge: { address: keys.doge.address },
                xrp: { address: keys.xrp.address },
                polygon: { address: keys.polygon.address },
                avalanche: { address: keys.avalanche.address },
                sui: { address: keys.sui.address },
                tron: { address: keys.tron.address },
                zcash: { address: keys.zcash.address },
                arbitrum: { address: keys.ethereum.address },
                base: { address: keys.ethereum.address }
            };
            return {
                success: true,
                payload: {
                    version: 'perennia-vault-v4',
                    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                    wallets: safeWallets,
                    vault: encryptedVault
                },
                mnemonic,
                addresses: safeWallets
            };
        } catch (e: any) {
            identity.walletMessage =
                e.message || 'Sovereign Generation Failed.';
            identity.disconnect();
            throw e;
        } finally {
            identity.isConnecting = false;
        }
    }

    async function handleGenerate() {
        localError = '';
        statusNotice = '';

        if (ui.isTutorialActive && ui.isTutorialSandbox) {
            seedWords = [...SANDBOX_MNEMONIC_WORDS];
            derivedKaspa = SANDBOX_WALLETS.kaspa.address;
            derivedBtc = SANDBOX_WALLETS.bitcoin.address;
            tempVaultPayload = {
                version: 'perennia-vault-v4',
                exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                wallets: SANDBOX_WALLETS,
                vault: browser
                    ? window.btoa(SANDBOX_MNEMONIC_WORDS.join(' '))
                    : ''
            };
            verifyWordIndices = [2, 14];
            verifyInput1 = '';
            verifyInput2 = '';
            viewState = 'create_seed';
            return;
        }

        if (password.length < 8) {
            localError = 'PASSWORD MUST BE AT LEAST 8 CHARACTERS.';
            return;
        }
        if (password !== confirmPassword) {
            localError = 'PASSWORDS DO NOT MATCH.';
            return;
        }
        try {
            const randomEntropy = window.crypto.getRandomValues(
                new Uint8Array(32)
            );
            const mnemonicObj = ethers.Mnemonic.fromEntropy(randomEntropy);
            const res = await buildAndSecureVault(
