                mnemonicObj.phrase,
                false
            );
            if (res && res.success && res.mnemonic) {
                seedWords = res.mnemonic.split(' ');
                tempVaultPayload = res.payload;
                derivedKaspa = res.addresses?.kaspa?.address || '';
                derivedBtc = res.addresses?.bitcoin?.address || '';
                verifyWordIndices = pickTwoRandomSeedIndices(seedWords.length);
                verifyInput1 = '';
                verifyInput2 = '';
                viewState = 'create_seed';
            }
        } catch {
            localError = 'CRYPTOGRAPHIC GENERATION FAILED.';
        }
    }

    function proceedToSeedVerification() {
        localError = '';
        statusNotice = '';
        if (ui.isTutorialActive && ui.isTutorialSandbox) {
            verifyWordIndices = [2, 14];
            verifyInput1 = seedWords[2] || 'able';
            verifyInput2 = seedWords[14] || 'achieve';
        } else {
            verifyWordIndices = pickTwoRandomSeedIndices(seedWords.length);
            verifyInput1 = '';
            verifyInput2 = '';
        }
        viewState = 'verify_seed';
    }

    function handleVerifySeedChallenge() {
        localError = '';
        if (ui.isTutorialActive && ui.isTutorialSandbox) {
            seedWords = [];
            verifyInput1 = '';
            verifyInput2 = '';
            ui.activateSandboxWalletSession();
            ui.showWalletModal = false;
            viewState = 'menu';
            return;
        }

        const [idx1, idx2] = verifyWordIndices;
        const expected1 = (seedWords[idx1] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const expected2 = (seedWords[idx2] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const provided1 = verifyInput1.trim().toLowerCase();
        const provided2 = verifyInput2.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!provided1 || !provided2) {
            localError = 'PLEASE ENTER BOTH REQUESTED SEED WORDS.';
            return;
        }
        if (provided1 !== expected1 || provided2 !== expected2) {
            localError = `VERIFICATION MISMATCH FOR WORD #${idx1 + 1} OR WORD #${idx2 + 1}. CHECK YOUR BACKUP.`;
            return;
        }
        seedWords = [];
        verifyInput1 = '';
        verifyInput2 = '';
        handleSecure();
    }

    async function handleImport() {
        localError = '';
        statusNotice = '';
        if (password.length < 8) {
            localError = 'PASSWORD MUST BE AT LEAST 8 CHARACTERS.';
            return;
        }
        if (password !== confirmPassword) {
            localError = 'PASSWORDS DO NOT MATCH.';
            return;
        }
        const cleanSeed = importSeed.trim().toLowerCase();
        const words = cleanSeed.split(/\s+/);
        if (words.length !== 12 && words.length !== 24) {
            localError = `EXPECTED 12 OR 24 WORDS. GOT ${words.length}.`;
            return;
        }
        if (!ethers.Mnemonic.isValidMnemonic(cleanSeed)) {
            localError = 'INVALID BIP-39 CHECKSUM ON SEED PHRASE.';
            return;
        }
        try {
            const res = await buildAndSecureVault(password, cleanSeed, true);
            if (res && res.success) {
                tempVaultPayload = res.payload;
                importSeed = '';
                handleSecure();
            }
        } catch {
            localError = 'CRYPTOGRAPHIC IMPORT FAILED.';
        }
    }

    function handleSecure() {
        if (tempVaultPayload) {
            identity.authorizeSovereignVault(tempVaultPayload);
            tempVaultPayload = null;
            seedWords = [];
            password = '';
            confirmPassword = '';
            viewState = 'menu';
            ui.showWalletModal = false;
        }
    }

    function exportEncryptedVaultJson(payloadOverride?: any) {
        if (!browser) return;
        localError = '';
        const sourcePayload =
            payloadOverride ||
            tempVaultPayload ||
            (() => {
                const raw = localStorage.getItem('perennia_sovereign_payload');
                return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
            })();
        if (!sourcePayload || !sourcePayload.vault || !sourcePayload.wallets) {
            localError = 'NO ENCRYPTED VAULT AVAILABLE TO EXPORT.';
            return;
        }
        const safeExport = {
            version: 'perennia-vault-v4',
            exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            wallets: sourcePayload.wallets,
            vault: sourcePayload.vault
        };
        const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(safeExport, null, 2)], {
            type: 'application/json'
        });
        const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        const shortAddr = (sourcePayload.wallets?.kaspa?.address || 'vault')
            .replace(/^kaspa:/i, '')
            .slice(-6);
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `perennia-vault-${shortAddr}.json`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        a.remove();
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        statusNotice = 'ENCRYPTED .JSON VAULT BACKUP DOWNLOADED.';
    }

    async function handleBackupFileUpload(e: Event) {
        const input = e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement;
        const file = input.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;
        localError = '';
        statusNotice = '';
        try {
            const text = await file.text();
            const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
            if (
                !parsed ||
                typeof parsed.vault !== 'string' ||
                !parsed.wallets?.kaspa?.address
            ) {
                throw new Error('INVALID VAULT .JSON FORMAT.');
            }
            localStorage.setItem(
                'perennia_sovereign_payload',
                JSON.stringify({
                    version: parsed.version || 'perennia-vault-v4',
                    wallets: parsed.wallets,
                    vault: parsed.vault
                })
            );
            hasStoredVault = true;
            password = '';
            statusNotice =
                'ENCRYPTED VAULT RESTORED. ENTER PASSWORD TO UNLOCK.';
            viewState = 'unlock';
        } catch (err: any) {
            localError =
                err.message || 'FAILED TO READ ENCRYPTED VAULT .JSON FILE.';
        } finally {
            input.value = '';
        }
    }

    async function handleUnlock() {
        localError = '';
        statusNotice = '';
        if (!password) {
            localError = 'PASSWORD REQUIRED.';
            return;
        }
        identity.isConnecting = true;
        identity.walletMessage = 'Decrypting Sovereign Vault...';
        try {
            const rawPayload = localStorage.getItem(
                'perennia_sovereign_payload'
            );
            if (!rawPayload) throw new Error('No vault found on this device.');
            const vaultPayload = JSON.parse(rawPayload);
            const mnemonic = await decryptVault(password, vaultPayload.vault);
            const keys = await deriveHoneycombKeys(mnemonic);
            let privateKeyHex = keys.kaspa.privateKey.replace('0x', '');
            const kasAddress = identity.normalizeKaspaAddress(
                keys.kaspa.address
            )!;
            identity.walletMessage = 'Requesting cryptographic handshake...';
            const challengeRes = await fetch('/api/auth/challenge', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ address: kasAddress })
            });
            if (!challengeRes.ok)
                throw new Error('Failed to secure connection challenge.');
            const { message } = await challengeRes.json();
            identity.walletMessage = 'Signing session authorization...';
            const msgBuf = new TextEncoder().encode(message);
            const hash = blake2b(msgBuf, { dkLen: 32 });
            const signatureBytes = schnorr.sign(
                hash,
                identity.hexToBytes(privateKeyHex)
            );
            const signature = identity.bytesToHex(signatureBytes);
            privateKeyHex = '0'.repeat(64);
            identity.walletMessage = 'Verifying session...';
            const authBody: Record<string, any> = {
                address: kasAddress,
                signature,
                message,
                provider: 'sovereign'
            };
            const authRes = await fetch('/api/auth', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(authBody)
            });
            if (!authRes.ok)
                throw new Error(
                    'Sovereign authentication rejected by backend.'
                );
            identity.walletMessage = 'Hydrating Omni-Chain Balances...';
            identity.authorizeSovereignVault(vaultPayload);
            password = '';
            ui.showWalletModal = false;
        } catch {
            identity.walletMessage = '';
            localError = 'INVALID VAULT PASSWORD.';
        } finally {
            identity.isConnecting = false;
        }
    }

    function resolveAuthorizeActionLabel(details: any): string {
        const actionType = String(details?.actionType || 'SWAP').toUpperCase();
        if (actionType === 'CREATE_P2P') {
            return identity.isCorporateAdmin
                ? 'Sign P2P Offer (Local 0x83)'
                : 'Sign Direct P2P Offer (Local)';
        }
        if (actionType === 'FILL_P2P') {
            return 'Execute P2P Fill (Local PSBT)';
        }
        if (actionType === 'FIAT_OFFRAMP') {
            const asset = String(details.payAsset || 'KAS').toUpperCase();
            return `Off-Ramp ${asset} → Bank ${(details.payoutMethod || 'ACH').toUpperCase()} (${details.sourceMode === 'onchain_kas' || details.sourceMode === 'onchain_l1' || !details.sourceMode ? '1-Click L1 Sign' : 'Zero-Gas Ledger'})`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'SEND_KAS') {
            return 'Send Kaspa (L1)';
        }
        if (actionType === 'SEND_L1' || actionType === 'L1_TRANSFER') {
            return `Send ${details.payAsset} (Client-Side L1)`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'SEND_KRC20') {
            return `Send ${details.payAsset} (KRC-20 L1)`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'COMPOUND_KAS') {
            return 'Compound KAS UTXOs';
        }
        if (actionType === 'WITHDRAW_SYNTHETIC') {
            return `Dispatch ${details.payAsset} to L1`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'KRC20_DEPLOY_FANOUT') {
            return `Deploy & Fan-Out Cap Table (${details.ticker || details.receiveAsset || 'KRC-20'})`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'KRC20_DEPLOY') {
            return `Deploy KRC-20 Token (${details.ticker || details.receiveAsset || 'KRC-20'})`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'KRC20_MINT') {
            return `Mint KRC-20 Token (${details.ticker || details.receiveAsset || 'KRC-20'})`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'RWA_FORGE') {
            return `Forge RWA KRC-20 (${details.ticker || details.receiveAsset || 'RWA'})`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'VPROG_ANCHOR') {
            return `Anchor vProg & Covenant State (${details.resourceId || 'vprog-v1'})`;
        }
        if (actionType === 'DEX_SWAP' || actionType === 'SWAP') {
            return `Swap ${details.payAsset || 'KAS'} → ${details.receiveAsset || 'USDC'} (Client-Side L1)`;
        }
        return `Sign ${details.payAsset || 'KAS'} Transaction (Local)`;
    }

    async function handleAuthorize() {
        localError = '';
        statusNotice = '';
        if (!password) {
            localError = 'PASSWORD REQUIRED.';
            return;
        }
        if (!identity.pendingTransactionDetails) {
            localError = 'NO PENDING TRANSACTION DETECTED.';
            return;
        }
        identity.isConnecting = true;
        identity.walletMessage = 'Unlocking Local Vault...';
        try {
            const rawPayload = localStorage.getItem(
                'perennia_sovereign_payload'
            );
            if (!rawPayload) throw new Error('No vault found on this device.');
            const vaultPayload = JSON.parse(rawPayload);
            const mnemonic = await decryptVault(password, vaultPayload.vault);
            const keys = await deriveHoneycombKeys(mnemonic);
            let privateKey = keys.kaspa.privateKey.startsWith('0x')
                ? keys.kaspa.privateKey.substring(2)
                : keys.kaspa.privateKey;
            const details = identity.pendingTransactionDetails;
            const actionType = String(
                details.actionType || details.intentType || 'SWAP'
            ).toUpperCase();

            if (actionType === 'SEND_KAS') {
                identity.walletMessage =
                    'Signing & Broadcasting Kaspa L1 Transfer...';
                txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const txId = await executeSovereignTransaction(
                    details.destinationAddress,
                    parseFloat(details.payAmount)
                );
                txState.lastTxId = txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('KAS', txId);
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (
                actionType === 'SEND_L1' ||
                actionType === 'L1_TRANSFER'
            ) {
                const meta = resolveSigningMetadataForAsset(
                    details.payAsset || 'KAS',
                    details.network,
                    details.contractAddress
                );
                identity.walletMessage = `Signing & Broadcasting ${meta.ticker} (${meta.network}) L1 Transfer Locally...`;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const { txId, explorerUrl } = await executeMultiChainL1Transfer(
                    {
                        asset: meta.ticker,
                        network: meta.network,
                        destinationAddress: details.destinationAddress,
                        amount: parseFloat(details.payAmount),
                        contractAddress: meta.contractAddress,
                        decimals: details.decimals ?? meta.decimals,
                        keys
                    }
                );
                txState.lastTxId = txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = explorerUrl;
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'SEND_KRC20') {
                const krcTicker = String(
                    details.payAsset || 'SILO'
                ).toUpperCase();
                identity.walletMessage = `Signing ${krcTicker} KRC-20 Transfer Inscription Locally...`;
                txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const txId = await executeSovereignKrc20Transfer(
                    krcTicker,
                    details.destinationAddress,
                    parseFloat(details.payAmount)
                );
                txState.lastTxId = txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('KAS', txId);
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'COMPOUND_KAS') {
                identity.walletMessage = 'Compounding L1 KAS UTXOs...';
                txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const { txId } = await executeSovereignUtxoCompound();
                txState.lastTxId = txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('KAS', txId);
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'SWAP' || actionType === 'DEX_SWAP') {
                const payAsset = String(details.payAsset || 'KAS')
                    .trim()
                    .toUpperCase();
                const receiveAsset = String(details.receiveAsset || 'USDC')
                    .trim()
                    .toUpperCase();
                const payAmountNum = parseFloat(details.payAmount);

                if (
                    details.psbtData?.psbt &&
                    Array.isArray(details.psbtData.psbt.inputs) &&
                    details.psbtData.psbt.inputs.length > 0
                ) {
                    identity.walletMessage =
                        'Signing Swap PSBT Locally in Browser...';
                    txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                    privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                    const psbtData = details.psbtData;
                    const txId = await executeSovereignPSBT(
                        psbtData.psbt,
                        psbtData.formattedUtxos || []
                    );
                    txState.lastTxId = txId;
                    txState.lastExplorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl(
                        'KAS',
                        txId
                    );
                    password = '';
                    ui.showWalletModal = false;
                    return;
                }

                // Multi-chain L1 swap from self-custody wallet (KAS, KRC-20, BTC, ETH/ERC-20, SOL)
                const meta = resolveSigningMetadataForAsset(
                    payAsset,
                    details.network,
                    details.contractAddress
                );
                let settlementAddress = String(
                    details.destinationAddress || ''
                ).trim();
                if (!settlementAddress) {
                    const previewRes = await fetch(
                        `/api/fiat/offramp?quoteAsset=${encodeURIComponent(meta.ticker)}&amountUsd=100`
                    ).catch(() => null);
                    if (previewRes && previewRes.ok) {
                        const previewData = await previewRes
                            .json()
                            .catch(() => ({}));
                        settlementAddress = String(
                            previewData?.depositPreview?.depositAddress ||
                                previewData?.masterTreasuryKasAddress ||
                                ''
                        ).trim();
                    }
                }
                if (!settlementAddress) {
                    privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                    throw new Error(
                        `Settlement deposit address for ${meta.ticker} is unavailable.`
                    );
                }

                identity.walletMessage = `Signing & Broadcasting ${meta.ticker} L1 Swap Leg Locally...`;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const { txId, explorerUrl } = await executeMultiChainL1Transfer(
                    {
                        asset: meta.ticker,
                        network: meta.network,
                        destinationAddress: settlementAddress,
                        amount: payAmountNum,
                        contractAddress: meta.contractAddress,
                        decimals: details.decimals ?? meta.decimals,
                        keys
                    }
                );

                identity.walletMessage = `Settling ${meta.ticker} → ${receiveAsset} via Smart Order Router...`;
                const swapRes = await fetch('/api/sor/swap', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                        payAsset: meta.ticker,
                        receiveAsset,
                        payAmount: payAmountNum,
                        amount: payAmountNum,
                        executionMode: 'INSTANT_SOR',
                        fundingSource: 'ONCHAIN_L1',
                        onchainTxId: txId
                    })
                });
                const swapData = await swapRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (!swapRes.ok || swapData.error) {
                    throw new Error(
                        swapData.error ||
                            'Smart Order Router rejected on-chain swap.'
                    );
                }

                txState.lastTxId =
                    swapData.txHash || swapData.orderId || txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl =
                    swapData.explorerUrl || explorerUrl;
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'CREATE_P2P') {
                identity.walletMessage =
                    'Signing Atomic P2P Offer Locally in Browser...';
                txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const psbtData = details.psbtData || {};
                const signedPsbtHex = await signClientP2pOffer(
                    Number(details.sellAmount || 0),
                    Number(details.buyAmount || 0),
                    psbtData.formattedUtxos || []
                );
                const newOrder = {
                    id: 'ORD-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase(),
                    sellToken: details.payAsset,
                    sellAmount: details.sellAmount,
                    buyToken: details.receiveAsset,
                    buyAmount: details.buyAmount,
                    rate: (
                        Number(details.buyAmount || 0) /
                        Math.max(1e-8, Number(details.sellAmount || 1))
                    ).toFixed(4),
                    sellerPsbt: signedPsbtHex
                };
                const p2pRes = await fetch('/api/p2p', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(newOrder)
                });
                if (!p2pRes.ok) {
                    const p2pErr = await p2pRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
                    throw new Error(
                        p2pErr.error ||
                            'Failed to post P2P offer to orderbook.'
                    );
                }
                txState.lastTxId = newOrder.id;
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'FILL_P2P') {
                identity.walletMessage =
                    'Signing & Broadcasting Atomic P2P Swap Locally in Browser...';
                txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const psbtData = details.psbtData || {};
                const txId = await executeClientP2pFill(
                    String(details.orderId || ''),
                    psbtData.formattedUtxos || []
                );
                txState.lastTxId = txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('KAS', txId);
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'FIAT_OFFRAMP') {
                const sourceMode = String(
                    details.sourceMode || 'onchain_kas'
                ).toLowerCase();
                const sourceAsset = String(
                    details.payAsset || 'KAS'
                )
                    .trim()
                    .toUpperCase();
                const payAmountNum = parseFloat(details.payAmount);
                const meta = resolveSigningMetadataForAsset(
                    sourceAsset,
                    details.network,
                    details.contractAddress
                );

                identity.walletMessage = 'Verifying Fiat Rail Pre-Flight...';
                const preFlightRes = await fetch('/api/fiat/offramp', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                        amountKas: payAmountNum,
                        kasAmount: payAmountNum,
                        amountAsset: payAmountNum,
                        sourceMode,
                        sourceAsset: meta.ticker,
                        fiatAmount: details.fiatAmount,
                        payoutMethod: details.payoutMethod,
                        bankLabel: details.bankLabel,
                        accountType: details.accountType,
                        routingNumber: details.routingNumber,
                        accountNumber: details.accountNumber,
                        externalCostBasisUsd: details.externalCostBasisUsd,
                        systemMode: ui.systemMode,
                        preFlightOnly: true
                    })
                });
                const preFlightData = await preFlightRes
                    .json()
                    .catch(() => ({}));
                if (!preFlightRes.ok) {
                    privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                    throw new Error(
                        preFlightData.error ||
                            'Fiat Off-Ramp pre-flight check rejected.'
                    );
                }

                const isLedgerSale =
                    sourceMode === 'ledger_kas' ||
                    sourceMode === 'ledger_usdc' ||
                    sourceMode === 'platform_balance';

                if (isLedgerSale) {
                    privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                    identity.walletMessage = `Debiting ${meta.ticker} Platform Balance & Queuing Bank Payout...`;
                    const offrampRes = await fetch('/api/fiat/offramp', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                            amountKas: payAmountNum,
                            kasAmount: payAmountNum,
                            amountAsset: payAmountNum,
                            sourceMode,
                            sourceAsset: meta.ticker,
                            fiatAmount: details.fiatAmount,
                            payoutMethod: details.payoutMethod,
                            bankLabel: details.bankLabel,
                            accountType: details.accountType,
                            routingNumber: details.routingNumber,
                            accountNumber: details.accountNumber,
                            externalCostBasisUsd: details.externalCostBasisUsd,
                            systemMode: ui.systemMode
                        })
                    });
                    const offrampData = await offrampRes
                        .json()
                        .catch(() => ({}));
                    if (!offrampRes.ok) {
                        throw new Error(
                            offrampData.error ||
                                'Ledger Fiat Off-Ramp execution failed.'
                        );
                    }
                    txState.lastTxId =
                        offrampData.wireReferenceId ||
                        offrampData.txId ||
                        'LEDGER_FIAT_QUEUED';
                    password = '';
                    ui.showWalletModal = false;
                    return;
                }

                const targetDepositAddress = String(
                    details.destinationAddress ||
                        preFlightData.depositAddress ||
                        ''
                ).trim();
                if (!targetDepositAddress) {
                    privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                    throw new Error(
                        `Settlement deposit address for ${meta.ticker} is unavailable.`
                    );
                }

                let txId = '';
                let explorerUrl = '';
                if (meta.isNativeKas) {
                    identity.walletMessage =
                        'Signing Kaspa L1 Off-Ramp Settlement Transfer...';
                    txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                    privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                    txId = await executeSovereignTransaction(
                        targetDepositAddress,
                        payAmountNum
                    );
                    explorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('KAS', txId);
                } else {
                    identity.walletMessage = `Signing & Broadcasting ${meta.ticker} (${meta.network}) L1 Settlement Transfer...`;
                    privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                    const l1Res = await executeMultiChainL1Transfer({
                        asset: meta.ticker,
                        network: meta.network,
                        destinationAddress: targetDepositAddress,
                        amount: payAmountNum,
                        contractAddress: meta.contractAddress,
                        decimals: details.decimals ?? meta.decimals,
                        keys
                    });
                    txId = l1Res.txId;
                    explorerUrl = l1Res.explorerUrl;
                }

                identity.walletMessage =
                    'Finalizing Bridge Liquidation & Bank Payout...';
                const offrampRes = await fetch('/api/fiat/offramp', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                        txId,
                        payoutId: details.payoutId,
                        amountKas: payAmountNum,
                        kasAmount: payAmountNum,
                        amountAsset: payAmountNum,
                        sourceMode: meta.isNativeKas
                            ? 'onchain_kas'
                            : 'direct_wholesale_deposit',
                        sourceAsset: meta.ticker,
                        fiatAmount: details.fiatAmount,
                        payoutMethod: details.payoutMethod,
                        bankLabel: details.bankLabel,
                        accountType: details.accountType,
                        routingNumber: details.routingNumber,
                        accountNumber: details.accountNumber,
                        externalCostBasisUsd: details.externalCostBasisUsd,
                        systemMode: ui.systemMode
                    })
                });
                const offrampData = await offrampRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (!offrampRes.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        offrampData.error || 'Bank transfer execution failed.'
                    );
                }
                txState.lastTxId =
                    txId || offrampData.wireReferenceId || offrampData.payoutId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = explorerUrl;
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'WITHDRAW_SYNTHETIC') {
                const targetAsset = String(
                    details.payAsset || 'KAS'
                ).toUpperCase();
                identity.walletMessage = `Dispatching ${targetAsset} Settlement to L1...`;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const reqBody = {
                    action: 'WITHDRAW_SYNTHETIC_ASSET',
                    wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                    payload: {
                        asset: targetAsset,
                        amount: parseFloat(details.payAmount),
                        destination: details.destinationAddress
                    }
                };
                const broadcastRes = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(reqBody)
                });
                const data = await broadcastRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (!broadcastRes.ok || !data.success) {
                    throw new Error(
                        data.error ||
                            `Failed to dispatch ${targetAsset} L1 withdrawal.`
                    );
                }
                const txId =
                    data.transaction_id ||
                    data.data?.txHash ||
                    `L1-${targetAsset}-${Date.now()}`;
                txState.lastTxId = txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl =
                    data.data?.explorerUrl ||
                    getChainExplorerTxUrl(targetAsset, txId);
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else if (actionType === 'KRC20_DEPLOY_FANOUT') {
                identity.walletMessage =
                    'Signing KRC-20 Deploy & Chained Cap-Table Fan-Out Locally in Browser...';
                txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const psbtData = details.psbtData || {};
                const { deployTxId } =
                    await executeSovereignKrc20DeployWithCapTableFanout({
                        deployPsbt: psbtData.psbt,
                        utxos: psbtData.formattedUtxos || [],
                        ticker: String(details.ticker || 'SILO'),
                        decimals: Number(details.decimals ?? 8),
                        capTable: details.capTable || []
                    });
                txState.lastTxId = deployTxId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl(
                    'KAS',
                    deployTxId
                );
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            } else {
                identity.walletMessage =
                    actionType === 'VPROG_ANCHOR'
                        ? 'Signing vProg & Covenant State Anchor Locally in Browser...'
                        : 'Signing Sovereign Inscription Envelope Locally in Browser...';
                txState.decryptedPrivateKeyHex = privateKey;
                privateKey = '0'.repeat(64);
                const psbtData = details.psbtData || {};
                const txId = await executeSovereignKrc20Envelope(
                    psbtData.psbt,
                    psbtData.formattedUtxos || [],
                    details.recipientAddress
                );
                txState.lastTxId = txId;
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = getChainExplorerTxUrl('KAS', txId);
                password = '';
                ui.showWalletModal = false;
                return;
            }
        } catch (e: any) {
            localError = e.message || 'AUTHORIZATION FAILED.';
            password = '';
        } finally {
            identity.isConnecting = false;
            if (!localError) {
                identity.isVaultUnlockPending = false;
                identity.pendingTransactionDetails = null;
            }
        }
    }

    async function copyToClipboard() {
        if (browser && seedWords.length > 0) {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(seedWords.join(' '));
            statusNotice = '24-WORD SEED COPIED TO CLIPBOARD.';
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (statusNotice === '24-WORD SEED COPIED TO CLIPBOARD.')
                    statusNotice = '';
            }, 3000);
        }
    }

    async function copyAddresses() {
        if (browser && derivedKaspa && derivedBtc) {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(
                `Kaspa: ${derivedKaspa}\nBTC: ${derivedBtc}`
            );
            statusNotice = 'PUBLIC ADDRESSES COPIED TO CLIPBOARD.';
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (statusNotice === 'PUBLIC ADDRESSES COPIED TO CLIPBOARD.')
                    statusNotice = '';
            }, 3000);
        }
    }
</script>

    function triggerTileSweep() {

    function handleUniversalTokenSearch(rawQuery: string) {
        tokenSearchQuery = rawQuery;
        discoveryStatusBanner = null;
        clearTimeout(discoverDebounceTimer);
        const trimmed = rawQuery.trim();
        if (trimmed.length < 2) return;

        discoverDebounceTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
            isDiscoveringCustomToken = true;
            try {
                if (typeof (treasury as any).discoverAndRegisterToken === 'function') {
                    const res = await (treasury as any).discoverAndRegisterToken(
                        trimmed,
                        true
                    );
                    if (res?.primary) {
                        discoveryStatusBanner = `✓ Discovered ${res.primary.ticker} (${res.primary.network}) @ ${formatSpotPriceDisplay(res.primary.spotPrice)}`;
                        return;
                    }
                }
                const resp = await fetch(
                    `/api/prices?discover=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}&register=1`
                );
                if (resp.ok) {
                    const data = await resp.json();
                    if (data.success && data.asset) {
                        const a = data.asset;
                        treasury.updateAsset(a.ticker, {
                            name: a.name || a.ticker,
                            assetClass: a.assetClass || 'DeFi',
                            network: a.network || 'ETH',
                            spotPrice: Number(a.spotPrice || 0),
                            delta: Number(a.change24h || 0),
                            contract: a.contract || a.ticker,
                            imgUrl: a.imgUrl || '',
                            theme: a.theme || { hex: '#18C6A5', pastel: '#99f6e4' }
                        });
                        discoveryStatusBanner = `✓ Discovered ${a.ticker} (${a.network}) @ ${formatSpotPriceDisplay(Number(a.spotPrice || 0))}`;
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore transient discovery error
            } finally {
                isDiscoveringCustomToken = false;
            }
        }, 260);
    }

    function resolveLiveSpotUsd(ticker: string): number {
        const clean = String(ticker || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (clean === 'USD' || clean === 'USDC' || clean === 'USDT') return 1.0;
        const assetObj = treasury.getAsset(clean);
        if (Number.isFinite(assetObj.spotPrice) && assetObj.spotPrice > 0) {
            return assetObj.spotPrice;
        }
        const kasSpot = treasury.getAsset('KAS').spotPrice || 0;
        if (clean === DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER && kasSpot > 0) {
            return Number((kasSpot / 23.809524).toFixed(6));
        }
        return 0;
    }

    let paySpotUsd = $derived(resolveLiveSpotUsd(payTicker));
    let receiveSpotUsd = $derived(resolveLiveSpotUsd(receiveTicker));

    let activeFeeRateDecimal = $derived(
        siloStakingTelemetry.feeRateCap > 0
            ? siloStakingTelemetry.feeRateCap
            : 0.015
    );

    let swapQuote = $derived.by(() => {
        const parsedIn = Math.max(0, parseFloat(payAmount) || 0);
        const rateRatio =
            paySpotUsd > 0 && receiveSpotUsd > 0
                ? paySpotUsd / receiveSpotUsd
                : 0;
        if (parsedIn <= 0 || paySpotUsd <= 0 || receiveSpotUsd <= 0) {
            return {
                grossUsd: 0,
                feeUsd: 0,
                netUsd: 0,
                estimatedOut: 0,
                exchangeRate: rateRatio
            };
        }
        if (payTicker === 'USD') {
            const onrampQuote = computeOnrampCostPlusQuote({
                assetTicker: receiveTicker,
                grossUsd: parsedIn,
                spotPriceUsd: receiveSpotUsd,
                autoStakeSilo: false,
                bundledKasOrSilo:
                    receiveTicker === 'KAS' ||
                    receiveTicker === DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER
            });
            return {
                grossUsd: onrampQuote.grossUsd,
                feeUsd: onrampQuote.feeUsd,
                netUsd: onrampQuote.guestNetUsd,
                estimatedOut: onrampQuote.estimatedTokens,
                exchangeRate: rateRatio
            };
        }
        const grossUsd = parsedIn * paySpotUsd;
        const feeUsd = grossUsd * activeFeeRateDecimal;
        const netUsd = Math.max(0, grossUsd - feeUsd);
        const estimatedOut = receiveSpotUsd > 0 ? netUsd / receiveSpotUsd : 0;
        return {
            grossUsd,
            feeUsd,
            netUsd,
            estimatedOut,
            exchangeRate: rateRatio
        };
    });

    function formatSpotPriceDisplay(price: number): string {
        if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return '$0.00';
        if (price < 0.01) return `$${price.toFixed(6)}`;
        if (price < 1) return `$${price.toFixed(4)}`;
        return `$${price.toLocaleString(undefined, {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2
        })}`;
    }

    function formatOracleRate(rate: number): string {
        if (!Number.isFinite(rate) || rate <= 0) return '0.000000';
        if (rate < 0.0001) return rate.toFixed(8);
        if (rate < 1) return rate.toFixed(6);
        return rate.toLocaleString(undefined, {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 6
        });
    }

    function setPayPercentage(pct: number) {
        const avail = Number(payToken.availableBalance || 0);
        if (avail <= 0) {
            payAmount = '0';
            return;
        }
        const feeBuffer =
            pct === 1.0 && payTicker === 'KAS' && payToken.onChain > 0
                ? 0.005
                : 0;
        const target = Math.max(0, avail * pct - feeBuffer);
        payAmount = target > 0 ? Number(target.toFixed(6)).toString() : '0';
    }

    function flipSwapTokens() {
        const prevPay = payTicker;
        payTicker = receiveTicker;
        receiveTicker = prevPay;
        swapError = null;
        swapSuccessBanner = null;
    }

    function cycleSlippage() {
        if (slippagePct === 0.5) slippagePct = 1.0;
        else if (slippagePct === 1.0) slippagePct = 0.1;
        else slippagePct = 0.5;
    }

    function openTokenModal(mode: TokenModalMode, extraIdx = 0) {

    function handleSelectTokenFromModal(asset: UnifiedAsset) {
        const tick = asset.ticker.toUpperCase();
        if (tokenModalTarget === 'pay') {
            if (tick === receiveTicker) {
                receiveTicker = payTicker;
            }
            payTicker = tick;
        } else if (tokenModalTarget === 'receive') {
            if (tick === payTicker) {
                payTicker = receiveTicker;
            }
            receiveTicker = tick;
        } else if (tokenModalTarget === 'lpB') {
            lpTokenBTicker = tick === 'KAS' ? 'USDC' : tick;
            recalculateLpAmountsFromA();
        } else if (tokenModalTarget === 'lpExtra') {
            extraPlantLegs = extraPlantLegs.map((leg, i) =>
                i === tokenModalExtraIndex
                    ? { ...leg, ticker: tick === 'KAS' ? 'SILO' : tick }
                    : leg
            );
            recalculateLpAmountsFromA();
        } else if (tokenModalTarget === 'p2pSell') {
            p2pSellTicker = tick;
        } else if (tokenModalTarget === 'p2pBuy') {
            p2pBuyTicker = tick;
        }
        isTokenModalOpen = false;
        tokenSearchQuery = '';
        discoveryStatusBanner = null;
    }

    let filteredModalAssets = $derived(
        treasury.registry.filter((a) => {
            if (tokenModalTarget !== 'pay' && a.ticker === 'USD') return false;
            const q = tokenSearchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

                    a.assetClass === 'Stablecoin' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'Ecosystem' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'DeFi' ||
                    a.assetClass === 'Tokenized Asset'
                );
            }
            return true;
        })
    );

    $effect(() => {

    export async function syncUserBalances() {
        if (!browser) return;
        try {
            const requests: Promise<Response | null>[] = [
                fetch('/api/p2p').catch(() => null)
            ];
            if (identity.isWalletConnected && identity.activeAddress) {
                requests.push(
                    fetch(
                        `/api/user/ledger?wallet=${encodeURIComponent(identity.activeAddress)}`
                    ).catch(() => null),
                    fetch(
                        `/api/balance?address=${encodeURIComponent(identity.activeAddress)}`
                    ).catch(() => null),
                    fetch('/api/state/action', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            action: 'GET_LP_POSITIONS',
                            payload: {}
                        })
                    }).catch(() => null),
                    fetch('/api/state/action', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            action: 'GET_SILO_STAKING',
                            payload: {}
                        })
                    }).catch(() => null)
                );
            }
            const [p2pRes, ledgerRes, balRes, lpRes, siloRes] =
                await Promise.all(requests);

            if (p2pRes && p2pRes.ok) {
                const p2pData = await p2pRes.json();
                const rawOrders = Array.isArray(p2pData.orders)
                    ? p2pData.orders
                    : Array.isArray(p2pData)
                      ? p2pData
                      : [];
                p2pOrders = rawOrders.map((o: any) => {
                    const sAmt = Number(o.offer_amount ?? o.sellAmount ?? 0);
                    const bAmt = Number(o.ask_amount ?? o.buyAmount ?? 0);
                    return {
                        id: String(o.order_id || o.id || ''),
                        seller: String(o.maker_wallet || o.seller || ''),
                        sellToken: String(
                            o.offer_asset || o.sellToken || 'KAS'
                        ).toUpperCase(),
                        sellAmount: sAmt,
                        buyToken: String(
                            o.ask_asset || o.buyToken || 'USDC'
                        ).toUpperCase(),
                        buyAmount: bAmt,
                        rate:
                            sAmt > 0
                                ? (bAmt / sAmt).toFixed(4)
                                : String(o.rate || '0.0000'),
                        status: String(o.status || 'OPEN').toUpperCase()
                    };
                });
            }

            if (ledgerRes && ledgerRes.ok) {
                const ledgerData = await ledgerRes.json();
                for (const [ticker, val] of Object.entries(ledgerData)) {
                    if (
                        ticker !== 'unassignedReserveKas' &&
                        ticker !== 'unassignedReserveTargetKas'
                    ) {
                        treasury.updateAsset(ticker.toUpperCase(), {
                            synthetic: Number(val) || 0
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            if (balRes && balRes.ok) {
                const balData = await balRes.json();
                if (typeof balData.balance === 'number') {
                    treasury.updateAsset('KAS', { onChain: balData.balance });
                }
            }
            if (lpRes && lpRes.ok) {
                const lpData = await lpRes.json();
                if (Array.isArray(lpData.data)) {
                    lpPositions = lpData.data;
                }
            }
            if (siloRes && siloRes.ok) {
                const siloData = await siloRes.json();
                if (siloData.data) {
                    siloStakingTelemetry = {
                        ...siloStakingTelemetry,
                        ...siloData.data
                    };
                }
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore transient sync error
        }
    }

    async function executeSwap() {
        swapError = null;
        swapSuccessBanner = null;
        lastSwapTxHash = null;
        lastSwapExplorerUrl = null;
        reservedUsdOnrampPass = null;

        if (!identity.isWalletConnected || !identity.activeAddress) {
            ui.showWalletModal = true;
            return;
        }

        const parsedAmount = parseFloat(payAmount);
        if (!Number.isFinite(parsedAmount) || parsedAmount <= 0) {
            swapError = 'Enter a valid swap amount greater than 0.';
            return;
        }
        if (payTicker === receiveTicker) {
            swapError = 'Pay asset and Receive asset must differ.';
            return;
        }
        if (paySpotUsd <= 0 || receiveSpotUsd <= 0) {
            swapError = `Live oracle price feed for ${paySpotUsd <= 0 ? payTicker : receiveTicker} is offline; failing closed.`;
            return;
        }

        if (payTicker === 'USD') {
            ui.openFiatModal(
                receiveTicker,
                receiveTicker === DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER,
                payAmount
            );
            return;
        }
        if (receiveTicker === 'USD') {
            activeDexTab = 'fiat';
            return;
        }

        const ledgerAvail = Number(payToken.synthetic || 0);
        const onChainAvail = Number(payToken.onChain || 0);
        const totalAvail = ledgerAvail + onChainAvail;

        if (
            !ui.isTutorialSandbox &&
            parsedAmount > totalAvail + 1e-8
        ) {
            swapError = `Insufficient ${payTicker} balance: requested ${parsedAmount.toFixed(4)} ${payTicker}, available ${totalAvail.toFixed(4)} ${payTicker}.`;
            return;
        }

        const useOnChain =
            !ui.isTutorialSandbox &&
            ledgerAvail < parsedAmount &&
            onChainAvail >= parsedAmount;

        if (useOnChain && payTicker !== 'KAS') {
            txState.lastTxId = '';
            txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
            pendingOnchainSwapSummary = {
                payAsset: payTicker,
                payAmount: parsedAmount,
                receiveAsset: receiveTicker,
                estimatedOut: swapQuote.estimatedOut
            };
            awaitingOnchainSwapSignature = true;
            requestUniversalL1Signature({
                intentType: 'DEX_SWAP',
                payAsset: payTicker,
                network: payToken.network,
                contractAddress: payToken.contract,
                payAmount: parsedAmount,
                receiveAsset: receiveTicker,
                estimatedReceiveAmount: swapQuote.estimatedOut,
                destinationAddress:
                    identity.masterTreasuryAddress || identity.activeAddress
            });
            return;
        }

        isExecuting = true;
        try {
            let clientUtxos: any[] | undefined = undefined;
            if (useOnChain && payTicker === 'KAS') {
                const utxoRes = await fetch(
                    `/api/utxos?address=${encodeURIComponent(identity.activeAddress)}`
                );
                if (utxoRes.ok) {
                    const utxoData = await utxoRes.json();
                    clientUtxos = Array.isArray(utxoData)
                        ? utxoData
                        : utxoData.entries || [];
                }
            }

            const res = await fetch('/api/sor/swap', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    wallet: identity.activeAddress,
                    payAsset: payTicker,
                    receiveAsset: receiveTicker,
                    payAmount: parsedAmount,
                    amount: parsedAmount,
                    executionMode: 'INSTANT_SOR',
                    fundingSource: useOnChain ? 'ONCHAIN_L1' : 'LEDGER',
                    utxos: clientUtxos
                })
            });

            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.error) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Swap execution rejected by router.'
                );
            }

            if (
                data.psbt &&
                Array.isArray(data.psbt.inputs) &&
                data.psbt.inputs.length > 0
            ) {
                txState.lastTxId = '';
                txState.lastExplorerUrl = '';
                pendingOnchainSwapSummary = {
                    payAsset: payTicker,
                    payAmount: parsedAmount,
                    receiveAsset: receiveTicker,
                    estimatedOut: Number(
                        data.receivedAmount ??
                            data.estimatedOutput ??
                            data.estimated_output ??
                            swapQuote.estimatedOut
                    )
                };
                awaitingOnchainSwapSignature = true;
                identity.requestVaultAuthorization({
                    actionType: 'SWAP',
                    payAsset: payTicker,
                    receiveAsset: receiveTicker,
                    payAmount: parsedAmount.toString(),
                    psbtData: {
                        psbt: data.psbt,
                        formattedUtxos: data.formattedUtxos || clientUtxos || []
                    }
                });
                return;
            }

            const outQty = Number(
                data.receivedAmount ??
                    data.estimatedOutput ??
                    data.estimated_output ??
                    swapQuote.estimatedOut
            );
            const txRef = String(
                data.txHash ||
                    data.orderId ||
                    data.transaction_uuid ||
                    ''
            );
            lastSwapTxHash = txRef || null;
            lastSwapExplorerUrl = txRef
                ? getChainExplorerTxUrl(receiveTicker, txRef)
                : null;
            swapSuccessBanner = `Execution Confirmed: ${parsedAmount.toLocaleString()} ${payTicker} → ${outQty.toFixed(6)} ${receiveTicker} ✓`;
            payAmount = '';
            triggerTileSweep();
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'dex_swap_btn',
                `${payTicker} → ${receiveTicker} CONFIRMED ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
            await syncUserBalances();
        } catch (err: any) {
            swapError = err.message || 'Swap execution failed.';
        } finally {
            if (!awaitingOnchainSwapSignature) {
                isExecuting = false;
            }
        }
    }

    // --- Liquidity Plant & SILO Staking Handlers ---
    function recalculateLpAmountsFromA() {
        const kasQty = parseFloat(lpAmountA) || 0;
        const kasSpot = resolveLiveSpotUsd('KAS');
        if (kasQty <= 0 || kasSpot <= 0) {
            lpAmountB = '';
            return;
        }
        const anchorUsd = kasQty * kasSpot;
        const bSpot = resolveLiveSpotUsd(lpTokenBTicker);
        if (bSpot > 0) {
            const bShareUsd = anchorUsd * (lpWeightPctB / 50.0);
            lpAmountB = Number((bShareUsd / bSpot).toFixed(6)).toString();
        }
        extraPlantLegs = extraPlantLegs.map((leg) => {
            const legSpot = resolveLiveSpotUsd(leg.ticker);
            if (legSpot <= 0) return { ...leg, amount: '0' };
            const legUsd = anchorUsd * (leg.weightPct / 50.0);
            return {
                ...leg,
                amount: Number((legUsd / legSpot).toFixed(6)).toString()
            };
        });
    }

    function recalculateLpAmountsFromB() {
        const bQty = parseFloat(lpAmountB) || 0;
        const bSpot = resolveLiveSpotUsd(lpTokenBTicker);
        const kasSpot = resolveLiveSpotUsd('KAS');
        if (bQty <= 0 || bSpot <= 0 || kasSpot <= 0 || lpWeightPctB <= 0) {
            lpAmountA = '';
            return;
        }
        const bUsd = bQty * bSpot;
        const anchorUsd = bUsd * (50.0 / lpWeightPctB);
        lpAmountA = Number((anchorUsd / kasSpot).toFixed(4)).toString();
        extraPlantLegs = extraPlantLegs.map((leg) => {
            const legSpot = resolveLiveSpotUsd(leg.ticker);
            if (legSpot <= 0) return { ...leg, amount: '0' };
            const legUsd = anchorUsd * (leg.weightPct / 50.0);
            return {
                ...leg,
                amount: Number((legUsd / legSpot).toFixed(6)).toString()
            };
        });
    }

    function setLpPercentageA(pct: number) {
        const avail = Number(lpTokenA.availableBalance || 0);
        lpAmountA =
            avail > 0 ? Number((avail * pct).toFixed(4)).toString() : '0';
        recalculateLpAmountsFromA();
    }

    function setLpPercentageB(pct: number) {
        const avail = Number(lpTokenB.availableBalance || 0);
        lpAmountB =
            avail > 0 ? Number((avail * pct).toFixed(6)).toString() : '0';
        recalculateLpAmountsFromB();
    }

    function handleLpInputA(e: Event) {
        lpAmountA = (e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement).value;
        recalculateLpAmountsFromA();
    }

    function handleLpInputB(e: Event) {
        lpAmountB = (e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement).value;
        recalculateLpAmountsFromB();
    }

    function addSecondaryPlantLeg(defaultTicker = 'XAU') {
        if (extraPlantLegs.length >= 3) return;
        const nextCount = 1 + extraPlantLegs.length + 1;
        const equalWeight = Number((50.0 / nextCount).toFixed(2));
        lpWeightPctB = equalWeight;
        extraPlantLegs = [
            ...extraPlantLegs.map((l) => ({ ...l, weightPct: equalWeight })),
            { ticker: defaultTicker, weightPct: equalWeight, amount: '' }
        ];
        recalculateLpAmountsFromA();
    }

    function removeSecondaryPlantLeg(idx: number) {
        const filtered = extraPlantLegs.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
        const totalSec = 1 + filtered.length;
        const equalWeight = Number((50.0 / totalSec).toFixed(2));
        lpWeightPctB = equalWeight;
        extraPlantLegs = filtered.map((l) => ({
            ...l,
            weightPct: equalWeight
        }));
        recalculateLpAmountsFromA();
    }

    function adjustDexPlantSecondaryWeights(
        changedKey: 'B' | number,
        rawNewPct: number
    ) {
        const clamped = Math.max(1, Math.min(48, rawNewPct));
        const rem = Math.max(1, 50.0 - clamped);
        if (changedKey === 'B') {
            lpWeightPctB = clamped;
            const n = extraPlantLegs.length;
            if (n > 0) {
                const share = Number((rem / n).toFixed(2));
                extraPlantLegs = extraPlantLegs.map((l) => ({
                    ...l,
                    weightPct: share
                }));
            }
        } else {
            const otherExtraCount = Math.max(0, extraPlantLegs.length - 1);
            const totalOtherLegs = 1 + otherExtraCount;
            const share = Number((rem / totalOtherLegs).toFixed(2));
            lpWeightPctB = share;
            extraPlantLegs = extraPlantLegs.map((l, idx) =>
                idx === changedKey
                    ? { ...l, weightPct: clamped }
                    : { ...l, weightPct: share }
            );
        }
        recalculateLpAmountsFromA();
    }

    async function executeSupplyLiquidity() {
        swapError = null;
        const amtA = parseFloat(lpAmountA) || 0;
        const amtB = parseFloat(lpAmountB) || 0;
        if (amtA <= 0 || amtB <= 0) {
            swapError = 'Enter valid liquidity amounts greater than 0.';
            return;
        }
        isProvidingLiquidity = true;
        try {
            const lockOpt =
                LOCK_OPTIONS[lockDurationIndex] || LOCK_OPTIONS[0];
            const pairSummary = [
                'KAS',
                lpTokenBTicker,
                ...extraPlantLegs.map((l) => l.ticker)
            ].join('/');
            const weights: Record<string, number> = {
                KAS: 0.5,
                [lpTokenBTicker]: Number((lpWeightPctB / 100).toFixed(4))
            };
            const reserves: Record<string, number> = {
                KAS: amtA,
                [lpTokenBTicker]: amtB
            };
            const secondaryAssets: Array<{
                ticker: string;
                weightPct: number;
                amount: number;
            }> = [
                {
                    ticker: lpTokenBTicker,
                    weightPct: lpWeightPctB,
                    amount: amtB
                }
            ];
            for (const leg of extraPlantLegs) {
                weights[leg.ticker] = Number((leg.weightPct / 100).toFixed(4));
                reserves[leg.ticker] = parseFloat(leg.amount) || 0;
                secondaryAssets.push({
                    ticker: leg.ticker,
                    weightPct: leg.weightPct,
                    amount: parseFloat(leg.amount) || 0
                });
            }
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'STAKE_LP',
                    payload: {
                        poolPair: pairSummary,
                        amountA: amtA,
                        amountB: amtB,
                        lockDurationDays: lockOpt.days,
                        weights,
                        reserves,
                        secondaryAssets
                    }
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.error || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to provision liquidity plant.'
                );
            }
            lpAmountA = '';
            lpAmountB = '';
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'dex_lp_stake_btn',
                `${pairSummary} STAKED ✓`,
                '#18C6A5'
            );
            await syncUserBalances();
        } catch (err: any) {
            swapError = err.message || 'Liquidity provisioning failed.';
        } finally {
            isProvidingLiquidity = false;
        }
    }

    async function withdrawLpPosition(lpId: string) {
        swapError = null;
        isWithdrawingLp = lpId;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/state/action', {
                method: 'POST',

                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'WITHDRAW_LP',
                    payload: { lpId }
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.error || data.success === false) {
                throw new Error(
                    data.error || 'Failed to withdraw LP position.'
                );
            }
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(`lp_pos_${lpId}`, 'WITHDRAWN ✓', '#18C6A5');
            await syncUserBalances();
        } catch (err: any) {
            swapError = err.message || 'LP withdrawal failed.';
        } finally {
            isWithdrawingLp = null;
        }
    }

    // --- P2P Orderbook Handlers ---
    async function createP2pOffer() {
        swapError = null;
        const sellAmt = parseFloat(p2pSellAmount) || 0;
        const buyAmt = parseFloat(p2pBuyAmount) || 0;
        if (sellAmt <= 0 || buyAmt <= 0) {
            swapError = 'Enter valid P2P offer and ask amounts.';
            return;
        }
        isExecuting = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/p2p', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'CREATE_ORDER',
                    makerWallet: identity.activeAddress,
                    offerAsset: p2pSellTicker,
                    offerAmount: sellAmt,
                    askAsset: p2pBuyTicker,
                    askAmount: buyAmt
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.error) {
                throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to deploy P2P offer.');
            }
            p2pSellAmount = '';
            p2pBuyAmount = '';
            swapSuccessBanner = `Atomic P2P Offer Deployed (${data.orderId}) ✓`;
            await syncUserBalances();
        } catch (err: any) {
            swapError = err.message || 'Failed to create P2P offer.';
        } finally {
            isExecuting = false;
        }
    }

    async function fillP2pOrder(order: any) {
        swapError = null;
        isExecuting = true;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/p2p', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'FILL_ORDER',
                    orderId: order.id
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.error) {
                throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to fill P2P contract.');
            }
            swapSuccessBanner = `Filled Atomic P2P Contract ${order.id} ✓`;
            await syncUserBalances();
        } catch (err: any) {
            swapError = err.message || 'Failed to execute P2P swap.';
        } finally {
            isExecuting = false;
        }
    }

    async function cancelP2pOrder(orderId: string) {
        swapError = null;
        isCancellingP2pId = orderId;
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/p2p', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'CANCEL_ORDER',
                    orderId
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!res.ok || data.error) {
                throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to cancel P2P offer.');
            }
            await syncUserBalances();
        } catch (err: any) {
            swapError = err.message || 'Failed to cancel P2P offer.';
        } finally {
            isCancellingP2pId = null;
        }
    }

    function handleTokenIconError(e: Event) {
        const target = e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement;
        target.style.display = 'none';
        if (target.nextElementSibling) {
            (target.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement).style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }

    function handleRealtimeDexSync() {
        syncUserBalances();
    }

    onMount(() => {
        syncUserBalances();
        treasury.syncRwaOraclePrices();
        if (browser) {
            window.addEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleRealtimeDexSync
            );
            window.addEventListener(
                'perennia:yield_update',
                handleRealtimeDexSync
            );
        }
    });

    onDestroy(() => {
        clearTimeout(discoverDebounceTimer);
        if (browser) {
            window.removeEventListener(
                'perennia:fiat_event',
                handleRealtimeDexSync
            );
            window.removeEventListener(
                'perennia:yield_update',
                handleRealtimeDexSync
            );
        }
    });
</script>

    // Auto-default orders >= $625 to ACH ($5 cap) and hard-gate $100,000+ to Institutional Wire
    $effect(() => {
        const parsedUsd = Math.max(0, parseFloat(globalFiatUsdInput) || 0);
        if (parsedUsd >= 100_000) {
            if (lastGlobalAchBucket !== 'wire100k') {
                lastGlobalAchBucket = 'wire100k';
            }
            if (globalFiatGatewayMethod !== 'wire') {
                globalFiatGatewayMethod = 'wire';
            }
            if (globalFiatPaymentRail !== 'BRIDGE_VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_WIRE') {
                globalFiatPaymentRail = 'BRIDGE_VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT_WIRE';
            }
        } else if (parsedUsd >= 625) {
            if (lastGlobalAchBucket !== 'above625') {
                lastGlobalAchBucket = 'above625';
                globalFiatGatewayMethod = 'ach';
                globalFiatPaymentRail = 'SOVEREIGN_WIRE_ACH';
            }
        } else {
            if (lastGlobalAchBucket !== 'below625') {
                lastGlobalAchBucket = 'below625';
                if (globalFiatGatewayMethod === 'wire') {
                    globalFiatGatewayMethod = 'ach';
                    globalFiatPaymentRail = 'SOVEREIGN_WIRE_ACH';
                }
            }
        }
    });

        if (

            inlineAbaTelemetry.checksumValid &&
            inlineAbaTelemetry.institutionName &&
            (inlineBankLabel === 'Primary Operating Account' ||
                !inlineBankLabel.trim())

                    globalFiatDeliveryMode = 'L1_KAS';

        const t = selectedGlobalTargetAsset;
        if (
            t.ticker === 'USD' ||
            t.ticker === 'USDC' ||
            t.ticker === 'USDT'
        ) {
            return 1.0;
        }
        if (t.spotPrice > 0) return t.spotPrice;
        const kasSpot = treasury.getAsset('KAS').spotPrice || 0;
        if (t.ticker === DEFAULT_ECOSYSTEM_TICKER && kasSpot > 0) {
            return Number((kasSpot / 23.809524).toFixed(6));
        }
        return 0;

            bundledKasOrSilo:

            paymentMethod: globalFiatGatewayMethod
        })

                .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')
                .slice(-6)

    let selectableGlobalAssets = $derived(
        treasury.registry.filter((a) => {
            if (a.ticker === 'USD') return false;
            const q = globalAssetSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!q) return true;
            return (
                a.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                a.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                a.assetClass.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                (a.contract && a.contract.toLowerCase().includes(q))
            );
        })
    );

    function formatGlobalSpotDisplay(price: number): string {
        if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) {
            return i18n.formatFiat(0, { decimals: 2 });
        }
        return i18n.formatFiat(price, { adaptiveSmallPrice: true });
    }

    function handleModalIconError(e: Event) {
        const target = e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement;
        target.style.display = 'none';
        if (target.nextElementSibling) {
            (target.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement).style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }

    function handleGlobalAssetSearchInput(raw: string) {
        globalAssetSearch = raw;
        globalDiscoveryNotice = null;
        clearTimeout(globalDiscoverTimer);
        const trimmed = raw.trim();
        if (trimmed.length < 2) return;
        globalDiscoverTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
            isDiscoveringGlobalAsset = true;
            try {
                if (
                    typeof (treasury as any).discoverAndRegisterToken ===
                    'function'
                ) {
                    const res = await (
                        treasury as any
                    ).discoverAndRegisterToken(trimmed, true);
                    if (res?.primary) {
                        globalDiscoveryNotice = `✓ Discovered ${res.primary.ticker} (${res.primary.network}) @ ${formatGlobalSpotDisplay(res.primary.spotPrice)}`;
                        return;
                    }
                }
                const resp = await fetch(
                    `/api/prices?discover=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}&register=1`
                );
                if (resp.ok) {
                    const data = await resp.json();
                    if (data.success && data.asset) {
                        const a = data.asset;
                        treasury.updateAsset(a.ticker, {
                            name: a.name || a.ticker,
                            assetClass: a.assetClass || 'DeFi',
                            network: a.network || 'ETH',
                            spotPrice: Number(a.spotPrice || 0),
                            delta: Number(a.change24h || 0),
                            contract: a.contract || a.ticker,
                            imgUrl: a.imgUrl || '',
                            theme: a.theme || {
                                hex: '#18C6A5',
                                pastel: '#99f6e4'
                            }
                        });
                        globalDiscoveryNotice = `✓ Discovered ${a.ticker} (${a.network}) @ ${formatGlobalSpotDisplay(Number(a.spotPrice || 0))}`;
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore discovery timeout
            } finally {
                isDiscoveringGlobalAsset = false;
            }
        }, 260);
    }

        if (ui.activeTab === 'treasury') {

        }
        if (ui.activeTab === 'FORGE' && !identity.canAccessForge) {
            ui.activeTab = 'OPERATIONS';
        }
    });

        ui.activeTab = 'OPERATIONS';
        ui.showWalletModal = true;
    }

    function resolveAutoStratumUrl(hashrateTh: number): string {
        if (hashrateTh > 10.0) {
            return 'stratum+tcp://pool.perennia.io:3334';
        }
        if (hashrateTh >= 1.0) {
            return 'stratum+tcp://pool.perennia.io:3333';
        }
        return 'stratum+tcp://pool.perennia.io:3332';
    }

    let isServerReachable = $state(true);

            ? ui.adminTargetWallet
            : identity.activeAddress;

    function copyHeaderWalletAddress() {
        if (identity.activeAddress && browser && navigator.clipboard) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(identity.activeAddress);
            headerPillShimmer = true;
            ui.triggerMicroBadge(
                'header_wallet_pill',

            setTimeout(() => {
                headerPillShimmer = false;

        }
